I don’t want any more people to suffer the same fate as me... I know it won’t be easy... But, if I can save even one soul from this pain, then...I’ll have at least served a purpose here.
I will hunt them down... Your enemies, my enemies, and everyone else’s. Even if in the end...I need to turn that bullet on myself. I’ll do whatever it takes.
May it only take one shot...
...Why do you even bother with someone like me?
Hm? I don’t think I’ve seen you in a while... So that’s why everyone here’s been so restless. Now, why don’t you quickly finish whatever you’re doing, and put everyone’s minds at ease?
You don’t have to go out of your way to talk to me. I prefer being alone... Socializing with others really isn’t my thing.

It kinda feels like I can’t go a single day here without a game of 20 questions. “Are you eating properly?” “Wanna go shopping with me?” “Do you like flowers?” Are you the reason people here can’t mind their own business?

I know you’ve been watching me, but do you have to do it in such a weird way? It is pretty funny though. ...Oh, this red soup? I dunno—spicy foods kinda do it for me. Without any kick, it just feels like something’s missing.

You always tell me to take good care of my body, and yet you never get any rest. So, stop right now and take a break. If you don’t, I’ll use this sword...on myself...and make you watch...over and over... Good. That’s what you should’ve been doing from the beginning.

A dinner party? To bring everyone closer as friends? Ughhh, what a drag... The last thing I need are friends. You guys go and enjoy yourselves—I’ll be fine sitting right here. ...Argh, fine. You win. I’ll go. I can’t say no with you looking at me like that...
I hear it’s your birthday today. Happy birthday. ...Why do you look so surprised? Even I’ll at least wish you a happy birthday. It’s not like I hate you or anything.

Hey, you. Say someone dies feeling satisfied after doing every single thing they’ve ever wanted to do. Would you call that “happiness?” ...I thought so. Happiness is something I’ll never be able to find for myself...

Why are you freaking out like that? Oh, this is just a scratch. It’ll heal in no time. “...Not treating it will get it infected?” Ugh, like I said, that kind of thing won’t... Fine. I’ll bandage it up, so stop worrying, okay?

Hey, why are you paying so much attention to me? There are plenty of other people here who need you. Treat me with kindness all you like, but I couldn’t care less about making friends anymore... Go and show that attention to someone else.
I wouldn’t call it a hobby of mine, but I don’t mind listening to music. Just sitting here and listening makes me happy. Or rather, music makes my heart throb, and I’m kinda into that.

See this? It’s a flower that someone gave their entire life away to make bloom. A flower that’ll allow me to die. I didn’t wish for her to make this flower... But, if it’s what saved her heart, then I’ve got no choice but to accept it, right?

With this flower, I can die anytime I want. But strangely enough, when I think that, my thoughts about dying vanish. So, I’m gonna live with you until it’s your time to go. You’re weak, so saving you might just be worth it.
The only thing I can do is not die. Nothing more, nothing less. There’s no point in making me stronger.
You still haven’t given up on me? To think there’d be oddballs like you out there... What’s this world coming to?
I’ll be your shield as often as you need me to. It’s easy—all I do is stand in front of the enemy. No need to worry—it’s painless. All the pain disappeared a long time ago.

I won’t die anyway, so it’s fine if I get hit whenever I attack. That doesn’t stop you from berating me though, telling me to take better care of myself, or whatever. Attacking while protecting myself at the same time’s something I’m just not cut out for.
Normally people want to get stronger in order to protect themselves. But since I can’t die, that’s something I just can’t wrap my brain around. Get stronger...get stronger again...then what?

I kinda feel I understand now. Getting stronger means becoming able to do more. So, for someone like me who can’t die, I’ll be able to find more reasons to live. That’s why...I wanna say thank you...for giving me a reason to live.
We’re done already? Hm, well that was easy.
You guys go get a head start. I’ll catch up after I let them kill me.
I’ll put in a little more effort.
Let’s just get this over with.
Alright, should we get going? This time...we will save the world.

Oh, so you’ve finally come back to see me, huh? I’ve been waiting for you this whole time. But, here you are acting like everything’s okay, even though you left me here all alone without even bothering to get in touch... A-Apologizing at this point won’t let you off the hook, you know. I’m still mad at you...!
We’re all going to die one day, so we need to keep that in mind, and live our lives without any regrets. Hmmm, there was a word for that sort of thing, right? What was it called again?
A witch’s power comes from the heart. The balance in our hearts is essential for keeping our powers balanced. How am I now? Hmmm, I’m feeling a little on the wicked side. Hehe.

Hey, I haven’t been myself lately. The me deep inside isn’t the true me...and because of that, I’ve probably been saying things I wouldn’t normally say. When that happens, I want you to stop me. I’m sure even the other me wants you to.

Mmm...I’m getting kind of tired. Hey, do you wanna pause for a break soon? There’s this nice shop I found... Oh, so that’s how it’s going to be? Fine—then you can kiss your precious world goodbye. Hehehe, that’s more like it. I found this bakery that makes the most delicious bread the other day. Let’s drop by.

Oh, you’re sleeping? I guess you have been busy recently, huh. ...Hey. If you’re tired of it all, let’s just run away. We can forget about everything, and go to some faraway place, where it’ll be just the two of us... I’d be okay with that, you know.
Happy birthday. The idea of us being here celebrating your birthday again is something I used to take for granted... It would be wonderful if we could do this again every year from now on, right?

Hey, can I ask just one small favor from you...? To tell the truth, Iris found out I made you skip work so we could go to that bakery, and now she’s calling for me to see her... So, I want you to come with me. If you’re there, I’m sure even Iris can’t get that angry... Please, just this once!
I’ve put on a few more pounds? How in the...?!

I thought I was ready...to give up my life and save the world. But, somewhere deep in my heart, I was hoping for a miracle that would let me save the world without dying... That’s why, when it was finally time to do it, at the very last second, I...

You know, you sure are getting along with a lot of the other girls lately. Well, that is your duty, I guess. It’s not like I thought I was the only special one or anything... Nnnrgh, why are these words coming out of my mouth...? Since when did I become someone so appalling...?

I feel the stronger I become, the larger this something inside me grows. You know, if you wanted me to turn my back on the world, I... Hehe, I guess there’s no way you’d ask for something like that, huh. I’m sure there’s gotta be a future out there where you save both me and the world, right?

You know, I’ve been thinking... What would happen if I just ran away? I’m fine with the two of us seeing peace come to the world,​ but tell me—wouldn’t it also be a sight to behold watching it be destroyed? Choose the path you like. We’ll have fun either way.
It looks like I’ve gotten stronger again.
I see you helped me grow a little more again. Thank you.
There’s my power, and the other power inside me... Yeah, I’m okay. I still have everything under control.
With me being able to draw out even more of this new power, does that mean it’s become that much more stable? Or, is it becoming a part of me? I wonder what the answer is.
Do you want me to save the world? Or, would you rather that I live on? I wonder which one is your reason for giving me all this power.

Even if I sacrifice myself to save the world, I won’t be around to see it afterwards. So, there’s no reason for me to keep caring, right? ...Is it strange for me to be having these kinds of thoughts? Hey, between the life of the world, and that of my own, which one is more precious to you? Well, which is it?
Hah-hah! We won because of me, right? Feel free to thank me as much as you like.
We lost...? Well, it’s just one of those days, right?
It’s time to show you my new power!
No demon or god will outshine me!
D-Dear Brother...! Thank goodness. You didn’t come back for so long, I was worried you might’ve been kidnapped... I’m so happy you’re safe.
I do hope I can be of help to you, Dear Brother...

I just finished grooming Prean... You know, at first I had two more bunnies named Zaruld and Skura, but they both ran off somewhere... Prean here was the only one who never left my side though. How did I come up with their names? Hehe, that’s a secret.

This crown has the ability to seal a witch’s powers away. Rean has one too, but it’s old, and has no more power left in it... There may still be other witches just like me out there...unable to go anywhere or do anything... Witches who are held as prisoners.
Oh, Dear Brother! Come over here and rest your head on my lap. I’ll tell you a bedtime story until you... Hm? Why are you holding yourself back? If it were Rean, she’d definitely jump at the offer...

Sometimes I wonder what would happen if I was kidnapped by scary people again... I’m not afraid though. After all, I'm sure you and Rean would... Huh? You won’t let anyone kidnap me anymore? D-Dear Brother... Okay, please make sure to keep me safe then! Hehe!
Happy birthday, Dear Brother. Here’s a little something from me... A tart topped with lots of fruit. Oh, the bigger one beside it is for Rean, so please save that for her, okay?
I was imprisoned because I was fated to be. Dear sister Zara shouldn’t have to place all the blame on herself...

As a child, I was afraid of going outside. My grandmother raised me to believe it was dangerous. That’s why I locked myself in my room for so long... But, Rean promised she'd protect me. That promise was what gave me the courage to take my first step outside.

There, there. You don’t have to be so upset, Rean... Oh, Dear Brother. ...To tell you the truth, Rean is pouting because of all the attention I give to Prean. Really, Rean can be such a handful... I...I sound happy? Heh, I have no idea what you’re talking about...

What a predicament this is... Ever since I told dear sister Zara that I’m afraid of walking outside alone, she started guarding me wherever I go... Even if I go, um, where I need my privacy... Still...I’m happy that we can be together again.

Nnnrgh... Dear sisters Cordie, Hathor, and Mimi asked me earlier, “Are head pats okay?” I said, “Yes,” believing they were talking about Prean, until their hands were all over my head... I was at a loss for words. I mean, Prean’s head looks much more pleasant to pat than mine. Here, just look at how soft and fluffy it is!

My whole life, I was always being protected. I thought that even if I tried to help, I would just get in the way. But, I’m done with just being protected—I want to carry the same burdens as everyone else. Dear Brother, would you allow someone like me to stand by your side and fight?
I can feel my light being set free...
So, this is your power, Dear Brother...
Even though everyone is always protecting me, you’ll still help me become stronger? Thank you so much, Dear Brother...!

Ah, it’s almost time for dear sister Lunalynn to arrive. I’d better get ready... Hm? Oh, yes, she’s been coming over to spend time with me recently. There are some things we have in common... Today, we’re planning to stay in my room the entire time. No going outside...! Would you like to join us, Dear Brother?

Apparently, dear sister Skuld successfully made an elixir that raises physical strength. Maybe, if I was stronger...if I had powerful muscles...then surely I’d be able to protect Rean...huh? “Stay as I am...and never change?” O-Okay, if you insist, Dear Brother.

Dear Brother, I’ve gotten stronger, and it’s all thanks to you... So...umm...would you like to take a moment to accompany me outside? Don’t worry—I'm not afraid anymore. I can walk on my own now. And, I can go even further with you by my side... Don’t you think so?
I’m sorry... I couldn’t provide enough healing...
It’s been a long time, hasn’t it. I understand the desire to escape from the weight of responsibilities, so I don’t blame you for your absence. Just...allow me to say this. ...Welcome home, Duke.
I feel a gentle breeze...filled with the warm fragrance of flowers... You have a wonderful place here. If I could, I’d like to bask in this moment forever...

I used to draw picture books quite often. It was only a hobby, so the artwork was rather atrocious...but I was able to bring smiles to the children in my neighborhood. There seems to be many young ones here too. Do you think I could make them smile if I started drawing again?

This uniform? Hehe, it doesn’t suit me, does it. I’m Supreme Commander of Emeria’s Armed Forces of Humanity. The highest officer charged with opposing demons and protecting humanity. In actuality, though, that rank shouldn’t have gone to me...but perhaps to someone with true strength, like Fenny...

Oh, are you taking a break, Duke? If you are, I’d like to make one request from you. Actually, I received some advice from a very talented artist just a moment ago. If it’s not too much trouble, would you allow me to practice drawing your portrait?
Since you’re in a position to lead your people as their Duke, you must be bearing their fate on your shoulders. Not just that—you’re also fighting to save the world... You have my utmost respect.

Happy birthday. I hope you can spare a moment from your busy schedule, as I’ve prepared a special present just for you. Please help yourself to this grilled cactus. ...Oh? Cactus isn’t seen as a delicacy here?

I apologize that you have to see me in this state. As the price for having this power, my body can’t move as well as others’. Perhaps great power comes at a high price. ...Or, since a witch’s power comes from the heart...perhaps punishment is what my heart wishes for...

I heard that Lady Elfriede was also tempted by a demon, and was on the verge of destroying your world... I can no longer hear the whispers of the demon in my head. Was it satisfied when I destroyed my world? Or, is it plotting something entirely different...?

Fenny apparently joined the Armed Forces out of her admiration for me. I don’t think I could’ve saved my world, but if I inspired someone like Fenny to come out and join us, then there might’ve been some meaning to what I did.

I admire the Queen of the fallen kingdom, the captain of the witch squadron, and of course, you, Duke... I feel you all have so much strength, with hearts that never waver. Perhaps, people like you were born to be in positions to lead others.

I was actually thinking about drawing another picture book. Once it’s finished, can I ask you to read it? This story’s about a girl who is deceived by a demon, but is saved by a kindhearted prince, then goes on to live happily ever after... Nnnrgh... You can probably tell who this story’s modeled after, can’t you...

I must take full responsibility for what I’ve done. Although I’m utterly terrified by this power, I feel that as long as I have you by my side, I can handle it. I know this is selfish of me to ask, but would you mind staying with me, by my side?
I don’t want any more power...
Are you telling me to fight once again...?
Fighting means robbing someone else of their life. That’s a choice I’m not strong enough to make...!
A new power’s welling up inside me. It feels so warm...much different from my own... To think this kind of power could also exist...

This power you’re giving me—the power of bonds... It’s a gentle power born from banding with others, not from fighting alone... I tried bearing the weight of the entire world all by myself... I now see it was wrong for me to do that...!

Even a burden too heavy for a single person to carry can become so much lighter if everyone helps support them. Being alone made me terrified of my power, but as long as everyone’s with me—as long as you’re with me, I feel I can handle it. This time...would you allow me to use this power and fight for the world?

Memo: ボイス追加(パラデアスキル2-2)
Text: If I have to use the power of demons...
I won’t ask for your forgiveness. But at the very least, I vow your lives won’t go to waste.
Have I made yet another mistake...?
If I can still be of any help...!
I’ll burn you down in an instant...!
At the very least, I have to give it my all...!
Hm...? Goodness gracious, here comes the Duke to grace us with his presence. Well now, pray tell how you intend on entertaining me today.

Just what were you thinking in making me, the great Gil’uial, wait for your return? Gahaha, oh come now! You visiting me is all that matters. Now then, do tell me what sort of adventures you had while you were away.
Now then, see to it you’re ready for another day of hard work. I, the eagle-eyed Gil’uial, shall make myself comfortable here as I keep a veeery close eye on your endeavors.

Good grief, is your head in the clouds? You can’t focus on work. Hmmm...shall we rest and have some tea, then? Ah yes, when you brew mine, make sure it isn’t piping hot. My tongue’s very sensitive to heat, you see.

Curious about these rats, are we? I, the desirous Gil’uial, wanted familiars of my own, like those songstress and dancer girls. So, I caught these rats intending on training them, but...it’s not going well. Ah, not a word of this to your attendant or apprentice handmaiden. I’ll never hear the end of it should they find out.

Hmmm, tired, are we? You won’t hear anyone complain should you take a short break. Even if your nap reveals you to have the most idiotic face the world has ever seen, I, the benevolent Gil’uial, shall keep it a secret.
Heh... You seek to know my age? Hmmm, very well... I’ll make it so none of your questions remain unanswered...if you do whatever it is I tell you... Gehehe! I’m teasing you.

Well! If it isn’t your birthday! Hehehe, happy birthday. Well, how old are you now? You’d best put candles on your cake while you still can. For once you become the same age as me, the eternal Gil’uial, you’ll run out of space to add even the smallest topping.

I’m glad to see Granny Rosalie’s still alive and kicking. Oh, come now—we must respect our elders! Hm? Of course, I, the youthful Gil’uial, am much younger than her. Even my skin’s softer! Here...why not touch and see for yourself? Gehe!
The Witch of the Deep Forest? Hm, indeed...I knew her master. One of the few friends I’ve ever had. However, how should I put it...? She was far too soft on that apprentice of hers.

I, the great Gil’uial, have eternal youth, but I’m not immortal. Even so, I do feel bored for long periods of time...but for those witches with immortality... Goodness... Although witches attain the powers they desire, the divine can be quite cruel indeed...
Good grief... I was so frightened this would happen, I even distanced myself from others... Wh-What?! No, I wasn’t saying anything. You must be hearing voices inside that thick skull of yours.

My name means, “Star of Twilight”—the star that shines first in the evening sky. From now on, as you make your way through the darkness, place all your confidence in me. No hesitations. No shame. No remorse. Should you lose your bearings, I, the shining Gil’uial, shall keep you on the right path!

Our farewell is inevitable... I can live one hundred lifetimes, but this is the one thing I can’t ever get used to... Hey, would you come with me...and create a few more memories for me to hold on to?
Gahaha! I’m in the prime of life!
Hmmm... Does this mean I, the powerful Gil’uial, still have a long way to go?
Hey, Duke. Are you fine focusing all your attention on me, the enchanting Gil’uial? Oh, go on then! It’s nothing for me to feel guilty about. Gehe!
This is the first time I’ve stayed in one place for so long. You should feel some pride in that, for you have the Almighty Witch, Gil’uial, under your care.

Now then, Duke... How should I repay this debt I owe you...? Heh, good grief. To make me, the unshakable Gil’uial, worry about such trivial things, you’re quite impressive. If you weren’t, however, that would make you unfit to be called the Duke, right? Gehe! Gahaha!
Duke. Till this moment, you’ve given me so many offerings. Perhaps it’s time you wish for something in return? Gehe... Now, say whatever it is your heart desires. Whisper it...right into my ear.
Heh! This comes at no surprise. The almighty Gil’uial is here, after all.
Hm. You see, even I have days like this... My apologies.
Oh! Um... H-Hello...! Was...there something you needed from me?

Ah...! It... It is nice to see you again after so long. Um... Do you...remember me? O-Oh, I am honored to hear that. I have always lacked a strong presence, and was often forgotten about by others ever since I was young. So, I simply assumed... U-Um, are you...truly sure you are not thinking of someone else?
I wish I could just disappear like bubbles in the waves... Ah! M-My apologies... I...did not think anyone would be coming to see me... Did you...by any chance...hear what I just said...?

I first saw this harp when it was about to be thrown out at a shop. I was able to save it after begging the owner to give it to me instead... Unnoticed by anyone its whole life, only to be thrown away in the end... I could not help but feel a kinship with it, so I simply could not let it meet such a fate.

My legs...have been weak ever since I was born, so I could never venture very far... Perhaps finding me pitiful in such a state, my father invited a harp player to our home to play for me. The performance I saw then was so wonderful, words do not do it justice, like it were truly painting a picture in my mind, and—! Ah...! I...am talking far too much, aren’t I... I apologize...

Um... If you are feeling tired, I can play a song on the harp for you. I cannot take your exhaustion away, but I can at least help you feel more relaxed... I-If it is not a bother to you, anyway... R-Really...?! Then, close your eyes and listen to this soothing harmony...

I struggle to talk to others and cannot hold a conversation very long... But, I can at least express myself through music! For example, “Hello,” is a deep, “Hmmm,” and “Thank you,” is “Sha-la-la!” Then, “Thank you for everything,” is this harmony here... Did my feelings get across to you?

Is it...your birthday? I can only play a song for you, but...will you listen? I-If it shall only bother you, I... Huh? You...would love to? Ah...! Th-Then, I shall play something for you right away...and make it full of happy birthday cheer!

As fragile as a bubble, faint as a fleeting rainbow, and more beautiful than the falling rain... The notes of this harp hum like gentle sighs through the air... Now, let us begin... This tale that shall surely one day find its end...

I lack a strong presence, so ever since I was a child, there have been many instances where I went unnoticed... Though it has caused me grief at times, it does have its uses. Like...if I ever need to conceal myself. I have full confidence that I would never be found. There is also... No, perhaps that is its only use... My apologies...

Oh, dear, oh dear...! T-This is quite the predicament...! The Princess suddenly summoned me, saying, “Strum a tune on mine Zivardian strings for me”... But, I am a harp player... I can play other instruments, but when I imagine myself possibly making a mistake...! Ahh... Oh, how I wish I could become a mere bubble and disappear...!

Once upon a time, there was a mischievous fox who caused nothing but trouble across the land. Many priding themselves on their magic tried to seal her, but not a single one succeeded. But, when a harp player used their harp to play the fox a lullaby, the fox miraculously fell into a doze. While lost in its slumber, the people were finally able to seal the fox away for good... Ever since then, the sound of a harp has been believed to ward against evil.

Young Asahi is so small, yet so diligent...and Miss Tama carries herself with such pride... What? I, too, shine in my own way...? Th-That cannot possibly be...! But, for someone such as yourself to say as much, I feel like I can truly believe it to be so... Thank you...

When I was overtaken by that demon, the reason I was able to fight off its possession was all thanks to this very harp. This little one made me remember my sound...the sound from the first time I ever played a harp. It brought my heart back to the light right before it could fall prey to the darkness... Hehe... Yes, my friend, let the two of us play together long into the future.
How strange... I can hear a new tone all around me...
Time and time again...the light pouring from you casts its rays upon my heart...
I can hear a gentle rhythm matching the beating of your heart... This is your sound... A fitting tone for such a warm, compassionate soul as yours.
Thank you... Um, will you continue to keep your eye on me...? So I do not spread any more suffering...or become a witch tainted by evil, I implore you... Please, watch over me...

Everyone here tells me I have a strong heart... But...I still lack faith in myself... It changes not the result of my falling for a demon’s words, nor the fact that I brought my own home to ruin... All of my regrets are exactly why I wish to become strong... Strong enough to feel pride in the tone of my own heart...

Your light which brought me back from the dark...and the sound of the musicians from my village, which rang out as though to push me forward... I shall never forget that kindness. If knowing pain is the very thing that makes one able to play songs of hope...I shall color the world in my sound... There it will meet the music born from the crossing of many hearts—the people’s symphony of peace.
Was I...able to be of any use?
Oh... How I wish I could just be a bubble and disappear...
Oh, melody of the night’s abyss...
Well, would you look at that. To think you’d come to see me instead of her. Makes me wonder what kind of mischief is on your mind.
Hmmm. Look who finally decided to come back. Though, I guess my face was the last thing you wanted to see, huh? Go ahead and do whatever you want. See if I care. Hmph!
I’m not polite and courteous like her. I take what I want by force, so be ready for what’s in store for you.

Sorry, “my lord,” but I couldn’t care less about your ever-so-kindhearted “rescue operations.” Does hearing me say that put a bad taste in your mouth? Well, this is me, okay? Even if I were to start having regrets now... Ugh, you sure can say that line with the straightest face, can’t you...
Going back in time, coming from a different world... I don’t think it’s often that those things are supposed to happen. Perhaps this world is far more dangerous than you all think it is.
What? You’re still working? Hmmm... Well, give it everything you’ve got then, I guess.

He’s so foolishly nice, quick to trust anyone, and smiles without a hint of doubt on his face... There’s not a single thing that makes me like him...but in the end, I guess I am who I am. ...Huh? What was I talking about...? If you weren’t paying attention, then too bad. I’m not repeating myself. Hmph!

So, it’s your birthday, huh. We can celebrate if you like, but you’ll be celebrating with me. It won’t be cheap, of course. ...W-Wait, why are you smiling? Isn’t that what you hate about me? You really are out of your mind, y’know...

I’ll return to my world one day. When that happens, you’re coming home with me, right? “...That’ll make a mess of things?” Hmmm... Okay, fine. But since you turned down an offer from me, that means you’re plenty prepared for the consequences, right? I’ll think of what you can do for me instead, so you better look forward to it, okay? ...Heh!

Hey you, apprentice handmaiden. If you think your small self can carry all those bags—ah... Of course, you’d fall down. You’re trying to carry them all at once, after all. You’re not hurt, right? Here, I’ll carry half of the bags for you, so hurry and get back on your feet.

Seriously, what is it about him that makes her feel this way...? Hey you, tell me. What about this guy do you like? Huh? You don’t like the Duke in that way? Come on now, do you really think you can lie to yourself?

Sorry, but tedious secretarial work just isn’t for me. Leave all that stuff to her. Instead, I’ll take on the dirty work that she can’t do. You need someone to take out and crush some garbage? Or, a beast to devour some prey? Just give the word, and I’ll do it.
You’re so foolishly kind, quick to depend on for anything, and never have a problem saying, “Thank you...” Why were those the only things missing from my life?

You remember how you turned down my offer, right? Well, I’ve decided what you can do for me instead. After I’m gone, I want you to cherish her. ...After all, I’m sure she’s your ideal version of me. And besides, she still needs you...while you already gave me more than I could ever ask for. ...I’m counting on you.
If you’re giving this to me, I’ll take it off your hands.
The way I fight is too dangerous? Sorry, but I don’t know how to fight any other way. Or perhaps, you’d prefer I kill our enemies more politely and courteously?
Perhaps, what you want to tell me is, “Fight by working together with your allies?” Don’t be ridiculous. That’s a hard no from me. If I put my trust in others, all they’ll do is betray me.

Even in a naively peaceful world like this, it takes power to live, huh? Alright. I’ll lend you mine, then. “Power is what the hand uses to take what it covets.” Not a bad idea, if I do say so myself.

I’m not looking to get too friendly with you people, but as long as no one dies, that works for me. ...Why are you so surprised? Did you expect anything less? It’s not like I killed others because I wanted to, you know...

You actually went and made me this strong... Fine. I’ll admit it. You’re such an unbelievable fool, and since I can’t find it in me to hate that, it makes me as big as a fool as you. That’s why I’ll only say this once. ...Thank you for accepting me as I am... ...Alright. That’s enough!!
You thought I’d just let you go? Tough luck. I’m not as nice as a certain Duke, you know.
This is going to cost you... Mark my words—I’ll make you regret this.
I’ll make minced meat out of you!
Cry, scream, and beg for forgiveness!
Well, if it isn’t my favorite customer! I haven’t seen you pop in for a while, so I was sure you had... Oh, no. Forget I said anything.
Alright, time to get out there and make some money.

Nrrgh, where did they go...? Oh hey, my favorite customer! I was doing a head count of the flabbycatties, but one’s missing... C’mon Boss, this isn’t good! You gotta actually watch...huh? What exactly are these things? They’re exactly what you see—just ordinary, run-of-the-mill flabbycatties.

If someone seeks help, deliver what they need. That’s my golden rule. I’ve seen many deaths that could’ve been prevented if supplies had been delivered sooner. So, I became the Merchant of Death, knowing full well what it means to keep one side of a battle alive.
Huh? You’re looking a bit burnt out, my favorite customer. If you’re buried in so much work that you need a helping paw, the flabbycatties and I got you covered... Of course...for free!

Merchants like me got a trick for surviving—we never stay in one place. We gotta be ready to run away at a moment’s notice. But, I feel safe next to you, my favorite customer. Hehe... It’s nice having a place to go home to.

Happy birthday, my favorite customer! I’m running a special birthday sale just for you~! There’s cake, everyday essentials, and even a coupon you can redeem for one date with yours truly. So, what’ll it be?

A war orphan like me doesn’t have many paths to choose from. I’m a part of war whether I like it or not. That’s why I decided to become a battlefield merchant. I’ve seen so many lives that would’ve been saved if they just had supplies...

Do you know about runes? They’re crystalized masses of magic power, and they strengthen different abilities depending on their source of power. But, if you leave them as mystery runes, you won’t be able to see what power’s inside... Basically, what you get depends on Lady Luck.

Artie’s a skilled blacksmith, but she can be a bit unstable at times... Make sure you treat her nicely, okay? You’re the only one other than me who she’s taken a liking to, after all. Oh, but, remember, I’m her partner, got it?

Wait, are those sugar cubes?! Oh, no, I don’t want any... Those just happen to be the flabbycatties’ favorite food... Oh, be careful though. Sugary snacks make them multiply. Also, fruit makes them gigantic, and candy makes them tiny, hehe, just in case you wanted to see for yourself~

Which do you think is evil, a weapon or a person? A person can’t protect themselves with a weak weapon, so I fully understand Artie’s feelings about wanting to creating strong weapons for peace... She just made a mistake in choosing her buyer, not in choosing what to believe in.

Soon, the world won’t need the Merchant of Death. And you, my favorite customer, are gonna make it happen, right? Oh, but, then I’d have to look for a new job, huh...? Well, I guess I’ll just make that your responsibility, my favorite customer~ Huh? You’re fine with that? Seriously?!
Thank you, my favorite customer. I guarantee you’ll get your money’s worth.
Well now... If I don’t provide you with quality service, I’m gonna have a price to pay, hehe.
Thank you as always, my favorite customer. From now on, I’ll put in even more work, so keep your expectations high. Oh, but business is business—the only one who can outperform me is me.

What’s that, my favorite customer? Are you interested in a flabbycatty by any chance? Um, well, Smile can be a bit cold... Oh, Angry, the one by your feet, can get quite rough, so forget about them! For first-timers like you, I recommend Twins. This flabbycatty’s just so friendly and down-to-earth~!

Hey there! Welcome to the Fran branch of Richesse’s traveling shop! It’s an exclusive VIP shop where only the chosen may enter. Yes...this hidden chamber of secrets is reserved solely for you, the Duke of Fran, and myself... Hehe. Oh, sorry, did you actually believe me?

If someone seeks help, deliver what they need. That’s my golden rule... Brave this cursed world, and deliver peace and hope to people stricken with fear. That’s something I should do—something I can do. Of course, I got you to help me, right my favorite customer~?♪
Uh oh... Gotta close up shop and hightail it outta here.
Things are about to get reeeal flashy!
If there’s any way I can assist you, sir, please give the word!
It’s been quite a while, sir. Were you off having fun? Well, getting some R&R is important in the long run, so you’ll hear nothing more from me. ...You did come back home to us, after all.
We’re at peace, and that’s exactly why we have to work even harder. There’s nothing out there that guarantees peace will last forever.

I see you have soldiers from different nations, and even knights under your command. Although the enemies we face are different, the fights for our nations—for justice—are the same. You showed me something very eye-opening. Thank you, sir.

You’re the Duke of the Duchy of Fran? I can’t say I’ve heard of that nation before. I have heard of Floran, but that’s supposed to be a kingdom... Huh? This is a different world than mine? I...see... Well, demons do exist, so I guess it’s only natural that different worlds do too.
...You look under the weather, sir. Are you okay? Resting’s another important job of yours, you know. No matter how hard you work for everyone, if you collapse, it’ll be the end of the line for us.

I feel unwavering justice emanating from within you, sir. You must’ve faced far more difficult choices than I ever have. Justice isn’t about good or evil. It’s about having unbending belief on the inside. That’s what I feel when I look at you.

Happy birthday, sir! Today is a day that deserves to be celebrated, so I prepared a special treat just for you. Here! Feast your eyes on this grilled cactus!! ...Huh? Cactus isn’t considered a treat here?

Soldiers fight, but they aren’t the most elite in an army. There are also weapon artisans, farmers, transportation officers, and cooks. If even one person is missing, the battle’s as good as lost. Everyone fights.
Even now, I still get nervous when I’m in Commander Paladea’s presence. I know she wishes that we treat each other as equals more, but I’ve always admired her, so I’m still not used to it...

Wh-What in the world is this food...?! It’s sweet, fluffy, and so delic—AH?! A-Ahem. Not bad, if do I say so myself. Good food can also have a positive impact on morale, you know. It’s even more important than weapons sometimes. Yes, yes. ...So? How does one go about making this food?

Forcing one’s idea of justice onto others is not only very easy—it’s also quite satisfying. So much so that it tends to become one’s primary objective. That’s why we soldiers need strict rules, and the iron will to exercise discipline.

Commander Paladea’s a hero who has defeated more demons than anyone. At first, I thought she was strict, powerful, and as regal as a flame. But when I actually met her, I learned how kind and thoughtful she was... To think we made such a kind person bear the fate of the world on her shoulders...

I heard this country’s raising flowers...so their beauty can bring smiles to people’s faces... I think that’s a wonderful mission, sir. When the day comes for me to lay down this cannon, I’d like to try my hand at doing something like that.
I’ve stopped aspiring to be like Commander Paladea. I can’t become her, after all.
Even if this world lacks justice...that’s not reason enough for me to abandon my ideals. I’ll hold onto them, as long as this fire burns in my heart.
I may have been promoted to chief officer, but that’s only because there was no one else available. I know full well just how inept I still am.
I don’t consider what I do as “justice” anymore. Or rather, acting in the name of justice is no excuse for me to escape the many responsibilities that come with pulling the trigger.
Power’s only a tool, and what we should really be seeking are the results we can achieve through using it. If we forget that...there’ll be nothing that distinguishes us humans from demons.

The power to protect the world is more than just the power to fight. I have something to protect. A place to go home to. They all give me the power to stand my ground in the face of real hardships. That’s the power from our bond, isn’t it, sir? You have my gratitude.
There’s no beauty in defeat. Only victory will pave the way for us!
Please retreat ahead of me, everyone. I’ve experienced many hopeless situations before, so don’t worry about me.
For mine own sake, I entreat thee to strive yet again today.
Verily, the prodigal one hath finally returned... Pray tell, whither didst thou go after leaving me behind? ...Do not dare flee! Kneel before me at once!!
Thou art too carefree in my presence. Pray, who dost thou take me for? ...’Tis disrespectful.

...Why dost thou look surprised? Is it perchance thy first time seeing shikigami? Hmmm... Well, I suppose I should enlighten thee... These creatures move by my power, silent familiars they are. They can only perform simple tasks, such as the delivering of messages...but should they capture thy interest, I am not averse to bestowing one unto thee.

Attending those of noble standing, such as I, are special servants called shadows. Their devotion lasts until death, when they sacrifice their own lives to ensure their masters retain theirs... Asahi is my shadow...but in mine eyes, she is more like...
Hm? Why dost thou keep working despite thy fatigue? ’Tis folly to overexert thyself. Understand? Then, take thy rest at once. I grant thee my permission.

Verily, thou dost serve me well. Though, ’tis not out of respect or fear... C-Could it be, thou hast feelings for me...?! Ahem... S-So I see... I believe thee to be of merit...but forgive me. I cannot requite thy feelings... Hm? Pray tell, just what is that stupefaction written across thy face?

Today is thy birthday, is it not? So, that is why thou hast come to me seeking words of commendation. Yes, yes, I understand... ’Tis for an honorable cause. Henceforth, I entreat thee to strive for excellence for mine own sake... Well? Hath my words sent thee soaring above the clouds? Verily, it was I who uttered those words, after all. Thou may boast about this to everyone to thy heart’s content.

Asahi! ...Whither hath that girl gone off to? What? She hath set out into those city streets outside on some errand of thine? Know this—Asahi is my shadow. And even Asahi, to think she would leave without my permission... Hm? She hath gone to buy sweets for me? ...! I-I shall make an exception just this once!

My country is rich in myths from the olden times, but amongst them, a tale of a fox hath long been loved by the people. ’Tis said that long ago...there existed a fox that caused nothing but mischief, and it was vanquished by mine ancestor... But, that fox’s mischief is greatly amusing... Next we speak, I shall regale thee with every single detail.

None but the one destined to join me in wedlock may call me by name... Not even mine own relatives are allowed that privilege. Hence, um... Asahi calling me by name is a secret that must be guarded from everyone else! Verily, even I have dignity to uphold... Understood?

...Oh, the boredom... Hm? OH, ’tis thee, and what perfect timing! Bid Asahi to prepare sweets at once. And then, might we have Aine the musician perform for us...? Wear not that look on thy face. Thou art welcome to request a portion of sweets for thyself. I grant thee my permission... To enjoy sweets while the melodies of the harp fill the air. Nothing proves more apt for times of boredom. We must make our time spent worthwhile, after all.

That entity you all call a demon...what in the world was that? Its very existence felt hollow, and as uncertain as a dream. Yet, it certainly did exist...as if born from mine own desires... Even now, it seems to be lurking in the shadows of my heart... ’Tis unsettling...

Many have wrought sins, fettering themselves to their pasts. Some bear those burdens as they try to move forward. Some wear smiles despite bearing the deepest of scars. Thine allies are strong. I wonder if I, too, can face mine own sins, bear them, and live on... No, I must bear them. So long as there are those at my side who still call me Princess...I shall not bring shame unto them... Such is how I handle my responsibilities.
Hehe! Do as thou deem fit.
Thou hast done the honorable. I shall reward thee.
Do continue thy offerings unto me. Thou shalt be recompensed lavishly.

Doth my eyes see a dream or reality? For if I believe not in a dream, it manifests unto reality... I am the noble moon who reigns over the night, for my majestic moonlight engulfs even the brightest of starlight... Shouldst thou find thyself lost in thy dreams, remember me. For no matter how dark thy dreams may be...I shall light thy way.

Thou hast served me well till this day. ’Tis only fitting that I recompense thee, I suppose... If there is anything thou desires, tell me and ’tis thine. Ah... Thou, however, appears to be a selfless soul... Very well. I shall decide. Take this—an origami crane crafted by mine own hands. Thou may cherish it as a family heirloom.

Thou hast helped Asahi and my subjects, then saved me. Such was an act of profound honor... No, at times like this, I must speak unto you all as equals... I thank thee. Unlike me, thou dost not possess desires tainted by greed. ’Tis for that reason that everyone gathers around thee... I, too, must become one whom others gather around, much like thee...
Hehe...! That was honorable, everyone. I commend you all.
Kn-Knaves! You all shalt be executed for this. Executed, I say!
I care not for what befalls anyone else!
Ah, the wind feels quite pleasant...
We’ve had quite the long vacation, sir. Have you had your fill? Or, would you like to relax a little longer here with me?
Have you done your warming-up exercises? Tediousness is no excuse for skipping them. You’ll be out of your element in the water, after all.

Ah, sir. Have you seen Moddey? Apparently she’s never been in the water before, so I thought it would be best to teach her how to swim...but any moment I try to get her under the water, she ends up running away... I do hope she can overcome this predicament...
Sir... I’ve heard this entire stretch of land belongs to Primavera, but is that true? I did have the impression she was a lady of prestige...but certainly not to this extent...
Fatigue’s written all over your face, sir. Is it from accompanying the children? Their energy can indeed keep one’s hands full. Take this opportunity to rest. I’ll see to the children in your stead.

Pardon me, sir, but...are you fine being here with me? Surely, there must be others you would rather spend time with... I see... No, it’s nothing. I just never thought there’d come a day where you and I could relax and just listen to the sound of the wind... Hehe. You’ve given me a memory I’ll always treasure.

So, today’s your birthday. Ah, yes—supposedly there’s a cafe up ahead with a view of the whole lake. Its beautiful sunset makes lovers from far and wide see it as a sacred place, and any two who go together are bound to get marr...ah... Th-That wasn’t my intention. My apologies.

This outfit, sir? I bought it from Richesse. If I’m not mistaken, it’s called a “swimsuit,” and can be used for underwater operations... If you’re interested in one, I recommend seeing Richesse. She had a wide selection to choose from.
Ah, sir...here you are. Um... If you have a moment, why don’t we relax and have a chat? We should take it easy now before this chance passes us by...

Is there anything you have trouble dealing with, sir? There’s nothing like that for me, per se, but there are things I must conquer. Flames, the stench of gunpowder... All these things, I must eventually overcome. After all, my mother doesn’t wish for me to just cry and do nothing.

You said we came here to rejuvenate our strength, but are you getting proper rest, sir? We need to spend times like this wisely on ourselves. Don’t simply idle about—rest until you feel completely refreshed. Even my drowsy commanding officer often said refreshing oneself is important work.

Moddey ran away again. What exactly am I doing wrong? I’ve even tried adopting the soft, gentle tone Valeriede uses when speaking to Nina, like, “See, there’s nothing to be scared about. Come on now.” ...Hm? This is how Valeriede always speaks to Nina.

Once we finish our vacation, our fight will resume. Does that worry me? Not in the slightest... If I were alone, the illusions of my past would likely still be haunting me...but now I have comrades who I must protect. I’ll show you I can grow even stronger, so that one day, I can protect you too...
I may have overcome my trauma...but this new me still has plenty of growing up to do.

Aversions and shortcomings—no one understands them better than I do. It certainly would be upsetting if someone else lectured me about what to do about mine...just like what I did to Moddey... I owe her an apology...
I thought I’d made Moddey angry with me, but apparently I was reading everything the wrong way. Well, it’s true that I offended her to some extent...but I also caused you to worry. Forgive me.

For my first time taking charge of others, I barely kept myself together... The experience has made me more sympathetic towards the hardships you face. It must’ve been hard for my commanding officer too. It truly was trying... One became lost again, and again, and... Huh? She’s a special case?

A witch’s power comes from the heart. There are memories that shackle me... My mother vanishing into the flames, the screams of souls being burned alive... The moment I decided to bear those shackles and move forward, a new power awakened within me... With this power, I know I can protect my comrades, and you.
I’m the one to blame... Forgive me.
Keep your hands off my comrades!
An attack like that won’t work on me anymore!
Nnrrggh... Moddey feels kinda... C-Can you please not stare at me?!
Ah!! Finally! Just where in the world have you been, m’lord?! I’ve been here putting up with all this embarrassment, waiting to get going, so I expect you to show up too, okay?!

Nnrrgh... Why does this swimsuit gotta be so darn tiny...? It’s practically underwear...! Huh? I look cute in it? Wh-What the heck?! Of all the things you could’ve said, m’lord... You’re really asking for it!

Why are you letting me borrow your coat, m’lord? So I don’t feel embarrassed? Oh, th-thank you... Nnrrgh... It’s me who should be taking care of you though... Hmph. Just you wait, m’lord. Next time, I’m gonna take care of you even more!

Am I getting magic power from the summer, or something? I feel being adventurous with my outfit lets me say things I’d normally be too embarrassed to say... To tell you the truth, my ever so kind and gentle lord, I like you... Hehehe! Oh, the look on your face! Betcha believed me, didn’t ’cha?

Aren’t you hot, m’lord? Here, I got you a cold drink and a towel. If there’s anything else you want... You wanna take a nap? I knew you were gonna say that, so I also made sure to have a parasol and beach chair ready for you. And, I’ll even throw in a snuggle with yours truly if you want. Hehehe!

You know how a witch’s power comes from the heart? Well, if their heart goes through emotional changes, their power and soul will be affected. That means, if their heart is crushed by negative emotions, their power will distort, and cause the witch to rage out of control. Betcha didn’t know that!

Happy birthday, m’lord! Moddey here’s gonna give you a special gift just for today. You can look at me in my swimsuit as much as you like! Whatcha say, you lucky guy? ...W-Wait. You really are... Uuu, on second thought, stop looking!!

Since long ago, waterfronts were places lost spirits could easily find their way to. That probably explains the fog. Lost spirits feel so much pain from longing to see someone... Maybe that’s why they’ve always flocked to loud, crowded places.
One time I slipped and fell into a river, but Laila was the first to jump in and save me. She was such a good girl, always by my side, always protecting me.

It’s. So. HOOOT! Ugh, I can’t take this anymore! This heat’s gonna melt my ears and tail right off...! I’m sure a dip in the water will make the pain go away...but it’s so scary... M’lord...you gotta do something...!

How can everyone walk outside in those shameless outfits like it’s nothing...?! Sabrina’s wearing a swimsuit, Hathor’s outfit basically is one, and Belle’s practically naked...! Am I the weirdo for feeling embarrassed...?

Since I’m always doing my best, you want to take care of me anytime I’m having a bad day? Are you sure? Actually, ever since Dad and Laila passed away, every day’s been... Gotcha! Didya think I was crying? Joke’s on you! Hehehe. ...But, when I really am feeling tired, I might just take you up on that offer.

A gravekeeper’s job is to ensure the departed are resting peacefully in their graves. But, it’s also nice to make them smile while they’re still with us, right? The only gravekeeper who can take care of someone from the cradle to the grave is me, after all. So, m’lord, want me to take care of ya until it’s your time to go?
A long time ago, I almost drowned in a river...so me and water still kiiinda don’t get along... Aha...
Hmph! ...I-I can do the doggy paddle, y’know... Laila taught me how...
This floaty ring is the best thing ever! Now, I’ll be safe and sound even if I can’t swim... Huh? Ah! Don’t let go! I’m still practicing!
Huh? There’s something in the lake! What in the world is that?! It’s like a small, floaty umbrella! I’ve never seen anything so cool!

Dan-da-dan~! Now I can swim all by myself. I got my floaty ring, and I know Laila’s always watching over me, so I know I’ll be A-okay. Come to think of it, can you swim, m’lord? If you ask nicely, Moddey here might just be able to teach you.

Thank you, m’lord. We had so much fun playing in the water together, I can barely remember I was even scared of it. To show my appreciation, I’ll be sure to take care of you a whooole lot more from now on, okay? Hehehe!
Hah hah~! Piece of cake! ...Huh? N-No! Anything but water... Anything!!
Oh nooo... There’s a hole in my floaty ring...!
Hey there! Are you also looking for a place to cool off? Then, look no further. Come on over!

Look who finally decided to show up. You made me wait for so long, I’m practically an ice cube now. For the apology you owe me, I think I’ll have you take me around and enjoy the festival~ I still haven’t had my fill, y’know.

Hey, have you seen Vera? One second, she was saying, “I can sense where people are, so I shall be fine.” And the next, she was gone. Vera probably left for the festival, but with all the people out there today, I was gonna suggest we go together... Huh? Vera’s Vera. You know, Primavera~!♪
You’re asking what I’m doing? Hehe, weeell...why don’t you take a guess? Answer correctly, and I might just give you a super special once-in-a-lifetime present~!
The silence after a festival makes me feel kinda lonely. For some reason, it just doesn’t sit well with me... I know. There’s no festival that lasts forever, but still...
Hey, you’re looking kinda tired. We don’t get many vacations like this, so we gotta take this chance to relax more. I just love how nice and cool this spot is... Hehe. Wanna join me?

Are you fine with me being the center of all your attention? Hmmm~ Guess that means I’m your favorite, huh? Hehe. You’re my favorite too, y’know. No, really... You’re my number one, especially when it comes to...hehe♪ Now, what did you think I was gonna say, hmmm?

Happy birthday! Your special day’s about to get even more special, you lucky dog, you~! “Why?” Well, just for today...I’m not against the idea of you having me all to yourself... Huh? I’m not teasing you. Why would I do that?
It’s great to relax like this once a while. Just empty our minds, and do nothing... We gotta take advantage of vacations whenever we can, y’know~

Hey, have you ever worn a yukata? It’s my first time, and I just can't figure out how to move in this thing. Shizu makes moving in a yukata look so easy, and she does it while looking so pretty too... Just what is her secret?

Nrrgh... This sash’s making my stomach hurt... What am I supposed to do with this, what’s it called, “obi?” If I just untie it, I’m sure I’ll feel a little more comfortable... Huh? I shouldn’t...? C’mon, it’ll be okay! There’s no one here but you and me~ ...It’s not gonna give us any problems, right?

You wanna know tips for shooting? Well, that was out of the blue... Oh! You’re looking at that shooting gallery! Well, I guess it is a bit tough, huh? No worries, though. I’ll teach you how to beat it, step by step. Treat me to something nice in return though, will ya?

I heard Vera and some other musicians are going to sing a requiem tonight. Apparently, the sight of them singing while facing the lake is so beautiful, hundreds of people come to watch them every year. Wanna go watch with me? Or...do you hate going places with me? Hehe, just kidding.

Hey you, talk about having the best timing! I met a troupe of traveling acrobats in the city, and we’re planning to put on a show in a few minutes. Wanna come along? Having you in the audience will help me perform in tip-top shape... “Why?” Hehe, you wanna know? The answer is...my little secret♪
Aww yeah! Just what I needed!♪
You must be expecting something amazing from me, huh? Guess I gotta work even harder so I don’t let ya down.
I’m gonna use my brand new trick, and this new power you’ve given me, and show just how much stronger I’ve gotten. Make sure you keep your eyes on me, ’kay?
What’cha think? Would you say I’m looking even more stunning than before? I’m doing my best to look good in this yukata thing... Huh? What’s wrong? Cat got your tongue?

Vera’s got Minivera, and Ivy’s got Emma... If only I had a sidekick of my own too... Well, what’cha say? Hehe, I’m just kidding. If I keep you all to myself, I’ll only be painting a huge target on my back.

It feels like home’s so far away... Hehe. You don’t have to give me that look—I won’t just get up and leave in the middle of the night. Traveling with you is so much fun, after all. And besides...if I leave, it looks like a certain someone’ll get lonely and start crying~
That’s a wrap for the world’s greatest gunslinger’s special show! Hope you had fun!♪
Now, if that wasn’t a total misfire...
Let’s go out with a bang!
You’ve got the best seat in the house!
I do hope you’re looking forward to tonight, my prince...
...You’re late. Just whose place were you staying at this time?

Hehe. I had no idea choosing a present could make me so happy. Each time I held a new present in my hands, I pictured every way it could make you smile. If it weren’t for you, I wouldn’t know how fun this time of year could be. Thank you.
You gave me so many wonderful things, so I want to give you so much in return. I poured so much of my love into this gift. I do hope you accept it...
...You’re talking with me right now, but you just looked at another girl, didn’t you? Why would you do that?

If you’re tired, why don’t you relax on my lap? You let that squire girl do that for you, right? Should I make you some herbal tea, like those girls in the garden? Or, maybe it’s better if I hug you. Really, really tight...

You’re my special someone, my prince. Am I your special someone too? ...I thought so. I mean, you keep me by your side at all times, and always make me happy... You’d never do any of that for someone who isn’t special...right?

Happy birthday... Hehe! To think that the two of us could spend this special day together, and make you a second gift out of it. I’m so happy... I do hope you let me stay by your side till the day is over... No visiting any other girls, okay?
Ahhh... You’re looking as handsome as always, my prince. ...Wh-Why are you backing away? Maybe, you’re feeling shy? Oh, that explains it. You’re so cute, my prince.
Tonight’s the night to give a special gift to that special someone... It’s going to be so wonderful, don’t you think? After all, I can make you know exactly how I feel about you...

Some girls say they hate themselves when they get jealous...but I don’t think there’s anything ugly about jealousy. After all, being able to love someone so deeply that you get jealous...is such a wonderful thing, isn’t it?
Just thinking about you fills me with so much joy, loneliness, misery, happiness... My heart gets in so much disarray... Hehehe. Being in love is painful, agonizing, and so precious...!

I know. I’m not a princess—just a wicked witch that fairy tale heroes would kill off. But here you are, filling my heart with so much happiness. That makes you wicked too, you know. Reaching your hand out to someone like me... That’s very, very wicked of you...my wonderful prince.

I can be a wicked witch if you like’d, or even a kind-hearted saint. If it’s for you, I’ll do anything. Every word you say...means the world to me. My prince... Oh, my prince...! Hehe... Thank you for showing me how wonderful these feelings are. I love you... Forever...and ever. Hehe... Hehehe...!
You just understand me so well...
Thank you... The more you give me, the harder it gets for me to ever leave your side.
If only it could be just the two of us, alone in this world...and everyone else could just...hehe! I guess I really am a wicked witch after all.
For you to give me something so special, on this special night... This means what I think it does, right...? Hehe... Hehehehe...!
I wanted to give you a present, but you went and gave me all of this instead... You really are so wonderful, my dear prince... I’ll never, ever, let you go...
Hehe...! I did this all for you, my prince.
Are you saying...you won’t accept my gift...?
Don’t even think of hurting my prince...!
Ah, it’s Daddy! I’m so happy you came to see me again today~
You’re late, Daddy! I thought you weren’t ever gonna come see me again. I’ve been waiting here this whole time, y’know...! Hmph!
When I wished on a star, a strange hole that lets me talk to you appeared... I wonder why...

I was just talking with Pon Pon. Heh-heh~... Y’know, just between you and me, Pon Pon here’s actually a special doll that has a mind of her own. Every night, she makes her way to your bedside and... Huh? You’ve seen a doll like that before? Y-You’re lying! There’s no way a doll would be able to...ah...! Rrrgh... Daddyyy...!

My mom and dad were really nice people, y’know. They believed everything the Church told them, convinced themselves that they were the reason I became a witch...always saying sorry to me... They were really nice... Really nice, but...
Are you sleepy, Daddy? If you wanna sleep, you gotta go home and sleep in your bed. You still have a home to go back to, after all...

Y’know Daddy, I think you’re what people call a “virtuous” person. Just like my mom and dad, you... N-No, it’s nothing. Really... After all, you wouldn’t think that dying would solve all your problems, would you, Daddy?

It’s your birthday today, Daddy? That means you get to eat lots of yummy food today! Y’know, on my birthday, my mom and dad would always make me all my favorite food and... No, it’s nothing. Happy birthday, Daddy.
This isn’t just a bear, it’s Pon Pon. Mom gave her to me when I was just thiiiis small! “A cute present for the cute birthday girl,” she said. I was so happy back then...

Thank you for everything you’ve done for me until now. Today’s my wedding with...huh?! Rrrgh... How’d you figure out it was a lie? I was so confident this time! Fine, I’ll change targets then. Next, I’ll tell the mommy with the thorns that I’m Daddy’s secret love child! ...Huh? Anything but that? Why?

Believing is hard, huh. My mom and dad believed the Church. Even when they told me it was their fault I got sick because they didn’t have enough faith, I didn’t doubt them at all, and the three of us did everything the Church told us to do... Back then, if I had doubted them even just a little bit, maybe things would’ve turned out differently...

Y’know Daddy, you’re really nice, just like my mom and dad were. But, you look like you’d be so easy to fool, I’m kinda worried... You gotta be sure to doubt people, okay? After all, the only one who can fool you is me—huh?! How did you know I was gonna say that?! Because you’re a grown-up...? Come on, Daddy... Anyone can see through that lie...

Heh-heh~ It is I, the genius swindler! There’s no one out there that this swindler can’t fool~! Now that you’ve fallen right into my trap, you won’t be able to... Hey, why are you laughing~? Rrngh... Y’know, I’m not as much of a child as you think I am, Daddy.

Hey, Daddy? How long are you gonna be here with me? Ah, no, it’s not that I hate you being here with me, it’s just... This hole’s slowly getting smaller, and one day, it’s gonna close up and be gone forever... Not being able to say goodbye is really sad. That’s why, when the time comes, I wanna say “see you later” instead. So until then, you better be sure to come see me, okay Daddy?
Oh boy, oh boy~! Look at all this power!
Another present for me, Daddy? Hehe, thank you!

With all this, I’m gonna become an adult in no time~ If I become an adult though, I won’t be able to suck up to Daddy... Now, that’s not good... ...Huh? Of course I’m telling the truth, Daddy~! Heh-heh~ No lies from me. Cross my heart~

Oh, the mommy with the thorns isn’t with you today. Huh? “What do you mean?” She’s always staring at you from behind that wall over there... Oh, were you guys playing hide-and-seek maybe? But then, why doesn’t she ever call out to you...? So strange~!

Daddy, I love you sooooo much. More than anything in the whole wide... Uuuu... These kinds of lies are still really hard for me. Ah, no, I’m not lying because I hate you, Daddy, it’s ’cause... Why are you laughing~?! Rrngh... Y’know Daddy, if you go easy on me just ’cause I’m a kid, that’s gonna come back to bite you later. Kids grow up in the blink of an eye, after all.
Waaah~! It’s not nice to hurt kids, y’know!
Come on, time’s a wastin’! We’ve gotta give it our all again today to see our mission through!

There you are! Where the heck were you this whole time?! We have a very important mission on our hands, so you can’t just slack off whenever you feel like it! If you keep dodging your responsibilities like this, don’t come crying to me if Artoria gives you an earful! ...Oh yeah... Artoria isn’t here, is she...
I wonder where everyone is right now... I hope they’re all safe and sound, wherever they are...

Everyone here sure is nice. They’re all soooo friendly, and cool, and super funny! Thanks to them, every day at this mansion is so much fun, it feels just like I’m...back with my old friends... I-I’m not crying, okay?! Th-There’s just something in my eye!

Getting all down in the dumps won’t solve a thing! It’s times like these when you just gotta smile, put your best foot forward, and believe in your heart that everyone’s alright! I just know that’s what Elaine would say if she were here.

Hey, there’s something I wanna ask you... Buuut, looks like you’re fast asleep. Jeez, you can be a real piece of work sometimes... I know you have a lot resting on your shoulders... Just...don't push yourself so hard, dummy.
I feel like you have the same power to bring people together as the Hero of the Staff did... Maybe people chosen by the Staff are all sorta just birds of a feather or somethin’.

Happy birthday! You know, I always used to celebrate birthdays with everyone just like this. It sure brings back such great memories! Since it is your special day today, I’ll do you the honor of celebrating it with you! Aren’t I just the sweetest?
If I ever reunite with everyone again someday, you’ve totally gotta meet them! They’re all really nice people, so I just know you guys’ll hit it off right away!

Elaine is a nun who serves our angel lord Samyaza and my best friend in the whole wide world! She’s super elegant, beautiful, and when she prays, Elaine practically glows like a goddess...! But, even though she’s a nun, Elaine’s not a stick in the mud at all. Little miss prays-a-lot was a total rulebreaker. She’d always skip out on training with me to fool around together instead!

My friend Artoria’s super serious, stronger than anyone I know, and a real drill sergeant when it comes to training. Whenever Elaine and I tried to get out of training for a day, she’d rip right into us, but I always knew she only got that mad at us ’cause she cared... Still, she didn’t have to chew us out that hard just for skipping a few battle drills every once in a while...

The Lance in your world is held by that one witch Elfriede, right? But, seems like it’s lost all its power now... Say, did’ja know that by using your emotions just right, the angel’s Lance even has the power to slay demons?

To tell you the truth, I don’t have any memories of my childhood. The earliest memory I have is Lord Samyaza holding out their hand to me... But, wherever I came from doesn’t matter. ’Cause now I have a family of friends that’s better than any real family could ever dream of being!

You’re asking why I still believe in everyone? ...No, I get it. I’m sure things’ll never go back to the way they once were. But, moping around and just giving up won’t change a thing! If I keep going with hope in my heart, a miracle might happen, after all. While I’m at it, might as well dream of a fairytale ending too, right?
So this is your power... It does feel oddly familiar, but it’s definitely unique to you.

I know training is important, but only ever training is just so boring! ...Breaks... Yeah, breaks! Kicking back and letting loose every once in a while is just as important for getting stronger! You think so too, right? Right?!
If I can get stronger this easily, skipping out on a training session here and there won’t hurt... I-I’m just kidding! Even I can put my nose to the grindstone when I have to, y’know?
By believing in others, we grow stronger. That’s the power us humans have, right? So, to get even stronger, will you tell me more about yourself?
You’re really gonna give the likes of me this much power...? People chosen by the Staff really are all kind at heart, huh.

I never would’ve guessed I had this much power inside me! The Staff must like you way more than it liked our Hero. Since you’ve given me all this power, guess I gotta do my best to live up to all the faith you’ve put in me! I’ll lend you even more of my magic than ever before, so you’d better keep relying on me from now on too, okay?
V is for victory! This is the power of our bonds at work!
Ugh... How could we have lost...?
Oh? Nice to see you, milord! How are you feeling today?

Long time no see. How about a quick check-up? Hmm, your heart rate is normal, and your body seems to be in good condition. I’m glad you’re still healthy... Oh? It...looks like your temperature’s going up...?
Good health is born from our daily choices... Being too lazy in life is no good for one’s health, you know.

I’m crushing some medicinal herbs for a salve I’m making. It’ll stay good for a long time...so I’m keeping it for a rainy day... Brushing off lighter wounds can leave a person in for a rude awakening, after all. Do be sure you exercise the utmost caution towards wounds as well, milord.

For a healer to help the most people possible, they must go on a journey after being recognized by their master... But over the course of that journey, there are those who end up staying in one place and those who continue wandering. Each healer chooses their own fate... As for me though... Well... I still haven’t decided what path I’ll take.

Milord! Your face looks positively lifeless...! This is just what a healer is for. This rejuvenating tea I made will relieve all your fatigue and get you back on your feet in no time! It’s my prided creation that I honed and refined with Skuld and Dian’s help. Now, here comes the unicorn! Open wide and say, “Aah~!”

The sun shines, the rain cleanses, and the earth provides... You have a smile like the sun, kindness like the rain, and a will as strong as the earth. Those are the reasons everyone gathers around you...as you treasure, cherish, and protect their lives.

Happy birthday, milord. Actually...I...I also prepared a gift for you... Will you accept it...? This is a medicine planner I made, and it’s even inscribed with my personal seal. Please feel free to use it if you like.

Among us healers, there are witches, those who only use holistic remedies, those who craft their own medicines... There are even other healers who treat patients with magic like me. I hope one day...all methods of healing will be accepted by people...

Sivi, you’ve fallen into your dreadful eating habits again... That’s the worst thing you can do for your health! Good health is born from our daily choices...so we need to start by correcting those choices of yours! With that settled, we should get Monica to add some medicinal cooking to your daily menu... I’ll consult with her right away.
I know many kind people. Like those who’ve told me, “thank you,” and those who helped shield me from the Witch Hunt’s wrath... I still want to believe kindness like theirs exists in this world.

Haah... Oh, milord... Well, it’s just... Isn’t everyone a little too careless when it comes to their own health? So many of their diets are unbalanced, not to mention they just hide away in their rooms all day... I-It’s so unhealthy. They all need to pay a little more concern towards their health! It wouldn’t hurt them to bathe in the sun or jog around the gardens sometimes, don’t you agree?

I thought witches were things to be afraid of—monsters who should live in isolation. That belief led me to build a wall between myself and others, even though people may never have seen me like that to begin with. Perhaps the one who had the most prejudice against witches this whole time...was me...

You cannot use healing powers, but with your compassion, love, and kindness, you’ve still managed to heal so many people’s hearts and save them... It would be great if I, too, could... No, it’s what I must do. I am a healer, after all. Taking away pain is what I’m here for.
It’s like being bathed in sunlight... Thank you, milord.

You have the power to turn sorrow into kindness, hate into love, and despair into hope... Despite my fragile heart, you still gently stood by my side... I’ll work even harder to repay all you have done for me, milord.

M-Milord, I need your help! Charlotte’s trying to eat a bar of soap... I-I desperately tried to stop her, but she wouldn’t listen to me at all...! Huh? I-It’s a snack? But, it had such a bright color and gave off such a strong smell... It’s a maca...ron? What’s that?

A part of me was ashamed of being a witch. I could’ve healed people so much faster by using magic, only I was too afraid to reveal I was a witch... But, I won’t hide that part of me any longer. I am a healer, after all. Helping those crying out in pain is exactly what I’m here for.

If the Curses were lifted and the world was at peace once more, the Witch Hunt may come to an end... But, the feelings that have taken root in people’s hearts will never disappear—not even their hatred or despair... There were times when I fell prey to that thought... But now, I believe people’s hearts aren’t so fragile that our darkest emotions can’t be overcome with the power of love and kindness. That’s what I think now...thanks to you, milord.
It may take a while to fully recover... Get well soon.
Anyone who’s hurt, come to me!
O sacred life, breathe once more...!
Oh, look who’s here! Welcome back.
Huh? Oh, Mister Duke! Long time no see! How’ve ya been?! Hm? Oh, her? Don’t worry. She’s still breathin’!

Your shoulders sure are tense, Mister Duke. C’mon, c’mon, loosen up! Hm? Well, always runnin’ at full speed is impossible, ain’t it? Same with huntin’. What’s important is bein’ able to perform at the top of your game when you need to most. So c’mon! If you get what I’m sayin’, make those shoulders loose as a goose already!

Better crush its head too juuust in case...! Oh, a cursed creature just came in, so I took care of it! Those things’re everywhere, so it’s a real pain in the butt, huh? Oh yeah, it won’t be botherin’ us anymore. See? ’Cause I bashed its head in real good!

I had a feelin’ she’d come to a place full of witches, an’ it looks like my intuition was right! I never would’a thought she’d get on your guys’ good side, though. She might just slice all your necks in the middle of the night, so I wouldn’t trust her too much if I were you!

Jeez, you look like crap! Oh, I know! I caught a real lively duck earlier, so you should have some while it’s still fresh! Here, hold its neck down for me... Huh? Why? ’Cause I’m gonna chop its neck, silly. ...You don’t need it right now? Why not?

I’m sayin’ this now ’cause I’m used to it, but I didn’t care for this country much at first, y’know. Everybody was so nice and friendly... All that stuff just kinda got to me. But, now...it doesn’t feel so bad! Could this be that infamous ability of yours at work again, Mister Duke?

I heard it’s your birthday! Happy birthday! Are ya gonna celebrate with everybody today? I thought there was a lot more hubbub than usual, so that’s what had ’em actin’ all crazy! You better thank everyone later though, got it? It’s pretty lucky to have people around who’ll celebrate your birthday with ya, y’know.

Oh, perfect timing! Do me a solid an’ tell me where the coolest part of this mansion is. Maybe it’s ’cause I’m from the snowy mountains, but this place feels like a sauna. I can’t kick my feet up an’ relax anywhere. C’mon, help a girl out!

...Big...Sis... Mm...? Oh, my bad. Guess I fell asleep for a bit... Wait, did I say somethin’ weird in my sleep? Well, that’s embarrassin’. I don’t know what I said, but forget you heard anythin’, ’kay? ’Kay?

Huh? Ya wanna know what I’m eatin’? ...These’re the roots of a tree I found growin’ over there. Well, obviously it doesn’t taste very good, but stayin’ alive is more important than flavor. ...Why’re you pinchin’ between your eyebrows like that? H-Hey, where d’you think you’re takin’ me?! Th-The dining hall?! Why?!

My big sis was super quiet an’ real pretty. She’d even say nice things about a little sister like me all the time... It sure made me happy. But, y’know, I could never just be honest an’ tell her, “Thanks...” I really should’a told her that at least once when I had the chance...

That woman was forced to join in the Witch Hunt, an’ the real bad guys are the Church. But, that’s not enough to convince me she’s totally innocent. She still made the choice to kill my sister. I don’t think I’ll ever be able to forgive her.

I... Me n’ that woman can only live accordin’ to this messed up knot of fate tyin’ us together, though I’m sure there’s gotta be an easier way to live than this. To make sure nobody else becomes like us...ya better do your best to save everybody, Mister Duke. If that’s your aim, I’ll even lend ya a tiiiny bit of my power!
So this is how it feels to get stronger. It’s kinda a weird feelin’, but I don’t hate it.
Oh, well would’ja look at that? Yeah, this ain’t bad at all!
I need to get even stronger than her... Hm? I didn’t say anythin’. You might wanna get that head o’ yours checked out!
If I’d had this kinda power back then... Just kiddin’. That sounded a lil’ too intense just now, even for me!
It sure raises the spirits to get stronger, doesn’t it? You’ll keep up this pace for me, won’tcha, Mister oh-so-gifted Duke?
I coulda never gotten this strong on my own. Thanks, Mister Duke. Oh, an’ don’t worry! I won’t kill that woman outta nowhere, so relax! ’Course...that goes for just lettin’ her die, too.
Whew! Another battle done ’n dusted! I’m just stoked that everyone’s so happy.
We lost, huh? Hm? Am I hurt? Don’t worry, this is nothin’. I won’t die from somethin’ like this.
I’ll end you in one blow!
The great Duke has come home! I must inform the Princess at once~!

It’s been a long time indeed, great Duke. Have you already greeted the Princess? If not, then I ask that when you do, tell her she was the first person you came to see. She’ll be in a sulky mood otherwise.
As the Princess’s shadow, I shall indeed work hard today, as I always do!

A humble shadow is what I am indeed! You’ll always find me at the Princess’s side, waiting to serve her. ...Huh? Why, the Princess is...not here?! Rrrgh, when did she...? This is a matter of utmost importance! My princess~?! Whereabouts are you~?!

Great Duke, I shall trust you with a secret about the Princess and me. You see~ When we’re alone together, she starts sulking unless I call her by “Lady Kaguya.” But, since we have to keep up appearances, this only happens when it’s just the two of us~! Hehehe!♪
It’s time for a break, great Duke. I have Zivardian tea, sweets, buckwheat pillows... Anything you can ask for, indeed!
