I’m sure you feel at ease, great Duke, for you have many people who protect you. Of course, you can count me as one of them. I shall protect both you and the Princess! Indeed—from the shadows!

Happy birthday, great Duke! This calls for a celebration by cannon fire! I shall make preparations at once... Huh? It’s the thought that counts? Awww... I was hoping to give you a gift of some sort though... What should I—AH! I just happen to have an origami shuriken. Here you are!

The Princess says the complete opposite of what she thinks. For instance, when she says, “For mine own sake, I entreat thee to strive for excellence,” she means, “Do your best.” And when she says, “Thou dost exhibit a carefree demeanor in my presence, simpleton. Pray, who dost thou take me for?” she means, “Thank you for always being my friend.” ...There’s a way to describe this kind of behavior. What was it again?

I once heard a story that, a long time ago, an ancestor of the Princess sealed away a mischievous fox... But, you mean to tell me that fox is Miss Tama...? No, such a story can’t possibly be true, right...? After all, to think that Miss Tama would cause any kind of mischief is... Huh? She’s the culprit behind the hole in the garden? Ugh, Miss Tama!!

Calling someone by name means you acknowledge their existence. The moment the Princess called me “Asahi,” not her shadow...I was able to truly become me. Surely the Princess must feel the same... After all, she has the brightest smile whenever I call her “Lady Kaguya...” She does turn bright red and hit me afterwards, though...

There’s only one master for me—the Princess. That will never change, even if our country is no more. The Princess says she’s no longer a princess... But to me, she’ll always be my princess! Although slightly lonely, no one comes even close to how noble she is. I’m proud to call her my master!

The Princess is strong. She was proud of those who sacrificed themselves to protect her, always telling them that what they did was honorable... Believing that no one dies in vain is enough for us to die with pleasure. ...Thus, as the Princess bade farewell to one life after another, no one ever noticed the sorrow on her face... Not one person...

The Princess treated me not as a mere shadow, but as “Asahi.” Still, I lacked the courage to cross the line that divided us as princess and shadow... And as a consequence, I caused her heart so much pain... Thus, I shall see to it she won’t have a sliver of sorrow on her face ever again. Indeed, as the Princess’s shadow—no, as Asahi, I shall protect Lady Kaguya for as long as there is breath left in me!
I indeed feel power stirring up inside me!
Whoa!! I indeed still have plenty of growing to do!
I’m growing even stronger! I appreciate all your help indeed.

Be swift as the wind, silent as the forest, fierce as the fire, and firm as the mountain... See yourself as one with heaven and earth... Learning from nature is the way of the shadows. I, too, will take in all of nature’s lessons, and strive to reach even greater heights!

Ha-hah! I’m indeed a completely different person than before! Of course, I won’t settle for staying at this level. I shall grow even more, and earn the Princess’s praise! I can just hear her now... “It doth appear that thou hast improved a little.” Hehe~

The one who created this distance between the Princess and me was none other than myself. I’m merely a shadow, yet she attempted to approach and bare her heart to me... But, there’s no more need to worry! I’m prepared for us to spend the rest of our lives together. Not as princess and shadow, but as Kaguya and Asahi. If any unease or fear looms before us, I shall indeed tear them all to pieces! ...Shing shing!
Eek! The princess is going to reprimand me~

Mm...? ...So you finally decided to show up, huh? We can’t get back the time you’ve lost, but it’s not too late to turn things around, either. On that note, crack open your books so I can get you up to speed on all the studying you missed.
When it comes to studying, one’s daily efforts are of utmost importance. If you skip even one day, it’ll take three just to catch up to where you left off.
Meria, you’re interrupting my research. I’m getting ticked off, so take a step back, will you? I-I’m...not saying I hate you... Nrgh...! That doesn’t mean I like you, either!

Do I want to become a researcher of things like artificial lifeforms, or magic that accelerates plant growth...? The possibility does intrigue me, but I’m not exactly the most proficient when it comes to conversing with others... At times like these, I almost envy Meria’s complete inability to feel any shame.

According to Meria, my cheeks are just like marshmallows, so rubbing her cheeks against mine gives her a burst of renewed energy. As a rule, I would never put any stock into anything so obviously preposterous, but operating only on conjecture and supposition does go against the very ethos of what it means to be a researcher, and you do seem fatigued, Teacher. Based on the evidence, it could be said to be effective at relieving fatigue, so, that’s why, with me, you should, um... Urgh... No, forget I said anything...

You must have it rough too, Teacher. With this many people around you, there must be at least one or two weirdos like Meria hassling you all the time... What?! You consider me one of those weirdos...?! You’re kidding, right...?

Happy birthday. ...I’m not used to celebrating things like this, but I brushed up on how to throw a so-called “birthday party” from some reference materials I found. I replicated the aforementioned “birthday party” perfectly for you, so I hope you enjoy it.

What’s Meria like, you ask? She’s loud, aggravating, and has zero respect for other people’s boundaries. She is a genius, but as a person, she lacks any admirable qualities, has less emotional intelligence than a sunflower, and is a complete and total nutjob. That’s who Meria is.

Since my research concerns plants, taking care of flowers is just another part of the job. Flowers sure are nice, aren’t they? Unlike people, who ultimately just betray or make a fool out of you, flowers grow as beautifully as the time you put into them. Haha... Thinking that way just goes to show how bitter I am even down to my roots, huh...?

Investigating the plant life that existed at the time these old relics were created is one part of my research. Having these ancient records from way, way before I was even born right before my eyes like this never feels any less strange, though.

...Why does Meria have to act so weird all the time? She’s always saying the nuttiest things, like that she has “better ideas” when she skips out on our research, or that hugging me “relieves her stress and makes her work go more smoothly”... I just don’t know what to do with her... What are you laughing at? It really does bug me, you know!

It’s hard to believe, but...apparently Meria used to be an obedient, diligent student. Thanks to the influence of a certain someone, however, her personality changed to what it is now... I’d like to meet this mystery person and give them a piece of my mind!

Even I want to fix this personality of mine... The reason I became like this probably lies in the lack of social interaction I had when I was younger, so I’m sure getting to be around such accomplished people as you and Meria can only be good for me... Or rather, I find the time I get to spend with you to be fairly enjoyable, so...if possible, um... Is it okay if I continue to stay by your side from now on as well, Teacher...?
It’s like...there’s a warmth spreading through my chest...
Why do both you and Meria care so much about someone like me? I...just don’t get it.
Um... Thank you... I’m...happy you thought of me...
This is the power of bonds...the caring power of the heart... I wonder if even someone like me has a heart like that buried somewhere...

You can fail and succeed as many times as it takes. I didn’t get what she meant by that before, but now I’ve started to understand a little better. Failure isn’t the end of the world, it’s just a necessary step towards your next success.

I don’t know why you’re going this far for me... But, I don’t hate it. In fact, I guess I would even say it feels nice... That’s because, Teacher, I...uh...u-um...t-trust you! Yeah, trust, that’s the right word...
I never learned the art of combat in class, so I’m glad that went as well as it did.
That’s why I told you I haven’t learned this in school before...
It’ll be okay... I can do this...

Ah, it’s you, sir! Welcome back! I’ll go let Fenny and Commander Paladea know you’re here! I’m a little nervous to talk to the Supreme Commander... But, I’ll muster up all my courage and just go for it!

MMM! Mm, mm! ...Pah! Hey there, sir! Haven’t seen you in a while! Oh! Let me go tell Monica and Iris that you’re back! We can all chow down on something tasty while catching up on each other’s reports!

Let’s do our best again today, sir! I’ll do whatever needs doing! I even helped in the fields back in Emeria, so I’ve got some muscle on me! Before that though, don’cha think it’d be good to have a light snack to get our energy levels up? I know I could certainly go for a little treat myself... Come on, can’t we? Pleeease?

This is bad. Really bad. I promised Illya I’d try to eat all the delicious desserts of Fran with her in just one day, but my stomach can only hold so much! I wonder if I can really finish them all...! I ate three meals’ worth of food just now as a light snack?! No way! Well, then I guess there’s nothing to worry about after all! Hehe!

Sir, I have a favor to ask. Would it be all right if I used my free time here to go around the Duchy playing songs for people? I want to get money to buy souvenirs for the other kids back home, so I thought I’d ask your permission first... “I’m acting like an Armed Forces member?!” Come on, it’s important to follow the proper steps for stuff like this!

You seem tired, sir. Here, lemme sing you a lullaby... Wait, but that’ll just put you to sleep, huh? Hmmm, in that case... I’ll bring you a nice warm drink to sip on! If you’re still sleepy after drinking it, then you can just get some shut-eye! That’d just go to show how much you need the sleep, after all!

A world where no one has to be sacrificed may be nothing more than a dream. But, if you give up on a dream like that, then you’ll always have to choose who you’d be okay sacrificing if the time came, right? That’s why I wanna search for a way to make such a dream into reality. Plus, I get the feeling that as long as I’m with you, I really can make that dream come true!
Happy birthday, sir! I prepared something special just for the occasion! Ta-dah~! The number one delicacy in all of Emeria—grilled cactus! ...Huh? Cactuses here are just for decoration?

When we get hungry, even our hearts begin to starve, and we lose something vital to keeping our humanity! Once that happens, we become capable of doing the kinda things demons do without a second thought...! That’s why food is super important fuel for our hearts, too. So, let’s eat till we’re stuffed! OM, NOM, NOM!

In the West of Emeria, many towns and villages were ravaged by demons and no longer produce enough food. That’s why the people of my village work together to do things like send out food on set schedules or secure safe routes for transporting rations! Even the Armed Forces of Humanity’s soldiers join in to help out!

Apparently there’s a saying from Shizu’s country that goes, “Empty stomachs do not reign victorious on the field of battle!”... Now those are some words to live by! They’re so good, I almost wanna put ’em in a picture frame and hang ’em up! No, wait, let’s hang ’em up after all! Then eat! A lot! Doesn’t that sound like fun?!
Having all this yummy food around makes me so happy! It’s like I’m in heaven! ...! Wait, what if this really is heaven?! Please, sir, pinch me so I know I’m not dreaming!

S-S-Stop right there, sir! Miss Primavera is like, a super talented songstress, isn’t she?! Why didn’t you tell me sooner?! I sang in front of someone that high level acting like I was hot stuff...! Aaaaaaaah! I bet she thinks I’m such a loser!!

Lately, I get full even when I’ve only eaten a little. I wonder why? ...I can’t put it into words very well, but as long as I’m with all of you, it just feels like everything’ll be okay... Thanks, sir. Hehehe! I just got the urge to thank you all of a sudden!
So this is what it feels like to get stronger! How strange... Oh, but I don’t hate it or anything! In fact, I love it!
This feeling... It feels familiar, like I’ve felt this way before somewhere. When was that again...?
Oh yeah!! This feeling! Now I remember! This warm, tingly feeling in my stomach! It’s the same sensation I get whenever I have warm soup!
I just can’t get enough of this warm feeling...! It’s making me kinda hungry.

Getting stronger sure makes you feel all warm and fuzzy inside! This’s all made me wanna drink some kinda tasty soup... ...! Sir, I just had the best idea...! Wouldn’t it be super yummy if you put some meat in a soup, too?!
Thanks to you, sir, I got to drink lots of tasty s... I mean, I got this strong! Hehehe, thanks. Sir, keep that warm soup—uh, power—coming, okay?
Th-Thank goodness we won...! All right! This calls for a celebratory feast! That way, we can eat lotsa yummy victory treats!
Uuu...! When I’m hungry, I can’t fight at all...! Let’s eat something so we can get our strength back, sir!
I’ll show you my conviction through song!
That should help you get back on your feet, right?
To think you would come all this way to see me... So you do see how glorious I am!
O-Oh, Master! ...M-My hands are clean. While you were away, I certainly did not set any traps in places you might frequent... Ah! ’T-Twas not me! I swear!
Stand back, human! Know who is standing before you! ’Tis none other than the infamous mononoke and mightiest guardian spirit—Tama the Glorious! Now, on your knees!

Oh, has this caught your eye? Weeell, ’tis naught but a tiny trap I have been crafting. Ah. I cannot unveil any more, even to the likes of you, Master. Why, you ask? Heh-heh! Well, of course...’tis because this is meant to be a surprise for you!

Why was I sealed away, you ask? Hmmm... Why, indeed? I recall playing a few petty pranks here and there...such as digging pitfalls in fields, scribbling on the face of that sleeping monk, and...hm? Those pranks are not as bad as one would think, now are they? I guess humans were the ones being mean all along.

Maaasteeer... You are in quite the predicament, it seems. But, the more you look at that mountain of documents before you, do you not feel more of an urge to just mix them all up? Heh-heh! I jest... Still, if you remain stuck to your desk for too long, you may actually end up giving in to that urge, you know.

Hehehe...! No need to be so bashful. Is this not how our relationship is? ...You broke my seal, therefore you will spend the rest of your life taking care of me, right? Hehe...! I shall be tagging along for the rest of your life, so prepare yourself.
’Tis your birthday I hear, Master. I have come all the way out here to celebrate with you... Happy birthday... Now then, where is the feast?
I. Am. BORED! Entertain me, I say!

I hear among your allies is an immortal witch called the Great Sorceress... Heh-heh! Living for only 200 years and acting high and mighty, eh? Well, I have lived twice as long—the Great Great Great Sorceress, I am! Grovel at my feet, human! ...By the way, how many days are in 200 years?

That hapless girl plays melodies as pure and clear as water—precisely what I fancy! But see...I have had my fair share of a certain harp player in the past... Not my cup of tea, to say the least... Hah... Never did I dream that being distracted with music would lead to being sealed away.

Do I bear a grudge for being sealed away? Heh-heh! Oh, the words that come out of your mouth, Master. I have no such thing... For being sealed away is a rare experience indeed... So, this is the future, huh? Quite an amusing place, if I do say so myself. Oh joy, oh joy~♪

Why do I avoid the moon princess, you ask? Master, are you some kind of fool?! ’Twas the head of this country, her ancestor, who sealed me away long ago... That girl may be young now, but there is no doubt that she possesses a similar power... As they say, “Do not poke the you-know-what.”

I had thought humans were all the same. Well, ’tis likely my mind remains unchanged... But you, Master, are the first of your kind I have ever met. Heh-heh, seems ’twas worth being sealed away. Or maybe, ’twas all so I could meet you... Heh... Quite the twist of fate, I would say.
Are you here to grovel at my feet too? Oh, a non-believer, are you...?
The world exists for my sake! For the infamous mononoke and the mightiest guardian spirit—Tama the Glorious!

My magnificent tails are shining ever so brightly...! By the way Master, do you know how many tails I have? Tails are symbols of power, you see~! I might gain more as my power grows. Heh-heh! Well, am I full of lies, or do I speak the truth...? Care to find out?

Heh-heh, how refreshing! By the way, Master...I have been curious for some time now...but what is the secret behind that staff of yours? I am aware you are the only one who can use it...but if I were to borrow it for a little prank...I guess you would not like that, would you? ...I promise it to be a harmless one though... No?

M-Master, what have you done to me? Ever since you gave me power, I have found myself unable to think of anything else but you. Good grief, this is all your fault... You have made it impossible for me to ever leave you, Master. You shall take responsibility for your actions! Heh-heh.
Heeeh-heh-heh-heh! Now you see just how superior I am!
I’ll do my part to ensure no dishonor falls on the name of the Guardian Knights.

So, you’ve finally returned... You’ll find that nothing has changed in your absence. I did ensure that everything was protected, after all... That goes without saying—I am a guardian knight, you know.
What’s that? You’re in need of a guard to escort you? Understood... I’ll go now and ask Lady Elfriede for permission to leave.

Has this portrait caught your eye? This is my beloved goddess... It’s thanks to Lady Elfriede that I am who I am today. She’s always watching over me to make sure I never forget that... Lady Elfriede...please keep your eyes on me, so that I may conduct myself as a knight without shame.

When Lady Elfriede was possessed by that demon, I definitely felt something was amiss. But, I was afraid of speaking my mind, and all I could do was obey her... Even though I thought she was wrong, all I could do was obey...and try to at least sully myself in the same sins as hers...

I’m one of Her Holiness’s Guardian Knights. Thus, I’ve even honed my administrative skills so I could be useful to her beyond combat. Once I get my hands on all your paperwork, it’ll be done in an instant. If you follow me, then get some rest. ...Are we clear?

I played a part in the Witch Hunt, and fully intend to face punishment. So before that happens, there’s something I want you to know... You have my gratitude...for saving Lady Elfriede...and for allowing me to stay at her side, despite being well aware of the sins I’ve committed... Thank you...

Today’s your birthday, right? It seemed like Lady Elfriede and Miss Loki were busy preparing gifts for you. I wonder if there’s anything I can give you too... Well, I have a miniature portrait of Lady Elfriede, but it’s not something I can give away...even to you. Give up on that idea... Instead, I’ll paint your portrait. I do have some talent with a paintbrush, if I may say so myself.

Recently, I’ve caught glimpses of Lady Elfriede behaving like a cat... Is this some kind of new illness? Or perhaps, a curse...? Huh? It’s neither? I-I see. It’s fine if that’s the case...but there must be something behind it. Something so deep, that a mere knight like myself could never possibly comprehend...

Grand Master Florence is nothing but admirable. During a battle the other day, enemies caught me off guard, but she risked her life by shielding me with her own body... She then said, “We’re comrades—this is what we do,” before going on to take all the enemies down in one fell swoop. No wonder Arianrhod looks up to her.

Lady Elfriede taught me many things long ago, like how angels were born from God’s light. They’re wardens of the Tree of Life, tasked with safeguarding the world, protecting its life, and creating a paradise for all. However, just as light creates shadows, God’s light also gave birth to demons. They’re the enemies of the world, seeking to destroy it, toy with its life, and create hell for everyone in it.

Purely obeying orders is no different than being a lap dog. I chose to be ignorant, so perhaps I don’t have any right to call myself a knight... But, even so...this was the path I chose. I won’t let the one I serve be branded as a sinner alone. By bearing the same sins and punishments, we’ll share the same fate. That’s my code of chivalry.

Lady Elfriede... Whenever you’re with Miss Loki, it’s as if you’ve returned to who you once were, and you seem to be enjoying yourself... Hm? She seems to enjoy talking to me too? I-I see... Thank goodness. So, she also sees me as someone close to her...

Now, saving the world is Lady Elfriede’s only reason for living. And once she has done that, I’m sure she’ll... When that time comes, I won’t be far behind her. You might try and stop me...but my life belongs to Lady Elfriede. To me, a world without her is as barren as a wasteland. So...I’m sorry...Duke...
Does this mean...you consider me...an ally? ...No, forget I said anything.
I’ll inevitably face punishment for my sins. But before I do...please allow me to devote myself to those in need of my power.

“Deceive not. Betray not... Be the blade that vanquishes thy lord’s foes, and the shield that guards thy lord’s life.” ...What are these words, you ask? It’s one of the oaths sworn by the Knights of Longinus. I wanted to etch it into my heart once more... So that I won’t ever again mistake the foes I must subdue from the allies I must protect.

Lady Elfriede entrusted Illya with the Staff of Tikkun, and Miss Loki started taking action immediately after she felt something was amiss... So...the only one who did nothing...was me... It’s unlikely I can call myself a knight ever again. But, even so...as long as Lady Elfriede keeps moving forward, so must I...!

Lady Elfriede protects those she wants to protect. That hasn’t changed to this day. If she says she wants to protect this beautiful world... No, that’s what I wish to do. I don’t think doing so will grant me forgiveness, but I’ll fight to protect this world. So long as there’s life left in me...!

Each knight upholds their own code of chivalry. Some choose to strike down their lords if they go down the wrong path. Some choose to spend the rest of their lives with their lords. And...some choose to follow their lords no matter what path they walk. I’m sorry, but after all is said and done, that is my code of chivalry... If you say it’s time for you to die, Lady Elfriede, then I’ll gladly leave this world alongside you.
Were you watching me, Lady Elfriede?
Go on ahead of me... I’ll hold them off right here...!
My shield does more than just protect!
Let this burn into your memory!
You came by to see how I was doing...? Th-Thank you so much, Master...!

Ah, Master...! Um... I tried making a new candy, so...will you try one...? I did a lot of test runs while you were away...thinking I could give you one when you got back... Ah...?! Wh-Why are you petting my head...?!
You want to try some...? Just a bite, okay...? Oh, it’s hot, so please be careful...!

One, two... One, two...! Slow and steady, so it won’t burn... Whew...! Huh...? Oh, Master...! I’m in the middle of making some candy right now. Making sure none of it gets burnt is a bit tougher than I thought... Cooking really does require a lot of arm strength, doesn’t it...? One, two... One, two...!

I celebrated Cerberus’s birthday every year... But, when we lived on that mountain, I couldn’t ever give her a proper present... So now, I want to give her as many special birthday presents as I can...! Next year, and the year after that... Forever...!

M-Master...! I heard that sweets can help give you a boost when you’re feeling tired...so I tried making you some candy that’s said to relieve fatigue... You’ve just seemed so exhausted recently, I got worried... U-Um... W-will you...try one...?
M-Master, do you...know what giving someone candy means...? Um, it means...that I... Uuu~...! Never mind...!!

Happy birthday, Master. Um... This year, I tried making some apple-flavored candy for you Master, because...well... I heard it was the perfect present to give someone important to you... That’s because, apple-flavored candy means...um...uh...! Oh, no, it was no trouble...! I-I’m just glad you like it...! A-Ahaha...! ...Haah...

Monica always keeps a close eye on everyone, doesn’t she? Like earlier, when Miss Illya said she was looking for her, Monica appeared right away with a tray of sweets... And, when Miss Skuld was searching for something, Monica handed her some medicinal herbs... Even when I was looking for more sugar, she gave me a bunch before I could even blink. But, how does she always seem to know exactly what everyone needs...? “Because she’s a handmaiden...?” Handmaidens sure are amazing, aren’t they?

We became friends with Kobel while living on that mountain. She knows a lot about wild edible plants and mushrooms, so she helped us out a lot with foraging for food. She and Cerberus would often, um...catch bugs together as well... A lot of big, huge bugs... Ha...haha...! But, it was no big deal...! I’m the big sister...after all...haha...! Big, huge bugs...don’t scare me at all...! Uuu...!

Did you know this, Master? Apparently, the reason people cry when they cut onions is because of the scent they give off. So, if you just make sure to pinch your nose while cutting them... Uuu...! My...sense of smell is too strong...so the scent has a much stronger effect on me...! Uuuu~...!

That...oughta do it...! Oh, is that you, Master? I’m just doing a little tidying up at the moment. It seems like Cerberus was playing in the garden, then came in here without wiping her feet. So, the floor got completely covered in her muddy footprints... Ah...! But please keep this a secret from Miss Iris, will you...?

Miss Lunalynn, Miss A.A., and I have decided to hold a study session on what it means to be a big sister... But, who else should we invite...? Oh, that’s right...! Miss Garmr told me she has a little brother, though they don’t get to meet anymore... Then, there’s Miss Skuld, too... Do you happen to know anyone else here who’s a big sister?

The candy Cerberus has is the one we made together. It’s magical candy, made with the power born from our bond... In the moment it was made, I could tell exactly how Cerberus felt... That she loved me with all of her heart... I’m sure Cerberus could also tell exactly how I felt. That I love her with all of my heart, too...!
With this, I can help out even more... Thank you, Master.

They say the secret ingredient of any delicious dish is love... But, that isn’t all I feel. There’s a new feeling inside me, born from having someone I want to make happy—my wish to see Cerberus smile... That’s the secret ingredient to my cooking...! Get ready, because your big sis is gonna work even harder to make you happy, Cerberus!

Miss A.A. told me she wants to learn more about what it means to be a big sister from me. But, I’m not such a good big sister that I can teach someone else about it... Huh...? I’m...a really reliable big sister...? Th...That’s not...! A-Ah...! I-It’s not what you think! My tail’s wagging for a different reason...!

A witch’s power comes from the heart... I want to be strong for Cerberus, to protect that sweet, smiling face of hers forever... I guess that feeling in my heart must have been what gave me this new power, huh...? I need to work even harder. As Cerberus’s big sister, I’ll protect her, no matter what...!

M-Master...! Thank you for believing in me...and watching over me...! Just knowing you have faith in me, and are always looking out for me, is enough to fill me with strength... And just thinking of your smile...is enough to warm my heart... This feeling I have for you is... A-Ahhh...! Um...n-never mind~...!
Hehe! This batch came out super delicious!
Uuu... I messed up... These candies are burnt to a crisp...!
Have a taste of this magical candy!
Hello, Your Grace. What shall we get to work on first today?
Ah, you have returned. Everyone was worried sick over you. Do be sure to let everyone know you are safe and sound.

Thanks to all you have done for me, I am able to live here without feeling lost anymore. But, I would not feel right relying on you for everything, so please, do not hesitate to tell me if there is anything I can do to assist you.
I shall be holding a small tea party with everyone after this. Would you like to join us? There will even be a banana cake I made at Matilda’s request.

These little ones are called Cucorn. They are a common fairy back in my world. Do you not have such creatures here? Hmm...I see... So while there are creatures who were born from the Curse, none are native to these lands. Hehe, then I suppose that makes these Cucorn the first of their kind in this world.

I blended an herbal tea with Iris earlier which is supposed to relieve fatigue. I was just about to brew some, so why don’t you try a cup? I know how busy you must be, but taking some time for yourself is important too.

I may not belong to this world, but I believe that is no excuse to avoid getting involved in what is happening here. I am sure the lord I serve back home would have made the same decision were he in my shoes.
I heard it is your birthday. Happy birthday, Your Grace. I hope the coming days bring you even better tidings.

Just like you are doing now, I, too, have had to rebuild my homeland together with the lord I serve. Our nation was burned to ashes by a being called a Mystical Beast, destroying everything we held dear. Perhaps that is the reason why...I cannot ignore what is happening in this world.

When I was first transported to this world, my mind was in a whirl from how different everything seemed. But after staying here for some time, I’ve started to notice some similarities. Like the color of the sky...the types of flowers that bloom...and many other things, too. Perhaps this means that...this world is not so far away from my own after all.

The other day when I put some ice cream on top of a slice of lemon cake and served it to Illya, she was thrilled. That combination...was one I came up with while thinking of my dear friend Sasha’s homeland...so I was very happy Illya took such a liking to it.
Natasha gave me a small bouquet of flowers the other day. I was thinking of coating some of the petals in sugar to give to her as thanks... Do you think she would like that?

In my world, there is also someone who is called a witch. Her name is Nadia and she is someone we can always count on. It may be difficult to change people’s impression of witches here right away, but I do hope that someday the witches in this world can be viewed the same way that Nadia is by the people.

You never leave a person in need alone even if it puts your life in danger... It is a quality of yours that reminds me of the lord I serve in my world. That is why just like my lord did for all of us, I know you can save this world from the Curse, Your Grace.
Thank you for thinking of me.
I will do my best to be of service to everyone.
I, too, want to be someone everyone can rely on.
I will work even harder to meet your expectations.
The power of being believed in by one’s comrades...is so warm, don’t you agree?
Until the day I return to my world comes, I will continue doing my best to aid you. I look forward to many more days together, Your Grace.
Shall we go back to revise our strategy?
Just the person I was waiting for! I’m glad you’re here!
Hey...! Just where the heck did you wander off to?

No matter how many times I see it, a sky with no ocean in it sure is amazing... To think the sky could look this different... Now wait a second, this is not the time to be aimlessly watching the clouds roll by...! I gotta find a way to return to my world! Let’s give it our all today, Duke!

The Upas and I were just taking a break and chatting! Do you wanna join us? ...Huh? You can’t understand them? No need to worry about that, I’ll interpret for you! Oh! Let’s invite Lise and all your friends here too! The more, the merrier!

These cute fellas here are my dear friends, the Upa Jellyfish. Through some strange turn of events, it seems they were also transported to this world. I’m glad, though... It’d be lonely here all alone, after all... J-Just so you know, I’m talking about the Upas, okay?! I-I’d be perfectly fine by myself...!

Hey, are you okay? You’re not looking so good... It must be hard being the Duke, huh. You kind of remind me of my mother. Hey, since the weather’s so nice today, wanna come over here and take a nap? Hehe, see? Even the Upas think that’s a good idea!

The forest I live in is really abundant with life, and has tons of delicious things growing in it. Like bananas! I could eat that sweet, fruity goodness every hour of the day! You know, I was actually hoping I could give some to you as thanks for saving me...but I guess that’s not gonna happen, huh. I’ll think of something else to give you instead, so look forward to it, okay?

Happy birthday! Hehe, surprised? I heard from Illya that today’s your birthday. It was kind of last minute, so I wasn’t able to get you a present... That’s why instead, I’ll perform a dance famous in my village just for you! Be honored you get to witness something so important!

There were witches in my world too, but they were a bit different than the ones here. The witches I knew...were a group of misfortunate girls forced to live as sacrifices for the world... That’s why, the fact that Illya and the others are able to use special powers, or are called witches by everyone doesn’t bother me in the slightest.

Just like you have Iris, I also have someone who protects me—my personal guard Hilda. She’s strong, beautiful, really cool...and I’m proud to have her by my side! Hilda’s not perfect though. She’s extremely naggy, overprotective, and really scary when she’s angry. But even so, she’s an irreplaceable part of my family.

I have two sisters—the strong-willed Esmerelda, and the gentle Elizabeth. Their personalities are the complete opposite of each other, but one thing they have in common is their hobby of teasing Hilda and I...which they enjoy a little too much, if you ask me... I can’t even begin to count the times they’ve made me cry... Esmerelda and Elizabeth may take things too far sometimes, but they’re both really nice and loving people.

Apparently, my grandmother, who was the queen before my mother, was able to see the past, present, and future at the same time. If that’s true, then maybe she knew all along that I was going to come to this world...

If something’s bothering you or you’re having a rough day, the perfect medicine is to get lots of sleep and eat tons of food! When you wake up the next morning, chances are you’ll have forgotten about whatever was bothering you in the first place. That’s what happens for me, at least. But, if you wake up and still don’t feel better, those lingering feelings will surely give you the push you might need to bounce back on your feet!

You know, I’m really glad the first person I met in this world was you. You’re my lifesaver, and I can’t thank you enough! I don’t know how much longer I’ll be here, but until I find a way to return to my world, I’ll continue lending you my strength! Let’s continue giving it our all!
Amazing! I feel so much power welling up inside me!
Very well, I’ll do my best to live up to your expectations!
Hehe, all the Upas are celebrating me getting stronger!
I feel like I’ve gained more confidence in myself!
The Queen of Jobari never forgets her debts. She pays them back tenfold!
I’ve grown so much since coming to the world. If all my friends back home saw me now, I bet they’d think I was a completely different person!
Time to show you what this queen’s truly made of!
Don’t make fun of me just because I’m small!
How’s it hangin’, Teach! Today’s another perfect day for playin’ hooky, don’cha think?

Ahhh! You finally made it! Since even you played hooky, Teach, Serruria was so mad, steam was comin’ outta her ears! You gotta apologize on the double! ...But, I’m glad you showed up. If you hadn’t, I was about to bear the wrath of Serruria’s rage all by my lonesome!
Whoa, my B! Sorry for bein’ late! Man, I can’t believe another alarm clock of mine broke! What a kooky koinkidink, huh?
The flowers here really are a sight for sore eyes, Teach. As a plant researcher myself, I can tell. These’re all raised with lots of love and care. That girl Natasha sure is sweet, huh?

Hm, hm, hm~♪ Huh? I seem like I’m in a good mood? Hehe, it was that obvious? Well, I actually just finished talkin’ to some other researchers here. We talked about things like magic and the nature of existence, and were able to have a lotta good debates back an’ forth. Man, that was fun! Ooh, I gotta tell Serruria all about it later!

Work can wait, so how’s about keepin’ me company for a while? C’mon Teach, don’t be a stranger—siddown! Bein’ beside me makes it easier to talk, don’cha think...? You still have work to do? Don’t sweat it! I thought you’d say that, so I went ahead and finished it all up earlier for ya!
I was created to be like a sorta incubator for that seed. The only ones who really treat me like an actual person are Serruria...and you, Teach.

Haaaappy birthday! To celebrate the miracle that is your birth, I prepared a super cool surprise for ya, Teach! Hehehe, I bet you’re dyin’ to see it, huh? Well, don’t get too excited just yet! ’Cause Serruria did her best to plan out a little somethin’ for you, too. I just know you’ll freak out when you see it, so just sit tight a lil’ longer, okay?

Ah! Hey, Teach, you’ll never believe this! Serruria was actually serious about makin’ me sort out 100,000 pollen spores by hand! Ain’t that just the cruelest thing you ever heard?! I’ve been doin’ this since yesterday, but I’m still not even...half-way... Ah... Ah... ACHOO! Ah...! G...GAH! Now I gotta start all over again~!!

Ughhhh~ Serruriaaa, this is too harddd! I can’t possibly do this on my own...! C’mon, be a pal and lend me a hand, will ya? Huh? You’ll really help?! You’re a lifesaver!! Then, I’ll be back once you’ve wrapped all this up for me!! ...Hey, thath hurth! My theekth can only threth tho muth~!

Building an artificial lifeform all for the purpose of creating a being with unimaginable power... I’m certainly nothin’ to sneeze at, but that girl A.A.’s really somethin’ else. I guess mankind never changes, even in another world... Huh? That research facility’s already been shut down? Hehe, Teach, you really are naïve... Humanity always finds a way...for better or worse.

Say what? There’re people out there who eat cactus?! You’re pullin’ my leg, right? They’re mostly water, so I don’t think cactus is very nutritious... But, you never know till you try, do ya? Hey, Serruria, c’mere for a sec!

The seed implanted inside me is most likely a remnant of the Curse that once led to the destruction of my world! Either that, or an acolyte of a demon left it here on purpose...! I’m sure our teacher knows the details, but that lady just rubs me the wrong way.

With you hangin’ around me this much, you must like me a lot, huh, Teach? C’mon, if that’s how you really feel, you should’a said so sooner! Huh? That is how you really feel...? Wh-When you’re so blunt about it, it’s pretty dang embarrassing, y’know... Ahaha~... W-Well anyway, let’s keep helpin’ each other from here on out too, ’kay?!
The only thing I’m bad at is exercise... So, you can fill in the blank, right?
I’m a researcher, y’know! We’re weak as lil’ ol’ flies! I already feel like I’m dyin’ out here!
Wait, this power... Wouldn’t it be better if you used it in battle, Teach?
I can’t do this anymore~! You’ll have to load me up with lotsa compliments before I try any harder!
Ohhh~? Do you really mean that~? Doesn’t matter how true it is, if you compliment me that much, I’m gonna get all shy on ya~

You’re a weird one, Teach, and that’s comin’ from me! Well, as a fellow weirdo, I guess that’s why we get along like two peas in a pod, huh? Oh c’mon, I’m just givin’ you a hard time. It may not look like it, but I’m pretty fond of ya, Teach. So, I’d be sunny as a sunflower if you kept hangin’ out with me like this from now on, too! Whaddaya say?
Phew! Glad that’s over! Savin’ the world’s no piece of cake, huh?
UGHHHH! I’m exhausteeeed~ Can we take a break now~?
Be an incubator till you die!

Oh, so you’ve returned...? Welcome back. If you’re going to be gone long, you really should give us fair warning, you know... Not for my sake, or anything... It’s just, if you left without a word, some of the other girls here would be worried sick... Really—that careless side of yours is just like Lucille...
I wonder...if God still watches over me...

Hm...? Wh-What...? Is it really that strange to see me offering a prayer to God...? Well, I guess it is. As I am now, it must be... Huh? You don’t think it’s strange...? Th-Then, why have you been staring at me like that...? “I-I look beautiful when I pray”...?! Tch...! Th-That’s what you were gawking at...?!

Lucille’s simply horrible, you know. She says I’m the one who abandoned her... But, she’s the one who left me... Not only that, she thinks I’m the popular one everyone rallies around... She should take a good look in a mirror... Oh, and then... Huh...? ...Hey, where do you think you’re going?

Your responsibilities as Duke seem tough. ...If it’s something small, I don’t mind helping you out a bit, you know... It’s nothing you have to thank me for... I only offered because...I thought that’s the sort of thing Lucille would do...

Lucille’s the type who can’t say no to anyone who needs her. That’s why, do not under any circumstances let yourself feel special. Well, not like I don’t understand how easy it is to get the wrong idea... I mean, Lucille is just so kind, cool, and...! Anyway, if you don’t want to end up like me, you better be careful.
Today’s your birthday...? Oh, is that so...? Happy birthday... Huh? “Thanks for the cake”...? L-Lucille...! I told you to keep that a secret...!

Ever since I could remember, I had always been living in a slum of abandoned witches... Not like that was unusual, or anything. Besides, it’s not like I lost all hope, either. Because...Lucille was there with me. Even back then, Lucille was everyone’s leader...and everyone’s... Forget I said anything...

Pola always followed after Lucille like a little lost puppy... That hasn’t changed even now... But, she seems more distant lately... Must be my fault, huh... Stupid Pola... There’s no need for you to feel responsible for what happened...

Fortina should have more confidence in herself, you know. She seems insecure at times when it comes to Florence... But, if you ask me, Fortina just doesn’t know how good she has it. Florence makes sure to voice her feelings properly, but Lucille seems to think people can just read her mind... So, I’m always... Hey, are you listening?

Lucille...! It’s so late already...! But, I’m not mad or anythi—...! Hm?! Wh-Why are you here? ...What? Lucille isn’t coming...? And you were tasked with delivering the bad news...? How interesting... Well, it’s no big deal... I’ll just have you accompany me for the rest of the day instead!

When we were kids, I told Lucille to stay with me until the end, and she agreed... But, she ended up leaving me behind... Lucille said she would always stay by my side...but if she finds something new she wants to protect again...I’m sure she’ll...!

If only I’d been born inside Lucille’s heart... That way, we’d always be together... I’ve had such thoughts at times... But then, I wouldn’t be able to stand beside her like I can now. ...To stay by Lucille’s side forevermore... I’ll do anything to make that happen. As that’s...my one and only wish...
Oh, you’re giving this to me? Interesting choice...
I guess it wouldn’t do to let this go to waste...
Will these clouded bubbles of mine reflect your destruction, or salvation...? I suppose only time will tell...

The nun at the orphanage loved both humans and witches equally... But, I...hated humans... I thought the humans who wanted Lucille to die...should all just disappear. Do you really have need for a power like mine...even if it was born from a heart full of hate...?

Lucille is everything to me... Even if everyone else here is doing their best to save the world, that won’t change. If you told me to pick between the world, or Lucille, I would choose Lucille without hesitation. If you’re really okay with me, even when I’m like this, then... Oh, right... That’s just the kind of person you are, huh... But still... Thanks.

The dark desires I’d long kept buried deep in the depths of my heart... I didn’t want anyone to know the ugliness of what I truly felt... So, in my grief, I sealed my shame inside my bubbles. But, there’s no longer any need for me to conceal my true feelings, is there? Because now, there’s someone who will accept every last one of my most wretched desires... And, there’s you—the one who will watch over us, until the day our journey meets its end...
Oh, have they repented enough for their sins?
...I’ll make them atone...no matter how long it takes...!
If God can still hear my prayer...
Oh, nice to see you! Now that you’re here, let’s go out and help everyone as much as we can again today, shall we?

Well, well, well, haven’t seen your face in a blue moon. But, it is no matter. Everyone needs to catch up on their rest some time or other. As long as we close our eyes and dream, even the most unattainable of wishes can come true. That can be a much needed comfort sometimes, don’t you agree?

What’s got you staring into space like that? ...Oh? Seems this new look of mine has caught your fancy. There’s no need to hide it. I can’t say I’m surprised, though. Even my oblivious master would have done a double take seeing me like this. Hehe...

I was just admiring the flowers here a little. Many more types of flowers exist now than when my master first told me of his dream. Back then, we never could’ve imagined such beautiful varieties could blossom here. I’m sure my master would be delighted if he could see them.  ...It just goes to show how much time has passed since then, doesn’t it?

I seem more cheerful than before? Hmm... It is partly because I may get to see my master again, but angels are the ones who love and bless humans, are they not? It’s only logical that same quality would transfer over to me too.

You seem quite exhausted. I could cast a spell on you to relieve that fatigue, but... Instead, come here. I’ll give you something that’ll make you feel even better... Hm? Why are you looking at me like that? My shoulder rubs are top-notch, you know. My master was always thrilled when I’d do it for him.
My memories with my master are my greatest treasure... But, do know that the memories I’ve shared with you have become just as much of an irreplaceable treasure in my heart.

Oh, so it’s your birthday today, is it? Happy birthday. To celebrate, how about I sing you a song? ...Hm? Why are you acting so shocked? In the past, people would sing a song to ring in the start of the flower festival too, you know.

Nothing lasts forever. The cycle of death and rebirth is the natural order of life. Perhaps a part of me deep down is aware of that, so despite my immortality, it makes me want to pass something on to the next generation too.

The demon lord sealed inside of Illya is a being with the power to destroy the world. Sealing such an abomination within a human being’s soul is something that should never have occurred... Just thinking about it makes me shiver. But, angels are the servants of God, not the allies of man. I suppose that’s why the angels did such a thing...

Lately, I’ve caught Elfriede staring intensely at these ears of mine. What a sinful body I must have to charm even one such as Her Holiness... Well, I suppose for the Pope, I can give special permission to pet my ears just this once.

Recently, I stumbled upon a strange new magic that seems to be popular with the youth. I believe the spell went, “Hark, o’ heroic power of darkness sleeping within! Unleash thyself upon our foes!” I’ve lived a long life, so to think there was still magic out there I’d never heard of... This world truly is vast. Perhaps next time I’ll ask how to use it.

Apostles are servants to the angels. While apostles must obey their will, all of us are on a quest to save the world. Saving this world is exactly what the angels desire most, so they likely offered me the chance to contract with an angel to aid them towards that very purpose. That’s why there’s no need to worry that the contract has changed who I am. I, the Great Sorceress Rosalie, haven’t changed a bit.

I want to see my master once more... That is my only wish. But, there is no need to rush. I shall help you bring peace back to the world, see you all off, and then have my wish be granted. So until then, just keep relying on me as always.
Seems I can still learn new tricks even at my age.
I can’t throw in the towel against the young’uns here just yet.
There’s no need to go out of your way to worship me now. I’m still the same as I always was.
Oh, what’s this? I didn’t know my flowers could change... I see... The meaning of these flowers reflects how I feel for my master. I suppose this must be part of my new power as well...

I can feel your Staff increasing my angelic power... Well, I suppose the Staff was said to be one of two sacred treasures handed down within the Church of Longinus. So I guess it is true that it was gifted to them 2000 years ago by the heavens, after all.

Although faint, I can feel traces of my master’s presence residing within your power. Hehe, thanks to that, you make me quite nostalgic for the past. Back then, I yearned for my master’s praise, so I always... Hm? What’s this? You’re petting my head? There’s no need to do that. You’ve made me feel more than rewarded enough already.

Memo: ボイス追加(ロザリースキル2-2)

Text: Now that I have some new tricks up my sleeves, no one is a match for me.
This is the Great Sorceress’s true power!
Light of miracles, strike them down!
One life is all we have, and we live it as we believe in living it, and then it’s gone... So, how about we get started? Blazing the trail to our victory.

It’s been a while. Glad to see you’re still in one piece. ...But, well... You being gone so long put Nebra in a fairly bad mood... So, you should hurry and let her know you’re... Oh, but when Nebra’s like that, it can be real tough to calm her down. I’ll go with you... Huh? You’ll be alright on your own? I-I see... Well, so long as you’re sure...
Call for me when you have need of my strength.

This? It’s a pouch of dried flowers the other kids gave me, back when I was just an orphan in the slums. They told me, “This’ll take away some of your fatigue, Leader”... The flowers should’ve lost all trace of their scent by now, but when I hold this, I strangely feel like I’m surrounded by their gentle fragrance... It inspires me to work even harder.

The one thing us abandoned orphans had was each other. So, if we all worked together, we could survive... Back then, I truly believed that. Naïve to realize how powerless I actually was... But, because I convinced everyone to believe in me, those kids all...

I’m in charge of leading others too, so I get it. Shouldering so much responsibility can be tough. I even know how hesitant you might feel to rely on anyone else... But, when you walk around looking so exhausted, it only makes everyone worry... Oh, sorry. I don’t mean to give you a hard time... Just, uh...make sure to rest up properly, alright?

The nun who took us in as orphans loved and cherished every life equally. She said it was a miracle we were all born in the same world, and that it would be a waste to hate one another... I think you and her resemble each other a little. Since you also love and respect every life you meet...

Ah...! So this is where you were. Thank goodness I ran into you... I heard it was your birthday today, so I brought you a cake. Oh, I didn’t make it, though. This was all Nebra’s handiwork... But, she was too shy to give it to you herself... Hehe... So, do you mind thanking her later for me? Oh, and before I forget... Happy birthday.

It’s not like I always hated humans. The nun who took us orphans in and raised us was one, after all. But, when that nun was killed by humans, that was the catalyst which led me to believe... That witches and humans could never truly coexist...

Everyone used to say Nebra was like a saint... But for a saint, she sure is childish in a lot of ways... Like the other day, when I went out alone with Pola. Nebra wouldn’t stop pouting, and it was real tough to cheer her back up. Wearing her heart on her sleeve like that must be what draws people to her.

The only way to save witches from humans is to fight. Some things can only be achieved by force. Everything I did was to save witches, whose very existence was deemed a sin by humans... But now, after seeing all that you’ve done, there are times I think, maybe there was another way, after all... Have I...been in the wrong all this time...?

Unvoiced feelings won’t be heard, huh...? Nebra’s and my hearts are one, so I always thought there’d be no need to put my feelings into words... No, it was that attitude of mine that made her so insecure in the first place... It’s just, whenever I think I should tell her how I feel...I freeze up a little...

For as long as I can remember, Pola’s always followed after me... To think she looked up to someone like me... It took hearing it from you for that to finally sink in. I only ever look to what’s far off in the distance, and lose sight of what’s already close at hand...feeling like I need to do everything myself... It’s not just Pola. Countless others have been supporting me all this time. ...If I’d only relied on them a bit more...maybe a different future could’ve been waiting for us...

I still haven’t settled on an answer as to whether witches and humans can truly coexist or not. Even knowing there are humans like you out there, once hatred like this takes root, it doesn’t wither away so easily. And, our wounds aren’t so shallow that they can just be nursed by shows of kindness alone... That’s exactly why I want to find the answer for myself. I have a feeling that answer exists in the future you aim to bring to light.
I’ll use this power to attain our victory...!
The goddess of victory smiles not on those who do nothing... Act, and she will act!

We only have one life to live, and can only live it by what we believe to be right... So, I’ll keep fighting for the one I’ve vowed to protect... That’s my calling in this life, after all... I’ll protect Nebra, and make a world where she can always stay smiling...!

I don’t regret becoming the leader of the Witch Liberation Army one bit. Witches with no place to belong needed somewhere to call home, after all... But, I’m well aware of the tragedy caused by my actions, and have no intention of running from the cross I now bear.

Only ever voicing one’s discontent, waiting around for things to be different, won’t change the world. That’s why I put my grievances into action. Even now, I don’t ever plan to change that part of myself. So, if there ever comes a time when I make the wrong choice, I want you to stop me... As your voice is sure to reach me.

What I aim to achieve won’t change. All I want is a future where witches will no longer be oppressed. I don’t know if witches and humans can ever truly come to coexist... But, if such a world can come to be, Nebra won’t have to cry anymore. That’s why I fight. For the future of witches, and for a world where Nebra can always stay smiling...
Hmph... Those who stand idle forfeit victory’s light, after all.
Kuh...! Go...! I’ll buy you the time to retreat...!
Let’s start focusing on what we can do now, and complete each task one after the other!

I haven’t seen you around lately, Duke. Where exactly have you been? That staff is proof that you were chosen by Lord Samyaza to save the world. So, get your act together, or we’ll have problems on our hands!
So, you saved Morgana too, I see. I’m truly grateful... Our other friends should also be safe wherever they are, right?

Being in a hurry does not mean you can run down the hall, Duke! ...What, did you think I was overreacting just now? Honestly—rules are rules, no matter how minor they might seem. When people slack off, thinking it’s okay to bend the rules a little, it leads to big problems!

I’m worried about the rest of my missing friends... Especially Myrlennia. She’s not just timid...she’s also a bit more pessimistic than most people... I don’t know if she can even handle being alone...

The Hero of the Staff was the type of person who’d hide his pain so he wouldn’t make anyone worried... That’s why you shouldn’t push yourself too hard, either, Duke. If there’s anything I can do, just say the word. ...By the way, I heard Arianrhod lets you rest your head on her lap like a pillow. Honestly—you aren’t making her do that, are you?
It’s strange. Whenever you’re by my side, I feel like I can do just about anything. It was the same with the Hero of the Staff... Just having him by my side made me feel...

Happy birthday! Here’s a small gift to mark the occasion. ...How unexpected of me, you say? I guess you’re right. I used to never bother with anything like birthdays...but these kinds of events were so important to the two Heroes, so celebrating makes me feel like they’re still here with me...

Hey, Morgana! You’re running down the hall again! Huh? “Flying doesn’t count as running?” That’s not the problem here!! ...And honestly, you’re just as bad, Duke. Kindness is your greatest virtue, but sometimes your mouth needs to lay down the law!

I’ve always been told that I’m too serious. Sure, being as uncompromising as I am might look like some kind of shortcoming... But, talking with Fenny and Iris has fully convinced me—I’m not in the wrong. The ones who don’t follow the rules are!

The demons and their acolytes have destroyed countless worlds, all in an attempt to break the seal on the most ancient of demons. Once the seal’s broken, every world will crumble to pieces. We must stop that from happening, whatever the cost. My friends and I still haven’t located the seal, though... Do you know where it is?
Why did Elaine kill the Hero of the Staff...? I have no intention of forgiving her, no matter what her reason was... But, I do know she wouldn’t have done so without one...
I’ve always been ridiculously serious, ridiculously uncompromising...and that’s why everyone hates me... I get it. There’s no way anyone would ever form a bond with someone like me...

Hey Duke, why do you trust me so much when all I do is boss you around? ...Huh? You say, I’m not bossy? Rather, I’m reliable because you know how hard I work every day...? Wh-What are you even talking about...?! Honestly—you’re a fool in every sense of the word...
The power of your staff... It feels so...familiar...
After everything that’s happened, what should I even do with this power...?
...Okay, I’ll quit with all the whining. After all, if the Hero of the Staff saw me like this, he’d say, “It’s not like you to act that way, Artoria.”
Thank you for always joining me whenever I train, Duke. ...Wait, why are you leaving already? Training isn’t done yet. Come on—the last 100 laps are waiting for us!

This holy sword, Caladbolg, is proof I was chosen by Lord Samyaza. Since it has lost its light, that means I’m not worthy to wield it anymore... But, this is all I have left... Huh...? The holy sword is...glowing...?!

A glimmer of light has returned to Caladbolg! Of course, it’s nowhere near its full strength... But, this must mean it’s okay for me to fight to save the world once again, right? ...Thank you, for everything.
Until we smash the demons’ schemes to pieces, nothing will stop us!
Feel the justice that crushes evil!
Ah, it’s Master! Did you come here to take a break too?
Master...where did you go? You were gone for so long, I thought you went back home already... Uuuuu, why are you petting my head~?
Let’s play and have tons of fun, Master!

Oh, I’m drawing in my picture diary. Carol taught me how to write a diary...but I don’t know my ABCs, so I’m drawing pictures like Miss Cherna. I’m gonna draw you too, Master! ...Look! There’s a perfect spot for you riiight here!
I can actually go home by myself now, y’know. Aren’t I the coolest? Hehehe. Then...keep on telling me I’m doing a good job, Master! Hehehe... I’m such a gooood kid~!
Haaah... I’m getting kinda sleepy... You look sleepy too, Master. Okay, let’s have our nap time under that tree... Master...could you carry me there...?

I’m a much bigger kid than I was before! Now, you’re not the only one who can give me hugs—I can give you hugs too! Hehehe... I’ll give you hugs every chance I ge...errrngh? Wait, what? It’s no different from what we always do??
Happy birthday, Master! Just now, me and Cerberus made your face out of sand. I’m so proud of it! You can see it over... Huh? I don’t know where it went... Can you help me find it, Master?

You know Cerberus? She plays a lot with me. We’re always in the garden racing each other, catching Bugsalot, Bugsworth, and their other friends... Then, when we’re done, we have nap time. Every day’s so much fun. My heart feels sooo warm and fuzzy.

I wonder if Moddey likes playing shark attack? Whenever me and Cerberus get close to her, Moddey perks up like, “whoa!” and then takes off like, “zooom!” So, me and Cerberus join her, and we all go “zooom!” together.

First, I clap my hands together, then say, “Thank you for the food!” ...Oh, what am I doing? Shizu taught it to me. She said it’s good manners to say, “Thank you for the food,” before eating. Come on, Master! Let’s clap our hands together, and have some snacks!

Y’know, I can go on errands all by myself now. The other day, I was able to go out alone, and buy all the things Miss Iris and Monica asked me to get... Hehehe. Aren’t I the coolest? What did I buy? Ummm... I forgot...

Hey Master, wanna get “married” to me? Ummm...I heard that when people get married, they get to be together forever... Hmmm~? We’ll be together forever, even if we don’t get married? I see... Yeah, that’s right! Me and Master will be together forever... Hehehe♪

Hmmm~? What’s that, Master? Did I have fun today? Of course I did! Today was sooo much fun! Let’s all come back here again one day! I mean it! Even if I grow up...you’ll bring me back here...with everyone else, right?
With this, I get to help Master more and more, huh!
Thank you so much, Master! Wanna do Nina’s Thank You High Five?
I looove you, Master! Master loves me too, right? I mean, you showed me sooo many times that you love me... I love you too, Master. Hehe~
I can swim really good! Miss Valeriede told me so... You shoulda seen me and Cerberus earlier—we swam all the way to that shore! But, Moddey didn’t come with us. Maybe...she...

Nnnrrrgh, I got lost again... But, I didn’t cry. It’s ’cause I got a home now. And, I got Master waiting for me to come back... That’s why, no matter how many times I get lost, I won’t cry anymore. Hehehe! Aren’t I the strongest kid ever?
Everyone gets 100 points and a gold star!
...Uuu... Am I a bad kid now?
Ah, Your Grace. Bathing in the sunlight feels quite pleasant, does it not?
Where have you been, Your Grace? I understand the desire to frolic upon coming to a place such as this, but you must attend to your duties.
My homeland was also near the sea, but it was always beset by falling snow and violent ocean waves. Thus, this tranquil lakeside feels quite refreshing.

Nina is such a pure and gentle child, is she not? It is our duty to protect the futures of children like her. ...Although truly, if she were to grow up without changing how she behaves, we may end up having some trouble on our hands.

Had I not become the Queen, I wonder what kind of life I would have led. Hehe... Such a thought is utterly beyond my imagination. But, as odd as it sounds, Ophelia and I would probably have spent our days enjoying the same kind of tranquility we are right now.

We are one in the same, Your Grace, in that we both tend to overexert ourselves. Working at a time like this will only make everyone angry. After all, getting proper rest when it is the time to do so is yet another one of our duties. Look, everyone is calling for you. Would you fancy going for a swim with us?

With so many incidents happening around this lake, it must pose quite the challenge for you, Your Grace. You have already gotten used to it all? Haha, I expected nothing less from you. However, I also welcome these challenges with open arms. For I can wield this sword if it means bringing smiles to everyone’s faces.
Happy birthday, Your Grace. On a day like this, why not consider taking some time to loosen up and have fun? Look, everyone seems eager, almost itching, to invite you to enjoy the lakeside with them.

A fog that meddles with hearts... Such a terrifying power indeed, yet it seems to have no effect on children as pure as Nina. Or perhaps...she was unaffected because of how differently we reacted to the fog. I denied the illusions that manifested before me, while Nina accepted and played with the ones she found. Yes, that may very well explain everything.

Hehe, Sonya truly is full of endless energy. I do not particularly admire her fascination with Vikings... But, I sincerely hope that she does not turn out like me, and grows up without obstructions as the bright, energetic child she is now.

Near my homeland is an island renowned for its hot spring. It possesses a mysterious charm that can calm even the most turbulent of hearts. Hence, I feel I understand how bathing in it every day would make Sivi the easygoing girl she is.

There are many hunters who call the forests of Vyde home. Normally, they are elite hunters who live quietly amongst the trees, but should conflict arise, their unparalleled knowledge of the forests turn them into elite warriors.

I did not choose to forge a future so wonderful that everyone would be safe from harm... Instead, I chose a path strewn with thorns...and a mountain of corpses... That is why, regret is the one luxury I must not allow myself to indulge in.

It is said that dreams are reflections of our truest desires, even those we are not consciously aware of... Yet, even though what I saw was all an illusion, to think that I... L-Let us stop thinking too deeply on the matter. That was but a fleeting vision—a short midsummer day’s dream.
Truly, I must repay you for all your kindness.
I am not much of a match for the heat. My homeland was a place confined in snow all year round, after all.
We must understand the messages that fate heralds by facing up to them. No matter how cruel each of our fates are, we must never run away from them.

In the truest sense possible, a ruler must encage themself in solitude. No matter how much friendship or advice they receive from others, it is their very own will that dictates their final decision. Otherwise, how can a ruler bear the responsibility for the decisions they make?

It seems all that is precious does not glisten. After all, even as I bore the cruelty of my fate, I was still fortunate enough to meet you, and forge a new bond with Ophelia. I look forward to continuing our journey together, Your Grace.
Security is mortals’ chiefest enemy. Let us keep our wits about us.
Things growing turn ripe upon their season. That said, perhaps I am still unripe...
Like the lightning that cleaves the night!
Like the twinkle of the first evening star!
Greetings, Duke. Now, escort me at once.

Making a lady wait this long... You sure have some nerve, showing your face like this. I’m quite angry, you know. As an apology, make me some tea. ...You do remember how I like it, don’t you? Because, if you forgot...I won’t say another word to you for the rest of my life...
What is it, Duke? ...“You have a favor to ask me”...? Well... If you beg cutely enough, perhaps I shall think fit to indulge your little request. Now, go on, then—beg.
What are you spacing out for, Duke? If you have nothing better to do, make me a cup of tea. No milk, two cubes of sugar. If you make it to my liking, you might even get a compliment out of me.

Witches, humans... There’s no great difference between the two. If I were to compare them to tea, they may each have different scents and flavors, but they’re both still tea all the same. To argue that one tea is better than the other is simply a waste of time. Making a world where everyone is free to like whatever “tea” they like is my dream. That’s why you’re assisting me as my escort, right Duke?

Duke... You promised to read my picture book to me at this time, didn’t you? Or did you forget? ...Haah... Get it together, will you? If I hadn’t come to get you, who knows what could’ve happened... Now, put that paperwork away, and get out my picture book at once.

Roses are red, violets are blue. Sugar is sweet, and...the spaced-out Duke’s face looks so silly, it’s a treat...! Hehe...! I’m only speaking the truth. Just look in a mirror. You’re so silly, in fact...it almost makes that face of yours seem cute.

Happy birthday, Duke. ...Oh? What are you so surprised for? You’re my dear escort, so wishing you a happy birthday is simply good manners, is it not? Now then, sit right there. Since it’s your special day, Duke, I shall make a cup of tea for you myself. But, remember—the sweet scent of freshly brewed tea, and the happiness it brings, must be savored.

I know what that girl, Mimi, is. She’s what is called a “cat,” isn’t she? Triangular ears, with a fluffy tail. And when you pet them, they purr. That’s what I read in a book, anyway. ...Though, it never mentioned anything about them being able to dance... I see... So cats must be good at dancing too, huh...? Duke...? Why are you laughing like that...?

Lady Nebra and Lady Lucille... What transpired between the two of them has reached my ears as well. ...Striving for a world where humans and witches join hands... Such a dream may be as fleeting as a bubble even now... But...a bubble that never pops doesn’t sound so bad, now does it?

How do you do, Star of Twilight? It is a pleasure to make your acquaintance. My dear mother was also born a witch. If my mother were still here...she would surely have been most delighted to meet you.

Witches in anguish over losing control of their powers... Witches in distress over those they love... And witches in despair over their own worth... At the end of their worry, grief, or anger, lies happiness and fulfillment... In your eyes, Duke, do the witches who have gathered here look any different from other humans? ...Hehe...! I knew you would say as much.

Mother, sisters... Am I becoming...a witch you can be proud of...? I shall keep striving to bring down the walls between witches and humans, so please watch over me, okay...? ...Eavesdropping, huh? What a delightful hobby you’ve picked up, Duke. It seems you’re in need of some discipline, so take a seat there, will you?

What makes you everyone’s savior isn’t that staff of yours. Always sticking your nose into everything because of that meddling, overly concerned personality of yours is what does. ...Hehe. That’s a compliment, of course. You’re being acknowledged by me, so be proud, Duke.
It’s only natural to escort a lady, is it not?

Not good, but not bad—that’s my review of your efforts so far. But, there’s no need to feel down. I only mean that you still have room to grow. Now then, show me what you can achieve when you put your mind to it, Duke.
I’m sure you’re aware that no kind of mediocre escorting will satisfy me, aren’t you...? So, keep up this pace and support my growth even more.
Well, well, looks like you’ve gotten the hang of things now. You’ve been working quite hard, haven’t you? Hehe, I’ll need to give your efforts due praise later, now won’t I?
You’ve become quite the accomplished escort, now haven’t you? You’re night and day from when we first met.

Since you’ve exerted yourself this much for my sake, it simply wouldn’t do to leave you without any words of thanks. I’m not so ill-mannered as to not express my gratitude, after all. ...Thank you, Duke. I shall entrust you as my escort from here on as well.
I’m on your side, after all. It’s only natural that we would be the victors, is it not?
I’m on your side, and this is the result...? I expected better, you know... When we get home, I’ll have you reflect duly on what went wrong today, Duke.
I won’t hold back, you know.
I’ll make sure not to hurt you so much.

It certainly has been a while, my lord. Rest assured, the mansion has been well-maintained by Miss Monica and Miss Iris. Please be sure to praise the two of them later—they will certainly be delighted.

This mansion is graced with an array of beautiful flowers, is it not? To cherish them all equally without choosing a single special blossom...you are quite the teaser, my lord. But, perhaps such conduct is befitting of the master of the country of flowers... Hehe, I am speaking of flowers, of course.

...Ah. Do forgive me. I was merely pondering how I might wield everyone’s weapons. As a butler, it is only natural to be proficient in handling all sorts of weaponry. In times of need, I can turn anything—be it silverware—into a weapon, without exception.

I am hurt, you say? Ah, pay it no mind. I do not feel any pain at the moment, so there is no need to fret. I am able to control whether or not pain or poison affects me. It is quite convenient. Though, if left unchecked, one of these days I just might die— Hm? “That’s enough, just get your wounds treated?” Very well, I will tend to them at once.

You appear quite tired, my lord. Please, do not overexert yourself—retire to your chambers if need be. If you were to fall asleep at your desk, I would have no choice but to carry you to bed... Would that be acceptable to you?

As you guessed, Moineau is merely an alias. I believe its origin lies in an old nursery rhyme about a bird of some sort. My real name, however, was inspired by the initials of the protagonist from a novel about seagulls. It was chosen with the hope that I, too, might soar freely like him. As far as telling you my true name... I will share it, but only if Lady Evelyn agrees.

Happy birthday, my lord. Please, come this way. We have prepared a small celebration for you. Everyone did their utmost to make it special, so please be sure to thank them all. And later, do make some time to accept the present that Lady Evelyn and I have prepared for you.

Pardon my intrusion, my lord. Is Lady Evelyn... Oh, it appears she is not here either. Just where could she be? It is time for me to brush her hair, too... If you happen to see Lady Evelyn, would you kindly relay that I am searching for her?

Miss Dian seems to favor firearms, does she not? I am quite capable with firearms as well, but I find close-range weapons more convenient. Though, I worry I may be a little out of practice, so I will have to ask her for tips sometime.

That knight... Excuse me. I could not help but let my gaze drift over, as she looked familiar. Where might we have met, you ask? ...I will leave that your imagination. Some things are better left unsaid, no? Let us leave the fact that I know Dame Luke just between us.

I often catch Miss Rustica glaring at me. Does she behave that way towards the others as well? While I do understand her propensity to be distrustful, I must say it is a bit troubling. When faced with such outright hostility, I fear I might one day act out of instinct... Could I trouble you, my lord, to subtly convey this to her on my behalf?

I heard a fire broke out at a well-known vacation estate. Apparently, it belonged to a prominent noble family. Tragically, a young lady who was recuperating there, along with the servants, were caught in the disaster. Truly unfortunate, is it not? You sense there is something more to the story? Oh, no, no. Fire is convenient—ahem. I mean, terrifying, so one must be cautious when handling it. I assure you, that is all I meant.

To be frank, I never imagined I could be living in such peace. For the longest time, as long as Lady Evelyn was happy, I was always content... I cannot express my gratitude to you enough, my lord. Please, continue to look after both my lady and myself in the days to come.
Oh, it appears I have grown stronger.
Ah. With this, I can be of greater service to you.
Does this mean you expect great things from me?
To think that I could become this strong... It is all thanks to you, my lord.
Color me surprised. Who would have thought I still had room to grow? Truly, my lord never ceases to amaze me.
To do all this for me, even knowing my true identity... I cannot be held responsible if Lady Evelyn gets jealous, you know?
That was quite satisfying to clean up.
Please do not hold this against me.
My, it’s been far too long, Duke...! In fact, I was just speaking with the others about when you might return. Hehe, now that you’re back, allow me to call everyone over to greet you.
Moineau has been attending to you night and day as of late, hasn’t she? Remember...Moineau is my butler, Duke. I won’t ever, ever, hand her over to you. Do we understand each other?

Yes, Duke...? ...“Moineau was looking for me”...? My, so it is already time for Moineau to brush my hair...! Duke. May I ask that you keep us meeting like this a secret? I shall give my apologies to Moineau properly later... These small games of hide-and-seek between us are the moments I treasure more than anything...!

This is just a trifling, old silver coin you could find anywhere... To others, it may be worth almost nothing. But to me, it’s worth more than anything else...! This coin is proof of our promise... Proof that I have the right to be here... To me, this silver coin shines brighter than any other... It’s the first star to shine in my evening sky...!

Duke, I heard you are in poor health...! I must offer you my sincerest apologies. I’m sure...it must be my fault... That isn’t true? Are you quite certain? ...I’m relieved to hear it, if so... But, please...I must ask that you do not put too much strain on yourself, alright...?

Ah, Duke... I apologize... I’m just a little scared to leave this hiding place... My legs simply won’t move... Even if my power has calmed down from before, I always wonder...if someone else won’t get hurt by it again... But, I do suppose a witch’s power is born from their heart, right? So, I must do my best to believe in myself...! Be that as it may...is it alright if I stay here for a while...until this pounding in my heart settles...?

My, so it’s your birthday! Oh, what to do, what to do...! Why, we simply must throw a grand party in your honor! But, before that... Happy birthday, Duke!
