Thank you for being born, as you are so precious to all of us. I do hope your future will be bright, and full of all the happiness you so deserve...!

Why, I’ll be! So there’s a maid with cat ears working at this mansion...! Why, she is simply adorable! Oh? You’re adorable too, Moineau. But, why would you ask such a thing? ...My... Hehe, you are simply darling, getting jealous like that...! I’m glad I get to see a new expression of yours. Do keep showing me more sides of you from now on as well, Moineau.

So you have diascia growing at your mansion as well, Duke... Yes, that flower was the very one I planted around the graves of those birds. That was the least I could do to atone for their lives...as they only kept being sent to me to measure the strength of my power...
Moineau picked out this watch for me. She said it was so that the two of us could share every moment together... Hehe, she’s surprisingly quite the romantic, that girl.

You want to know about the fire at that vacation estate...? My, word gets to you fast, Duke... Then, I shall tell you. About that fire, and what happened to that departed noblewoman... Oh no, I am simply a common girl named Evelyn. The noblewoman Evelyn certainly did die, on the night of that full moon... Now, let me tell you the tale of a pitiful witch, who wouldn’t allow herself to wake from a dream built of lies...

Listen to this, Duke...! The other day, I had a tea party with Lady Amour. I’ve never had the chance to speak with another noblewoman before, so I’m glad I gathered the courage to ask her to tea. You must be so happy that Lady Amour cares for you so much, Duke. You two have my full support!

I never thought the day would come...when I’d feel pride in being a witch... But, yes...I’m very happy now...! To have met Moineau, and you, Duke. Knowing the two of you has been the greatest happiness of my life. So, please allow me to stay by your side and be of use to you for as long as I can.
Why, I’ll be! Hehe...! Thank you very much.
Regardless of what they may be, gifts always make me happy! I simply must find a way to repay you.
To think my power can be of use to someone... It’s still difficult to believe, even now. Yes...this feels just like a dream...!

Look, Moineau! Do you see how strong I’ve become? I must give the Duke my thanks, don’t you agree? ...“It is still too dangerous, so I must take care to stay behind the others in battle”...? Hehe, if you’re going to worry so much, then you simply need to stay by my side and guard me, Moineau.
I’m surrounded by people who love and care for me... Ahh... What a gentle daydream this is... If this truly is all a dream, I implore you... Please, don’t ever wake me...

When I lived at that estate, I was always longing... Longing for the day I could be with my family once more... That desire ended as nothing more than a dream. But now, I find these days at your mansion to be just as precious to me.
Was my power of use to you...?!
Oh dear... I suppose there was nothing we could have done, was there...?
I won’t fear this power any longer...!
Hello. Are you here to request a delivery?
I’ve been waiting for you. I have a letter addressed to you, sir. Could you just sign here, please?
It looks like it might rain today. I’ll have to make sure not to get any important letters wet on my route.
I’m sorting some letters right now. Each and every envelope is filled with someone’s precious feelings, so I have to handle them with care.
For some reason, animals have been drawn towards me since I was little. I wonder if they can understand my own feelings better than I can.
You mustn’t push yourself when you’re feeling unwell. After all, if a recipient isn’t in good health, even the most important letters won’t properly reach them.

I was reviewing my delivery routes, but it looks I’ll be able to reach my destination quicker with this shortcut. You must be familiar with your own city, right, sir? I’d like to confirm this path, so could I ask you to guide me?

Happy birthday, sir. I have a letter here, expressing my thanks. I wrote it just for you, so would you be so kind as to read it later? Huh? You’re going to read it...now? Um, certainly, if that’s what you’d like...

My parents...? I don’t think I’m quite ready to talk about them yet... But, someday, when I’ve grown stronger...could I tell you about the time I was able to spend with them...and how much they loved me?

Letters don’t always bring good news. I heard Miss Theodora once couldn’t bring herself to open a certain letter she’d received. But, it turned out she was able to reunite with her old friends after mustering up the courage to read it... I suppose that’s just another mysterious power letters hold.

I received a request to deliver a love letter from one of the witches here. But, just before I’d gone to deliver it, she asked for it back, saying it was “too embarrassing,” after all. It’s become more of a common occurrence than you’d think. It just goes to show that everyone’s entrusting so many important feelings to their letters, aren’t they?

Miss Veela seems to be exchanging letters with her friend, Miss Lou. Whenever she receives a response, Miss Veela always dons such a huge, childlike grin. In fact, she gets so impatient to get her letters, she sometimes goes to Miss Lou’s house to retrieve them herself.

In this country, people often include flowers with their letters, don’t they? When one opens the envelope, they are surprised with the pleasant scent of fresh blossoms... That’s sure to pass on the sender’s feelings. Hehe. ...I was smiling just now? O-Oh, really...?

Would you happen to have time to read something I’ve never shown anyone before...? It’s a letter to my parents, filled with all of my thoughts and feelings that I’d like to share with them. Um... I wonder why...I’m feeling so nervous...
Thank you. I feel a little stronger now.
With this power, I should be able to deliver even more letters.
Some letters contain highly sensitive information. That’s why some mail carriers are authorized to carry weapons.
I can’t say I’ll be much help in a battle, but I’ll always protect any important letters entrusted to me. That’s my job, after all.

Every letter that passes through my hands contains someone’s precious feelings that must be protected... In a way, my job delivering those feelings feels a little similar to your work helping witches.
When I’m with you, I truly feel like I’m able to deliver any letter, no matter what obstacles may get in my way. Would it be too much to ask if I could continue working by your side?
It looks like my deliveries will go smoothly.
My apologies... It looks like today’s delivery...will be late...
Nothing will get in the way of my work.
Wah...! Duke! It’s been a while, hasn’t it?! Are yuh still as hale an’ hearty as always? Oh good, I’m glad to hear it! Um...now then, go on an’ make yerself at home, okay?

I’m always messin’ things up. Like one time, when I tried to cook usin’ mushrooms I’d foraged, it turned out all of ’em were poisonous... Wah...! The mushrooms I foraged yesterday on the mountain nearby looked similar...! I’m gonna go check ’em real quick...!

Oh, Duke...! Um, I’m headin’ to a “manners class” right now. The other day, I started eatin’ some food with my hands instead o’ usin’ a fork ’cause it tasted so good. But, Miss Lillicotte got real mad an’ said, “Such indecency is most unbecomin’ o’ a lady!”... For such a tiny girl, she sure is more prim an’ proper than the likes o’ me...

Back in my village, I was a priestess to the Great Dragon God. I may not have had any other talents to speak of, but I could at least hear the Great Dragon God’s voice! ...Yeah, that’s right! I can still hear their voice, even if I’m far an’ away from the Great Dragon God’s mountain.

Hawawa...! Duke, yuh look deathly pale! F-First, let me get yuh a warm blanket...! ...Wait... If I go grab yuh one, it’ll only get dirty on the way here... Then, I’ll just make medicine for yuh out o’ some medicinal herbs... Uuu, but if I mess up the dose, it’ll end up becomin’ poison...! G-Great Dragon God, help me~...!

Ever since I came here, nothin’ but good things’ve happened! I reunited with Fenrir an’ Cerberus, an’ I even started to like myself a lil’ more...! It’s all thanks to yuh lettin’ me stay here, Duke. Even if I only came here to follow the Great Dragon God’s will...I do hope yuh’ll let me stay by yer side from now on, too...!

Happy birthday, Duke! Now, come ’ere! I prepared a bunch o’ delicious dishes for yuh! There’s mushroom skewers, hearty mushroom soup, creamy mushroom stew... Waaah! Sorry for not noticin’ sooner! Creamy stew an’ soup are too similar, so I should prepare somethin’ different for yuh, huh...!

The mountain I called home back in Lupus was sacred, ’cause it was where the Great Dragon God lived. So whether I was foragin’ for wild plants to eat or drawin’ water from the river, the Great Dragon God was always watchin’ over me!

Hawawa, is that yuh, Great Dragon God?! ...Oh, sorry, Miss Cu Sith...! I thought yuh were the Great Dragon God the first time we met too, didn’t I...? ...“I can just call yuh Cu Sith...?” Hehe, yuh got it, Miss Cu Sith! ...Waaah...! ...Guess it’ll be a while ’til I get the hang of it...

Hawawa, is that yuh, Great Dragon God?! ...Oh, it’s yuh, Petra. Sorry, looks like I was wrong again... “Yuh hate yer horns...?” Well, to me, they look just like the Great Dragon God’s! They’re real pretty, an’ look cool, n’ all! ...Waaah, d-don’t cry, Petra...! ...Wait, yer...thankin’ me? Ehehe, it was no bother at all!

Hawawa, is that yuh, Great Dragon God?! ...No, that isn’t the Great Dragon God...! It’s somethin’ else... Somethin’ wicked, an’ scary...! Duke, that girl over there... Who is she...?! ...“Miss Carmilla”...? How come I feel such a dark aura...comin’ from such a cute girl...?

Maybe it’s ’cause Fran is warm, but there’re tons o’ bugs here yuh just can’t find in the mountains! All of ’em are so big, an’ have a ton o’ legs...! Haaah... What beautiful bugs they are...! I’ll go show ’em to Fenrir n’ Cerberus later, too!

I thought strong people like yuh, Duke, weren’t afraid o’ anythin’... But, I was wrong. I realized that, the strong don’t back down even if they’re scared...’cause there’re people they wanna protect...! Duke... Thank yuh for teachin’ me that! I’m so glad I had the chance to come here an’ meet a person like yuh...!
Wah! No way... Did yuh just give me some power, Duke?! Hawawa...! I’m not worthy of all this...!
Yer givin’ me more power again...?! Thank yuh so much, Duke! Yer power feels just like the sun, an’ just as warm...!
Is it really alright to give me so much power...? Oooh then, I’ll do my best, even if it risks my very life...! ...“There’s no reason to go that far”...? But...! ...Uuu...okay...
Duke, yuh really are kind...! Yuh always make sure I don’t put too much pressure on myself... Since yer always so kind to me...I feel like I can try even harder!

Uuu, I’ve been given such great power from yuh, but...if I can’t move when it matters most...! ...No, I can’t keep worryin’ like this forever! That’s why...! I’ll just keep rememberin’ what yuh taught me, Duke...!
This power is proof of the trust yuh’ve placed in me, Duke. I swear to protect yuh, usin’ all this power yuh’ve given me...! So, make sure to keep yer eyes on me, okay?
This was all thanks to all o’ yuh! ...I-It’s thanks to me, too...? Hehe, I’m glad...!
I wanna be like everyone else...!
There’s no need to push yerself...!

What should I do...? He hasn’t come back yet... Wh-What if he’s in trouble...? Should I...? Yeah, I should just go and look for... AH! Th-There you are, my lord! Thank goodness you’re safe. I-I was really worried... Uuuuu~
Please look at the garden, my lord. The flowers have blossomed so beautifully. I want to share a bit of this happiness with you too. Here you go.

There’s a flower bed in the garden for everyone to plant the kind of flowers they like. It’s always been Freesia, Merlyn, and Granny Rosalie who have been using it. But lately, I’ve been seeing Fenny, Yuni, and Meria coming around to visit... Hehe. The flower bed has certainly gotten a lot more cheerful.
I’m trying out the flower-growing methods written in Dad’s diary. Doing so makes me remember the times Mom and Dad used to teach me... It feels like I’m back reliving those happy moments. Hehe.

If you’re feeling tired, please have some of this herbal tea I made. Today’s batch turned out to be really good. Lately, I’ve been learning how to brew tea from all kinds of people... I...want to brighten up your day after all, my lord... I-I’d be so happy if the tea is to your liking.
My lord, how do I look in this outfit...? I guess, you prefer someone prettier and more mature than someone like me, huh... Huh? You like how cute I look too...? U-Uuuuu~~~~!

Happy birthday, my lord. I took a bunch of my favorite flowers and made a bouquet for you. Here you go... Y-You don’t have to act so happy about it... It’s nothing special, after all... But, even though you always overplay your excitement, seeing you smile so much makes me smile too. Hehehe...
In my heart lies the power of the Curse... I’ve always been scared of it... But, I learned it’s a flower that holds a special place in Mom and Dad’s hearts, so it doesn’t scare me anymore.

Armstrong helped me tend to the garden. She said it was her very first time planting flowers, and that she had a lot of fun. At first, I thought she looked kind of scary, but...hehe. There’s no way anyone who likes flowers could be bad, right?

Fia scares me a bit since she’s not very talkative, but she always takes care of the flower that’s pinned to her chest... I’m sure she likes flowers... So, I found one that I think would be the perfect match for her. I wonder if she’ll like it...

I’m going to meet a bunch of the other girls later, and we’re going to make sweets out of flowers together. The sweets are really pretty, so once they’re done, I’ll be sure to share some with you, my lord.
U-Um... I’m really happy that you always worry about me, my lord...but you’re always with me... I-If some kind of rumor about us starts spreading, I’m sure it’s going to cause you a lot of trouble...

U-Um, what are your favorite flowers, my lord? I was thinking, it would be nice if I liked the same flowers as you do... Hehe. We could talk about them together, grow them together, go out on strolls together... Oh, if I could spend every day like that with you, my lord...I would be so happy.
Thank you for everything that you do for me.
You’re giving me so much... I’m so happy.
Other than my love for flowers, I don’t have any real strong suit... And yet, you’ve always been there for me, and it gave me the strength to push forward.
You’ve helped me so much, my lord, but I haven’t been able to repay any of your kindness... If you give me any more, I won’t even know how I could possibly return the favor.
Only after watering flowers, tending to them, and showering them with lots of love every day do they blossom beautifully. Just like how I am now, right? Hehe.

My lord, you always wish for our happiness instead of your own. That’s why I like you. Thank you so much for everything. ...Ah! Wh-When I say I like you, I don’t mean it in that way... Um, I-I mean... Uuuuu...!
These flowers have blossomed so beautifully. Would you accept them?
I guess...they didn’t like flowers, did they...
A bouquet of cheer, just for you.
Ah~ Duke! Let’s A.T. again today~
Hm? Wait, has it been a while since we last saw each other~? Then, I guess I should say, welcome back~
What kind of place will you take me to today~?

Oooo, this is new~! Oh, Duke~! Huh~? What am I reading? Why, a map, of course! A map of a world that isn’t mine...! All worlds really are big, aren’t they~? There’re still so many places lil’ Eureka has yet to discover~♪

What happened the day I set out on my journey? Mmmm... Nothing really happened in particular. I just left a letter that said, “I’ll be setting out on a journey to complete my map. Don’t bother looking for me.” Then, I just went off on my merry way, wherever the wind took me~ ...Huh? That’s not a journey, it’s running away from home...?

Oh, what’s this? Are you a lil’ sleepy one today~? When your eyes start feeling heavy, you should just do nothing and stare off into space~ That way, your head will get all empty~... Nrgh... Now I’m feeling like a lil’ sleepy Eureka... Mm...

I have a ton of super fun stuff written down in my travel diary~! I mean, if I wrote the bad stuff, it’d be no fun to reread, right? Hehe, I’ll write down a lot of stuff about you, too, Duke. So, keep adventuring with me lots and lots, okay~?
Duke~, happy birthday~! Your present from me is a map of the inside of your mansion~ Oh, or would you have preferred some grilled cactus? But, you know...I don’t like cactus very much...

Hehe~♪ Just a bit ago, Milla let me hear aaaall about her travels~ She mentioned so many routes I never even knew about...! With this, I’ve gotten one step closer to completing the map of my world~ I’m so happy...! Hehe! Now, whose stories should I listen to next~?

Adventurer Eureka’s big dream is making maps of all the different worlds out there~! I don’t know much about demons or anything, but what I do know is, as long as I’m with you, Duke, I can go to all kinds of new worlds! So, let’s A.T. lots and lots~ What’s A.T.? It means, “adventure together”~ ’Cause saying the whole thing’s a pain. ...Huh? But, I just said it anyway...?

Lately, there’s a lil’ someone I’ve gotten close to~ What was their name again...? Oh, right, Prean! They’re always so cool, saying stuff like, “I’ll be the one to protect my princess!” They even call me a “funny girl”... Hm? Why’re you acting so shocked?

Fenny works so hard and so fast~ She’s really something~ I just take it easy-peasy lemon-squeezy, so I could never rush around like that... But Fenny is Fenny, and I’m Eureka~ I have my own special pace just for me, so it’s no big deal, right~?

While I was on my big adventure, my world was attacked by an army of demons... I was saved by some army members pretty quickly, but...I’m sure there were lots of people they didn’t reach in time... But, that’s just all the more reason I should do everything I can now as a survivor, though, right?

I am an adventurer, so it would be nice if I could make my journey go faster... But well, it’s not like there’s any real rush... If you’re here, Duke, then I think I’ll take a little detour and stick around with you all a bit longer~ As long as I’m with you, I feel like I can have a ton of fun new adventures anyway~! So, A.T. a lot more with me, okay~?
Whoa~... My body’s bursting with power~!
Let’s take it slow as we head for new frontiers~
There’s so much power inside me that I never knew about... The world sure is full of surprises~

I’m gonna keep going at my own pace, so don’t push yourself too much either, Duke~ ...Hm~? I only meant I’ll get stronger slowly over time, so there’s no need to force yourself to match me. I want you to go at your own pace too~... Oh, so you’re not pushing yourself? Then I guess there’s nothing to worry about!

My journey’s still got a long, long way to go~ There’ve been lots of hurdles along the way... But, until I complete my maps of each world, A.T. with me just a liiittle longer~ I’ll help you out with my power lots too~! Hehe~ Just leave it to me!

The great adventurer Eureka... In the shadow of her epic journey, there was another pretty great hero who saved the adventurer’s world~...! ...What, this? It’s the last page of my travel diary~! I was just thinking I should write down all my adventures with you too~ So, you have to join me on my journey until I see the farthest corners of each world, got it~?
Yaaaay~! Now we can blaze a trail to our next destination~
Hey Mister, over here! Yay, you made it! Alright, we got a fun day of shopping ahead of us. Let’s get started!
Ah, you’re late, Mister! Didn’t you promise to go shopping with me?! As punishment, you’re gonna carry aaaall the stuff we buy, okay?
The city’s buzzing with people everywhere! It’s so fun, isn’t it?
Ah! Mister! You made me wait for so long, I ended up making so many of these little snowmen... Hehe, I’m not mad at you. After all, I had plenty of fun even while waiting for you.

Oh, you’re asking about my bear earmuffs? Hehe, that’s right! My big sis gave them to me as a present. Aren’t they the cutest? I can feel my big sis’s love packed into these earmuffs, because when I put them on, they make me all warm and cozy!
Huh? Are you feeling tired, Mister? Me too—I’m tired from all the walking. Why don’t we take a break at the shop over there? I hear they’ve got some yummy bread. C’mon, let’s go!

Are you feeling cold, Mister? Ah, you’re not wearing any gloves, are you?! Well, I can’t just leave you like that, can I... Hold on, I’ll warm you right up. Hehehe~♪ My big sis gave me these mittens, and thanks to them, my hands are nice and warm~!

Hey Mister! Happy birthday! Hehehe~ Don’t worry—I made sure to get you a present. ...Tada! It’s a bear-shaped cupcake. I made it just for you. And if you like, I brought some tea to go along with it. So please, dig in~!
With us going shopping together like this, it kind of feels like we’re on a date, don’t you think?

My big sis can’t really handle places with big crowds...but I’m glad she looked like she was having fun at the party. That made all the planning worth it. All that said... Hah...she was absolutely gorgeous at the party...

Oh, Mister! Can we take a small detour? I heard there’s a really nice shop around here that has delicious tea... Hehehe~♪ I wanna buy some to go with the bread I’m bringing to the next tea party my big sis, Theodora, and I are having. Nothing goes better with bread than good tea, after all~!

On the Holy Night, it’s customary to give someone special to you a present as a way of showing gratitude, right? My big sis is special to me, of course...but that doesn’t mean there’s only one special person in my life. Hehehe...

You’re saying I look warm and cozy? Hehe~ Of course! I’m bundled up in everything my big sis gave me, you know. These earmuffs she got me for my Holy Night present...and even these mittens and scarf she made herself. Each piece is filled with her love, and that’s what makes me all warm and cozy!

Hey, Mister! Here you go! This is my Holy Night present for you. The Holy Night is when you give a present to someone special, right? Hehe! Well, you’re special to me too, Mister... Hehehe♪ Did I surprise you? I hope you look forward to opening it and seeing what’s inside!
Who’s even more fired up and ready to go? Me, that’s who!
I gotta grow even stronger! So I can be with my big sis forever!

Thank you, Mister! With this, I’ll be able to protect my...no. I’ll be able to fight alongside my big sis! Forget simply protecting each other, or waiting around to be protected. We both can do more than that now. Hehehe~!

Even when the days are cold, you’ve got nothing to worry about. After all, I’m the bright sun that shines down on you, my big sis—everyone! At least, I try to be... Huh? You agree with me...? C-C’mon, Mister... Don’t make me blush like that! Hehehe.

Big Sis has given me loads of presents over the years. My stuffed bear, these earmuffs, mittens...along with tons and tons of love... I need to make sure I can give back just as much as she’s given to me! So, I’ll be counting on you even more from here on out, Mister!
Hehehe♪ This’s what we do best after all, right, Big Sis?
U-Umm... Does this outfit...look strange on me...?
Ah, my lord! Th-Thank goodness... I couldn’t find you anywhere, so I thought I’d gotten the date of the party wrong again... Aaah, I’m so glad I found you...
Sol made this scarf just for me. Hehe, it’s so warm and cozy... I’ll treasure it for the rest of my life...

Oh, look at all this bread. I see a small bun shaped like a bear, a sandwich filled with lots of vegetables, and even a sandwich packed with plenty of fruit and cream... Maybe for someone with a sweet tooth? Hehe, I can’t believe my eyes, Sol. You really went above and beyond, didn’t you?
Sol was the one who planned the party tonight. Hehe! ...She told me, “I wanted to make lots of fun memories with you, Big Sis!” ...Oh Sol, she really is the best sister ever... Hehehe...!

You don’t look too good, my lord... Ah! If you’re tired, why don’t we step away from the party for a little bit? Being around so many people can be quite exhausting, after all... A-And, there’s something I want to give you...!
Umm, I heard the Holy Night is a special time that you spend with someone special... But, are you really okay spending it with someone like me...?
Happy birthday, my lord. This time, I made sure to write down a memo so I wouldn’t get the date wrong again. Here’s your present... AH! ...I forgot it in my room...! It was all ready to go too...

Everyone’s helping prepare for the party, huh? I wonder if there’s something I can do too... Oh, I know. I can carry this plate of meat! ...Ah, you’re going to take it for me, Sol? I see. Thank you... Umm, then I’ll take this...huh? You’re going to do that for me, my lord? U-Ummm, then...is there anything I can help with...?

When we were children, Sol and I once got presents on the Holy Night. The night before, Sol and I were in bed waiting so excitedly, wondering what kind of presents we’d get, and before we knew it, we had fallen fast asleep... Hehe. That sure takes me back.

Oh, you’re asking about this dress? I was in such a rush and didn’t have much time, so Priscilla and the others helped me put it on. ...Still, though, I don’t think this kind of outfit really looks good on...huh? I look...pretty, you say? Who? M-ME?! I-I’m sorry... Ah...I mean, hearing that makes me so happy...
A while back, I was too scared to sleep because I was so afraid of that dream... But lately, that dream has all but gone away. I have Sol and you, my lord, to thank for that.

I forgot to mention it, but when I was this close to giving up on making Sol’s present, a strange girl appeared in my room. She encouraged me not to give up...and thanks to her, I managed to get it ready on time. But, she didn’t seem like a friend of Sol’s... Is she an acquaintance of yours, my lord?

Ummm, here...! Tonight’s when you give a present to someone you cherish, right...? It’s not much, but I tried knitting some gloves for you... You’re always there, taking care of me, so...I’d be happy if you accepted them... Ah! It’s embarrassing to watch you open the present right in front of me, so please open it later...
I’m sorry... You went and did this all for someone like me...
I’m so...warm... It’s like I could feel your heart...
I want to do something too... Something only a big sister can do...
Th-Thank you... Yes...Sol told me that you’d be happier if I said, “Thank you” instead of, “I’m sorry...”
I’m no good at whatever I do, and I fail at just about everything...but getting a gift for Sol was the one thing I didn’t want to give up on...

Because of the way I am, I must’ve caused you so much trouble... Hehe. But of course, that’s something you’re not worried about, right? Thank you. I’m really happy you were the one who came and saved me.
Maybe I can make it to the party on time now!
I’m sorry... I knew I shouldn’t have gotten too excited about the party... I’m so sorry...
Heeello, helloooo~! I’m always here watching over the path you’re all walking together, Young Master.

Stopping in place can also be part of a journey at times. So, I won’t say anything about you taking a break. Get plenty of rest, and once you feel better, you can show me your journey with everyone again!

I just can’t get enough of seeing everyone working their hardest! You guys are always doing your best around the clock, so I’m simply obsessed with not only you, Young Master, but everyone else here, too!

I’d only ever planned on watching over Illya from afar... But, things have changed now. Oh, there’s no need to worry though! I won’t interfere in her decision in any way. Regardless of what she may choose in the end, I’ll respect her will.

I heard that Valeriede, Sophia, and Rosalie are all teachers of a sort as well. The four of us all got fired up talking about how important it is to love your own students... But, everyone insisted their students were the cutest, and refused to back down...! Hehe! Everyone’s so naïve! It goes without saying that my pupils are the cutest, after all. You agree with me, right?

If you’re tired, you should rest too, Young Master! Come on, there’s no need to hold back—get over here! You work so hard all the time, you deserve some praise. So, let me spoil you a little! There—what a good duke you are!

I can see the hidden power lying within everyone around me. But, that’s all I can do. I can only give people trying their hardest a slight push on the back at best. Since you can support everyone while walking alongside them, you’re much more worthy of praise, Young Master!

Happy birthdaaaay! Since you’re always working so hard, Young Master, I’ll give you a celebratory hug as your present!♪ Nowww, don’t be shyyy~! Ah...! Oh, come now... There’s nothing to be embarrassed about!

Fenrir is so small, but holds so much bravery in her heart...! She really, really did her best, didn’t she...? Uuu...! When I imagine little Fenrir trying her hardest for her sister, I can’t stop my tears from flowing out...! I just want to pet that tiny head of hers over and over...!

All of the girls here at your mansion are cute, but Illya is by far the cutest, don’t you think? Bearing a destiny more cruel than anyone’s, she’s encountered countless hardships, but still continues to face her fate head-on in her own way... Illya was adorable as a child too, but she’s still cute as a button even now!

Keep going! There’s only a liiittle more to go...! ...Ahhh, she tripped! But, wow! She was able to keep from crying...! ...Yay! She made it! ...Ah! Were you...watching me just now...? Ahaha, that’s embarrassing... Seeing such a small child carry something so big, I just couldn’t help but cheer them on... I was even moved to the point of tears!

Angels take the word of their creator, God, as absolute guiding principles for their behavior. So, while those who contract with an angel gain the power of God Himself, they’re also forced to follow the will of the angel they contract with in exchange. In other words, they become just another one of God’s slaves.

Demons don’t have an object of worship. That’s why, even if you become an acolyte, there’s no need to follow anyone’s orders. In exchange, you simply become a slave to your own free will. There’s no need to hold back from whatever you may desire. In fact, all a demon needs from you is... Wait, what was I talking about again? Hmm... Well, whatever!

None of you give up, even when facing the end of the world itself. You all continue to fight despite your fear. I believe that’s the most noble effort a person could ever make! So, until you all reach the end of your journey, will you let me keep watching over you? I just know it will turn into a most wonderful sight to behold!
Huh... So this is how it feels to get stronger.
Interesting, verrrry interesting... So this is how you’ve been giving everyone power then, huh?
A witch’s power comes from the heart...? Huh, so that’s how you all are thinking about it nowadays.
If you ever want more power for yourself, Young Master, all you have to do is ask! For you, I’d grant whatever you desire in a heartbeat!

I get the feeling I also desired power like this for myself once... But, the details are pretty fuzzy whenever I try to remember. Though, since I’m able to help everyone as I currently am, I guess it doesn’t really matter now, huh?

Regardless of what path you choose to travel, Young Master, I won’t tell you it’s the wrong one to walk. So don’t worry what anyone else thinks, and just choose the path that feels most right to you. No matter what happens, I’ll always be on your side, after all!
An instructor’s gotta show off sometimes!
We did it! Seeing everyone try their best out on the battlefield made this instructor pleased as punch!
Defeat isn’t all bad. It only shows how much more you can grow from here!
Ah...! Duke! It’s a relief to see you again... I was worried something may have happened to you. I’m just glad to see you’re all right.
Migratory birds don’t stop in just one place. They spread their wings, and travel far and wide. I’ll do my best not to lose to them!

Oh, I apologize for spacing out, Duke... I was just gazing out the window. It just looks and feels so similar to what I’d see outside the window of the house I lived in with Gran, I couldn’t help myself... Despite this being a whole different world and country, it’s strange that it can still make me feel so nostalgic, don’t you think?

The truth is, I was once on the verge of death, when Miss Rustica’s friend...Miss Aura, saved me. Lady Rosalie said that, since I’d been given a piece of Miss Aura’s power before, it activated in that moment, and became my power as a witch. I’m not sure what really happened that day, but the idea of being given her power is like inheriting a family quilt. It’s quite a lovely thought, wouldn’t you say?
Duke. I just made some hot cocoa, so please have some if you’d like. Also...take care to rest so you don’t push yourself to the breaking point, okay...? I’ll help with anything too if you need it!

The weather today was good, so I washed your bedding together with Monica. It all got really soft, so it should feel very cozy to sleep on! I also put a pouch of dried flowers by your pillow to help you sleep better. If the scent is too strong for you, I’ll go change it, so just let me know!

Happy birthday, Duke...! My present for you is, um...a handkerchief I embroidered a bluebird onto... I’m sorry it’s such a simple gift... You’re so kind, Duke, that I just want you to be happy... You are? Hehehe, I’m glad!

I only became a witch recently, but I’ll do my best to become someone you can all rely on some day! I’m good at things like laundry, cooking, cleaning, sewing... Uuu... But, saying that makes me feel...like I’m not actually all that reliable here, huh...? I-I’ll go run around the garden a little to help build some muscle up!

Miss Rustica may seem cold, but she’s actually a very kind and caring person! Oh, I know! Just think of her as a slightly larger than average cat... Ah! P-Please keep it a secret from Miss Rustica that I compared her to a cat! Pinky swear you won’t...?

What are my favorite foods...? Um...maybe porridge...? I used to eat it a lot with Gran... It’s also really good when you add honey or dried fruits on top too...! Other than that... I suppose I also like herb tea and salads made from medicinal plants...? Hmm... I don’t think I’ve ever thought about what foods I like before...

Gran made a lot of gifts for me using her power as a witch. This bluebird brooch is one of those gifts. It seems to be based on a species of migratory bird, though I don’t know its exact name... But, bluebirds are nice, aren’t they? They’re a symbol of good luck, so looking at this brooch makes me feel hopeful that something good will happen.

I heard that Miss Freesia also lived together with her grandmother! But, when Miss Freesia talked about her, she looked like she was trying to hold back tears... We both got a little teary-eyed then. The day after, she gave me a freesia flower as thanks for our conversation, but... What do you think would be a good gift in return...?

It probably isn’t good to drown in one’s sadness... But, I still want people to know it’s okay to feel sad. You don’t have to hold back your tears. It’s okay to let everything pour out, and then move forward. ...If you ever feel like you want to cry, Duke, please tell me. I’ll stay right by your side, as long as you need me.
Th-Thank you very much! I’ll do my best to be of use to you!
...I’m starting to worry if I can really contribute enough as I am... Uuu... I hope I can...
I can’t stay worried forever, can I? Yeah, it’ll be okay. I can do this...
Am I being of use to everyone? I’m worried if I’m doing all of this right or not... If I’m not doing enough, please don’t hesitate to let me know, okay?
You’re always doing so much for me, Duke, but I... I need to work even harder!

Duke, thank you so much for all that you do for me...! I don’t have much experience in battle, so I’m usually just doing my best not to get in everyone else’s way... But, I’ll do everything in my power to stand beside you all without bringing you guys down! Please, let me keep fighting by your side as long as I’m of use to you!
Duke, are you hurt anywhere...? ...I’m glad to hear you’re unharmed...!
Uuu... I’m sorry... If I had only tried a little harder...
I just want to protect everyone...!
If you’re going to hurt my friends...!
I’ve awaited your return, my lord. All is prepared on my end. Please summon me when ’tis time to depart for battle.

Are you setting out, my lord? Very well, you shall have me as your companion. You’re truly admirable for surveying your domain so diligently. ’Tis clear to me why none ever question your place as Duke.
Ah... Why, hello, my lord. There’s nothing quite as invigorating as training at sunrise, wouldn’t you say? Care to join me? We can start off with 1000 swings of the great katana.

I finally bestowed a name unto my great katana—“Winter’s Bloom.” ’Tis a tribute to that lone flower amidst the snow, and shall serve as a reminder of the wisdom you imparted upon me that day, my lord.
My lord, I urge you to take a moment to rest. As we say, “The indigo dyer need also imbue their own garments with color.” In other words, please care for yourself as much as you do for others.

To think that you’ve not only granted me a place at your side, but also guidance on how to live... You’ve truly given me more kindness than I can ever repay. Thus, I vow to do so in full—till the day I’m ushered in as a guest of the realm beyond...

Is today the day of your birth, my lord? Such a truly joyous occasion! May I be so bold as to offer a dance in celebration? Hmmm... Though, I do recall performing a dance for you before. Very well—what would you say to a sword dance instead?

Thanks to you and everyone here, I’ve become well-acquainted with the ways of this land. I’m still ill at ease with your “knife” and “fork”... But as we say, “Steady drops wear away the stone.” I vow to prove victorious against the knife and fork.

Miss Claudia was coughing, yet she smiled as she spoke of how she wields her swords to etch proof of her existence. To outshine her family’s founder. My homeland saw many a samurai brave affliction to etch their names into history. Thus, I’ve no doubt that Miss Claudia will succeed.

Miss Ophelia’s blade is a sight like no other. Each movement, a kaleidoscope of elegance and luster—unmatched perfection in all its facets. She’s the first whose blade I find myself wishing to gaze upon without end.

Miss Luke’s blade epitomizes strength in simplicity—a mirror of her honest nature. And...though a woman, she brandishes the techniques of men. As bold as I may sound, I do feel a sense of kinship with her... Hopefully Miss Luke and I can one day sit down and enjoy a nice heart-to-heart.

Zivard... Though a different world, its resemblance to my homeland is striking. Especially when it comes to its people’s attire. While we have no magic crystals to seal fearsome spirits in, I’ve heard many a tale of some sealed within our shrines.

Till this day, I’ve honed this blade for my own sake... For I’d wished to earn a place in my family through the recognition of my father and brothers. Though ’twas all but a fleeting dream...I bear no regrets. The flower blooming amidst the snow that day revealed where my final abode shall be. I’m not without my flaws...but please allow me to serve you, for as long as I still have breath in me.
Oh my... It appears my power has grown.
As your blade, I pledge to keep honing my edge.
I shall take this power you’ve bestowed upon me, my lord, and wield it with all my might on the battlefield.
To have earned your favor fills me with boundless joy and gratitude. Though, a small part of me does worry if I’ll ever encounter this much fortune again.
You have my deepest gratitude. My life, my great katana—all are yours... I shall stand by your side till my last petal falls, my lord.

I’m overwhelmed with gratitude, for as we say, “The flower one most desires sits at the highest treetop...” Seeking strength alone left me tethered to the ground. ’Tis solely thanks to you, my lord, that I was able to reach these new heights.
Your commands were brilliantly executed, my lord.
I can’t bear to show my face. If only I hadn’t been so careless...
...Hey. If you’re going to be gone long, let Tillie know first. She’s been on edge this whole time, wondering when you’d be back.
I have no intention of getting close to you. My life is devoted to the sole purpose of protecting Tillie. Nothing more, nothing less.
For a duke, you sure have a lot of time on your hands. Don’t you have anything better to do than exchange pleasantries with me?

What, this bird? Back in the cemetery, it must’ve mistook me for some kind of statue, perching on my shoulder. But, it hasn’t left my side since. ...Rather than stick with me, you should fly free, and go where you wish. You’re the one with wings, after all...

What’s with that sorry look on your face? You should already know how long and perilous the path you’ve chosen is. If you’re going to complain now, why not just quit? ...Well, not that I think you’ll listen anyway.

...Hey, be a little more cautious, will you? Don’t just trust anyone you meet with a sob story. Just watching you gets on my nerves. Really... You’re like a chick mistaking every bird for its mother. Be more careful about who you trust, alright? I won’t be the one to bail you out if you get hurt some day. You...trust me? Haah... Your ability to win people over certainly resembles Aura, at least...

The girls around here are all squawking a bit louder today. Did something happen? It’s your birthday? Oh, is that all? Unfortunately for you, I didn’t prepare any gifts. But, I won’t say sorry. Instead, I’ll let you have a sparring match with me. Oh? Don’t be scared. I’ll hold back just enough that your life will be spared. So, come on. Take out that staff of yours, great Duke.

Bubbles that melt all they touch... That Curse was wreaking havoc on my world. Hmph... Well, what happened makes sense to me. A world like that, fraught with nothing but strife, probably deserved to melt away into nothing... But, even in such a good-for-nothing world, there were girls who would stop at nothing to save their friends. Well, not that those girls had it easy or anything... The kindest among us always get hurt the most...

Tillie, stop pulling my sleeve like that... If there’s something you want to say, just say it. ...Stop being mean to the Duke? I’ve done nothing of the sort. Besides, aren’t you the one who compared me to a cat the other day? Care to explain yourself? ...Cats are cute, so it’s not mean...? ...Good grief. The things you come up with...

Rean, was it? If you don’t want to lose someone precious to you, it’s vital not to give up—you have to keep moving forward. Hmph... But, can’t put much stock in the words of one who couldn’t even protect their closest friend, now can you...? ...Sorry. I was just talking to myself. Forget I said anything.

You’re a real gravekeeper, so calling myself as such in front of you leaves a bad taste in my mouth. A gravekeeper is one who protects the eternal rest of the dead. A self-righteous fool who fears being left alone, so much they deny their only friend a peaceful death, doesn’t count. Someone such as yourself, who buried not only your friends and family, but even those who persecuted you, is far more befitting of the title.

In my world, there’s a place called the City of Graves. It’s the final resting place for witches who escaped persecution. Aura rests there as well. If I die, bury me beside her. ...Don’t get any ideas. I said if. And don’t you dare say a word of this to Tillie. A girl her age having to mourn yet another loss... I can’t let that happen.

Having this many witches stay in your mansion... Did you not stop and think if you had enough food to feed all these girls before reaching out to them? You may be a duke, but surely there’s a limit to your personal assets, right? ...“That’s no reason not to save people”...? Right... I almost forgot that pesky nature of yours for a moment. That you’re as self-sacrificial as martyrs come...
Don’t get any ideas. You’re the one choosing to do this, so don’t expect anything out of me.
I’m fine as I am now. If you’re in the mood to share your power, give it to the others here.
...My blade is for protecting Tillie. Just because you’re gifting me power doesn’t mean I’ll pay you back.
...I already told you my blade isn’t for you, but it seems words don’t get through to you. ...It’s a waste of breath to keep repeating myself. Do as you wish.
...Hey. I told you to do as you wish, but I didn’t tell you to go this far. ...You’re only doing what I said, so I shouldn’t worry about it...? You can be surprisingly stubborn, you know that?

...The longer you do this, the more I feel like nothing but a common thief... I guess you’ve won me over. I’ll pay you back for all the power you’ve given me out on the battlefield. That’ll make us even, so don’t hold your breath—you won’t get a thank you out of me.
Do you really have to get so excited over every little thing?
Tch... Damn it...! Did I let my guard down too much?
Burn with the smoke of the pyre...!
Oh, welcome back! I made sure to keep a strict guard over the mansion while you were gone! Hehe♪ This is only a fraction of what I can do!
...! You never came back, so I was worried sick... If you’re gonna be late, you’ve gotta report it first! Got that?
I can’t let myself hold Leader Lucille back! You better do your best not to trip her up too, okay?

No enemies spotted in the perimeter... The coast’s all clear...! Huh? You want to know what I’m doing? I’m scouting the area—duh! You never know when or where an enemy might pop up, after all. If anyone suspicious comes along, I’ll be locked and loaded, ready to fire...! “Don’t walk around the mansion pointing my gun?” But why?!

In my world, witches and humans live in two separate territories. Long ago, witches led a rebellion against humans, and as a result...the two groups have lived divided ever since. But, witches can awaken to their powers at any time. So, if a witch happens to be born on the human’s side... Well, you don’t need me to spell it out for you, right...?

Hey, are you okay? You’ve got some major bags under your eyes... If there’s anything I can do to take something off your plate, just say the word! Hehe, it’s not every day I’m willing to follow the orders of someone besides Leader Lucille, so speak now or forever hold your peace!

The only leader for me is Miss Lucille. That’ll never change. So, you’ll never be my leader... But, I do trust you, which means I do see you as a friend... I mean, you’re the human Miss Lucille placed her trust in, after all.

Wait, it’s your birthday?! I-I’m sorry...! I didn’t prepare a single thing... Wh-What should I... Oh, I know! Why don’t we go on a birthday outing together? Memories are the most precious gift of all, as they say...! Ah, but, before that... Happy birthday!
Nebra was always so kind, and yet she... Are the demons to blame? The Witch Hunt? Or...was everything because of what I said that day...?

Even if you try to shorten Miss Lucille’s name, there’s no way to do it! Hehe, it’s the perfect kind of name for my savior, my queen! ...Huh? It can be shortened to Lucy, or even Lucy-Lou...? So there are nicknames I can give her...! Miss Lucille really does have the perfect name...!

“Witches should just live with other witches...” Those words twisted the fates of many people. Not just Leader Lucille’s and Nebra’s... A lot of people’s futures were...! If I hadn’t said such a thing, then maybe...

Leader Lucille and Nebra were always together...always, as if they were one and the same... I’m sure the two of them need one another, being irreplaceable in each other’s hearts... Someone like me, who could only ever chase after Leader Lucille’s shadow, never had a chance of being what Nebra was to her...

When we were under attack by those cursed bubbles, I was forced to make a difficult choice on my own for the first time. I never realized how terrifying it was to make such a choice... If I’d picked wrong, many lives would’ve been lost... So, Leader Lucille had been fighting against such fears all on her own this whole time...

I’d always said I trusted Leader Lucille’s judgement, but really, I was just depending on her... Deep down, though, a part of me knew how much of a burden that was on her, yet I still... I’m going to change myself. I won’t just chase after others anymore. I’ll work hard so I can proudly call myself Leader Lucille’s friend!
Did I get a bit more cool just now?
Hehe! With this, I’ll be just like Leader Lucille in no time...!
I won’t just push everything on to Leader Lucille, chasing after her like some lost puppy anymore! I’ll decide my future on my own. Otherwise, I won’t be able to call myself Leader Lucille’s friend!

My words created an even deeper rift between humans and witches...and caused Leader Lucille and Nebra to break ties... That’s why, I’m sometimes too scared to say what I really think... But, I still need to decide things for myself...! I need to pave the road to my future with my own two hands. So, even if I’m afraid, I still have to make my choice!

Someone like me who only ever followed after Leader Lucille can never truly stand by her side. The only one who can is... I’ll be all right. These feelings alone are all I need to do my best for Leader Lucille. If those two can one day stand side by side again, just like before...that’s...enough for me.

Always following after someone else and nodding along to whatever they think... I’m through with that now. I’ll pave the way to the path I believe in with my own power. Otherwise, I won’t be able to show my face to Leader Lucille anymore!
We did it! This’s our victory!
Ugh... I can’t face Leader Lucille after that...
Have a taste of my power!
Ah, Mister Duke... Er... W-Welcome back... Um...I-I hope you’ve been...well...?
I’ve got to keep it together and not stand in everyone’s way...! Uuu...but I’m still scaaared~!

Laaa...! Oh, Mister Duke... I was just warming up. My power deals with words, so I have to take care of my voice. That’s why sometimes I practice alone like this...since I don’t really have anyone to talk with. Otherwise, I just might forget how to use my voice...

...I’m sorry! I know I have to give it my all and fight, but I always just end up suppressing my power... Huh? I’m fine just the way I am? Oh, you...you sound just like my teacher... No, don’t worry about it... Thank you very much, Mister Duke.

It looks like you have a lot on your plate... If I commanded you to rest, you really would... But, no! That’d only defeat the purpose of taking a break, just like my teacher told me before... Using force is a big no-no! On another note, if I asked you to please rest...would you listen to me?

You’re so different from my teacher, but similar in some ways. Like how you continue to believe in me even after all my mistakes...or tell me I’m fine just the way I am. Not to mention...the way I feel at ease when I’m around you...and stuff...

H-Happy birthday... Oh, this...? Back in the village, it was customary to prepare pouches of dried flowers... It’s my first time gifting one, so I’m not sure if I did a very good job... Huh? You appreciate the thought? I-It was nothing, really... Hehehe.

I’m able to harness the power of words. Whatever I say becomes reality... I know it must sound like a dream, but the truth is, I can’t control my power. I wouldn’t get too close if I were you... I’m sure you’ll also... Never mind... I shouldn’t say any more, huh?

In my village, it was customary to help each other in any way we could. Like controlling the weather to help grow crops... That’s why everyone counted on me to help out, too... But...I couldn’t live up to their expectations.

This is a hat...a magic hat given to me by my teacher... When I put it on, it lends me confidence and courage. I didn’t believe it myself at first...but this hat’s never let me down. It’s a heartwarming comfort...like my teacher’s right there, encouraging me.

Yuni lived in the woods for quite a bit, so it might take her a while to get used to the city. I also grew up deep in a forest, so there are so many things I’ve never seen before... I should go explore and learn more about city life together with Yuni and Rusalka. For example...macarons are food, not soap!!

Stella’s Sovereign Shield? Bow-wow-WOW...? I suppose naming your skills is convenient... But since my power uses words, I should consider some more proper vocabulary... Ah...! N-Not that there’s anything wrong with Stella and Chiffon’s skills’ names! I...er...I...!

Just like my teacher, you told me I’m fine just the way I am. But to tell the truth, I don’t think I should stay like this. I can’t just hide behind others forever... I’ve got to get stronger on my own. Because one day, I want to pass this hat on to someone else...once I become a respectable adult, like my teacher.
Now will I be able to control my power?
A witch’s power comes from the heart, so confronting my power means facing my own heart... And if this power comes from my heart, I have to face it head-on... That’s what my teacher told me.

Whenever I’m scared, I pull my hat down just a little tighter. And if I feel nervous, I remember your light... I’m always just being protected, you know? But, I believe one day I’ll be able to take off this hat. Until then, I need to keep it together.

Stella taught me a bunch of new incantations! I’m sure a few of them should be useful to you. Well, here goes... “O-O...Dark Servant...of the A-Abyss...I c-call upon th-thee...” I’m sorry. I don’t know why, but I feel a little foolish...

Words are meant to convey your feelings to another’s heart... My teacher said many such kind words to me, filled with understanding and compassion... Now it’s my turn to pass them on...magic words that lend courage to another!
I-I’m glad...I didn’t get in the way this time...
I-I’m so sorry! It was all my fault...wasn’t it?
It’s going to get a little chilly~!
For my big sister, I swear I’ll...
Must be nice, being able to lounge around like this. Unlike us, you get to live longer, yet you waste your limited time so carelessly. Very human of you.

You know, I was created to inherit all of my big sister A.A.’s power and skill. Catch my drift? Then instead of offering me tea, hop to it and hand over your finest magic crystals. Isn’t that what you humans call manners?
Oh, dear sister! May I accompany you to school again today? ...And what are you smirking for? Don’t you have work to do or something?

Since I’m simply surrounded by witches, I guess I have no choice but to interact with them in order to learn more about the human heart. It looks like they’re holding a cooking class today...but when it comes to cooking, can’t you just follow the recipe? What’s the point of practicing?

It’s your prerogative if you want to work yourself to death, but do me a favor and let me know beforehand. I’ll try to salvage whatever organic parts I can transfer to my sister, while you’re still alive.

You humans are such weak and foolish creatures...but I can’t deny some individuals do have their merits. Even pesky bugs can be useful in the right environments. Is this what it means when people say it’s about how you use the tools you’re given?

Today’s the day you were born? And that’s means for celebration? I don’t really get it, but if it’ll help me understand humans more, I suppose I can play along. It’s just like you humans to fuss over such useless things, right? ...So, here... What? If you don’t want it, you can just throw it away, okay?

Whenever my big sister talks about her past, she always smiles a little. Just a tiny bit...but I can’t stand it. Knowing I wasn’t there for those moments, I feel left behind, or just...empty. Just what is this...in my heart...?

Sustenance is required to provide nutrients and preserve life. The flavor shouldn’t matter...or so I thought. ...Well, you know it’s just like you humans to add meaningless flair to things like this. Yeah, that’s it.

So there is such a thing as an immortal witch, isn’t there? With her power, I could save my sister... I’ll do a bit of research and prepare for a dissection at once! ...And why can’t I? She’s immortal, isn’t she?
I heard Mother died once...then, she transferred her memories into a different homunculus body. Unfortunately, we don’t have the facilities to make any more, so we can’t repeat the past.

Names are nothing more than identifiers, so feel free to call me by my serial number, designated ID, or whatever. “Little D?” ...Only my mother and sister are allowed to call me that. Pull that again, and I’ll end you.

Your relentless optimism and irrational aversion to planning are so foolish... Though, I can’t help but feel a strange attachment to you. Or, some kind of strange, tingly feeling in my chest... If this is how a human heart feels without despair or hate...well, I suppose it’s not terrible. ...But I’m only saying all this so I can save my sister, okay? Don’t get any ideas.
You’re seriously beyond help, doing something so meaningless. It’s almost enough to make me sick, having to rely on someone so foolish.
I didn’t believe in all that nonsense about a witch’s power coming from the heart, but that power is some pretty powerful stuff. Keep it coming.
Humans get stronger by forming bonds, huh? I won’t argue with that—these results speak for themselves. But really, it just means that weaker creatures tend to stick together, doesn’t it?
All living beings have unique skillsets and differing rates of learning, so why would you even think of gathering everyone together to study? “Because it’s fun?” Typical human answer, so illogical.
If being foolish is proof of being human, you must be the most “human” of them all. What? It’s a compliment.

Bonds, hearts, love, and happiness. These are the things humans hold dear, right? The concepts are so illogical and half-baked, who better to learn from than someone as foolish as you? Now that that’s settled, keep loving me, okay? Don’t worry, I’ll love you too.
Did you expect any different from me? I don’t know why you’re so surprised. Get your jaw off the floor already.
Tch... Am I really almost at my limit?
Keep your filthy hands off my big sister!
It has been a while. I’m glad we could meet again while I’m still operational.
The professor wants me to live like a normal girl, so I have been attending school. She always asks me if I’m having fun or not, and...I think I am.

Would you like to go stargazing with me tonight? The professor told me that each star in the sky is another world, just like ours. Vast worlds like the one we live in, existing on each of those tiny stars high up in the clouds. I cannot comprehend it. So, I would like to learn more.
Though we may not share a blood bond like human siblings, I do feel that D.D. and I are sisters. We are connected by something that cannot be seen, but felt. I wonder...what that “something” is?
You look quite pale. Are you tired? Understood. Here, I will give you a hug. How does that feel? The professor always feels better after I do this.
Life ends eventually. It is just part of nature. But, I have learned it is also human nature to try and resist that reality. How about you? When my life ends, would you cry for me?
I would like to celebrate the day of your birth. Happy birthday. And if possible, I would like you to celebrate the day of my creation as well.
It seems that my heart is keeping my broken body together. Therefore, I would like to talk to as many people as I can and gather research on what it means to have a heart.
I have tried asking the other sisters here, but what does it really mean to be a “big sister?” Is it normal to want to do things for your little sister?

Meow, meow, meeeow. Apparently, mimicking a cat will allow one to grow cat ears. I thought it was nonsense at first, but it must be true because the Pope said so. I asked the professor about it, and she confirmed it while bursting into laughter. So, I have been testing the theory out... Meow.

Do you know why the sky is so blue? It is because fairies are blue. And because we can only see the blue fairies living up in the sky, that is what makes it blue. The professor told me so. But the sky turns red sometimes? ...Oh, that is true. Professor...what is the meaning of this?

A master and servant relationship, where I must pledge loyalty to a lord, is still difficult for me to understand... But, I would willingly risk my life to protect the professor, my sister, and you... That is a feeling I think I can slightly understand.

The warm feeling I get when I’m with the professor and D.D. is the same when I’m with you. So, this warmth must be the power of our bonds. The human power that gives me strength through light, not rust. Just the thought of that warmth protecting me is... I cannot really put it into words, but...I think it is wonderful.
This formless concept called a “heart” is giving life to a puppet like me. What a fascinating phenomenon.
I wonder how much more I can learn with the time I have left.
I heard humans go to Heaven after death. I wonder if these broken wings of metal can carry me there.
The more I learn about this heart of mine, the less I understand its workings. It feels warm when I’m with others, but grows cold when I’m alone... What is the meaning of this?
I think the sky is pretty. And I believe that is special. If that is what it means to have a heart...I think it is quite beautiful.

What is a heart? An emotion? A dream...? Thanks to you, I feel a bit more familiar with these concepts. To want to spend what little time one has left with the people they cherish... That is what it means to have a “heart,” right?
We have lost. What a shame.
I will protect my little sister.
Ah! Hurray, Mister’s back! Welcome home! I feel like the whole mansion got brighter as soon as you walked in!

Ah! Mister, it’s you! I’m so glad you’ve come back. I’m used to people being gone a while, but everyone else is probably... I’m sure you have your reasons, though. So, whenever you do come back from a long journey, make sure you talk with everyone lots and lots, okay?
Let’s give today our best shot! C’mon, say it with me now! “Seize the day~!”

My friend is the best friend you could ever ask for! She’s so pretty you wouldn’t believe it, and on top of that, she even treats plants and animals with kindness! We carved these flower reliefs together, too. Ever since Grita suddenly disappeared, I’ve been really worried... But! I have faith we’ll meet again some day. So, when we do, I’ll just have to fill her in on all the fun stuff I’ve been up to!
Huh? The petals of these tulips have always been the same purple color as Grita’s eyes... Why did they all turn yellow...? It was such a pretty color, too...

Mister, you don’t look so good...! Oh, Mister... Trying to power through when you’re sick will only make you feel worse, you know? I’ll go get some medicine from Miss Skuld... You’ll be fine, so don’t worry about it? Oh no, you don’t! If medicine sounds yucky, at least try to lay down in bed. I’ll bring you some tea with lemon and ginger in it later, so make sure to drink it, okay?

You really are a great person, Mister. You’re always saving a bunch of people, and you’re kind, and caring... Being around you makes me feel like everything will be okay. You’re a bit different from Grita, but I like you, too!
Happy birthday, Mister! Here’s a bookmark I made for you out of pressed flowers growing in Fran! I wanted you to be able to bring some of Fran’s flowers with you, even when you have to go far away.

The truth is, my health’s been really bad ever since I was little. I was practically always in bed sleeping off fevers, so I’d only ever get to watch kids my age playing from my window... But! After my friend started living with me, my condition got way better... Does that mean having friends can heal you?!

Oh, hi Mister! I’m about to head to a flower field with Nina and Cerberus, since I promised to teach them how to make flower crowns before. I’ll make one to bring back as a souvenir for you too, Mister!

Apparently Veela also spent a lot of time alone growing up. But, she said she was really happy when she made her first friend. ...Hehe, friends really are the best, huh? Oh, right! I promised Veela we’d go somewhere together today! I’ll meet up with you again a little later, okay?

Ah, wait...! Oh... I’m sorry, I mistook you for someone else. I felt like I knew someone who has wings too, and called out to you without thinking... I’m really sorry! ...Where in the world would I have seen someone like that...?

Oh, that’s right! The other day, I made a huge discovery! It turns out Miss Iris is actually a twin! There’s the super strict Iris we know, and her rule-breaking twin sister... Huh? They’re not twins? And they’re the same, but different...? The other one’s also Miss Iris...just from another world...? Wh-What you’re saying’s so complicated, it’s making my head spin...!

U-Um! Mister, there’s something I’d like to ask you! ...Would you please let me stay in your mansion, even after we find Grita...?! As thanks for helping me search for her, I want to help you somehow, too! ...It’s okay as long as I get my mother’s permission? Okay! Oh, but I’m a little nervous, so would you come with me when I ask her...? Hehehe, thank you so much, Mister!
Wow! Thank you so much, Mister!
If Grita could see me now, I’m sure she’d be shocked speechless!
Wow...! I can feel power flowing right through me...! It’s just like when I’m with Grita!
Now that I’m stronger, I can protect everyone without getting injured like I did before... Before? Injured...? Wait, when did something like that happen...?

Your power is strong, but warm... It’s strange. You and Grita are totally different, but I feel like you remind me of her somehow. It’s like, uh...mm... Uuu~! Sorry, but I can’t put it any better than that. I just feel weirdly happy that being with you is like being with Grita... So, thank you bunches and bunches, Mister!
Hurray! We did it, Mister! Great work, everyone!
Uuu... I’m sorry... If only I was a little stronger...
You’ll be okay! Just leave this to me!
Oh, howdy there, Partner! So, you’ve come ’round again today, huh?
Long time no see, Partner! While you were gone, I got heaps of gunslingin’ practice in. So, I’m sure I’ve reached a whole new caliber ’pared to when ya last laid eyes on me!
I’ve gotta do my best again today so I can catch up to my role model, the great Cordie! Yippee-ki-yay!

I can’t slack off on carin’ for my ol’ gun, here... The truth is, my goal’s to become able to sling, spin, an’ shoot two guns as beautifully as the great Cordie does. But, ’cause I’m still half-rate, this girl here’s all I got for now... I’m gonna keep practicin’, though, till the day I can sling two guns as effortlessly as she does!

G-Great Cordie, a half-rate gunslinger like me can’t possibly put on a show with the likes of you... Ah, uh, not that I’m sayin’ I don’t wanna do a show with you... Hehe... In fact, it makes me chipper as a jaybird... But, with my skills right now, I still can’t... Huh?! You already called everybody over...?! No, wait, my heart ain’t ready yet~!

Ugh... For some reason, I just feel plum tuckered out... You do too, Partner? Then, let’s hunker down an’ rest here for a spell. Nobody’ll get mad if you ditch out on your duties every once in a blue moon, ya silly goose!

You’re wonderin’ why I’ve been starin’ at you this whole time? ’Cause you’re the guy the great Cordie thinks is the bee’s knees! So, I thought watchin’ you might teach me a thing or two... Oh, but I’ll get outta your hair if I’m botherin’ you... Huh? I’m not? Gee whillikers, that sure is a load off my mind, then!
Happy birthday, Partner! Since you’re the big star of the day, I’ve prepared a special show just for you! So, just kick back and enjoy these blazin’ trick shots!

My aim’s to become a gunslinger unlike any other, just like my role model—the great Cordie! That’s just another reason I gotta practice like my life depends on it! Just you wait—I’m gonna knock everybody’s socks off before ya know it!

I heard Miss Mimi took up dancin’ ’cause she admired Miss Hathor so much, but...their dances are night an’ day, to say the least... Though, Miss Hathor did say, “Our dances being different doesn’t matter. That girl’s dance is one of a kind—a dance only she can do.” I don’t wanna just copy the great Cordie, neither. I gotta find a style I could call my own...!

I heard they got a circus out in Miss Paladea’s country, too. It just goes to show, that even in different countries ’n worlds, there’re still folks out there who want nothin’ more than to put smiles on people’s faces!

Miss Sophia didn’t crack even a hint of a smile again today... She always praises my performances, but her expression never changes one bit... What’s that? Miss Sophia’s just bad at smilin’? Hehe! Hearin’ that just makes me wanna put a smile on ’er face even more! Alright, time for another round~!

Miss Charlotte’s sure got a great smile on ’er. Sometimes she looks a bit sad behind her smile, but seein’ how she always keeps one on her face anyway...makes me wanna learn just how she does it! In fact, maybe there’s a chance she’d let me become her apprentice! She is the master of maximum smileage, after all!

For a girl like me, who was stuck in the depths of despair after becomin’ a witch, the great Cordie was like a shinin’ light. A light of hope that brought color to the dark world around me... I know I’ve still got a long way to go... But, just like the great Cordie, I wanna be the kinda person that can shine a light on somebody else some day. So, it’d be a real help if you kept cheerin’ me on, Partner!
Thanks for all your support! I’ll do my best not to let ya down!
My aim’s to be just like the great Cordie... So, I wanna be the second greatest gunslinger in the world. Yup, you heard me—second. ’Cause first is already taken by the great Cordie, after all!

Tryin’ to make everyone in the world smile again... That part of you resembles the great Cordie a tad, Partner. Y’all shine so bright, a gal like me can’t possibly compete... Hehehe... Oh, don’t you worry now. All that means is, I just gotta try even harder so I can compete with y’all one day. Just you watch, Great Cordie...!

I always get nervous before a show... It’s just, when I think no one’ll wanna watch me again... But, it’s nothin’ I can’t handle! As long as I put a big, bright smile on my face, I can make all my doubts an’ nerves disappear. ’Cause what struck my heart back then was that shinin’ smile of the great Cordie’s... Hehe! So, if I smile too, I’m sure it’ll strike the hearts of my audience too!

Ah! Partner! What’d ya power me up this much for...? Oh...! Could you be...a secret fan of mine?! Juuuust kiddi...huh?! Wait, you are?! Hehehe, now you’re makin’ me blush~! Well, I can’t let a fan of mine down, so from this day on, I’m gonna work even harder! So keep on rallyin’ behind me, will ya? Get ready world, ’cause Flack’s in the saddle!
Place any tips in the ol’ hat here!♪
T-Times like these, ya just gotta turn tail and skedaddle! Let’s get outta here!
There’s no tricks up these sleeves!
Feast your eyes on this next act!
Oh, there you are! What’cha up to today~?
...Huh? Well, look who’s late to the party~! Don’t worry, I made sure to keep things lively while you were gone.
Okay! How ’bout we get to work putting smiles on people’s faces again today?♪

Hmm...what should we do next~? ...Oh, I was just doing some brainstorming~! I’m trying to come up with the Fran Circus Troupe’s next act, but it’s not really coming together... It sure is tough being ringmaster, y’know~?

You think I’ve been spending more time with Flack lately? I mean, how can I say no to that face, especially when she says stuff like, “I became a travelin’ gunslinger ’cause I wanna be just like you, Great Cordie!” Ohoho~? Do I sense someone getting jealous ’cause they can’t have me all to themselves anymore~? Just kidding~!
Oh? Didja come here to skip out on work, too? Sure, take it easy! Don’t worry, I won’t tell Iris, so let’s take a breather together, ’kay?

Once the world went back to its normal, peaceful self, I’d planned on heading straight back to my old circus troupe. But...it’s just too much fun hanging out with you, so it looks like those plans’ll hafta wait. You’ve really got me in a tough spot here. I just...can’t get enough of you, y’know...? Hehe♪ Now, was that just a joke, or was I telling the truth~? Take a wild guess.
Happy birthday! This year, we’re going all out! Brace yourself, ’cause I’m gonna make it one you won’t ever forget!
I’ve gotta keep my pistols in tip-top shape~ Hm~? If you’re interested, I can teach ya a thing or two, y’know? Sure, now watch reeeal closely~
Found ya, Flack! C’mon, we’re gonna do a show in the city square—huh? Of course, you’ll be a part of it too! Don’t worry your cute lil’ head! There’s no need to be nervous, okay...? Now, let’s go~!

Oh, right. You were there in the crowd too, right? “Where,” you ask? Why, the grand debut performance of the Fran Circus Troupe, of course! Hathor, Mimi, Milla, and even Tropon were all... Wait, don’t tell me you missed it? Alright, fiiine. As a special treat, I guess I’ll just have to put on the best show ever, just for you!

“Why did I form the Fran Circus Troupe?” Hmm... Well, at first I just wanted to bring the joy of the circus to all the kids out there who’ve never experienced it... But now that the Curses are good and gone, I think everyone can actually fully enjoy the circus to their heart’s content. I’m really glad I trusted you... Just kidding...or am I?♪

Hm? I seem pretty busy these days? Hmph, and whose fault do you think that is? It’s almost like a certain someone’s always getting swarmed by more and more girls each day... Then they join my circus, and on top of that, my shooting practice never ends... See, I am pretty popular myself, y’know~? Buuut, if you insist, maybe I could squeeze you in somewhere at the top of my busy schedule. That sound good to you?

You really are something else, y’know that? You’re surrounded by all these smiling faces, all day, every day. You must be some kind of magician. Like, when you smile, I just can’t help but smile too... But, don’t think you’ve taken the spotlight away from me! ’Cause when I smile, everyone else smiles too, right? Sooo, that must mean you and I are the perfect match, don’tcha think? Huh~? Why’re you looking away~?
All righty! Leave this to me!♪
Looks like it’s time for me to shine again~!
You wanna see the greatest in action even more, huh? Hehe, sure thing! Just follow my lead!
Aw, jeez, that Flack! I know she looks up to me and all that, but she’s always copying me or following me around. It’s been a lot, y’know? Man, it sure is tough being popular~

Handling this much power’s a piece of cake for the world’s greatest gunslinger~! But, the world’s even bigger than I imagined, and there’s still so many places I haven’t been to. Uuu! In that case, I’ll just have to take over the world and shine at the very top! Of course, you’re gonna come along for the ride too, right?

Step right up, everyone! Please welcome to the stage, your favorite superstar and the world’s greatest gunslinger, the Great Cordie! From here on out, I’ll be making sure your eyes are glued on me, so no blinking allowed! Watch me reeeal close, okay? Hehe... Aw, c’mon, really? Right after I warned you? Eyes over here, got it?♪
And, that’s a wrap! Hehe!♪ Did you enjoy the show~?
Oh no~ Well, we all have those days...
And now, for my next act~!
Hm? Oh, it’s you. Welcome back, Duke.
I thought you got separated from the pack... Well, as long as you’re still in one piece, that is all that matters.

My mother was strong. As her daughter, I thought I was able to survive the harshness of nature because I was strong, too. Even though, in truth, I only ever survived this long thanks to my mother’s compassion... The ones who taught me that strength isn’t everything were her and Mihri. So, I want to learn from you as well, Duke—what it takes to live beyond survival.

No matter the country, those charged with leading their pack sure are diligent. Even Elfriede, that high-ranking holy woman, focused on my words more intently as we were talking the other day... I’ve probably got the wrong idea? She was just focused on my ears...? But, why? Are my ears truly such a rarity here...?

Duke, I’ve even heard tell of how kind-hearted you are from the animals here. Like from the birds nesting around the mansion, and the mice living in the attic— Damn it, the mice told me to keep that a secret...! I’ll take responsibility and find them a new home, so pretend you didn’t hear anything, will you?
Take a break, Duke. Even if survival is about more than strength, it’s still a fact that the weaker one is, the easier it is to take them down. If you understand what I’m saying, rest.

Duke, the members of your tribe all seem quite...happy... I’m sure it’s because you care for each and every one of them so dearly... I wonder if I can change... If I...can make everyone happy, like you can... You think that as long as I feel that way, I can...? It’s okay not to rush, and just try to change little by little...? ...I see... You really are as kind as they say.

So, today is the day of your birth, Duke? Then, we shall hold a festival to celebrate. The festival for my birth goes on for seven days and seven nights, but for you, a full month of festivities should suffice. What? That’s too long? It’s normally only one day here? I...see... If that is the local custom...then... But, one day is just too...! At least hold it for seven. No, how does three days sound?

I resented being born half human. I always wanted to be a full-blooded wolf...but now, I’ve started to think being like this isn’t so bad. I’d be lying, though, if I said I didn’t still wish to have been born as a wolf instead... But, I’m trying to accept myself as I am, little by little.

Mihri, huh...? That girl’s just about the only one to address me in such a disrespectful manner. ...But, well, she has come to my aid enough times that I can’t fully disparage her... Be that as it may! She won’t get a “thank you” out of me—not ever! If I ever did say it, she’d never let me hear the end of it...!

Most of you People of the Stone settled near my tribe and lived without any respect for nature... But, it seems some of you have actual sense. Ayse, was it? Give some of that calmness of yours to Mihri, will you? I’m begging you—just think of it as doing me a favor...! And while you’re at it, bear the brunt of her antics for me too, will you...?

There’s someone else here who bears a name related to stars? ...“Sovereign of the Stars,” you say...? ...A sovereign and a chief of a pack, huh... A conversation between the two of us would be most worthwhile... Now then, I simply must go find them at once. Why don’t you join me, Duke?
