Duke... If you keep going, you’ll walk right into a trap. I’m sure this is Lady Tama’s doing. Even if she calls such acts of hers “harmless pranks,” she’s taking things too far... What? There’s a paper stuck on my back with something written on it...? Read it out for me, will you? ...“Do look forward to my next prank as well!”...? Can I pretend I didn’t see this...? I suppose I can’t...can I...?

For too long, I tried to live only as a wolf. That led me to be ignorant of the ways of humans. ...What I am about to say is most difficult for me to admit, as it denies the very way of life I’ve adopted until now. But, these words must be spoken. Please, keep giving me your guidance...until I find my place in the world of humans... Thank you... I’ll heed your teachings well, Duke.
My fangs and claws have grown even sharper. You have my thanks, Duke.
You’re giving this to me...? ...I must do all I can to live up to the faith you’ve put in me.
One needs power to lead a pack. I will use the power you have given me to lead, just as the unmoving light of Heaven guides us from above.
The Shining Star of the Plains, the One Chosen by Spirits... I promise to work in a manner befitting all of my names.
The old me would have suspected that you helping me like this is because you see me as weak. But, my eyes have opened since then. You aren’t doing this out of pity—you’re doing this out of care.
I thought of strength as something cold, like the honed edge of a steel blade. But...it seems strength can be gained through warmth as well...
Just as I thought. Impressive, Duke.
...Well, the outcome is what it is... But, I just can’t get used to losing...
To be greeted by the world’s cutest, Carmilla... You must be the luckiest minion alive, don’t you agree?
Hey, minion! Where have you been?! You’re my minion, so you have to stay by my side at all times! ...So, don’t you dare wander off again without telling me...okay?
If you ever find yourself in a tough spot, you better come straight to me, got it? You’re mine, after all, and I’ll be sure to protect what’s mine! That’s just how amazing I am!

Miniooon! Listen... I could really go for a snack right now. Hmmm... Cake is fine and all, but you know what I’m actually craving, don’t you...? ...Come on, you wouldn’t mind sparing just a bit of your life force for me...right?

Ugh, you’re such a softy, minion. I bet your little witch friends are just as weak and pathetic, huh? Oh well, I guess I’ll just have to... Wait, where are you going? Are you mad at me...? You don’t care if I insult you, but you won’t forgive me for badmouthing the others...? I-I’m sorry...! I’ll take it all back, just don’t be mad... Please don’t hate me...!

Get it together, minion! I know you’re crazy about me, but that doesn’t mean you should work yourself to the bone! If you’re tired, you have to rest. Got it? Unleeess...you’d rather become an actual minion who can’t feel pain or exhaustion? How’s that sound?

You’re sensing some kind of power from a demon within me? Does that mean...you think I’m devilishly cute? W-Well... No need to point out the obvious—it’s not going to make me happy or anything. Jeez~♪

It’s your birthday today, minion? Never mind that—my birthday party’s way more important, isn’t it? It’s got to be a grand party too, fit for someone as amazing as the adorable Carmilla! And then...I guess we could celebrate your birthday too, if we have time♪

What’s the deal with that Lumica girl? She’s always so bright—just being near her feels blinding, like I’m about to get purified by her light or something... And yet, she comes to talk without realizing what she’s doing to me... Eek! There she is again! Minion, help meee!

Illya’s been staring at you a lot, hasn’t she? Actually, now that I think about it, a lot of the other girls here have, too... You’re my minion, so don’t even think about getting cozy with anyone else, got it?
I feel a power similar to mine coming from Eirene. You don’t think... Could she be scheming to take my place as head of my clan...? Well, tell her to bring it on! I’ll show her who’s boss!
Eirene’s actually kind of nice! She just wouldn’t stop going on about how adorable, courageous, and wonderful I am for always trying my hardest! But, well, anyone with eyes could see that~!♪

Minion, I’m bored. Let’s hang out! Huh? You’ve got work, so maybe later? ...Why don’t you love me...even after I’ve gotten so cute? I’ll just have to become even cuter...and cuter, and cuter, and cuter, and CUTER! ...Huh? You’re giving up work to play with me after all? ...Jeez~ You really are just too obsessed with me, minion!♡

Hey, minion. This might sound weird, but...sometimes, I can’t remember my family... Could it be that they’re already... No, that can’t be right... You won’t leave me, right? You’ll stay by my side forever, won’t you? ...Yeah, thanks. Hehe...
Draining life force from others works well enough, but borrowing power’s not half-bad either. Want me to give you a little chomp as thanks?
Mmm, delicious~!♪ I think I could get used to this. More, please~!
You don’t have to state the obvious—I already know I’m the strongest! But, some extra praise just might get me to work even harder~♪ So, get to it and shower me with compliments!
Wow, minion! You’re sooo devoted to me, aren’t you? I knew it—you really do love me~!♪ Don’t tell me you were expecting a treat or something~?

I’m the strongest! With this power, I won’t ever lose my family again! ...W-Wait. My family... They’re still with me, right...? Then, what are these memories...? Who...are those people...? No, what are they...?

Look how strong I’ve gotten! And it’s all thanks to you, minion! Good job! Now, let’s use this power to take over the world!♪ Of course, I’ll be keeping you by my side. You’re my precious little minion, after all!
Aww, sucks to be you! But did you really think you could beat me?
You’re going to be the one in tears next time! I swear, I swear, I swear!
Hah! You’re so weak, I made you squeak~!
Ah! Duke! What’s the story, morning glory? Ready to tackle another day?

Well, well, looks like you’ve been doing just fine! Worrying about you sure was a waste of time...! Ehehe! Oh, come on, I’m just pulling your leg! But still, you can’t make a girl worry like that, got it?

Whenever you start feeling a bit “blah,” you should just think of something fun! Like riding a horse through a field, taking an afternoon nap on the grass...imagining those who have wronged you falling into pits of manure... Huh? You don’t fantasize about things like that?! How virtuous...!

Oh, this get-up I’m wearing? One day, the great guardian deity, her nastiness Yildiz, pronounced she found restrictive garb such as this simply intolerable! She thus insisted that I, her ever-so-faithful servant, wear it in her stead— Wait, since when did I become that rotten wolf’s servant?! I don’t remember signing off on this!!

People in the city typically refer to folks like me as a “witch.” But, tribes all tend to use different names for us. Like spirit child, priestess, medium... Is “Messenger of Flames” one of those...? Wh-Who did you hear that from?! Nrghrghrgh...! That nickname’s the bane of my existence, so don’t even think about calling me that!

Whoa! You look like you could keel over right here! Jeez, you’ve got to let yourself rest a little more. Cure number one for exhaustion is sleep, number two is sleep, and so are numbers three, four, and five! Now, if you get what I’m putting down, hurry up and catch some Z’s, Duke!

I’m not too good at giving words of encouragement... But, I’ll say them a lot to you, Duke. It will all be alright. It will all be alright! You aren’t alone, Duke. We’re all right here beside you! So, if anything happens, don’t feel like you need to carry everything on your own, okay?

Say what?! It’s your birthday today, Duke?! You should’ve said so sooner! ...I wonder if food for 1,000 guests will be enough...! That’s way too much? Really? I have a sinking feeling we’re gonna need a whole lot more than that, though...

Right now, I’m acting as the tribe coordinator for Yildiz’s settlement. I’m the only one in the know about the city, after all. We’ve teamed up with the other tribes, so we can all stay alert to the city’s movements. Though, if the city was plotting something, the smaller animals would just tell Yildiz, so we’d still be fine. But, it’s important to form a coordinated front with other tribes anyway!

When I first saw your mother, Yildiz, I was shocked. I couldn’t believe wolves got that big! I was relieved to hear she doesn’t eat humans, but... What, Yildiz? Your mother just said I look tasty...? Ahaha, there you go again Mama Wolf, you jokester you! Uh, that was a joke, right? Right? Tell me I’m right! Take it back, Yildiz!!
Fenrir and Cerberus sure are such sweet girls! Haah... If only a certain wolf around here could be half as adorable...! Oh...? It’s not like I was talking about you, Yildiz. But, if the shoe fits...!

The people of the tribes commune with spirits and befriend animals. But, many city people explain away the acts of spirits as just naturally occurring phenomena, and only view animals as livestock. So, both sides often yell things at each other like, “Get with the times!” or, “The spirits will punish you!” Sometimes, they even break out into fights... That’s why all of us here have to do our best, so both sides can one day coexist in peace.

Hm? What is it, Miss Liberia? Is Yildiz my friend...? Abso-freaking-lutely not! We aren’t friends like you and Miss Ayse are— ...Yildiz said the same thing? So we must be good friends? Nrghghghgh~! Knowing we both feel the same only ticks me off more!!

Even with the power to protect myself from fire, it takes a lot of courage to jump into burning flames. But, if it’s to protect everyone, I’ll do it as many times as I have to! After all, I don’t want a single one of you to disappear from my world—that’s just how important you and everyone else has become to me!
Hehe! Thanks for the pick-me-up, Duke!
Alright! With this, I’ll protect everyone here!
Keep powering me up, and show that snot-nosed Yildiz who’s boss, Duke!
Hehe~! Just leave everything to me, Mihri, Protector from the Flames! ...Scratch that... I went a little overboard just now, didn’t I...?

...Yeah... I won’t belittle or hate myself anymore. This power was a precious gift from my mother, after all. I have to treasure it—no one else can do it for me. Otherwise, I can’t show my mother the respect she deserves, right?
Woohoo! Come on, celebrate with me, Duke!
Nrgh...! I can’t take anymore...! My muscles are all outta juice...!

Ahh! Master, you finally came! I’ve been waiting here forever ’cause you promised to play with me! You know, I’m starting to think I ha...! Ehehe~! I really love it when Master gives me headpats~ Weeell, I guess I’ll forgive you if you spend the whole day playing with me, okay?
Master! Look, look! Big Sis gave me these candies... See? When I hold them up to the sun, they get all twinkly and sparkly! Haah... It’s so pretty...

Hmm, what should I add~? Hey! No peeking, Master! This is a shared diary we girls are passing around. It’s chock-full of everyone’s secrets, so Master isn’t allowed to snoop! If you really wanna see what I usually write about, we can start our own shared diary! That way, we can share and read each other’s secrets, okay?

Big Sis is suuuper good at cooking! And not just sweets, either. She can make really yummy stews with mountain veggies... Oh! Maybe I should start learning how to cook too. Big Sis always makes food for me, so I wanna surprise her with my own yummy food too!

Master, are you feeling okay? Oh, I know...! Here, take this. Big Sis and I made this special candy that gives you a boost of energy! Since you’re so tired, I’ll feed it to you! Now, open reeeal wide~!♪
Hey, Master! Hey, Master! Guess what... I love you sooo much! Do you love me, too? ...Ehehe!♪ Then, our hearts must be matching~!
Birthdays are so much fun, aren’t they? Eating lots of yummy food, playing lots with everyone... I had tons of fun on my birthday, so next time, let’s make your birthday suuuper fun too, Master!
Uuu... Going to school together with Big Sis is fun and all, but...studying is so boring!

Look, Master, look~! I found something reeeally cool in the garden earlier. See, isn’t this bug just adorable? Kobel and I caught it while it was sitting on a tree branch. Isn’t it amazing~? C’mon, Bugsington! I’m gonna give you to Big Sis as a surprise present!

I got scolded by Yuni for eating candy after brushing my teeth. She told me, “You’ll get cavities!” But, I don’t like brushing my teeth... Oh! I know, I know! Master, you can brush them for me! Huh? “I have to do it myself?” Urgh... Then, can you check to make sure I brushed properly?

Ah, Big Sis! I’ll help you clean our room! That way, I can spend even more time with you... Ehehe!♪ Tidying up, cleaning, saying “good morning” and “good night”...everything’s better when we do it together, Big Sis!

Oh, Master! Shhh! I was napping with Big Sis, but I woke up before her... Big Sis is still sleeping peacefully... But, snuggling up with her is making me sleepy all over again... Mmm... Wake me up when it’s dinner time, okay...? Zzz...

Why does candy have to disappear when you eat it... If I run out, I can just ask for more next year? ...Yeah, you’re right! And next time, you can help me make some too, Master! These candies that I made together with Big Sis turned out so sparkly... So, if the three of us work together, I bet they’d sparkle even more, don’t you think? Ehehe!
Yaaay~! Look at me, I’m sparkling!
I helped make this candy, you know! Isn’t that amazing?
Master! If you don’t give me more headpats, I might bite~ Hehehe!
Guess what I can do, Master! I can help Big Sis, go shopping, and even find lost kids all by myself! Aren’t I amazing? Aren’t I?

Look how much I’ve grown, Master! I’ve learned to cook a little bit, and I don’t even cry anymore when I get separated from Big Sis! Ehehe~! Isn’t that great? Don’t I deserve some extra headpats~? Don’t I?
Ehehe~! Looks like I won~!♪ Did I do good? Did I? Did I~?
Welcome back. If you’re looking for Liberia, I believe she’s in the garden. Or, were you perhaps looking for me?

Oh, it’s been a while...! Uh...just to fill you in... Liberia seems to be under the impression that you’ve “returned to the dirt”... I at least cleared up her misunderstanding, but you should probably provide some visual verification by meeting her face-to-face.
What area should we go to conduct research today?

Oh, this? I’m conducting a test on the water quality of a pond. I can determine changes in the environment from things like the behavior of the small fish living there. Small animals like these understand the environment much better than we do. The most us humans can do is make inferences based on what they tell us. Animals really are amazing, aren’t they?

You want to know the reason I became a researcher? Good question... While I do come from a long line of researchers, I suppose the biggest reason was that I wanted to make everyone’s lives better. Knowledge exists for the sake of improving our lives. Learning something new can give us the power to help others... Though, I’m only repeating what my father used to tell me, anyway.
Your work seems tough... How about I give you a helping hand? I may not be the best at keeping my room tidy, but organizing documents is my specialty. ...Then, just leave this stack of papers to me.

Mmm~! Ahh...! I guess my exhaustion really was catching up with me...! Huh? “Did I stay up all night again researching?” Hehe...! There’s no need to look so worried. This time, I made sure to get a full night’s rest. After all, if anything were to happen to me, it would only give people like you and Liberia more things to worry about, right?

Ah... Um, today is your birthday, right...? I see, that’s good...! I got so absorbed in my research again, I thought it might have passed midnight already... Then, allow me to start over! Happy birthday, Duke! Here—I embroidered a handkerchief for you as a present. This is called Tottoh embroidery, and... Huh? “Is it...a cat...?” That’s...supposed to be Liberia...

Haah... Oh, Duke... “I seem down”...? Well...I’m not the best when it comes to cleaning my room... Lately, I kept telling myself, “I’ll just do it tomorrow!” and let things pile up... So now, my room looks like a sandstorm blew through it... To top it all off, Iris got mad and said, “Stand out in the hall until I’ve cleaned this mess up”... I...I’ve seen the error of my ways...

Before I met Liberia, a part of me looked down on the People of the Sand. I thought they were all ignorant fools, refusing to listen to reason... But, by meeting Liberia, I realized just how wrong I’d always been. She showed me the truth... That the real fool, blind to their own ignorance, and prejudiced in their judgement...was me...

Liberia and I are friends, but we differ in every respect you can imagine. Our hobbies, our likes, our dislikes—everything! Hehe, it’s certainly unprecedented, isn’t it? I’m sure the reason the two of us are friends isn’t because we get along, but simply because we want to be.

Liberia’s tribe, the People of the Sand, seems to have a wide variety of unique laws they follow. As a result, Liberia’s understanding of the world tends to be just as unique... Still, to think she can eat that kind of food, and even do that kind of dance...! ...A-Ask Liberia for the details...! I-I just can’t put it into words...

What is it, Liberia...? Weren’t you just taking a lesson with the other girls...? Huh? “You left because you wanted to be taught by me instead”...? W-Well, if you insist, I suppose I can take over for your other instructor. Okay, hurry and take a seat...! Now then, what subject would you like to tackle today?

Oh, Duke! Perfect timing. I’m just about to head out with Liberia, so I wanted to tell you that I don’t think we’ll be back until late. Huh...? “Is it fieldwork”...? No, we’re just going out for a picnic today. Yes, you heard that right. Today I just want to relax, and go see as many places as I can with Liberia...since now, we finally have the freedom to do so! Anyway, I’ll see you later, Duke!
This feels just like dawning upon a new theory... Thank you.
I feel like I’ve gained new knowledge from you yet again... Thank you, Duke!

I wonder why everyone hates studying so much...? Expanding your knowledge means expanding how much you can do... That can only be to one’s benefit, so why hate it? Everyone here sure is strange, don’t you think?

Liberia is my friend... That hasn’t changed even now. But, the past me hid that fact from my fellow researchers and family. Deep down, I thought being friends with her was something to be ashamed of... Things are different now, though—I’m proud to call Liberia my friend. Because...that’s the kind of person I want to become...!

A world where witches are no longer persecuted is what you’re striving for... Though, I’m sure there are people in the world who hate blindly, based only on their own assumptions...like how I was before. But, just as meeting Liberia changed me, I’m sure you have the power to change how the people of this world think. And, you have me...no, all of us, right here beside you. You can overcome any obstacle in your path with the power of bonds—just as Liberia and I have. So, I know you’ll be alright!
Hehehe...! Exactly the result I predicted!
Th-This...was all due to my lack of research...
Ah, Mister Apprentice! Didn’t I tell you not to go off on your own anymore? I really thought you wouldn’t come back to see me again. It just hasn’t been the same around here without you...
Even if I am your master, I can’t just have one apprentice forever... B-But, don’t worry! You’ll always be my one and only Mister Apprentice, okay?
I can’t say I’m the biggest fan of alcohol. It’s the bitter taste that doesn’t agree with me... So, I’m having some juice instead. How about a glass, Mister Apprentice?
Stella’s always fawning over me, saying how amazing I am. I still have a long way to go, but maybe I’m finally starting to appear more like a proper master.

Mister Apprentice, I told you to take proper breaks! As your master, I can’t approve of you overworking yourself. I-If you continue to ignore your master’s instructions, I just might...get mad...or something...

Did you know the Holy Night’s miracle is said to grant wishes...? If you really could wish for anything, what would it be, Mister Apprentice? If it were me, I think I’d wish to always stay by your side...maybe... A-As your master, of course!
Happy birthday, Mister Apprentice. I tried making a pumpkin pie using my master’s secret recipe. Would you like to try some? O-Or...would you prefer if I gave you a hug again...?

Stella’s pretty amazing, don’t you think? She’s always so sure of herself. As your master, I should try acting a bit more dignified, too... Huh? Stella’s actually pretty shy...? Still, to think she’s always able to look so sure of herself... In that case, I-I’ll have to push myself a little more, too!

I spoke with some researchers from Derulla who specialize in studying plants. I learned quite a bit, but Miss Meria was...well, a bit too enthusiastic for me... On the other hand, I feel like I could get along just fine with Miss Serruria.

Before coming here, I lived deep in the forest of Brook with my master. The library there is full of my master’s books—not just spellbooks, but also picture books for bedtime stories, and secret recipe books. Because of that, I often get nostalgic and end up reading instead of tidying up...

When I visited home, I left some flowers for my master. I hadn’t been able to bloom any flowers since that day... But now, I can make small ones bloom again. Master... I’m sorry it took so long, but...happy birthday...

Urgh... There shouldn’t be any alcohol in this juice...but, I’m feelin’ a lil’ tipshy... Huh? Mishter Apprentishe... Why’re you laughing? Thaf’s no way to treat your mashter, don’t you think? Mister Apprentishe, how do you really feel about me, anyway? I care for you sho much, but here you are, jusht...always being by my shide, helping me whenever shomething happens... Am I...fulfilling my duties as your mashter...? Am I any closher to becoming more like my mashter...?

That day, when you suddenly came to my house, I was so surprised that I ended up blurting out, “Won’t you become my apprentice?”... I didn’t think you’d actually agree to become my apprentice, or that you’d stay by my side for this long... Thank you, Mister Apprentice. Would you allow me to continue being your master...for many more years to come?
I think I’m in good form today!
I’ve grown stronger all thanks to you, Mister Apprentice!
Do I seem a bit more like a proper master now? I can always do my best when you’re by my side.
I know I can’t keep relying on you all the time. I need to show you what a proper master looks like...at least once!
I’ll show you just how much I’ve grown as your master! If I take this, then do that... Huh? Wh-Whaaat?!

I guess it’s impossible to grow stronger all at once. It’s best to take things slow, one step at a time. That’s why, as your master, I’d like to keep going down this path together with you... H-How does that sound?
We did it! Did you see your master in action?
I-I’ll cover you all, so run...!
Now, let us depart beyond these hallowed halls! For the world itself awaits us!

Heh...! Oh no, no need to explain! I understand. A fashionably late arrival simply has more cool factor, right? Yeah, I totally feel you. I see you’re at that age too, huh...? No, no, save your words! I read you loud and clear, Boss~♪
Heh-heh-heh...! Do you also desire the miraculous power of my holy darkness...? Very well! Use it to your heart’s content!

Whew, that oughta do it...! Oh, Boss! “Why am I cleaning Master Gil’uial’s room?” Hehe~! I’ll have you know, cleaning makes for an excellent training regimen! That’s what Master Gil’uial said, anyway— GYAAAAAH! M-M-MOUSE! ...Ah, I-I’m...h-h-hugging...B-Boss...?! ...Hahooo~...

Master Merlyn sure is amazing, huh? She’s even called “The Witch of the Deep Forest,” right? Plus, she’s your master too, isn’t she? Master Merlyn even knows a ton of magic... But...whenever I tell her how great she is, she always looks so worn out... I wonder why?

Hark, Boss! Rejoice, as I, Stella, have come to your aid! Hehe, I heard your heart’s cries for help carried on the wintry winds, so I— ...Huh? You’re...grateful...? Ah, uh...u-um... Y-Y-You’re...w-w-well, welcome...! ...Uuu...

What is it, Boss? Do you have business with... HUH?! Is that a p-p-present?! For M-ME?! ...Oh... So this is just a thank-you gift, huh... W-WELL, if you insist, I can’t very well refuse, now can I...?! ...Ehehe!♪ I’m so happy...! Thank you, Boss...!
B-Boss...! H-Happy...b-buh, buh...BIRTHDAY!! Hehehe♪ I was able to say it properly this time. That must mean I’ve grown this year too, huh...!

Heh...! Dost thou know my true identity...? “Sovereign of the Stars”...? Oh, no, no! I, Stella, have evolved from such trifling nomenclature, reaching greater heights than ever before! That’s right—I have ascended, and become Stella, the Shining Star of Holy Darkness...! HAH-hah-hah-hah...! Worship and fear me, O children of mwan...! ...Aaaugh~... I bith my tongue...!

Uuu, it’s cold...! Ah, it’s even snowing, too... Boss, you must be freezing getting snowed on like that. Come on, get under my umbrella... AH...! ...Oh, um... Well...you’re just...a bit closer than I... But...as long as it’s you, Boss...you can get even closer...if you want...

Oh, Master Meeerlyn~♪ What’re you up to? Wait, don’t tell me you’re in the middle of practicing some ultra special magic?! Or, are you trying to create some never-before-seen, super secret spell...?! Huh...? “You’re just heading out to clean your library”...? Then, let me come, too! You’re always helping me out, so it’s the least I can do! Hehe, just leave those dust bunnies to me!

Boss... It seems I’ve stumbled upon a very grave, but very true truth... If word of this ever gets out, I’m sure to be destroyed on the spot...! Huh...? “What’d I learn”...? I’ll tell you... Sealed within this mansion is the God of Destruction, and when they awake from their slumber, the whole world will be— Huh? You knew that already? Whaaat, but that’s so boooring~!

Did you need something, Boss? ...WHAT?! You...wanna know what I was trying to tell you that night...? ...I was g-gonna shay... I-I, was, am, B-B-Boss...! No, I mean, I’m not you, I’m Stella...! I mean, the Holy Miracle is, uh... AHHH! N-Neber mwiiind~...!

B-Boss...! Uh... Are you free right now...? You’re free, right? ...Perfect! Then... W-Would you...like to go...shee the city lightsh together?! ...Aaugh, I messed up again...! Huh...? You’ll go with me...? For real?! I-In-In that case... Let’s go right now...! And, since we’re going together...can we try...holding hands...?
Heh, mercy me... If you expect this much of me, I guess I have to show you all I’ve got...
I shall be the shadow that drifts in the realm between darkness and light...! Heh, yeah, that sounded good...!

Guh...! C-Can you see it too...? The dark light that feasts away at my soul...! But, fret not...! I will do everything in my power to keep its hunger at bay...as that is I, the Holy Star... Uh, Sovereign of Darkness... Wait... Which was it again?

You’re always giving me and everyone else power, Boss, so... Oh, I know! While you’re here, why don’t you try coming up with your own magic spell? If you need help, I can come up with one for you! Ah... O-Or... W-We could come up with one...together...? I-It can be a curse for two...! M-me and you, Boss...

Ah... Um... Boss... I-I don’t think it’s fair if I’m always the one receiving something from you... S-S-So, l-let me do something for you too for once...! ...Huh? You’re...always in my debt for all the help I give you...? But, I haven’t done anything... I’m just happy you’re always by my... A...Awawawa~...! I-I mean, I also, li-li-like...b-being with you, B-B-Bo... GYAAAAAH! I can’t say it after all~!!
AH-HAHAH! Did you see that?! This is the power of the Shining Star of Holy Darkness! Now, cower before the might of Stella! AH-HAHAH, HAHAHA~!
Kuh...! I-I’ll leave things here for today...! But mark my words—I’ll get you for this~!
Welcome back. ...What? Is it really that surprising for me to greet you?
It’s been a while. You’ve sure been gone for a pretty long time, you know. Just where did you disappear off to?

I can’t prove it or anything, but...if this flower were to wither away again, it’ll be gone for good. At least, that’s the vibe I’m getting. That doesn’t mean I’m gonna use it right away, though. I’ll live as a human, and die as a human. That was what she wished for me to do, after all.
For some reason, this flower just sways back and forth, even when there’s no wind blowing. ...Wait, now I’m getting the creeps. Yeah, I should get rid of it...
Another picture postcard came from Yubera? I already told her I don’t want any more, but that girl just keeps sending them over anyway, huh.

You’re still overworking yourself, I see. Guess old habits die hard. Speaking of which, I hear the only cure for idiots is death... Wanna try dying and see how it feels like? Just once. ...Relax. I’m just pulling your leg—no need to have that ridiculous look on your face. But, if you’re really not in a hurry to die, then you’d best go to bed now.

“If I started going to school with everyone, I’ll make friends with them?” There you go again, sticking your nose where it doesn’t belong. Well, it’s not like I’m gonna go anyways. I’m fine staying right here.

So, I hear it’s your birthday? Happy birthday. Well, I don’t have anything special prepared, but you better enjoy this day while you can. Birthdays mean nothing to me, since I can’t die and all, but they definitely do for someone like you.

Since she could kill me—someone who can’t die—that means she could erase a witch’s power, right? Thinking about it makes me realize how incredible she was. But, what was she, really? I should’ve at least asked what her name was...
I got a letter from Yubera, and it sounds like she’s started working at some big art museum near the sanatorium. Glad to hear she’s doing well over there.

I might actually have a knack for raising flowers. All I have to do is water them, then sit back, enjoy viewing the fruits of my labor, all while zoning out to some music or something. Nice and easy, right?

Y’know, there’s some kid who keeps trying to dissect me. Dissection doesn’t hurt, but it doesn’t exactly put me in a good mood either, so I’d be more than happy if she’d take that hobby of hers somewhere else. Just...do something about it, will you? ...“I can ask her big sister to get her to stop?” Hah...what a drag...

I had Richesse get me a new kind of spice. Supposedly, it’s so spicy that a single bite spells certain death, but that’s the least of my concerns. In fact, I think I’d enjoy the extra kick. You wanna try some? Hehe. There you go again with that funny look on your face.

I can’t exactly put my finger on it, but even now, I feel that she’s right by my side, and I’ll be able to see her again soon. ...I know, I know. There’s no way that could really happen. But, I miss her. I don’t need to feel her touch, or even hear her voice. If I could just see her one last time, though, that would be... Hey. You wouldn’t happen to know how to make that happen, would you?
Make me stronger all you want, but the only thing I can do is not die. If it wasn’t obvious enough, that part about me hasn’t changed.

This flower was made at the cost of her life. It’s not real, so it doesn’t need water, and it usually doesn’t smell or anything. But, there was one time when it gave off the sweetest fragrance. I wonder, just what was that...?
Sometimes, I get the feeling this flower is giving me power. Maybe, she is actually by my side, and... No. It’d be crazy to think that’s even possible, huh.
New powers are nothing but headaches. I’m perfectly content with sticking to my usual, thank you very much. After all, I’ll live on, just like I’ve always done—with her, and just like her.
...Hah. I doubt anything I say will get through that thick skull of yours. Well, my goal is to live as a human. So, I guess I’ll lend you a hand. Just a little.

I still have no idea why you even bother with someone like me. But, I’m grateful. I actually wanna try doing what I can to help others, and I’m sure a big reason I feel like that is because you don’t know how to mind your own business. ...That’s why...I wanna say thank you. Looks like you’re stuck with me, so...don’t go anywhere, okay?
That should be good enough, yeah?
Don’t worry. Killing me isn’t actually enough to make me die.
Even I can handle something like this.
I’ll split my life essence with you.

Hehe... Hehehe... I knew it. Of course I’d be thrown away eventually. What else is new? I’m just a gloomy good-for-nothing, after all... No matter where I go, I’m nothing but a burden, and everyone thinks I’m a creep... But... But, I really wanted to believe...things would be different this time...!
E-Even without the fairies, I-I-I’ve got to...try my...best...

Oww... Oh, this? I bumped into a rabbit out in the garden and twisted my ankle... I guess...I don’t even stand a chance against one cute little bunny, huh...? I mean, I know I’m a klutz, but sometimes I even surprise myself... Hehehe...

Guinevere was like a kind mother, opening her arms to anyone and everyone. She’d always tell me I was amazing, that I had a gift, all while holding me tight... Do you think she’d find it creepy if I called her “Mom”...? Ehehe...

U-Um, Mister Duke? Maybe it’d be best if you didn’t push yourself too much... I-I know you must be disgusted by someone like me trying to order you around, but... Your health is important to me, so...um...
Y-Y-You’re counting on me...? If you keep buttering me up like that, I...I...! Nnrrgh... I-I’m sorry... I’m not used to being praised, so my stomach starts to turn whenever I feel happy... Hehehe...

H-Happy...birthday...! I’m sure you don’t want someone like me celebrating your special day, but I just couldn’t help myself... You can throw this present away later, but for now...w-would you accept it?

I-I’ve heard that all my friends are here, but I don’t have the guts to face them yet... I-It’s not that I don’t care—I love them all! So that’s why...if they told me I’m useless even when it really matters, I don’t think I could go on living... I'm...better off not seeing them for now...

Artoria's always been such a hard worker. She’s really something else. We’re basically polar opposites, but I’m proud to be her friend... Oh, who do I think I am, calling myself her friend... Ehehe...

Morgana’s always so bubbly and upbeat, but for some reason she treats me like her friend. It makes me so happy, whenever I see her face, I...feel like I’m going to hurl... Look at me, just seeing my friends makes me sick to my stomach... Hehe... Ehehehe...

The world Elaine headed off to, the place she calls “Paradise,” is said to be plagued by a Curse that grants wishes... Elaine was like a kind, gentle big sister to me. I really loved her, so I keep wondering... Why...? Why would she go so far as to betray us all...just to go there...?
Both the Hero of the Staff and the Hero of the Lance were very nice people. I always thought, maybe this is what it’d be like to have older brothers... They really were...like family to me...

H-Huh? How are you guys all here...? I thought for sure you’d all long abandoned someone as useless as me... “Mister Duke called you all together?” Th-Thank you so much... I’ve wanted to see everyone again for so long, but I didn’t have the courage... Mister Duke, I...I can’t thank you enough...!
H-Huh? Y-You’re giving that...to me...? Whaaa....?
Y-You must be disappointed in a worthless wreck like me. I’ve let you down, haven’t I? I guess it’s only a matter of time before you abandon me too, isn’t it? Hehehehe...
N-No, p-please, don’t praise me too much...! It’ll make me so happy, I might hurl...! Nnnrggh...
I’m no good at everything I do, and I’m only ever causing trouble for everyone... But even so, everyone’s so nice to me... I know I can’t stay the way I am. I know, but...

Why is everyone, including you, Mister Duke, so nice to someone like me...? I-I was always told that just by existing, I was a burden... That I had no right to keep living... That everyone would be better off without me...! So why...? Why are you all so kind...?
Y-You guys were all amazing... I really was the only useless one, huh? Hehehe...
Just as I thought, hehehe... You guys would’ve been better off without me here, right?
This is all I can do...
I’m actually kinda good at this...!
Well well, it is a pleasure to see you! I take it you are here to ask for something only my purse can afford?
Well well... At long last, my dear peasant duke once again graces me with his presence. Do know, the price for the time you made me sit and wait...does not come cheap.
I take it there is something you wish to ask of me? Hehe... Seek my ear? Then, you best bend the knee.

Listen... I bought a couple of new dresses, but I want to ask your opinion on them. This red dress is brimming with elegance—the kind that screams “Regina.” But, I can say the same for this yellow one too... Huh? “Both look good on me?” My...you best work on that indecisiveness of yours. After all, a gentleman who cannot make up his mind will fall out of a lady’s favor before he even realizes it.

Your face says it all—“Why does Regina carry a doll that is so worn and tattered?” ...Such is a mystery that puzzles even the likes of me. Although this doll is not to my liking, I find myself unable to throw him away... Or rather, something tells me I must not... It pains me that I cannot explain why my hands refuse to part with him...

Work, you say? Such trifling matters are best left to your attendants...but I suppose there is no way around it. Thus I, the ever-so-elegant Lady Regina, shall offer my assistance. ...Hehe. This is an opportunity not many are fortunate to have, so shower me with gratitude to your heart’s content! Oh-hohoho!

Every plebeian who comes near me only has eyes on my wealth... Or so I believed, until I met you. My money seems to be the last thing on your mind, and you simply give me everything, without even so much as asking for a coin in return. Does this mean...my beauty has made you utterly smitten with me?

Ah, there you are—I finally found you! Today is your birthday, is it not? Hehe, you must be overjoyed that I remembered. Anything your heart desires, I will gladly buy...what? Y...You do not need anything, you say? And, you are simply content with me greeting you “Happy birthday”...? H-How terribly...modest of you! But, very well. I shall greet you “Happy birthday” till you are overflowing with delight. You best be grateful!

Oh my, just the gentleman I was looking for... Be a dear and pour me another cup of tea, will you? ...Wait, just what are you doing? Give me that pot this instant! See, this is how you make a proper cup of tea. There, now please enjoy~! ...Stop, why am I the one doing the serving? A-Admit it! This was your plan all along!

U-Unbelievable... Sophia claims my manners are...“wrong?!” I-If this persists, I will end up having to join those country bumpkins in their “manners class”... This is me, the zenith of ladyship, we are talking about, after all! It is beyond humiliation...! Very well. If this is what it comes to, I shall pass Sophia’s exam with flying colors. Just wait and see! Oh-hohoho!

As a duke, I assume you have a fiancée or two... But, should you ever wish to wiggle yourself out of any of your engagements, I shall lend you my assistance. Though, that may lead to waves of unfounded scandals and uproars... Hehe. How entertaining, indeed.

Good grief... Miss Lunalynn is simply too oblivious to her responsibilities as an older sister. I mean, her younger sister, Soltina, is always looking after her... As the older sister, Miss Lunalynn must be the one who takes care of Soltina—not the other way around. Take me, for instance. I cannot tell you how much I took care of my... My... I mean, my... Forgive me, I am not feeling very well... Allow me to take my leave and rest for a moment.

To bend the knee before me, I see you are full of promise, my dear little kitten. Very well, I shall take you as my pet and... Wait, where are you running off to? Stop right there, Purr-incess Regina! I will buy you anything your heart desires, so come back this instant! Purr-incess Regina!!

Hehe. There is no point in hiding how you feel. I understand you more than you can ever know... Everyone comes near me with their eyes purely on my wealth... Everyone, but you... In other words, my very presence makes your heart melt like butter, right?! Hehe. Ah~ The ever-so-elegant Regina’s allure truly is frightening, even to herself... Huh? What is it? Hey—where do you think you are going? Do not dare walk away from me~!
Why, thank you. Pray tell, how much would it cost to reward you for what you have given me?
My, how commendable of you. Now then, for your rewar...huh? “You are doing this because it pleases you, so no reward is necessary?” Ugh, good grief... I knew there was something odd about you...

Hehe. Although your mouth claims you have no need for any reward, your eyes beg for praise. Oh, come now—there is no need to be shy. Here, I shall lavish you with all the praise you can possibly crave, so bend the kn... Huh? You truly do not want any? Ugh, y-you impossible creature! That was your final chance—do not even dare come back begging for a single word of praise!

Since you are so devoted to serving me, perhaps this means that you secretly desire my eyes on you? Hehe, you should not keep everything bottled up inside. You love me to the moon and back, and I know that all too well. After all, I am the most alluring lady you have ever laid eyes on, right? Now then, love and cherish me until your heart is satisfied! Oh-hohoho!

Oh-hohoho! Glorious! What a truly glorious feeling! As I thought, no one in this world dazzles brighter than I. The world itself was made for my sake! And to think, you are the first to ever bring me such delight... Well, if you ever fail to do something as simple as that, do not be surprised if I grow tired of you and leave... So, be a dear, and keep devoting yourself to my endless entertainment. Hehe!
NNRRGGHH! Y-You shall pay for this insolence!
How’s it hanging, my Duke? So, is today finally the day you’re gonna give up?

Haha! Well, look who decided to show up! I thought for sure you’d finally thrown in the towel...but nope, here you are...again... Hah... You’re a real piece of work, you know that? The Staff just has to choose guys whose souls are so alike, huh? I mean, I guess that’s why they’re chosen in the first place... Huh? What? Oh, nothing~ Just talking to myself!♥
Nnnope! I’m not gonna work one bit! That’s just not my style. I mean, isn’t it impressive enough that I’m here—blinking, breathing, and all?

Hmm? Oh, I was just thinking... All the girls who’ve gathered here are such good eggs, aren’t they? So honest, so well-behaved! I’m kinda jealous they’re able to trust others so purely. But, like, trust too much and you might get burned—just like me! And nobody wants that, am I right? Ahaha!

Trixie’s just a nickname! My real name means “bringer of joy,” but I’ve since learned there’s no such thing as “joy” in this world. Not to mention hope or trust... There’s no way I could be a “bringer” of any of those things. I didn’t have the right to go by that name anymore...so I ditched it! And now I’m just Trixie. End of story!
You’re looking a little beat, my Duke! Wanna borrow my lap for a quick nap? Aww, look at you getting all red~! C’mon, quit acting all tough and come here!

I want you to give up. But at the same time, I hope your hard work’ll actually pay off. Haha, what do I actually want? I’m a real basket case, aren’t I...?​ Juuust kidding! Did I actually fool you with my moving performance? Ahaha, your face is priceless! ...Thanks a lot, my Duke. For what, you ask? Hehehe, that’s for me to know and you to never find out!

A little birdie told me it’s your special day today. Happy birthday, my Duke! If we’re gonna make this a day to remember...wanna get into a little trouble with me to celebrate? How does eating a whole cake at midnight sound? What, too tame? Oho~ So you wanna get reeeal bad? Hahaha! I’m just kidding! Oh, man! Your face right now’s killing me~!

The world I came from’s long gone. Toootally wiped out. So, there’s nowhere left for me to go back to. Not that I ever would, anyway. I’m planning to spend the rest of my days here, so you better not get tired of me~!

So there are others here who’ve also come from different worlds, huh? Artoria, Morgana...and Soteira too? Hey, fellow wanderers! Since we’ve all come from different worlds, we should become besties! We’ll call ourselves “The Drifters”! Woo-hoo! I’ll drink to that!

I see... So some of the girls here contracted with demons, huh...? You’re really something, my Duke, taking in poor souls like that. But hey, at least they’re better off than some folks who’ve fallen to the depths without any demon’s help, all on their own.

Merlyyy! Hehe, look at you all blushed up from just a hug! You’re such a cutie! “What’s wrong?” Aw, nothing really! Just felt like it! Y’know, from behind, you kinda remind me of this wise owl-like buddy I used to know. I always hugged her like this, so I guess it’s just a habit of mine. My bad, my bad~!

Huh? What’s up, Eirene? ...You think I’m really, really doing my best? Nah, are you sure you’ve got the right girl? I’m always slacking off and trying to get the Duke to give up his noble quest, ya know?! Don’t... D-Don’t look at me with those big eyes while saying all that mushy stuff! I-It’s throwing me off, so just leave me alone!

You know, my Duke, I can’t say you’re the sharpest tool in the shed. In fact, you’re the spitting image of my childhood friend—kind to a fault, even if you end up hurting yourself. ...Maybe that’s why. When you smile, it feels like I’m being saved, just a little. So, like...keep smiling...okay?
Ohhh! Thank you, thank you! What gracious gifts for a mooch like me!
Are you sure about that? Devoting all your precious resources to making a slacker like me stronger? Welp, don’t come crying to me if ya regret it later~!

Well, I guess I’ll say thanks. But seriously, it’s such a waste lending your power to a walking disaster like me! Why don’t you give it to someone more motivated? You’d get way more bang for your buck that way.
Seriously, nothing good’s gonna come from making me stronger! Ugh, now I can’t slack off as much with all these expectations of me~!

Waaah... Farewell, my dear, blissful days of carefree lounging... My Duke...every time you make me stronger, my peaceful life slips further and further away... Can’t you just stop already...? Wink, wink! Nudge, nudge.

Aww, man...this bites. I mean, you’re a completely different person, from an entirely different world than mine... And yet, I can’t help but lend you a hand. It’s all because you’re too much like him. I’m really losing it, aren’t I? You’re seriously throwing me off my game. Just how do you plan on taking responsibility for this?
Are we done? Sweet! Great work out there, guys! I’m beat, so I’ll be taking my break now, ’kay?
Huh? We lost? You’ve gotta be kidding me... For real? Guess I must’ve slacked off just a bit too much...
Oh, what’s this? Did you come all the way here just to see me? You sure know how to make a girl happy.

Long time no see...! You hadn’t shown your face in so long, I thought you’d died...! And just when I was thinking I’d have another ghost around to keep me company. What a shame...! Oh, I’m just pulling your leg! Think of it as a little ghostly humor to get you back in the spirit of things. Welcome back.

As I am now, almost nothing remains of my power as the “Witch of Murder.” And, thanks to the holes in my memory, I can’t even remember my real name... I’ve become nothing more than a frail, ill-fated beauty.
You see, the current me is something akin to a ghost... So, I don’t have the power to do much. About all I can do is shake my flower petals and give Fia a nice show.
Jeez... You should just hurry up and forget about a wretch like me... Treating that flower I gave you so preciously, even now... You really are impossible, you know that...?

Hey, don’t you think you should take a break soon? Or, were you hoping to enjoy the ghost life with me? I’d be more than happy to have you as my ghostly companion! I’ll warn you, though—being a ghost may be nice and easy, but the nights are about as fun as watching paint dry.

I think most people would find my existence disturbing, and steer well clear of me, you know... “I seemed lonely, so you just couldn’t leave me alone”...? Jeez, is that the line you give out to everyone? ...You’re quite the naughty boy, going after a woman my age.

Since I can’t remember my own birthday, would you let me celebrate yours instead? Having a ghost celebrate your birthday might seem like a bit of a bad omen, but it’s not every day you get to experience something like this, right? So, there’s no need to hold back! Let me give you the birthday of a lifetime!

It looks like Fia’s flourishing here. She may act like everything’s a pain, but she’s just a normal girl at heart. I’m glad to see she’s made some friends. ...That girl’s no longer alone. I guess she doesn’t need someone like me anymore.

Long, long ago back in Byrune, I apparently conducted research on witches. Who would have thought that after all that, I’d become a witch myself, and then a ghost... It just goes to show, you never know what life will throw your way, huh?

It seems like that gravekeeper Moddey can see me. I’m glad she’s doing so much to try and help me out, but whenever I hear that lullaby of hers, I get...kinda... Oooh, that was close...! I was seconds away from knocking on Heaven’s door just now...!

I remember hearing of Dian before. It seems she’s got quite the knack for brewing tea. The professor she served often spoke highly of it, you see. That’s exactly why...what happened was so...regrettable... As far as a way to turn her professor back to normal is concerned, I...don’t remember...

“Artificial Angel”... I’ve heard Professor Mertillier’s theory before, but to think she actually managed to bring a homunculus witch to life...! That professor really is a genius...! Oh, right! She’s at this mansion too, isn’t she? ...What? You mean that little girl over there is the professor...?! Hahaha! I guess the mind of a genius really does elude me!

I ask that you don’t tell Fia of my existence. After all, it’s not like I can touch her, or even talk to her anymore. Don’t you think it’s best if she just forgets about a shadow of the past like me, and looks toward a new light instead...? It must be a painful request to indulge for someone as kind as you, but this is the best choice for us. ...I’m counting on you.
Oh, what’s this? Trying to make me—a ghost—stronger, are you?
Putting even the dead to work...? The world sure is cruel...

Now, I’m the lingering scent of my magic left in the flower and Fia’s memories of me, made into one by your staff’s power of bonds. In other words, various elements just miraculously happened to fall into place, so it wouldn’t be strange if I suddenly disappeared, either. That’s why you shouldn’t get your hopes up too high, alright?

Huh...? I’m getting stronger, even as I am now...? ...Oh, I get it...! So my current state, where a trace of my soul is being held in an artificial body, also makes me something of a homunculus myself, huh...?

My power was born from my wish for the world to be destroyed. So, it’s meant to do exactly that. Are you saying you want to use a power like that to bring peace to the world...? Good grief... If you really mean that, I just can’t refuse.

Ever since that day, I’ve only been able to watch life pass me by, unable to do anything else. That still hasn’t changed—or rather, now I can do even less than before. But, it seems there are two strange people out there who still believe in a ghost like me, anyway. So, I’ll try to hold off on going to Heaven for just a little bit longer.
Nice work, everyone~! ...Well, it’s not like anyone but you can hear me, though...
And to think, the old me could’ve dealt with them using only the tip of my finger...
Aaand another one bites the dust!

Text:
Goodbye to the sunset
A lonely voice echoes vibrantly in my mind
Long ago, here and now
People’s prayers resound
with melodies of the heart

I knew right from the beginning that
this journey would have an ending.
There was no escaping that day,
so I set forth with an empty bag.

In the rain-filled streets, I sway to-and-fro
With my weeping heart
Right now, I wish you were here,
smiling with me

I waited for sunrise, checking my calendar
Tomorrow’s the day I stop crying
I asked time and again
“If I can be free, will I be saved?”

Goodbye forever
My heart longs to stay, but I have to go on
This unending journey will take me
To where the moonlight shines

I had found more than joy. More than sadness.
Within me, emotions I had never
felt before began to stir.
As my bag got heavier, my legs got lighter.

Every time I blink
The world changes—it makes me dizzy
As time goes on
We’ll become bubbles in the wind

In between the gray clouds
The blue sky starts shining through
Sunlight fills the room
I’ve seen this sight before

I waited for sunrise, hiding into the night
When my growing fears began to overflow
In my heart, an amber glow from long ago
Shines bright

I couldn’t protect my homeland,
so there’s no way I can protect the world.
That’s what I thought, until I found them...

Miracles overflowing throughout the world.
Wishes that never stop praying
for those who are precious...
Courage summoned for those who are loved...
They turn even the deepest darkness into light.

That is the magic that will save the world.

I dreamed telling myself
“There’s nothing to fear”
I weave my dreams together,
but it’s time to go back
To where I’m alive

Goodbye to days long ago
Here I go again, hitting the trail
I hold your hand in mine
As our journey brings us closer together
Endlessly, endlessly

The flower petals fall and dance
To where the moonlight shines
To where the moonlight shines

Before I knew it,
my bag was filled to the brim.
But, it’s fine.
Because when my journey
comes to an end,
I know I won’t be alone.

Dragging my body as heavy as lead
I walk aimlessly through town
before the dawn
My river of tears has long since dried up
Leaving only my empty heart

I wish I could have lived
Not knowing anything
If the sun rises again one day
I’m sure I’ll finally be able to truly smile

To this day, whenever the rain falls...
everything comes back to me, my lord.
...The time I first met you.
...The time your warm smile welcomed me...
as I was drowning in mud and despair.
Even if it is just for a while...
may I stay by your side?

Whenever I feel someone’s kindness
I just know someday they’ll leave me behind
I tell myself unconditional love doesn’t exist
And close my eyes to forget all about it

I wish I could have lived
Not knowing anyone
Was the one who decided I was worthless
Me and me alone?

The one who sold me off to the Church
for being a witch...was my own father.
Inside that leather bag was a handful of gold coins... That was all I was worth to him.

Braving through life
And meeting my end
Both scare me, and I’m here just breathing
Even the light looks like an alluring trap
Laid out by the shadows,
kept beyond my grasp

After making my escape,
the cold rain strikes my body.
Finally succumbing to exhaustion,
I crumbled into the mud.
I ask myself as my mind fades to black...
“Who in the world would want someone like me...?
Why...was I even born at all...?”

I thought I could do anything
I thought I could be the hero
And anytime, anywhere
I could shine like the brightest jewels
But when I looked back, everyone was gone
I was just a filthy stone
with nothing but hope
Ah, can I ever change?

Braving through life
And meeting my end
Both scare me, and I’m here just breathing
Now I think I’m okay with that
A faint light within me begins to shine

The one who came to my rescue was the Duke.
He gave me a warm bed,
a new home—so many gifts.
It was then that I first realized...
“I want repay him for saving me.
...I want to live, devoting everything to him.”

When I live each normal day
again and again
I feel my time now is
a dream I can believe in
Even if the light was an alluring trap
Laid out by the shadows
I want to reach out and touch it

Now everything is clear to me—
I know exactly why I’m here...
The rain has stopped.
Now, let us go, my lord.

Here I am, like crumpled,
leftover bread crust
All alone in this room
I try sitting where you always sat
For some reason,
I just can’t keep it together

Hey, little bear, listen.
My heart remembers
Those clumsy fingers
that used to stir it
Hey, little bear,
why do you have these small scratches?
If you’re not stitched up,
everything will spill out
Even into my dreams

My most prized possession is this worn out,
slightly misshapen stuffed bear.
When Big Sis and I were driven out of town,
it was the one thing I refused to leave behind.
The proof of the precious bond we share.

Every time I look at this bear’s cute lopsided face,
I’m reminded of those days.
When Big Sis and I lived together—
the happiest days of my life.

I try to pull at the raggedy stitches
But with just a touch,
they tore apart, I cried
And that’s the end of it
This longing for you
I’ve held onto so tightly
Will one day be carried off by the wind
Here to wipe my tears
is my stuffed bear

All I wanted was to keep living our quiet,
peaceful lives together.
But...fate had other plans.
The demon known as the Witch Hunt,
took my dearest person away from me.

Somewhere, you call out my name
Your voice sounding so sleepy
Kind and hesitating,
you lean on my shoulder
Ever so gently

Hey, little bear,
listen just a little bit longer
Your seams are crooked,
and your button’s about to fall off
Hey, little bear, why do I always
Let the most important things pass me by?
Even though I was looking for them

I wanted to believe
that we would see each other again.
But...there was nothing I could do...
Of all the witches captured by the Inquisition,
there hasn’t been a single one who has returned.

So...when I heard Big Sis
had become a Witch of Qlipha...
I was kind of happy.
Because even if she was
a witch who cursed this world...
at least she was alive.

Our goodbye was as swift as a bubble
It softly fell, popped,
And vanished without a trace
Only the bond that ties us together
Is stuffed with love, even now
My worn-out stuffed bear

I know you might be doing all this
for my sake out of love, Big Sis,
but this can’t be how things end for us!
I want to see you again...
Hey Big Sis, whenever I was crying,
you’d always come stay by my side, right?
Now it’s my turn.
If you’re out there crying right now,
I’ll come running. I promise.

One day, I had a dream
If I stretched out my hand
a little further
Would you have been there?

I try to pull at the raggedy stitches
But with just a touch,
they tear apart, I cried,
And that’s the end of it
This longing for you
I’ve held onto so tightly
Will one day be carried off by the wind
Here to wipe my tears
is my stuffed bear

This bear is the proof of my bond with my big sis.
Even when we’re apart,
just hugging it makes it feel like she’s right here.
Big Sis, you’re always saying,
“You’re amazing, Sol.”
But if that really is the case...
then it’s all thanks to you, you know.
Because just having you next to me...
gives me all the strength in the world.

I swallowed my loneliness,
suffered through pain
Coughed up my weakness,
and found strength
But that wasn’t the end

Executioner.
The sword that strikes down rulers who
have descended down the path of tyranny.
I entrusted that sword to my beloved friend.
...To have her kill me.
Even though my request would
be an unbearable burden to her.

Alone and lost in this corner of the world
I embrace my loneliness
and walk through today
So cold, even the pain numbs away
In the heart of the deep, moonless night

We stood at the throne and promised each other.
Should we stray from our paths, we would
take our swords and end one another.
Executioner—the vanquisher of tyrants,
and Oathkeeper—the mark of a knight’s loyalty...
To entrust our lives to each other...
or to bind our fates in twisted chains.

It feels like today is crushing me
With the weight of the burdens on my back
But I’m still wishing that
tomorrow will come

That’s why today
I swallowed my loneliness,
suffered through pain
Coughed up my weakness,
and found strength
But that still wasn’t enough for me
And I even pushed away
the hands held out to me
All that’s left inside is my fragile heart

Even loneliness can create strength
I say that to myself,
holding tightly on to today
I continued fooling this heart of mine
It wept as I just looked away

The cursed light that consumes the land—
the one who called upon this tragedy...was me.
Tears that mourn a loved one transform
into crystals that emanate a sinister glow.
...I must keep my promise.
If forcing you to suffer like this is my sin...
my penance...will be to die alongside you.

I’m afraid of how frail I’ll become
If I hold on to you and can’t let go
When I paint over the stranger in the mirror
They start breaking all over again
Then I won’t be able to
lean on you anymore
Because you’ve gone away

Her stone altar emanates an ominous light.
I traversed her fallen crystals,
finally reaching my destination.
I was ready for what I must do.
Just before her eyes completely succumb to madness, tears roll down her cheeks.
I unsheathed Oathkeeper. It is time I fulfill my vow.
“...I love you, Ophelia.”

I swallowed my loneliness,
suffered through pain
Coughed up my weakness,
and found strength
But that still wasn’t enough for me
And I even pushed away
the hands held out to me

But that still wasn’t enough for me
And I even sold your heart away
Killing even the pain you had inside
Soon will come the break of dawn

I see a heart frozen with fear
And push it far away from me
Across the distant sky,
Everyone’s the same

Longing for connection, we reach out,
But grasp nothing but air
We get a bit scared
Because we are all alone

We were abandoned
on top of a pitch black mountain
that no one ever dares come near.
When Cerberus got scared,
I wrapped my trembling arms around her.
“It’s okay. Big Sis is here.”
With those words, she’d smile at me
through the tears on her face.

“That’s right. I gotta protect my little sister.”
But... Cerberus should’ve been within my reach,
but I was too scared to even move.
Then... She was gone... In her place—
the cursed lightning that was destroying the world.

Can I ever brave the darkest nights
And become stronger?

If I only had one treasure,
that would be enough
Just the courage to protect with all I have
Something so precious, it brings me to tears
As my arms tremble holding onto it tightly
Kindness becomes pain
Even if my tears run dry,
I’ll make my way to you

I just wanted a little bit of courage...!
I don’t need amazing powers to save the world,
or even the strength to fight off bad guys...!
Just a sliver of courage that would’ve helped me
protect my dear sister’s smile.
It should’ve been enough
to just reach my hand out to her...
But back then...I couldn’t even lift a finger.

If someone had the same dreams as me
That would make me so happy

I keep hiding from my fears again and again
But, I see where I need to be,
no running away
Even if I were to howl in pain,
And crack into tiny pieces,
I’ll wipe my tears and stand right back up
I’m weak, but I’ll never stop
pushing forward

The Cerberus I remember was always smiling.
Hehe... What kind of big sister am I?
How could I not’ve realized it sooner?
Courage isn’t having the power to fight...!
She was scared,
but she braved through it all to smile for me.
That kindness of hers is what true courage is.

If this little promise is trampled on,
And gets covered with mud,
I’ll pick it back up
If I gently wipe the stains away
It will shine warmly once again

I’d given up, believing I didn’t have
a single ounce of courage.
But in reality, I had more than I could imagine.
Keeping Cerberus in my mind
gives me that courage...
Courage that I’ll always treasure.
It might be too late at this point,
but I don’t wanna regret anything anymore...!

I wish upon a star
for just a little bit of strength

If I only had one treasure,
that would be enough
Just the courage to protect with all I have
Flowing through my heart
I’m sure one day we can go back to the days
When we held each other without letting go
Kindness becomes pain
I fill with wounds, but not regret
Pushing through the storm,
I’ll make my way to you

I’ll walk forward, step...by step...
If my legs tremble with fear,
or if I’m torn apart by lightning,
I’ll keep getting back up.
She’s out there crying, after all...
calling out to me over and over...
“Big Sis. Big Sis...”
If you’re crying,
I’ll save you as many times as it takes.
So let’s go home...together.

Oh! Are you lost, too?
Heh, no need to worry—
I’ll show you the way!
After all, that’s my job as a gravekeeper, hehehehe~♪

Lost in midnight’s maze
The night owls are stumbling about
It’s about time they go to bed

Those bright, shining stars
Surely are singing this lullaby
They call your name to be with you

If you can’t fall asleep
Then entrust yourself to me

Doki doki doggy night
Count all the stray sheep you like
Make it make it makin’ night
But that won’t help you get any sleep
Boogie boogie boogie night
Come to bed six feet under
And close your eyes
Ah... I’ll be by your side
watching over you
Until you rest in peace

Gravekeeping is my calling.
I may not look it, but I’ve always been good
at taking care of people!
Cleaning the graves, changing the flowers—
there’s always so much to do.
Betcha didn’t know this job’s
actually pretty tough.
Yet, not only do people not thank us,
they call us “bad omens”—they hate us.

But...does any of that really matter?
After all, we’re the only ones who can take
care of people after they’ve departed.
The grave for Laila, and the one for Dad...
I dug them both all by myself, y’know.

Little, puny lowlifes
Big, mighty kings—and even you
Everyone looks the same
when they’re asleep

If you have a wish
Come show me the purity in your heart
After I look you up and down, I got you

Even if you’re naughty
I’ll make sure you have sweet dreams

Doki doki doggy night
The dark night has fallen
Make it make it makin’ night
But it’s not scary—no need to cry
Boogie boogie boogie night
I’ll hold your shivering hand
and be your guide
Now, time to sink into the depths below
And sing out loud

A disease struck,
and everyone disappeared from the village.
Having become a witch, I stayed
and kept working despite all that.
The poor forgotten souls that
everyone left behind...
They all must be so lonely, huh?

That’s why, I’ll be right here—
By their sides, ensuring they all have
a peaceful rest.
Dad, Laila, watch over me, okay?

Doki doki doggy night
Count all the stray sheep you like
Make it make it makin’ night
But that won’t help you get any sleep
Boogie boogie boogie night
Come to bed six feet under
And close your eyes
Ah... I’ll be by your side watching over you
Until you rest in peace

Can’t sleep, huh? Hehe, it’ll be okay.
I’ll remember you. I’ll stay by your side.
So close your eyes,
and may you rest in peace.
Hehehehe~♪

Monsters with big horns...and sharp claws.
That’s how witches were depicted
in the picture books I used to read as a child.
That’s why, I knew right away
that girl wasn’t a witch.
I knew...and yet...
I couldn’t do anything for her...

Emotions that consume me more and more
Wither away and petrify
Horns just begin to grow
From those who lie and
those who tell the truth

What should I do?
For just a little longer
Could I make anyone smile my way?
I can’t find what I desire
Where is it now?
Please, tell me

Every gentle caress from me
Brings more scars to all that I touch

The place I ran away to is so cold...and scary...
But...I can’t go back home anymore.
Because...I’m a monster.

No one sees this flower wilting away
Frozen in ice while waiting
for dreams to come

Before they are gone forever
Sugar crystals always become blades
Their sweetness leaves a pain so sharp
But they were once round,
safe enough to touch

What should I do?
Just one more time
Can I ever find it in my heart to smile?
If only I could throw everything away
I would finally be at peace,
or so I believed

In the end, it’s all that remains of me
A past I wish would be lost,
like tears in the rain

The sound of roaring hooves in the mud
and angry knights quickly approaching.
I race down the mountain path
into the woods, trip and fall,
but I keep frantically crawling away in fear.

I’m scared... I’m so scared.
Someone save me!
I try desperately to scream out,
but even my voice
turns into the dark howl of a monster...
That’s where I always wake up.

I gazed into the vast, starless sky
Wrapped my arms around myself,
trembling all alone

Can...I ask you to do me just one favor...?
Please...tell me that...
meeting you wasn’t just a dream.
When I wake up shaking,
could you please just...stay here by my side?

Emotions that consume me more and more
Wither away and petrify
Horns just begin to grow
From those who lie and
those who tell the truth

Diamonds sparkle up in the moonlit sky
Look how they twinkle—
so far, yet so close
Ah...

Destiny traps me in its walls,
but I’ll defy it
And live my life as I am

The cold basement floor...
and the weeping faces of the women
that were brought there...
That’s all I ever saw at my fiancé’s estate.

I had always dreamed of meeting
my one true love—my prince.
But...the man who greeted me there
was the farthest thing from that.
The priest I went to for help
pointed his finger at me and screamed,
“Filthy witch, don’t lie!”

My story began in total darkness
But, I’m sure it’ll end in bright sunlight
If my wish could come true,
I’d always be
The one who prays only for you—
your étoile

Mother and Father told me
that their child was no witch...
That...they don’t remember
ever giving birth to me.
Hehe...ahahahah...

There’s no such thing as “beautiful” in this world.
After being betrayed by faith,

The one once called the “Witch of Murder.” Lily should be dead, but a trace of her soul left in a flower, Fia’s feelings for her, and an angel’s power in the Duke’s staff align, temporarily bringing Lily back. Only the Duke can see her, but Lily asks him to tell no one, especially Fia, of her existence.

It won’t disappear...
My guilt from that day...no matter what I do...

“I’m sure you’ll do great,” my mother smiled.
I watched her, and all my brothers and sisters
wave goodbye to me as I stepped into the
carriage bound for the city.

Living in a poor farming village with tons
of children is...difficult to say the least...
From a very early age, I learned just how hard
my parents worked to support us.

Which is why, following my family’s rule,
I left home at the age of 12—just as all my
older sisters had done.

If I go somewhere that has a lot of people,
there’s bound to be work to do.
I’d be lying if I said I wasn’t worried...

But with just as much anticipation overflowing
in me, I ventured into a new town.

I had heard that both my mom and sisters
used to work as handmaidens, which is why
I wanted to follow in their footsteps.

There are people who would say that
being a handmaiden is the perfect job for
country folk like us who’ve never had
any form of schooling...

But I’ve always wanted to
become a handmaiden.
It’s been my goal ever since I was younger,
when I realized just how much
I enjoy taking care of people.

I’d become a handmaiden...and one day,
I’d have that fateful encounter,
just like my mother did.
I’d meet the master I’m destined to serve,
and work to make him happy...
That was my dream.

To achieve that dream, I believed I could
overcome any hardship...
It never even crossed my mind that
a witch couldn’t become a handmaiden...

“There’s no way in hell I’d employ a witch.”

With those words, my master banished me
from his estate.

Hah... Not again...
After being flung outside, my entire body
aching, I slowly limped away.

I wonder how many times this makes...
I’ve worked for many masters.
At the beginning, everyone is so nice to me,
“You’re such a hard worker,” they smile.

But the second they find out I’m a witch...
they change.

I’ve got no allowance...and barely enough
money for food tomorrow...
Why does being a witch mean
I have to suffer like this...?
Are...witches not allowed to be handmaidens...?

“Working is very tough.
It’s not all fun and games.”
That was what my sister wrote in one
of the letters she used to send me.

But those letters, and the remittances she
sent with them stopped coming a while ago...
I wonder if my sisters also had the same
troubles I’m having...

“You’re a hard worker, Monica.
I’m sure you’ll do great.”
That’s what my mother always used to say,
but...I feel like I’m about to break.

Witches can’t become handmaidens...
Witches aren’t allowed to have dreams...

No one taught me any of this...!

No matter how hard I try, that hard work
will never pay off...because I’m a witch.

If that’s the case...then is there
any point in trying at all?

At what felt like my 100th master’s estate,
I was finally captured by the Knights of Longinus.

My master was such a nice man.
He knew I was a witch,
yet still let me stay with him...

But...he was just keeping me so that
he could hand me over to the Church.
I was never truly welcome there.

I wonder if witches aren’t allowed
to have dreams...

I wanted to become a handmaiden and
be of use to others...but I guess that dream
will never come true.

At that moment...the knights that were
dragging me away went flying, and a strange
man and woman rescued me.

The place they brought me to...was a large
mansion—the new mansion I was to work at.

...This...is it... This is my fateful encounter...
Mom, I finally met him—the master that
I’m destined to serve.

To my dear family back home,

Right now, I’m working at my master’s estate
as an apprentice handmaiden.
He rescued me when I got caught up in the
Witch Hunt, and agreed to let me stay with him.

My master is fighting everyday to save other
girls who are in the same situation I am.
His goal is to save every single witch out there,
and it seems he has a long, cruel journey
ahead of him.

So in order to help ease his troubles even just
a little bit, I want to serve as his handmaiden
and take care of him.

I plan to spare no effort in attending to him
each and every day.

There are still times when I get discouraged...
but right now, I feel like the happiest girl
in the world.

Sincerely, Monica.

The world has been destroyed.

A country incinerated by hellfire.
A kingdom consumed by crystals.
An empire purged by the Tree of Life.

These calamities—known as “Curses”—
appeared without warning and laid waste to
every single nation.

But, I refuse to let that stop me.
Because above all else, as the one entrusted
with the “Staff” by Her Holiness, I don’t want
to lose anyone important to me ever again.

With my heart filled with determination,
I took my first step into the ravaged world.
To search this vast land for the one and only
“Successor.”

“Be a ruler who can protect the weak.”
That was the lesson I learned from my parents.

But, I failed to live up to what they taught me.
I lost everything,
and was the only one left alive.
I fell into despair, but the one who saved me
was Her Holiness, the Pope.

Everyone has a small
glimmer of light inside them.
When they’re happy.
When they’re having fun.
When they’ve met the one they love.

That light fills their hearts with warmth.
And there’s someone who can take their own
light and share it with everyone.

Someone whose kindness towards others can
illuminate anyone’s path.

That person was Her Holiness.

One day, Her Holiness called me into
the deepest part of the cathedral.

There are two relics that have existed since
the beginning of the Church of Longinus’s
2000-year history.

The Baptismal Fire that was bestowed
by God—the “Lance of Longinus.”
The Divine Oak that descended
from Heaven—the “Staff of Tikkun.”

These two sacred treasures—said to awaken
when the world comes to an end—were now
in the hands of Her Holiness.

“I am not long for this world.”

A black infestation begins to spread
throughout Her Holiness’s body.

“Find the ‘Successor’ of the Staff.
The fate of the world is at stake.”

She held the Staff out to me,
but I couldn’t accept it.

After all, I couldn’t even save my homeland,
so the idea of me saving the world was...

As I stood there trembling,
Her Holiness gently smiled at me.

“There is no need to worry.
I have absolute faith that you can do it.”

And so, I set foot on my journey to
search for the “Successor.”
Soon after that, the “Curses”
engulfed the world.

As I wander from one country to the next,
all the worries I had bottled up begin crawling
back into my mind.
If I don’t find the Successor,
the world will truly be destroyed.
The fate of the world depends on me...

Her Holiness told me not to worry, but even if
I searched every corner of the world,
that doesn’t mean I can meet every single
person out there.
I don’t even know what kind of person
the “Successor” is to begin with...

What if I was unable to meet them?
What if I did, but didn’t know?
What if...they’ve already fallen victim
to the Curses...?

...No! Do not lose heart! Because this time...
This time, I will protect everyone with
my own two hands...!
If I don’t, then what would be the point of
everything I’ve done until now...?

I’m the only one—
the only one who can do this...

The world’s already being destroyed.
That’s what I learned throught this journey.

The Curses encroached upon the land,
overrunning it with creatures
I’ve never seen before.
Nowhere was safe.

But, people were still living.
After experiencing pain, sadness,
the loss of loved ones, despair that
plunged their worlds into darkness...
they discovered light inside themselves.

Someone’s kindness, a smile they remember,
bright memories of a loved one—everyone had
a gentle light shining through the despair
in their hearts.

That’s right.
The world hasn’t been destroyed just yet.
As long as someone keeps another close
to their heart, that light will never die!

This world can’t help but tremble as it stands
on its last legs, and that’s why it can’t help
but shine.

The waning flame inside of me began burning
bright red once more.

The very last place I visited was Fran—
the country of flowers.

I couldn’t find the Successor anywhere else,
so that means they must be here...

But, what if they aren’t here, either?
That very thought terrifies me.
At this point though, there’s just no more time
to search through the entire world again...

I pray as I take my first step inside
Fran’s largest city. And then...

...Ah. There’s no mistake about it.
With a light so warm and gentle,
that person is undoubtedly the one
chosen by the Staff—the Successor.

The real journey to save the world starts now.

But, I’m not worried.
I already know that as long as people keep
others in their hearts, light will never vanish
from the world.

“Nice to meet you. I know this is sudden,
but would you like to join me in saving
the world?”

My life has been filled with nothing but
misery and despair.
