I’ll keep creating weapons that protect lives,
using these hands that Richesse—
that my partner believes in.

Freshly spilled blood spread in slow waves,
its heat melting the fallen snow.

Insulated by his overcoat,
my grandfather’s corpse was still warm.
From his thin frame,
a trail of white smoke floated up
from the bullet hole shot into
his back seconds before.

“Now... You’ll be coming with us.”

That was the declaration
the Inquisition imparted to me.

When I looked back,
my little sister was staring at me
with horror-stricken eyes,
a blade held to her neck.
Now, only one path lay before me.

“...Please. At least...spare my sister.”

Killing all emotion in my voice,
I gave that single request.
In place of a response,
the Inquisitor’s lips only
curled into a sadistic smirk.

My family lived in hiding
deep within the snowy mountains.
For my sister and I,
who had become witches,
living deep in the forests
of the desolate mountains
provided the perfect hiding place.

I learned how to survive as a hunter
from my grandfather...
and the laws of nature.
In order to live,
we must sacrifice the lives of others.
Even if that means...
taking the lives of the innocent.

On the list I’d been given,
there were six witches’ names—
the lives I was to take
in exchange for my sister’s.
If I killed those six witches,
my sister would be returned to me.

That’s what the Inquisition had told me.

A letter arrived from my sister.
The dried ink of the typewriter
penned a cruelly brief message.

“I’m alright. Please don’t worry.”
That was all it said.
Right on schedule, the fifth of its kind.
A letter arrived for each witch I killed.

I hadn’t gotten to see her
even once since that day.
But, even so...
This was the single
thread of hope I had left.
It was hope entangled in misery.
But, no matter how thin a thread it may be...
If that was the only thing I could cling to,
I had no choice but to grasp it for dear life.

The final target.
I took aim as I always did...
and pulled the trigger.
Then, I approached the body...
to ensure the deed was done.

However, a pair of
shaking legs blocked my path.
My eyes met ones welling with tears.
Trying to shield my target...
was a young girl.

“Please... Don’t hurt my sister...!”

Hearing the anguished cry,
the gravely wounded witch
desperately tries to rouse her body.

“No... Save yourself...”

Her voice is hoarse.
She’s likely already beyond saving.
Stuck immobile in place,
the witch looks at me with pleading eyes.

“Please...I beg of you.
At least...spare my sister...”

—Nnnrgh...!
I couldn’t help but see my own
desperation reflected in her.

What I’m doing now...
is exactly what those scum did to me...
But...there’s no other path I can take...
This is the only way...to save my sister...!

—I pulled the trigger.
Her head jerked back with a snap,
and as though the thread of
her life had been severed,
her body lied as still as a ragdoll.
In a state of shock,
the girl squeaked out a small cry.

“Big Sis...!”

I ran away as fast as I could.
I...couldn’t take any more...

In the forest at the rendezvous point.
Awaiting the crunch of my footsteps in
the snow was the sound of a single gunshot.
Magic energy radiates from the bullet
that just shot into the wall behind me.
My opponent is a witch.

“You did well. But, your job ends here.”

As though lurking in the surrounding shadows,
the voice of an Inquisitor also reaches my ears.
In that moment, everything became clear.
I had served my purpose.
In other words...my sister was already...
No... She’s probably been
dead from the start...!

If... If I just made it through this list...
they said they’d give my sister back to me...!
Ahh, I... What...have I...?!

I don’t want to remember
what happened after that.
After shooting the legs of the fleeing Inquisitor,
all I know is that I shot countless rounds
into his skull as he begged for mercy.

When I came to, before my eyes
lied the gun-wielding witch
collapsed on her side.
She had lost conciousness,
but her wounds were shallow,
and she was still breathing.
Thank goodness...

—I didn’t want to have any more
witches’ blood on my hands...

Freshly spilled blood—my blood—
spread in slow waves,
its heat melting the fallen snow.
With the remainder of
my fading consciousness,
I attended to the collapsed witch’s wounds.

From her inner pocket,
I found a list of orders and a letter.
The letter was scrawled with
a simple message from
a sender called, “Mother.”
It was just as I’d feared.
She was being used...
exactly as I had been.
That must mean...
the most important person
to this girl was also...already...

According to the list,
the girl’s next target after me...
wasn’t a witch.
Her target was the Duke of Fran—
a man who saves witches and fights
together with them against the Church.

I see... So there’s still something I can do.
Something I must do.
The Church’s Inquisition—
the perpetrators of my deception...
The ones...who had murdered
my grandfather...and my sister...!

I’ll hunt each and every one of them down.

Holding on to my
steadily waning consciousness
with my welling anger as fuel,
I headed into the forest’s depths
step by limping step.
The trail of my footprints was slowly
covered by the snow falling overhead.

The Duke’s mansion...was where I found her.
The little sister...of the final witch I had killed.

I don’t know when she first arrived.
But, it seems she’s told the others that
she’d come here looking for me.

If that girl so wishes,
I will gladly forfeit my life to her.
But...until then...I must protect her.
I will do so...until she chooses to
enact her revenge.

I’m sure...God doesn’t exist.
But...if there is someone
looking down on us...
Please, protect her.
At least let me, who couldn’t even
save my own sister...save that girl.

I know that it’s selfish, and I’m sure...
she doesn’t want this from the likes of me...
But...even so...

...I beg you...

“If you’re going to die anyway,
why not give your life over to me?”

Some strange girl asked me that
out of the blue one day.
Her question made her seem very rude.
Then again, it’s not like my life was
precious to me at this point.

So, as I pulled the sword out of my heart,
I answered. “Sure.”

The sword left a hole in my chest
that slowly began to heal.
The girl grinned as she watched it all
unfold before her very eyes.

Just who is this person? What a creep...
That was my first impression of her.

Even now, I still don’t know her name,
but what I do know is what she was called.

“The Witch of Murder.”

This dreadful witch, who could destroy
the world with the touch of her fingertip,
smiled at me as gleefully as a child.

“A witch’s power comes from the heart.
The power to defy death should’ve been
born from a heart that doesn’t wish to die,
yet you want to. Why?”

The moment I thought of asking her
why she wanted to know,
she answered me.
“I want to save you.”

I’m not foolish enough to
believe such empty words.

But, if she’s that curious,
I’ll tell her my story.

Bandits came to my village
and attacked my family.
The fear I felt from seeing it
all happen turned me into a witch.

When one’s family is attacked
before their very eyes,
it’s normal to wanna save them, right?

Well, I couldn’t even think about
saving my family...

I was so scared...
so frightened...so hopeless.
I wished only...to save myself...

I wanted to save my family.
The family I was supposed to have loved.

But, I was so scared...
All I thought was that I didn’t want to die...
and ran away, leaving everyone behind...!
Then, I was given my power...
My...punishment...

Look at me. You can stab me!
Crush me! Even break me!!

...But, I can’t even die...
For the rest of eternity,
I’ll live on...alone...

“Don’t worry. That power can
become someone else’s solace.”

...Enough with the half-minded words!
I know who you are, “Witch of Murder.”
You destroyed a single city, was it?
If only I had that kind of power too...

As my words trailed off,
the witch looked at me,
shook her head, and spoke.
“This power isn’t as good as you think it is.”

She started telling me her story.
“There’s nothing significant about
what I have to say.”

“My lover died in an accident.
I fell into despair, screaming that
the world should be destroyed.
Of course, I wasn’t serious.
It’s just what I thought at the time.”

“But, I did feel anger for this asinine world.
That anger was real.”

“My wish was granted.
When I came to,
the entire city was gone.
My family, friends,
every single person who lived there...
They had all turned to dust.”

“My murderous power changes
anything I touch into dust.
This is how my wish took shape.
Doesn’t fate have a sick sense of humor?
I’m just an ugly monster
wearing the skin of a human.”

She laughed happily
after telling me her story.
Her heart was also broken,
but in a way that was different than mine.

The two of us then set out on a journey.

The “Witch of Murder” has
a bounty on her head.
As we ran away from city to city,
she turned my body to dust,
claiming she was conducting experiments.

I had no clue what
she was doing while I was dead.
Whenever I was resurrected,
her grin would always be there to greet me.

“Good morning.
Now, that’s a face that creeps me out
no matter how many times I see it.”
“Thank you. Now then,
let me try killing you one more time.”

I’ve gotten used to these exchanges of ours.
As my life feels more and more detached
from my body, even my sense of reality
begins slipping away.

That reminds me.
It should be about time we leave this city.

Are we going to a southern city
famous for its cuisine next?
I wanna go to a hot spring in the north too.
Hey, what do you think?

As I asked about our next destination,
she no longer had her usual grin.
Instead, she had a gentle smile on her face.

“Our journey’s over.
It’s time for our wishes to finally come true.”

Then, her body started turning to dust.

“I was bound to die by my own power,
so I’m glad I made it in time.
As we part ways, I’ll crystalize my power
and leave it with you.
Using it should allow even you to die.”

Why...would you do something like that...?

“Even a cursed power can save others.
Power may take the shape of a monster,
but at its heart is a human.
That is what I wanted to prove to you.”

...I...see.

“You are my solace.
Thanks to you, I can die as a human.
I wish that you may also be blessed
with a happy death.”

With those last words, she turned to dust,
leaving behind a single white flower
that lay at her feet.

“...Our wishes,” huh.
She really was a selfish person
until the very end.

I felt her warmth in the flower
as I held it in my hands,
and tears that were once dry
ran down my cheeks.

In the end, the Witch of Murder
used her power for me.

Even if a power is cursed,
there’s no doubt that at its core is
a human who loves others.
That’s what she meant when
she said she could “die as a human.”

I gently stroked the flower she left behind.
With this, I’ll be able to die too...

But, now’s not the time to do so.

I’ll fulfill her dying wish.
That’ll be the “proof of my humanity.”

I sewed the flower near my heart,
and started walking.

I’ll die as a human.
Until then, I’ll live on.
That was her dying wish...

To provide me the only way I can die.
Not as a monster, but as a normal girl.

When we started our journey and
dispelled the Curse of flowers,
I felt something strange inside me.
The moment the entire Curse was
dispelled from the country of Fran,
I realized what had happened.

The Curse wasn’t dispelled.
It was only sealed away inside of me.
After every Curse has converged into me,
I’m sure that in the end, I’ll...

There are 10 Curses destroying the world,
and it’s impossible for them all to be
sealed away inside a single person.
But, there’s one secret I’ve been hiding.

When I was a child,
I was called the child of miracles.
Everyone said I was born
with the power of God,
capable of performing
His miracle only once.

I’m afraid of dying.
But, knowing that my life can save the world
provided with me with a little bit of solace.
That’s why, it wasn’t dying that I was
afraid of—it was the idea of dying
without being able to use this power.

To save the world, I thought our journey
would be full of pain and hardships.
It’s unforgivable to have fun
while saving the world.
We have to undergo the
pain and hardships.

But...with those gentle eyes of his,
he noticed how I was changing for the worse.
Then, a trial that was meant for me to
face alone became something shared
by the two of us.

Half of my pain disappeared,
then the next thing I knew,
it was completely gone.
With him and so many friends
lending me their hands,
this journey of pain and hardships
turned into one full of fun and joy.

Our journey will one day come to an end.
That’s something I should’ve known all along.
And yet...right now...

Still lacking the strength to say goodbye,
the end of our journey appeared
right before my very eyes.

Inside a large crater lies the altar of sealing.
There, we save Her Holiness from
the demon controlling her,
and the power of the Staff
purges the final Curse.
At last, the world is saved...!

...No, something’s off. Why was it so easy?
Don’t tell me...the demons were waiting
for every Curse to be dispelled...?
For every Curse to converge into one place...?

There are only 10 Witches of Qlipha
in the world, and each one possesses
the power of a guardian angel.
When such power to protect the world inverts,
it becomes a power that destroys—a “Curse.”
That means, to take away a Curse...
is to take away a “power to protect
the world...”

Suddenly, a power taking
the shape of ominous,
piercing spikes pours out from me.
I hear Her Holiness cry out in dread.

“An 11th Curse...?!
But...such a thing should not exist...!”

The altar of sealing shatters,
and something enters my body.

The angels of old lose their power,
their seals broken, allowing for
the advent of the demon lord.
My body, reshaped by the 10 Curses,
becoming his vessel.

But, demons are inherently cunning,
and arrogant all the same.

The demon lord begins to resurrect.
The 10 seals have been broken,
leaving the 11th inside me.
It was a miracle that shouldn’t exist—
the result of demons’ schemes
and angels’ deception.
...A black key that turns souls into prisons.

It all finally dawned upon me.
I wield the power of God,
and can perform His miracle only once.

That power was for this very moment.

Long ago, the demon lord
tried to destroy the world.
With his overwhelming power,
the angels could do nothing
but seal him away.

That very same demon lord is inside me,
but he has yet to regain all his strength.
Now’s the time to use my life to save the world.

I turned to meet those familiar,
gentle eyes for one last time.
I was only able to make it this far
because you were always there for me.
So, I want to say thank you.
...Goodbye.

A light as pure as snow begins
to pour out from within me.
This single miracle can make my wish—
my final wish—come true.
To use my life to save the world.

And yet...

Where did I go wrong...?
I thought I was ready for
this to happen, but...
Hey... Please... I beg you...
Save me...!

I knew it was wrong to
have fun saving the world.
At the very last second,
I was too weak to wish for
peace to come to the world...
Then, the miracle made
my wish come true.

My wish came true, and I was saved.
The demon lord remained inside me.
Right now I can keep his power at bay,
but when he eventually makes his return,
the end of the world will be on my hands...

To prevent that from happening,
I would have to go deep into the underworld
and find the demons’ throne.
To seal the demon lord away...
Or, to kill all that remains of me.

Until now, I wasn’t afraid... But...

If only I’d been oblivious to everything,
then I could’ve easily saved the world.
Now, I’m trembling as I walk.
Smiling desperately so I don’t break.
But one day, I’ll be at the end of my rope.

When that happens,
can I hang on to being myself...?
Once I’m there at the demons’ throne,
what is it that I’ll wish for...?

There’s an angel and a demon inside me.
The angel tells me to save the world,
while the demon whispers
the sweetest temptations.

You’ve already abandoned the world.
You knew what you truly wanted,
so why are you hesitating now?

...He’s trying to save the world.
So, I’ll do the same.
Not for the world, but for him.

But, I’m sure he’ll look at me with
those gentle eyes and say,
“Your life is more precious
to me than the world.”

...Ah...yes...
If I heard such
wonderful words from him,
it might make me just
want to abandon the world.

After all, there’s a secret I’ve been hiding.
The power of God is hidden away
in someone who shouldn’t exist—
the foolish Witch of Qlipha who
bears the number 0.

That is who I am.

There exists a legend in my village.

Long ago, there was a cult
that worshipped a witch,
and a small group of people
who fled from their clutches.
It is said that those people
created this village.

“There are still lurkers out there,
chasing after witches.
If those scary people
find you outside all alone,
they’ll snatch you up and drag you away.”

My grandmother, the village chief,
would give that warning to the children
on almost a daily basis...

Only a few people believed her.
Everyone else ran away to the world outside.

But, I was so scared,
I didn’t have the courage to leave,
so I secluded myself in the safety of my room.

It’s lonely spending day after day just
seeing everyone off as they leave the nest,
but feeling lonely will always be better
than feeling afraid.

That was my world,
but then Rean came along,
and changed it.

“...Priscilla, I’ll protect you.”

I was just a coward,
but Rean made that promise to me.

Even though I was still unable
to step outside my room,
Rean was far from upset.
With the words, “I promise,”
she took my hand,
and brought me into the world outside.

The sights I saw for the first time
were so bright, and so gentle that
they brought tears to my eyes...
All my fears had instantly faded away.

Rean must have shared
some of her courage with me.

From then on, I began going outside
to play with Rean.

Dear sister Zara and dear sister Skuld
eventually joined our little group,
adding even more to the fun.

In time, there may come a day
when Rean leaves the village,
just like everyone else.

Even so, right now...
Even if it’s just for this brief moment...
I want to be with her...!

I made that wish deep in my heart
each time I saw Rean smile.

But, the time for us to say goodbye
came when we least expected it.

One day, I went with Rean outside the village.
I knew what we were doing was really bad,
and that I needed to put a stop to
everything, but...

“It’s okay—I’ll protect you.”

With her face beaming as brightly as
it did that day, Rean tried to take me
out to an even vaster world.

I couldn’t help but feel happy
at her enthusiasm,
so I took her by the hand.

Then, on the way home,
those men found us.

But...I’d heard the cult was destroyed!
There’s no way they could’ve been revived...!

Rean fights them alone to protect me...
but more and more scars cover her body
with each passing minute,
before she finally collapses to the ground.

...Ngh... ...I want power.

Fierce power that can protect Rean...
The moment I made that wish,
flames engulfed everything around me.

No way... The power of a witch?
The legend was true...

As those men watched me,
the looks in their eyes changed.

I was so scared.
But, if it’s a witch that they’re looking for...
I slowly made my way towards them.

“...I’ll go. So please...
Please spare Rean!”

As I pleaded with them,
they unveiled a crown.

It was a sacrificial crown.
It marks a living sacrifice,
supressing the power of
the witch who wears it.

There’s a similar crown in my village.
I heard that it allowed them to imprison
the witch who once founded our village.

The one in the village no longer
contains any of that power,
but I was scared of it since long ago.

Still, Rean served me
like she was my knight...
vowing to me,
“Priscilla, I’ll protect you.”

Since then, I stopped being scared...
of the legend, and the crown.
Rean turned everything into
memories I treasured.

...I have to protect Rean.
This time, I will protect her...

“Our witch! Our beloved witch!”
As the men continued their feverish chant,
I presented my head to them.

Then, the moment they placed
that cold crown on top of it,
my mind began to feel faint.

...The mark of a living sacrifice.
I see. That certainly is what it is...

If I lose focus for even a second,
it makes me feel like my entire heart
will be taken away.

Suddenly...I heard a voice
scream my name from behind me.

...!

I desperately bottled up my scream.
I mustn’t look back.
Being as weak as I am,
I know I’ll end up turning to her,
begging her to save me.

Rean has always protected me.
That’s why, at least in the end, I want to...

...You and the sun go hand in hand.
So please, Rean...
Live on freely under the bright, open sky...

Goodbye...

They locked me inside a tall tower.

As long as I stay here, those men won’t
lay a hand on Rean or the village.
That’s what they promised me.

I’ll be okay. I’m used to being shut away.
That’s how I’ve always been, even until now.

But, the one who tried taking me outside
is no longer here.

I wonder how many days, or even months,
have passed by since then.

It probably hasn’t been that many.
But, in this room where not even
a single ray of sunlight peeks in,
it’s impossible for me to even know that.

Is it morning? Night?
I don’t even know why
I have to stay locked up in here.

Suddenly, the crown fell from my head.
At that moment, I saw a vision of
a person flash in my mind.
But...just who was that?

I don’t know. Am I supposed to be
waiting for someone?

Why...why is something I can’t remember...
making me hurt so much...?

“...Priscilla, I’ll protect you...”

Those words echo in my mind
over and over again.
But, I just can’t remember anything...
Who are you...?

I should be scared to death of this crown,
so why can’t I just let go of it...?

Suddenly, I felt as if someone was
calling out my name. But, who...?
I know this voice... I...remember...!

It’s someone who’s as bright as the sun.
Someone who always fills me with courage...

That’s right. I’ve been waiting for this moment.
The moment when you come and save me...

“I’ve come to keep my promise.
Let’s go home, Priscilla. Together.”

...! ...Rean!

Huh? How strange.
I can’t get my words to come out,
even though there are so many things
I wanted to say.

But now, I’ll say the words
I want to tell you the most.
Thank you, Rean!

One day, an army of demons
appeared out of the blue.
They attacked my village...
yet all I did was watch...
Then suddenly, a voice spoke to me.

“...I’ll give you power.”

After hearing those words,
a white flame was born within me,
burning away every demon in sight.

That voice...
I was sure it was the voice of God.
I’ve always hated fighting...
but I continued using this power
in hopes to save others.
Before I knew it, people started
calling me【The Witch of Justice】.

“...Use your power to save the world...
until you use that very same power
to destroy it.”

The truth finally dawned on me...
The voice that spoke to me was not God...
It was a demon...

Years have passed since the demons arrived.
Humanity has continued
fighting against them...
but the world has already fallen into ruin.

80% of the land has crumbled away,
leaving less than 10% of humanity alive.
At this rate, even the little land we have left
will vanish into the watery depths...

There’s only one way to
prevent that from happening...
Burn the demons away.
But, they’re lurking in
the hearts of many people out there...
not just in mine...

“...To destroy the demons...
you must destroy humanity.”

N-No! That’s such a blatant lie...!
Surely there must be another way...!
...In actuality though,
it made perfect sense to me.
Demons don’t tell lies—
only the cruelest of truths.

To save the world, I have no choice...
but to destroy humanity...

I didn’t want to know anything.
If I didn’t, there wouldn’t be any suffering...
I wish I wasn’t capable of doing it...
but I was given so much power.

Destroy humanity to save the world?
How could I do something so...
utterly terrifying...?

“...There’s no more time.
Soon, the world will be destroyed.”

Stop! Don’t rush me!
We’re talking about me
destroying humanity here!
Having no more time is not reason enough
for me to make that decision...!
There’s no way I can just do it
without a proper reason, you know?!
As long as there’s a reason...
a proper reason...even I would...!

...A reason?
What reason...am I looking for?
A reason for me...to kill everyone...?

A-Ah... No... No way...
Since when...have I become...?!
Ah... AAAAAAH...!

Destroy humanity...or destroy the world.
To think I have to be the one
to make that choice...!

...I beg you, take control of me.
You have that kind of power, right...?!
If you wanted to destroy humanity,
that’s what you should do, right?!
And yet...why...?
Why are you making me choose...?!
Why...me...?!

...There’s no other way.
If these are my only choices...
I will go with the one with
at least some hope for a future...

The white flame that was
born in my time of need...
is now being tinged in black...
Hehe... Just like this heart of mine...

“Why? Why are you doing this...?
Commander... Paladea!!”

I hear a voice calling from behind me...
But, lacking any courage to look back,
I unleash my flames.

I will destroy humanity to save the world...
With my putrid black flames of justice...

Nothing but burned fields
as far as the eye can see.
The demon was right.
By reducing everything to ashes...
the world was saved...

Was this really the right thing to do...?
Did this really save the world...?
Demons don’t lie.
That’s what I believed...
But...is that true?
Was that demon
cunning enough to deceive me?

Did I...destroy...the entire world...?!

Ah... Aaahhh... Wh-What...have I done...?
...Please. Someone speak to me...
Say that the world isn’t destroyed...!
That this is all one big lie...! Please...!

Surely survivors are out there.
I continued walking clinging to that belief,
but all I saw were flames.
The people I was supposed to protect...
My home... Everything was...

Why...? Why did this happen...?
I should have protected
everyone’s future...right? Didn’t I?
Please, someone answer me...
Tell me that I did protect everyone...
That...this is all one big lie...

...Am I really...all alone?
Did I really destroy...everything...?
No... God, no...!
Hey, please... I’m begging...
Someone, anyone...
let me hear your voice...!
Please...!

“Commander Paladea!!”

I hear a voice.
One as powerful as a flame...

“For the sake of the future
you fought to protect,
I will defeat you right where you stand!”

Ahh... Thank you...
As that powerful voice resounds in my ears,
the black flames begin to disappear...

When I came to,
the world had returned to normal...
It was true “power” that did this,
not one that’s fake like mine.

I fell for the whispers of that demon,
lacking the conviction to put my trust in others.
Even though, as long as strong people
like Fenny were fighting,
there should’ve been
no way for humanity to lose.

I can’t hear that demon’s voice anymore.
Was it consumed by my flames?
Or perhaps...
My flames still burn black.
Maybe it’s too late for them to
return to the color they once were...

I’m no longer worthy to bear
the weight of the world on my shoulders...!
Even so, if this power can still be of any use...
would you please allow me to help you, Duke?

At the very least, so I can proudly say
I’m【The Witch of Justice】that
Fenny admired so much.

How about an old story?
One of when I, the great Gil’uial,
was just born.

The place I called home was located
on the farthest reaches of Fran.
A village created by witches.

Needless to say,
my mother was also a witch.
But soon after giving birth to me,
she left, never to return.

As you know, just because
witch blood runs through one’s veins,
it doesn’t mean one will become a witch.

Hence, it’s a village custom to exile
those who don’t become witches.
Villagers undergo training until
their talents are discerned...

Ah...! But, my birth was extraordinary,
for I was born with the ability to use magic.

Thus, the village witnessed the birth
of its youngest witch in history.

Gehe! Do you wish to hear
what happens next?

It was tough being as good as I was,
and it didn’t take long before I proved
to be the most adept witch in the village.

Driven by my growing curiousity,
I, the inquisitive Gil’uial, left the village
without even a second thought.

Unlike now, there were no
Curses to hinder my travels.
Hence, I enjoyed the sights of
so many countries out there.

But at the same time,
questions began springing
into my mind.

The world is so vast,
yet why must we witches
stay hidden in secret?

We possess special powers,
yet why must we keep feeling
ashamed about them?

Questions like those.

Ever since that day,
my travels found their purpose.

No more hidden villages.
I’ll find kindred spirits and
build a country where we can
live openly as witches...

Yes. In a manner of speaking,
I, the cunning Gil’uial, was plotting
a coup d’état. Gehehe!

But you see, the more witches I met,
the more it made me realize just
how many misconceptions I had.

Take for instance, one mighty witch
who hid her powers away,
and chose a life of peace
with her loved ones.

When I asked her to explain herself,
what she told me was,
“You’ll understand one day.”

...But the real question is, will I?

...Ah yes, there was
another witch I met.

She was living on
the outskirts of some village,
doing favors for villagers who
occasionally visited her.

So, I asked her why she
bent over backwards for riffraff
who’d only come to her
when they’re in trouble.

And you know what she said?
“Because I just can’t help but
love the village I was born in.”

She must’ve also known that
the villagers feared her though.

When old age finally claimed her,
those villagers all breathed
a collective sigh of relief.

...That’s a sight that
I will never, ever, forget.

There was also a witch
who lived hidden away,
deep in the forest...
One who lived longer than me...
Oh! And one who was planning
to start a revolution.

She was filled with the same zeal I had
in my younger days, proclaiming,
“I’ll build a country for witches!”

If we’d met a little sooner,
I might’ve helped her cause.

However, even I, the wise Gil’uial,
would’ve clearly understood back then
just how foolhardy a revoltion was.

Not only that, but it wasn’t
something every witch wished for.

So, I tried convincing her to
think of another way...
but my words just went in
one ear and out the other.

Since I’ve caught no wind of any
rumors about her thereafter, it means...
Well, I’m sure you can figure it out.

If she were still alive,
I’d like nothing more than to
have another chat with her.

By the time I ended my travels
and returned home,
I found everything had
long since fallen into ruin.

Ah, no one was persecuted,
or anything of the sort.
Simply put, all the villagers just
died when age caught up to them.
And the village must’ve been
so perfectly hidden away that
not a single new face moved in.

Even when I was traveling
the world seeking compatriots,
I met all sorts of witches.
Many of whom I could open my heart to...

But in the end,
they all died and left me behind.

To this day...this feeling of loneliness
is the one thing I can’t ever get used to...

Since then,
I occupied the village ruins,
and began my research.
How to wield power,
and how to strengthen it.
How to hide, and how to fight.
Research done by a witch,
for all witches out there.

If I can’t build a country for witches,
I thought this research would
at least make up for it.

...Ah...it wasn’t long after that.
I soon learned about you, Duke.

This place that you’ve created is
the very thing I once tried to build.

A country where witches can live as witches...
Heh, to think my most cherished dream
could be accomplished with
the greatest of ease...

Hehe... The meaning behind
their words are finally
becoming clear to me.

Duke. I’m sure you can save
every witch out there...
Even me, and my heart
that has since lost its way.

So, I ask that you continue
showing me those miracles of yours.

As long as you allow me to,
I, the great Gil’uial,
will stay by your side.

Born with weak legs,
I spent much of my early life
stuck within the walls of my home.

Feeling sorry for my plight, one day,
my father brought an esteemed
harp player home with him.

That moment would change
the course of my life forever...

The moment I heard
the reverberating hum
of the harp’s strings,
the walls around me
seemed to change.

The fresh scent of sunlit earth
and the trill of birdsong...
Through its melody, the harp
gave me a glimpse of the outside world.

This is the power of music.
A rhapsody of dreams,
giving color to a dull world...
Someday, I, too,
want to make a sound just like that...!

This village, called the Village of Musicians,
took pride in its beautiful lake,
where musicians would always gather
to play their songs.

I was also invited to play with them,
but lacking the courage
to perform in front of others,
I let fear overtake me and ran away...

How could I not?
I mean, what if I were
to make a mistake...?

But, when I played my harp off by myself,
I could hear music in the distance.
It was as though it were in step
with my own playing.
“There’s no rush.
Come join us
when you feel up to it.”

I felt as if that was what the music was saying.
So, I played a melody in turn.

“Thank you.
Once I muster the courage,
I shall join you...”

Our separated chords
echoed as though in conversation.

Then, one day...
the lake suddenly dried up entirely overnight.

Why...did this happen all of a sudden...?

From that moment forth,
the atmosphere of the village
completely changed.

Smiles vanished from peoples’ faces,
and the sound of music
could no longer be heard...

There were even people
who chose to leave the village behind.
All I could do was watch them go.

After all, how could someone like me
do anything to help...

It was then that it happened.
When I heard a song
coming from the dried lakebed.

Above the dried lake
was a seemingly wounded...fairy?
Or so it appeared...
The ball of light weakly
bobbed in the air as if it were alive.

What a strange light...
But...I cannot help but feel
a strange sense of fear when I look at it...

Though I know not why the sight of it
makes me feel that way...

“Let me tell you how to
save your village, my dear...”

In that moment,
the voice of the fairy entered my mind.
But...how could I possibly
save the village...?

“For a special girl like you
who can hear my voice,
it is possible.”

“Allow me to awaken the power
sleeping within you...”

Power comes from the heart,
and our hearts are full of wishes.
If you wish for something strongly enough,
your power will surge forth in answer...

That was what the fairy told me, but...
I lack faith in myself.
After all...I can never do anything right...

“Everyone wants you to do this.
Now, before it is too late...!”

Everyone...?
As though beckoned to do so,
I stretched out my hand towards the fairy.

In that instant, something entered my body,
and I felt power well up within me.
With this, maybe even I can...!

The sound of gently flowing water...
and the harmony of a warmly
drifting breeze rushed into my mind...
Please, I beg you!
Come back to us...!

Strumming my harp as though in prayer,
water began to emerge in answer to my song.
Th-Thank goodness...!
It worked...!

But, the next moment,
my body suddenly grew heavy.
Why...is this...?

No longer able to stand,
water continued to pour into the lake,
as though rising to meet me...
Before I knew it, the lake...
had flooded out far past its shores.

At this rate, the village
shall be completely submerged...!
What... What should I do...?!

“Were you not the one
who yearned for such power?”

B-But...I never intended
for this to happen...!
I just wanted to return
the village back to normal...
I never thought things
would turn out like this...!

“This is what your wish has wrought.”

My wish...made everyone...!

I knew I would fail...
If it were someone besides me,
this never would have happened...

“Then, why don’t I shoulder
everything for you?
Your sins, your pain...
All you need to do is sleep.
Leave everything to me...”

“Yes...
I shall give all of myself to you, little fairy.
That is for the best...
No matter how I may try to atone,
I shall surely fail, just like always...”

But, that very moment,
my harp rang out.
This sound...
I remember!
This was the sound I made
the first time I ever played the harp...

I...do not want to throw anything away...!
Not my memories, nor my soul...
I do not want to forget any
of the feelings music has given me!

If my sins, my dreams,
and everything else
are all born from my heart,
I shall shoulder them all.
If that is what my heart is,
I shall accept everything that I am...!

“So, you choose to undergo this trial?
No matter.
My true target lies elsewhere...”

Then...I felt something...leave my body.

The one who saved me as
I drifted unconscious atop the lake
was a gentleman from another world.

His tone of voice was ever so gentle,
and the sound of his heartbeat was calm,
like the steady beating of a drum.

But, I did not deserve to be saved.
After all, I was the one
who caused everyone to...

If I had only become nothing but bubbles
melting into the lapping waves of the lake,
that would have made everyone far more...

Then, my harp rang out by itself once more.
But, it was not my sound.
This sound was...the distant encouragement
I had always heard from afar—
all of the musicians’ sound.

I began to play my harp in response.
Sorry, everyone.
I caused all of this...
Which is why...I must go.

I know not if this shall atone for my sins.
But, I also know only languishing
in despair solves nothing.
That is why I must leave here.

Just as music has shown me the world,
I shall color this broken world with my song.

The sound of lament
only leaves the world dull,
which is why we must play.
The notes woven by all—
the song of this world.

A handful of gold coins.
That was all I was worth to my father.
After using my power to send him flying,
I fled home.

And to think, I believed...

I was a child working day and night,
trading what I could, even bread, for money.
My father gambled all my earnings away...
but I believed everything would be worth it.

And yet, my father smiled
as he took those gold coins.
Not at me, but at the nameless
Knights who paid him.

All I wanted was for you to appreciate me...
That’s it...!

I just ran, and ran, and ran...
until I collapsed from exhaustion
on an unfamiliar road.

After trading my food for money,
I’m sold off, and now wait for my life
to end in the middle of nowhere...
Is this how my life was supposed to be...?

...Why was I even...born?

As my mind grows faint, the footsteps of
an approaching horse rumble in my ears...

“...I wasn’t born to be that
goddamn fool’s daughter...!”

With my last ounce of strength,
I tumble into the shadows.
A carriage immediately passes by.

I could make out the coat of arms
of the Duke on the carriage.
If they found me,
would they’ve killed me?
Or maybe...

As that last thought ran through my mind,
everything faded to black.

Three days pass.
With rainwater no longer able
to keep me from starving,
I make my way to a bustling street.

I have no money, of course,
so I head towards a garbage can
sitting in front of a shop.

Passers-by pierce me with their cold stares
as I rummage through the garbage.
I suppress all my emotions,
and bring a scrap of bread to my mouth.

One bite sends shivers throughout my body.
The bread’s moldy, but as sweet as honey.

“Nnrgh... Nnnnrrggh...!”

I weep as I greedily devour the bread.

“This is so I can live.”
Each time I whisper those words,
a piece of me goes missing.

Theft. Extortion. Burglary.
Since I have the power of a witch,
there are plenty of jobs for me
to do so long as I’m not picky.

That scrap of bread left me
with a heavy heart,
but even it gradually got
used to this way of life.

And besides, the backstreets were
teeming with orphans like me.
“This isn’t for me, but for everyone.”
Whispering those words made me
feel a little better.

I put my life on the line for
a meager amount of money,
then share tiny pieces of bread
with everyone.

Life was hard, but when
those innocent smiles said,
“Thank you for everything, Iris,”
that alone made everything worth it.

Ahh... This was the life I always wished for.

At last, I found my true family.

As time went on, my name and reputation
as a witch became infamous.

Because of that, there have been
countless attempts on my life,
but I hold no regrets.
After all, I live so my family can too.

One day, after taking
a number of days to
complete a big job,
I finally came home.

The job was dangerous,
but it paid a great deal of money.
We’ll be able to have warm food
for a good while.
Everyone’ll be so happy.

“Hey, everyone! I’m home!”

As I approach my friends,
they gather around me.
But...something feels off.

“What’s wrong? ...Nrgh...!”

A sharp pain shoots into my back.
I turn my head to find
a blade thrust into me,
and a friend holding the hilt.

Wh-Why...?

Why...? I don’t understand. Why...?
I can’t even wrap my head around the pain.
The only word I keep asking myself is, “Why?”

One of those innocent smiles answered me.

“If someone eats a witch’s heart,
they’ll get that witch’s power, right?
So if I do that, the next leader will be me.”

...You’re kidding me, right?
You actually believed that rumor?
That’s the reason you’re going to kill me?
That...that stupid reason...?

...Heh... Hahaha...

I devoted myself to my father,
only to be sold off...
Now, the friends I devoted
myself to are going to eat me!
Hahaha!

Ah-hahahaha!

Ah-haha... You’re right.
How could I’ve been so wrong?
In the end, we’re all filthy beasts
greedy for garbage.
It’s only fitting that we
feed on each other, right?

I pull the blade out of my back,
and point it towards my frightened friends.
After whispering, “This is so I can live,”
my face twists into a smile.

I take what I want, and kill who I hate.
After doing that countless times over,
no one was left to oppose me.

What’s so great about that, though?
Even if I have everything
this world has to offer,
those cold pieces of bread
I shared with everyone are long gone...

The morning sun rises,
tinging all I can see.
With the world engulfed in light,
everything looks as if it had been destroyed.
I thought it rather beautiful.

If only I, too, could just vanish from here...

After making my wish, I step into the light.

Then, I leave my world...and meet her.

I see a girl with a soft, tender smile.
The Duke walking at her side
looks like a gentleman.

Everything made sense at first glance.
That girl’s me, and this is a possible future
where I’m happy.

Ah, that’s right.
If I was at the side of
someone who needed me,
and was able to support them,
that would’ve made me happy.

...What the hell? Don’t you even dare...
What’s the point in showing all of this
to me now?!

I was never going to have a future like this!
There was no way for me to live other than
swallowing all that mud and blood!!

It’s not like I wanted to become like this...
and yet, to realize now that it’s all been
one huge mistake...
What the hell am I supposed to do...?!

...No, this isn’t like me at all.
I take what I want. That’s how I live.
Which means...

I look up to the two smiling happily before me,
and make my way towards them...

I was a war orphan in
a country full of civil wars.
Nothing really out of the ordinary.

Even so, I refuse to live just whining
about how terrible my life is.
All I know is the battlefield,
and that’s why I know
there are things I can do.

Like, be a battlefield merchant.

Having a merchant on the battlefield
would save many lives.
I’ve witnessed many that would’ve been
saved if they just had resources.

...If someone seeks help,
deliver what they need.
No matter where they are.
That’s my golden rule.

Some time ago,
I ventured into a remote region.

It was terrible to see.
War left the land with nothing but scars.
My hometown was the same,
when a lack of supplies left us defenseless...

But, something was different here.
Just when I thought this place had
been completely wiped out,
I found survivors...
each of them with unique weapons.

Those weapons were enhanced with magic—
specially crafted to protect their wielders
rather than kill an enemy.
They are what saved the village.

It was my first time seeing
weapons like those.

I eventually found myself wanting to
meet the one who made them,
and began my search.

I also had requests from the village children
to take care of, after all.

Waiting for me at the end of
my search was a blacksmith.
But, her eyes were full of darkness,
and her heart tightly locked away.

“...Many are dead because of
a weapon I made.”

After saying that,
Artie knocked my hand away.

Ah, I see what’s happened.
This girl’s broken.

The way I see it though,
as someone who’s known
war their entire life,
death was inevitable.

That’s why I might not be able to truly
understand the despair she’s feeling.
But...

Her weapons undoubtedly saved lives.
I’ve seen firsthand just how many lives
weapons that protect have saved.

I grasped Artie’s hands.
Those heroic hands that
saved the lives of many.

Then, I held out the sword and letters that
those children entrusted to me to deliver.

“Thanks to this sword, everyone survived.
Here’s your proof.”

“Thank you for saving my life...”

That was one of many messages
in this bundle of letters.
What started off as only one letter
quickly grew as I went from
battlefield to battlefield.

“There’s one letter for
each life you’ve saved.”
Hearing those words,
Artie broke down in tears.

I saw how tiny her back was.
It was so fragile and gentle.
No one would believe she’d tried to bear
the weight of other people’s lives on it.

She needs someone to support her.
Just like a sword has a sheath,
a sharp blade needs something to protect it.
Yes—a partner.

From this point on,
I’ll help bear the weight you carry.
Your sins, your pain—everything.

I held my hand out to Artie,
and this time, she firmly took hold of it.

Since then, I became
Artie’s personal merchant,
and the two of us set up shop together.

Come to think of it, that was the beginning.
The beginning of the unstoppable duo—
the genius blacksmith and
the invincible merchant!

One day, I happened to hear a rumor.
One about an evil sword.

It’s said to be a murderous sword,
created by Artie with the purpose of
destroying lives.

Apparently it’s raging out of control,
striking down anything in its path.

No regular weapon’s powerful enough
to destroy that evil sword.
It’s gotta be one augmented with
even more magic power.

Still filled with regret,
Artie was trying to pour
all of her magic power into a weapon
like some kind of punishment.
But, there was no way I was gonna
let her do that.

“If that’s what needs to be done,
my power is yours to use, partner.”

I took Artie by the hand.
“We’re partners.
My power is yours,
and your sins are mine.”

“Besides, the two of us now have
much more power than
you had when you were alone then.”

“We’ll quell that evil sword,
and restore peace...”

“Together, we’ll turn our hopes into a power
that’ll bring that destructive sword and
our sins to an end.”

Our creation was draped
in two colors of light.
It was a magic sword,
and the spirits of Artie and me
made it shine brilliantly...

Now, we have a chance...!

We quickly made our way to the ruins of
the battlefield where the evil sword
was rumored to be.

When we saw the crater,
and smelled the stench of death,
we knew it was there.

Its ominous glow looked as though
it was swarming with the regrets of
every victim it had claimed...

This...is a weapon?
It’s more like a monster...
No—now’s not the time to be scared!

Suddenly, Artie took my hand into her own.
The sound of her warm heartbeat begins to
drown out my fear and anxiety.

That’s right. The two of us are one.

We will never be broken!

We took one look at each other before
charging towards the evil sword.
The holy radiance of our blade
tears the ominous power asunder.

As the evil sword crumbled away,
its ominous glow vanished as if
being pulled into the heavens.

We did it. We destroyed the sword.

As I sighed in relief,
Artie threw her arms
around me from behind.
With tears welling in her eyes,
she said to me...

“Thank you, Richesse.
And, I’m sorry for dragging you into this.”

It looks like she doesn’t quite get it yet.

“There’s no way I wasn’t gonna help you.
We’re partners after all.
We share sins, pain—everything.”

“I’ll help you carry the burdens that are
too heavy for you to carry alone.”

“That’s why, if there’s ever
a time I’m in trouble,
you better be sure to help me too,
okay partner? Hehe.”

A beautiful, white flame wraps around me.
That flame kept us humans safe,
and burned only the demons away.

“There’s no more need to worry.
Leave everything to me.”

Even now, I vividly remember
the sight of her standing gallantly
in the heat haze as she spoke to us.

The young me admired everything I saw.
Her world-saving kindness.
Her strength that condemns evil.
Her pure, white light.

After all, she was the embodiment of
humanity’s hope, and our bright future.

I’m going to be her.
I’m going to become a bright,
shining flame of justice, just like her.

She’s the supreme commander of
the Armed Forces of Humanity,
【The Witch of Justice】Paladea.
The absolute justice I admire.

Ordinary weapons have
no effect against demons.
So, after joining the Armed Forces,
I was given a large cannon.

If I master it, I’ll be able to
level even an entire mountain.
But, when I fired it,
I was only able to break a few rocks.

Some of the more seasoned soldiers
saw that and laughed at me,
saying, “You don’t pull a trigger
with your finger.
You pull it with your heart.”

I won’t deny that I’m still inexperienced.
But, when it comes to the strength of heart,
no one can beat me.
I am going to become
Commander Paladea, after all.

I’ll show you exactly how
to turn heart into power.
Now, behold...my flame of justice!

My voice resounded as I pulled the trigger.
But, only tiny singes were left on
the rocks sitting in the line of fire.

...Is this cannon broken?

My cannon was problematic as usual,
but the fight against the demons
was progressing in our favor.
My efforts were recognized,
and I was promoted to chief officer.

Throughout the land,
humanity was scoring victory after victory.
The day we take back our world
from the demons is close at hand.
That’s what everyone believed.

Until the calamity struck...

Suddenly, black flames
appeared all over the world.
In the blink of an eye,
the flames spread everywhere,
burning to death both
human and demon alike.

There, in the center of the flames was...

“Why? Why are you doing this...?
Commander... Paladea!!”

The one I admired didn’t utter a single word,
and the flames only grew stronger.

Running wild like a turbid flood,
the black flames swallowed us
and the entire world whole.

Even voices of resentment were
burned away from the land,
leaving only the resounding
sneers of demons.

The black flames destroyed the world.
But, I woke up to an unbelievable sight—
the world had returned back to normal.

It’s said to be a miracle brought about
by a single staff of a single human being.
Just what exactly would I have to sacrifice
to attain that level of power...?

He and his friends were on
a journey to save the world,
searching for the source
of the black flames,
which he called the “Curse.”

I have an idea on where to
find Commander Paladea.
But...

Once I see her, what should I do?
I’d always admired her.
Becoming her was my ambition.
She was everything to me, and yet...

It was Commander Paladea
who destroyed the world.

From this point, what should I believe in...?
What is it that I should be fighting for...?

My heart wavers as I continue walking
with the man and his friends.
My cannon had finally stopped
responding to me.

I walk with the man and his friends,
half-dragging my broken cannon behind me.

I thought power was justice.
That’s why I underwent
the most rigorous of training.

But now, saving the world right before
my very eyes is a person who’d be
better off being called weak.

This person’s dispelling
the cursed black flames,
holding his hand out to the people,
and restoring the smiles they lost.

He’s different from
the one I once admired.
But, there’s a familiar
warmth and gentleness...

Ah, what the heck...
How could I have not realized
something so simple?
What’s important isn’t power.
It’s what we fight for that is.

I didn’t even understand something
that was so completely obvious.

I wanted to become a flame.
I was fighting because I wanted to
become just like Commander Paladea—
a flame of justice that burns down
the most terrifying of demons.

But, I didn’t find my brand of justice
going down that path.
The whole time, I was depending on
others to give me a reason to fight.

Why did Commander Paladea
do something so horrible?
That, I don’t know.
But, what I do know
is what I had admired.

Her beautiful white flame.
Her towering gentleness.
Her dazzling light that
embodies our bright future.

The more I thought about it,
the simpler the answer became.
After all, the sight I saw that day
is still etched deep in my heart.

Before long, our destination
came into view.
The headquarters of the
Armed Forces of Humanity,
still engulfed in black flames.

There, Commander Paladea—
【The Witch of Justice】—
awaited our arrival.

Commander Paladea,
I wanted to become you.
I wanted to become just like you—
a powerful flame that could
protect the people.

But, there was no need for
me to become any of that.

There’s already a fire
burning inside me.
On that day, you gave me
a beautiful, white flame,
and it still hasn’t stopped burning.

As long as it doesn’t die out,
I will not stray from my path.
That blindingly straight,
gentle light is the justice I long admired.

That’s why I’m going to hold fast
to my brand of justice.
Even if that means fighting you...

“Commander Paladea!!”

My cannon responds
to my determination.
Within it stirs a fire—
quiet, powerful, and true.

“For the sake of the future
you fought to protect,
I will defeat you right where you stand!”

“I don’t want to die...”

Once those words left
the lips of that “shadow,”
she drew her final breath.

...This time ’twas poison...

Since I was born, there hath been
countless attempts on my life.
And each time, there hath been
someone who died in my stead.

In my youth, the deaths of servants
would at times unsettle my heart.
But now, not one emotion stirs within me.

Of course, such is the way.
The duty of my shadows
is to keep me alive,
while surviving peril is mine.

Therefore, I alone must continue to live.
Whosever life be sacrificed...
I alone...

I am special.
Thus, I possess servants called shadows.

Not all lives bear the same value.
I stand without equal,
and my shadows are but dispensable.

Verily, my life far outweighs theirs.

Then one day,
a new shadow was brought before me...

“I, Asahi, shall protect you, my princess.
Even if it means my death!”

This lowly shadow
dared address me with a smile.
Acting as if I were but some ordinary person.

“’Tis disrespectful,”
I soon reprimanded her.
Yet, that smile of hers did not fade away.

A most peculiar servant indeed.
She was the first to introduce
herself to me by name.

...Asahi, was it?

To give her name to me
without a trace of fear...
Verily, an unexpected
simpleton hath arrived...

Asahi was more peculiar
than I had anticipated.

She smiles no matter what I decree...
And even when I try to act as a princess,
being in her presence somehow
throws me into disarray.

However, this upsets me not.

Ah, yes.
I shall try my hand at granting Asahi
the privilege to call me by name.

In truth, such an act is unforgivable,
but this is Asahi.
At this moment in time,
not a soul will be concerned.

Then, Asahi and I will form
a link even stronger than that of
a mere shadow and princess...

“I must refuse, my princess.
...For I am but a shadow.”

She smiled in reply,
though tinged with unease.
Ah, I see.
In Asahi’s eyes,
I am nothing more
than her master.

Hm. Why doth this vex me now...?
Have I not known this all along?

I am above all lowly shadows.

And yet...why do I feel such pain in my heart...?

“There are countless replacements
for every shadow, are there not?”

It suddenly felt as if someone
whispered such words into mine ear.

...Verily. My life doth far outweigh
that of any shadow.

To Asahi, I am the Princess.
Nothing more, nothing less.

Soon thereafter,
something happened.

The news of Asahi’s death
had reached mine ears.

After she and an assassin
struck each other down, Asahi then...

My other servants led me
from my chamber to see
Asahi’s lifeless body,
yet I was unable to even
lay a finger on it.

That day marked the first time
I had ever wept for a shadow.

Why am I trembling?
Is this not how things hath always been?
Someone protects me, then dies.
Should I not be accustomed to such a sight?

’Tis times like these
when I must act like a princess...

But, what doth it even mean
to act like a princess?

That ’tis unbefitting to feel sorrow
upon someone’s death?

No. The only thing that was
unbefitting was me.

Every life bears the same value,
each one irreplaceable.​
Asahi...every shadow who hath gone...
nothing can replace them!
And yet...I...!

“...I long to see thee again, Asahi.”

“Then, why not let
her come back to life?”

In that moment,
I heard someone whisper
into mine ear once more.

“You are special.
That’s something you’re allowed to do.”

Verily. I am special.
All in this world exists for me!

All live and die...as I so desire...!

The lives of my subjects belong to me.
’Tis for mine own sake that they live and die.

If so it be, there should be no issue
if I decide even when one lives or dies.
I shall not let thee die, Asahi.
Do not dare think of dying
without my permission.
As such...

“Each and every one of thee
shall bequeath your lives unto Asahi.”

If I could slowly drain tiny slivers of life
from many a person, and channel it to Asahi...

Then, as if responding to my desire,
a fog enshrouds the land, and begins
draining the life from my subjects.

With this much,
it shall amount to Asahi’s life...

Suddenly...voices crying out
in pain reach mine ears.
Voices begging to be saved.

Why do they sound so pained?
I am taking but tiny slivers...

“Save me...
Please don’t take
my life away...Princess...”

As the countless pleas resound in mine ears,
I hear that whisper once more.

“This is what you wished for, isn’t it?”

Verily...
I did wish for this...
What would befall the lives of others
mattered not to me.

What...have I done...?

My mind sank into the dark abyss.

Many have perished to keep me alive.
’Tis my duty to bear the weight of those lives,
and live on in solitude.

Hence, I convinced myself that I was special.
To flee from the responsibility
of bearing such a heavy burden.

Yet...the moment I met Asahi,
I felt my heart tremble.

Much like everyone else,
I long for someone I can live with.
I wish they see me not as special,
but simply as me.
Someone who calls my name, and...!

“Lady Kaguya!!”

In that moment,
a voice reached mine ears.
A voice that calls not
for the Princess,
but for me.
This voice is...

“I shall live by your side simply as Asahi!
So, please come back to me...
LADY KAGUYA!”

Golden hues of light
melt away the darkness,
guiding me back to reality.
There is but one I know
who can perform such a feat.

The one whose unceasing
noise has brightened
my world ever so vibrantly.
My sunshine. Yet...

“As the one who willed
mine own country’s destruction,
I can no longer call myself
a princess... However...”

Asahi then smiled as she had
done when we first met, dispelling
my lingering anxieties, and spoke.

“Yes. From now, till forever.
I shall dedicate my life to you...
Lady Kaguya.”

If I have compelled thee to speak so,
then I must assume responsibility.
From now, till forever, I, too,
shall be at thy side.
Not as a princess,
but simply as Kaguya.

...What should I do?

In an effort to rejuvenate our strength,
everyone came to the lake to play, but...

“I can do the doggy paddle, y’know!
I don’t need your help, you dummy!
You big, blue DUMMY!”

After saying that,
Moddey cried and fled from my sight.

The doggy paddle?
All she did was cling to me, though...

...At times like this,
Sophia and Valeriede would
undoubtedly know the best course of action.

...I truly have no idea what to do.

I was also nervous when
I first experienced the water,
but I learned there was no need
to feel frightened.

Even Cerberus is over there enjoying herself,
jumping and splashing about...

But, everyone here is smaller
and younger than I am.

As the one entrusted by the Duke
to take charge of everyone,​
I must do something for them.

That’s it. I’ll start by helping them
get accustomed to the water.

The best remedy for
alleviating fear is play.
Bearing that in mind,
I took Moddey towards
the area of water where
everyone was playing...

“N-No, get the heck away from me!
Anything but water... Anything!”

Moddey then ran away as fast
as her legs could carry her.
Why in the world would she...?

Moddey hates me.

I thought she was having fun
in the water with everyone.
Nina was going “Yah!”
and Sonya was yelling “Here I go!”
Maybe Cerberus overdid it
with “Kaboom!” though...

...What should I do?

Before I knew it,
everyone returned to the lake,
and resumed playing in the water.

Moddey stayed some distance away,
keeping her eyes on everyone...
I knew it—she wants to join them.

As the one in charge of these children, I...!

Suddenly, I heard screams
coming from the lake.

My eyes dashed to
the direction of the voices.
There, I saw the children
cowering in the water,
and a cursed creature standing
atop the water’s surface.

That must be what’s scaring the children...!

The Duke entrusted them to me.
I must carry out my mission...!

Before I could do anything,
the creature roared,
and the entire area was covered in fog.

I have a bad feeling about this...
The same as I felt back then.
When the Knights’ bloodlust
consumed my entire village.
When...the Witch Hunt began.

By the time I felt something was amiss,
I was already too late...
and because of me, Ma was...

“...Sabrina.”

That voice...
No, it can’t be possible.
After all, she...

My mother emerged from within the fog.
Her smile was warm and gentle,
just as how I remembered it...

But in the next instant,
her body was engulfed in flames.

“...Save me, Sabrina.”

As those words leave my mother’s mouth,
she reaches her hand out to me...
No... This is an illusion,
not my mother. But...

“...I see. Once again, all you’re doing is
watching while I burn, aren’t you?”

...That’s right. That day, all I did was watch
as the flames swallowed my mother alive...

That day, I could do nothing as my mother
was tossed into the raging fire.
Nothing... Even as she called out
my name again and again...

My past still has me in its chains.

Everything I witnessed that day
flashed into my mind,
paralyzing my body.
I can’t run to my mother,
let alone reach out towards her...

I still am, and always will be,
that powerless little girl...

“Sabrina!”

Suddenly, Moddey called out my name.

I look and see her in the lake,
despite her hating it so much...

“Your mother’s resting peacefully.
If the same thing happened to you,
you’ll make her so worried she’ll jump
straight out of her grave.”

“Go on, show her.
Show her who you are now...!”

Moddey’s right. I’m no longer
that powerless little girl.
I am Sabrina.
Comrade to the Duke—to everyone!

Reach out. Step forward!
Your comrades are counting on you...
Move!

In that moment,
I found a strange light
shining in my hand.
Is this...a new power?

Ever since that fateful day,
my past refused to unbind me
from its chains.

But...even with the way I am now...

I have comrades who depend on me—
who believe in me.
That’s why...!

The light in my hand dispelled the flames
that blocked my path.

This time, I will save everyone!

With one leap forward,
I took hold of my mother’s
outstretched hand.

I will never forget that day
for the rest of my life.
It will live on inside me,
becoming my curse.
Even so...

“Just remembering that day
had always frightened me.
But, not anymore.
I will live on bearing this scar.
So, please...rest in peace, Ma.”

With one last warm smile,
the illusion of my mother vanished.

...Goodbye, Ma. I’ll keep moving forward
with my comrades at my side.

After bidding my mother farewell
deep within my heart,
I raised my head and focused
on the remaining enemy.

I quickly draw my sword and tear apart
the blockade of illusions before me,
clearing my path.

I dash full speed ahead...
towards the creature...
piercing through it!

...Haaaah!!

As if bursting like a bubble,
the cursed creature vanished into the air,
lifting the fog from the area.
Ahh, I won. I won against...myself...

The light that now dwells in
my hand is proof of that.

Around me, the children regained
their senses and began to move.
Thank goodness.
Everyone appears to be unharmed.

“You did great, Moddey.”

Hearing those words,
Moddey looked proud of herself.
“Didja expect anything
less from me?” she said.

“By the way, Moddey.
You don’t seem bothered being
this deep in the water.
It looks like you’ve overcome your fear.”

“...Ah... Ahhhhh...!
Just as I thought—I can’t do water...!
Lailaaa! Saaave meee!!”

To think she can run around in
the lake with that much energy...
With how quickly she’s grown,
it looks like she has much to teach me too.

We took some time off
our journey to visit a lake...
but to tell the truth, I hate water...

I’ll take it slow and start by
dipping my feet in... Aaah!

I get only one toe in,
but that’s all it takes to make
goosebumps run all over my body,
and my tail stand straight up.

Sabrina softly giggled as she watched me.

“To think that you’re scared of
the water, of all things.
I guess you are a child, after all.”

The nerve...!
I’m already a fully fledged,
grown-up gravekeeper!
Not some kid!
I-If I get serious enough...
I can...at least... Nnrrrggh...!

“There, there. Everyone has something
they’re not good at dealing with.”

The water was barely up to my knees,
but I was already clinging onto Sabrina
for dear life...

Nnnrrggh... You dummy!
You big, blue DUMMY!!

Nnnrgh... Why did I run away
crying like some kid...?
I wanna hide under a rock...

I thought for sure Sabrina had enough of me,
but she came to see how I was doing.
“We’ll start by helping you get accustomed
to the water,” she said.

Y’know, Sabrina might not be so bad after all...

...Yeah! I know I’m better than this!
If water’s the problem, all I gotta do is fix it!

“That’s the spirit.
As it so happens,
I know something that’ll help us out.”

After saying that, I saw her holding
a bucket filled to the brim with water.

...What’s thaaat...?
I hope you’re not gonna do
what I think you’re gonna do...

“If you have fun playing with water,
it’ll stop frightening you. Here!”

AAAHHH!!
I can’t believe you just splashed me!
No matter what you say, I...AAAH!!
Why’s there water attacking me from behind?!

Hey...uh...guys?
What’s with all the smiles?
This isn’t some
water splashing game, y’know...
No, wai... Sto... AAAAAAH!!

Humans are helpless in
the face of the stormy sea.
There’s nothing we can do but
accept our fate and get soaked...

I was gazing out at the lake,
letting the truth of life sink in,
when I heard voices.
Voices so faint, only a gravekeeper
like me could make them out.

I could hear their pain and suffering...
Something happened here a long time ago...

At that moment, I heard
screams coming from the lake.
I turned to see everyone cowering in the water,
and in front of them, a cursed creature!

Right as I was about to go and save them,
a strange fog fell over me.

“You’re useless.”

...!
Inside the fog, my late dad appeared
right before my very eyes.

“When the disease came to our village,
all you did was watch.”

Then, all of a sudden,
I fell right into the lake.

The fog trapped me in an illusion.
I knew none of this was real,
but I was so scared...
I couldn’t breathe...or move...

“Nothing’s changed.
You’re still useless.”

Then, everything went black.

A gravekeeper’s job is to
watch over the departed.
Ensuring they have a peaceful rest
is all we can do.

I don’t think there’s anything wrong with that.
I mean, can you imagine someone dying,
only to be left all alone?
It’d be so sad if no one watched over them.

But, that doesn’t mean a gravekeeper
should wait around for someone to die.

After seeing the Duke save
one person after another,
I did some soul searching.

What is the job of a gravekeeper?
And, as a gravekeeper,
what can I do for everyone?

“My foolish daughter.
Just give up, and rest in peace.”

My father’s voice echoes
throughout the inside of the lake.

...It’s true. I’m just a tiny, useless kid.
But, I realized something after I left the village.

To let someone rest
peacefully in their grave,
I gotta make sure they’re
smiling before they go in.
Make them smile,
just like what the Duke does.

Gravekeepers aren’t bystanders
who just watch over the departed.
We have another important job—
taking care of everyone so they can smile!

At that moment,
something dove into the lake.
No way... It’s Laila!

...That’s right. You always knew
how to make me smile, huh Laila?

I rise to my feet with Laila at my side.
The illusion no longer had me in its clutches.

When I opened my eyes, the fog had waned.
The area was still blanketed in white,
but I could see a figure hanging their head.

“Sabrina!”

There’s no answer.
The fog’s trapped her in its prison.
But, now I know the words
I should say to her!

“Your mother’s resting peacefully.
If the same thing happened to you,
you’ll make her so worried
she’ll jump straight out of her grave!
Go on, show her.
Show her who you are now...!”

The fog starts to thicken once more,
hiding Sabrina away.
But, I’m not worried.

Sabrina’s someone who fights
so that everyone can smile.
...See, look.

The fog is torn apart
by a blinding cascade of light.

It looks like everyone’s saved now that
Sabrina defeated that cursed creature.

Laila nuzzles against me,
then runs off into the sky.
Next to her was Dad,
smiling like he does once in a blue moon.

“Keep it up,” he tells me.
That goes without saying, y’know.

I’ll make everyone smile,
whether they’re alive or not.
That’s a job only a gravekeeper
like me can do! Hehehe.

So...don’t worry about me.

Dad had already said his piece.
Laila barked happily...then they both
disappeared into the big blue sky.

Thank you, Dad...Laila... Goodbye.
As I saw them off,
Sabrina smiled happily at me.

“You don’t seem bothered
being this deep in the water.
It looks like you’ve overcome your fear.”

“...Ah... Ahhhhh...!
Just as I thought—I can’t do water...!
Lailaaa! Saaave meee!!”

I just love festivals.

I can’t get enough of the noise, laughter,
and of course, everyone’s sights locked
onto my circus troupemates and me!

There’s a festival in a city famous for art.
It was apparently started by musicians as
a ritual ceremony to mourn the dead.

But nowadays, it’s become more like
an annual music festival,
with hundreds of visitors coming from
all over to see it.

The streets are alive with
traveling entertainers and dancers.
It’s a festival that can only be
experienced in this city of art.

How can I not join in on the fun!

Right now, my circus troupemates
aren’t here with me,
but I’m more than enough to put on
a show that’ll set the place on fire!

I quickly head to the city square and see
traveling acrobats putting on a show.
Watching them were children with
bright smiles on their faces.

Then, as I was about to ask
the acrobats if I could join them,
something happened.

“Enough with the noise.
This is a ritual ceremony, damn sinners.”

When that elderly man came out
of the crowd and said that,
the music came to a complete stop,
and the smiles disappeared from
the children’s faces.

Wait, didn’t Vera say something about this?

I think she said, while this event’s
more like a music festival nowadays,
one of the elderly thinks otherwise,
and causes an uproar every year.

And, the ritual ceremony should be
held quietly to mourn the dead,
so making noise will incur
the wrath of the dead, or something...

“It’s absolutely ridiculous
how vulgar acrobatics are.
Get that filth out of my city!”

After saying that,
the elderly man swung his cane around,
causing everyone around him to
clear out and leave.

As the atmosphere grew awkward,
I heard the sound of a child crying.

“Hey there. What’s wrong?”

I called out to a young boy crouching down
in a corner, and he had a look of surprise
when we exchanged glances.
As he sobbed, he spoke to me.

“I just came to watch all the shows...
but...the wrath of the dead...”

That’s all I could make out.
Hmmm... Maybe the uproar
just now scared him?

But, he wasn’t the only one
who was shaken up.
Everyone was...
Even that elderly man...

Alright. Guess I’m up!

If the ringmaster found out that I let
an audience go home with gloomy faces,
he’d definitely give me an earful.

Gather ’round!
The world’s greatest gunslinger’s
special show is about to begin!

I captured the audience’s gaze the moment
they heard the boom of my voice.

Standing among them was that young boy...
Keep your eyes on me.
I’m about to turn that frown upside down!

Here I go!
Check out these ultra-fast quick shots,
and magnificent gun spinning!
Followed by...my trusty trick shots!

After I closed out my performance
with a cool pose,
the children responded with
smiles and applause.

But, the only one that wasn’t laughing
was that elderly man.

...Guess I’m not there yet.
I wasn’t able to put
a smile on everyone’s face.

The moment that thought
ran through my head,
cheerful music started to play.

It was those traveling acrobats!

“Let’s do this together.
We’ll brighten up this festival,
and put smiles on everyone’s faces!”

They then started putting on
all different kinds of performances.

Now, that’s what I’m talking about!♪

Keep your eyes on us.
There’s no way you can stop us
from putting a smile on your face!

The streets were alive
with cheers and laughter,
when suddenly...
fog started blanketing the area.

There’s something weird about this fog...
I’ve got a very bad feeling about this...

“The wrath of the dead... It’s real.”

Someone said the words that fanned
the flames of everyone’s anxiety,
and the fog started to thicken in response.

The smiles started to fade away...
one by one.

I wonder what my circus troupemates
would do at a time like this...

They’d probably say,
“Let’s put on a show that’ll
make everyone smile so hard,
they’ll forget whatever they were
worrying about.”

Fun memories are precious,
and I won’t let any scary ones
take them away.
That’s why...!

“Alright, everyone!
All eyes and ears on me!”

“Step right up for an exciting show that’ll
send your worries flying into the sky!”

As the creepy fog hung over us,
I carried on with the show.

...Don’t you worry about a thing, everyone...
Keep your eyes on me...!

Suddenly, I heard the faint sound of applause.

It was the elderly man!
As he clapped his hands,
I saw a huge smile on his face!

Afterwards, more and more
people started to clap,
their faces left with
no more traces of worry!

Huh? The fog’s been lifted...?
Just what the heck was that?

Oh well. More importantly...
Hey, bring the music back!
Make some more noise, everyone!
We’ve got a festival to enjoy!♪

Thank you very much!

I took a slight bow,
when I heard a voice whispering to me.

“...Thank you. This is what
I’ve always wanted to see.”

I look back and see
that young boy starting to fade,
till he finally vanished.
His smile never leaving his face.

No way... Was that...?

Then, the elderly man came to me
with an awkward look on his face,
and spoke to me.

“I apologize for my actions earlier.
I hate outsiders,
and I wasn’t in the best mood,
but your show really made my day.”

I finally put a smile on his face.

Soon after, fireworks shoot into the sky,
soothing the spirits of the dead,
and bringing the festival to a close.

...I’ll do my best so the smiles
we see here don’t ever fade away.
So, make sure you come back
for some more fun, okay...?

Alright, time to get
my head back in the game...
Hey, all you kids, grandparents,
and everyone in between!
Come join me for some fun!

Behold the world’s greatest gunslinger,
and leave with memories
that you’ll treasure forever!

It’s almost lunchtime, my prince.
Are you going to that bakery
you’ve recently taken a liking to...?

The snow is really coming down today.
Take care of yourself so you don’t
catch a cold, okay?

As I watch over my prince from afar,
I don’t hear any voices around me,
until one suddenly reaches my ears.

“The Holy Night’s almost here.
Now’s the time to give your
sweetheart a special gift!”

Come to think of it,
I think I’ve heard about that as a child.
Once a year, you give a special gift to
your special someone on the Holy Night.

Back then, there wasn’t anyone for me
to give a gift to, but... Hehe!

Now I have you, my dear prince.
I’ll prepare a wonderful gift, just for you.

As the snow began piling up around
the gorgeously decorated city,
so many couples looked around for
presents with smiles on their faces.

But, how can simply buying a present
for the one I love be enough...?

And besides, I know everything
there is to know about you.
So, I’m well aware you’ll be
happy with any gift from me.

That’s why my gift needs to be
something that’ll truly make you happy.

After all, this is our very first
Holy Night together, my prince.
My gift can’t be anything but special.

Just you wait.
I’ll be sure to give you something
filled with every single drop of my love.

Colorful candles, music boxes, large cakes...
All of these customary presents are
wonderful in their own way.

But, no... They’re just too normal...
My gift needs to be even more special...!

Still without any ideas,
I returned to the mansion, and...
Ah! Hehe...! Just as I was thinking about you,
here you are right before my very eyes.
This must be destiny.

...But, you’re usually working
in your room at this hour, right?
So, why are you...?

Could it be, you’re also trying to
find a present for someone...?

......

I quietly watched to see what he was up to,
when I saw him with a little girl who had
a big smile on her face.

“Thank you for coming to see me, Daddy!”

Da... Daddy...?

She just called my prince, “Daddy...”

Daddy... Daddy... Daddy... Da...ddy... Daddy...
Who is the mother...?

Huh? So she just calls all men “Daddy,”
and all women “Mommy?”

That’s what my prince explained
after he noticed me there.

...So that’s how it is.
Okay, if that’s the case, then it’s fine...
Ahh! Thank goodness...!

But, she needs to change
how she refers to people...

“What’s wrong, Mommy?”

She’s still a child, so everything’s okay...
Daddy. Mommy... Hehehe!

I was too caught by surprise earlier to notice,
but she was inside a mysterious hole
that was floating in midair.

Although I’m curious about what that hole is...
my prince is talking to her like it’s no big deal.
I’m sure he sees how lonely she looks,
and wants to keep her calm.

Ahh...! I knew you were
a gentleman, my prince...!
You haven’t changed one bit
since the time you saved me...!

“This here’s Pon Pon.”

The little girl in the hole pulled out
a stuffed bear and showed it to me.

“My mom gave me this bear!
It’s my treasure!”

As the little girl beamed with pride,
my prince happily gave her a nod, saying,
“And that treasure is the only one of
its kind in the whole wide world.”

...Is that true?
