So, if it’s a gift from someone precious,
even an ordinary stuffed doll can
become a precious treasure...

...Hehe, I see!
A gift doesn’t have to be “special.”
As long as someone puts
their heart into a gift,
anything can become a treasure...

That’s right...!
Even I would be happy with anything
that you handpicked for me, my prince.

Heh-hehehe...!
There’s only three days left
before the Holy Night.
I have no time to waste.

Once I had all the materials I needed,
I quickly got to work.

I cut cloth, then sew the pieces together.
Each stitch of the needle fills the gift
with a piece of my heart.

Ahhh, my prince.
You saved me from
that ice-cold dungeon.
I’m a witch, but you always
fill my darkness with light.
My kind, beloved prince.

I love you... Always...and forever...

I stuff the gift with pieces
of cotton and my heart,
and the thread seals them all inside.

Hehe, it’s finished!
Oh my prince, I just know this gift—
this handmade doll—
will make you happy...

In a way, the doll takes after me.
Not in how it looks, but in how it feels.

That’s not surprising though.
After all...this doll’s filled with
so much of my “love...”

As I was about to give
my prince the finished doll,
I felt a small pain in my chest.

A dull pain, like being pricked by thorns.
I knew what this was... Jealousy...

You’re just a doll...but you’ll get to
always be by my prince’s side,
and he’ll cherish you.
That’s not fair...
I can’t even get him to turn
and look my way!

...! I-I can’t think like that.
I worked so hard to make you...

I’m sorry, my prince...
I guess I am a wicked witch after all.
I really just wanted to be by your side,
like your knight.

But, I’m okay.
Even if there’s no way for
me to make you smile,
I’m sure this doll can.

From the time you say, “Good morning,”
till it’s time to say, “Good night,” hug it tight,
and always keep it by your side...
In my place...

Hehe... Hehehe...
It’s about time to go.

...My prince...
I’m going to send you
a gift that’s brimming with
my everlasting love.

I do hope you’re looking forward to tonight.

Right after I was born, I got sick—
with a sickness called “becoming a witch.”

Day in and day out, my mom and dad
were always apologizing to me.

“We’re so sorry, dear.
This happened because
we didn’t have enough Faith.”

“We’re going to find
a way to cure you, okay?”

I don’t quite get all their grown-up talk.
Mom and Dad are so nice...
What did they do wrong?
Why is God mad at them?

I don’t quite get it all...
but I gotta do my best to
make my sickness go away.

Taking after my mom and dad,
every night before bed,
I prayed to the stars.

“Please make my sickness go away,
so that Mom and Dad can be happy again...”

Then one day, Dad came home
with a huge smile on his face.

“The Church taught me a way to
turn a witch back into a human!”

“There’s no need to worry, dear.
You leave the rest to your mom and dad!”

Dad sounded so happy...
but I had a really bad feeling about it all.

My chest felt so tight...like it was
telling me not to listen to the Church.
That it would all be one big mistake.

But, Mom and Dad are doing all this for me.
There’s no way I can tell them to stop.

Leaving things be, my mom and dad
did as the Church told them to
and offered up everything we had.
Our house, our clothes, everything...

But, my sickness showed
no signs of getting better.

Life got really tough,
but my mom and dad
continued going to the Church.

Any food they get they give to me.
The two of them haven’t eaten in days.
“Grown-ups don’t get hungry,” they say.

Whenever they see my worried face,
all they do is say sorry...

But, I’m the one who’s
supposed to be saying sorry...

Oh, I know! The Wish of the Holy Night!
If you wish on a star on the Holy Night,
you’re wish’ll come true!
That’s what Mom said!

Mmm... Maybe I need to wish on
a big star for my wish though...
Oh! The star on top of the tree
in the town square is big! Perfect!

As I was on my way to the town square,
I found a strange hole in the ground.

Slowly peaking inside, I saw...

There was a strange world on
the other side of the hole,
and in it...was Daddy.

But, he got really surprised
when I called him that...
I don’t get why, though.
Men are “Daddy,”
and women are “Mommy.”

From then on, I started talking
with Daddy every day.
Though for some reason,
a mommy with thorns is with him today.

“Hey you. Just whose child are you?”

Huh? I’m Mom and Dad’s child...
I wonder why she’s asking...

Oh, I know! Since we’re doing introductions,
I’ll also introduce Pon Pon!
“My mom gave me this bear!
It’s my treasure!”

When I showed Pon Pon to them,
Daddy smiled and said,
“That’s a lovely treasure you’ve got there.”
Hehehe, it is, isn’t it!

After that, the mommy with the thorns
started mumbling something
as she walked away.

I wonder what’s wrong?
Well, she looked really happy,
so I guess it’s nothing!

That day, I was on my way
to go see Daddy,
just like I did every day.

But this time,
my mom and dad stopped me.

Their voices were so soft...
Their faces...so uneasy...
I got a really bad feeling.

It was the same one as before.
My chest felt so tight...like it was...

“Forgive us, dear.
This is the only way to save you.”

“From now on, things might
get really tough for you,
but God will surely watch over you.”

With tears in their eyes,
my mom and dad gave me a big hug...
before softly pushing me outside,
and shutting the door behind me.

“We’ll pay for our sins with our lives.
So please... Please forgive our daughter.”

I heard voices on the other side of the door.
They were my parents’ voices.
Their final voices...

Everything that happened
after that is really hazy.

But, there is one thing I remember.

When the Church’s Knights came
to calm down the commotion,
they laughed, saying,
“Foolish idiots.
Who’d believe a lie like that?”

At that moment, I realized everything.
It was as if a gust of wind had blown me
straight to the finish line of a race.
My mind was so clear.
It all finally made sense.

My parents...had been fooled...

There’s no way to turn
a witch back into a human...
but the Church used that
and fooled my kind parents,
stealing all our belongings.

Realizing there was nothing left
they could give the Church,
my parents instead gave their lives...!

Idiots... Two...foolish idiots...

Did you really believe there was a way...?
To turn me, a witch, back into a human?

You two are idiots for
believing something like that...

My mom and dad were such nice people...
but they’re idiots.

The Church thinks that if a witch is involved,
they can do whatever the heck they want.
If it’s a witch, they can lie...and deceive...!

Well, I won’t let them deceive me.

Honesty doesn’t pay off.
If so, then I’ll become a liar.

I won’t let myself be
some fool and get killed.
I’ll become the one who fools...
and I’ll survive...!

...If the Church hates witches so much,
I wonder what they’d do if me, a witch,
took all the money they stole and
gave it out to other witches.
Who'd be the fool then?

Now then, let’s get down to business...

“Hey, Father. Yeah, you.
Wanna know of a way to get
an audience with the Pope?”

Boy, what a relief!
I was just about to give up hope,
but to think I’d bump into
the wielder of the angel’s Staff
all the way out here.
This must also be the work
of my guardian angel!

I’m not from this world.
But, you all must still be
in the same boat as me, right?
On a journey to find the underworld
to defeat the demon lord.

That was my group’s goal, too.
My angel lord Samyaza chose
my two friends to be the Hero of the Staff
and the Hero of the Lance.
To fulfill their destinies as the chosen ones,
they set out on a journey with me
and four other witches.

But, partway through our journey,
we all got separated...

They’re all my most precious friends.
So, would you mind if I joined
you guys on your travels?
If we have the same goal in mind,
I’m sure I’ll be able to run into them again
if I stick with you.

Bonds are the very thing that
give us humans strength.
As the wielder of the Staff,
I’m sure you know that
even better than I do though.

My friends and I have been together
ever since we were kids,
and all endured the same rigorous training.
We all came from different backgrounds,
but we were as close as family.

Elaine the nun in particular
was my closest friend,
and the most like a sister to me.
Since we slept in the same bed,
we’d always stay up till morning
talking to each other.
About God, where we came from,
and of course, a sleepover must—
moonlit talks about love!

Though when we overslept
and missed training,
Artoria may have gotten
a teensy bit angry with us...
But, even though the Heroes were
never involved in our antics,
they’d always brave her super long-winded
lectures right alongside us.

We were more like a family than
any real family could ever be,
and practically spent
every waking moment together!

We did go our separate ways when it was
time to take a bath though, of course!

Once we’d overcome the seven trials
set out by our angel lord Samyaza,
we were finally able to set out on our journey.

I’d been dreaming of this day
ever since I could remember!
I mean, a journey with the family I love
was just bound to be fun, right?

Though because I was so giddy,
Artoria did yell at me, saying,
“Do not forget we are doing this
to save the world, Morgana!”

But, I was just so excited, y’know?!
I was about to set off on a journey to
never before seen worlds together with
all of my very best friends!
There was no way I could contain myself!

The first time we opened a “door”
and set foot into the light on the other side...
I still remember my heart pounding so hard
I thought it’d burst!

And so began our long, long journey
to save the world.

We traveled across many worlds
on our journey.

There were worlds just like ours,
and ones with completely different cultures.
Some worlds were ruled by witches,
while others were so beautiful
it felt like we’d stumbled upon a miracle!

Each world had been
left in ruins by demons,
so our quest was no picnic...
But, as we overcame
the dangers in our path,
the bonds tying us together
grew even stronger!

Those days were so much fun,
it all felt like a dream!

Of course, our mission
never slipped our minds though.
The Hero of the Staff protected all of us,
while the Hero of the Lance
slayed the demons in our path.
Me, Elaine, and the other witches
were the two Heroes’ support
as they fulfilled their destinies.

Since we’d done all that tedious training,
our formation was absolutely perfect,
I’ll have you know!

But, we still had no idea...
what true horrors demons were capable of.

In the distant past, seven demons
wielding catastrophic power were
sealed away by powerful angels.
Now, those demons are only able to
use whatever tiny amount of power
leaks from their seals.

But, us humans are far from perfect.
Each of us has a chink in
the armor of our hearts.
They’re things we don’t even
see as weakness,
like traces of doubt in our minds,
arrogance, or the tiniest
sliver of jealousy...

It’s through those tiny cracks
that the demons whisper to us.
Little by little, inch by inch,
their words rot away at us
by giving us that sweet
sugar of temptation...

One day...the Hero of the Staff
and Elaine went missing.
When we went out to search
for the two of them, we saw it.

Elaine...murdering the Hero of the Staff...

I couldn’t believe my eyes...
How could someone as sweet as Elaine
do such a thing...?
Yeah... A demon must have wormed
its way into her heart...!
Surely, that was why she...

While we were still stuck in shock,
the two of them vanished before
we could even register what had happened.

Those of us who remained
split into two groups.
The Hero of the Lance believed we should
continue seeing our mission through,
while Artoria was adamant we should
chase after Elaine and take our revenge.

Artoria had looked up to the Hero of the Staff.
But, she’d likely held stronger feelings for him
than just that...

Bonds are the very thing that give humanity
the power to face off against demons.
But, from that day on,
our hearts were divided...

With our destination undecided,
we still tried to walk through a new “door.”
However, that only caused the world to
fling us in every which direction...

With all of us flung into a vortex by the door,
I was lucky to have ended up here...
But, I don’t know where the others wound up.
If they never reach another world,
they might just keep falling...and falling...!

The peace of the world is important too,
but to me, my friends are worth even more.
That’s why...I want to save everyone.
I want to find out why Elaine did what she did.

And...I want to journey again...with everyone.
After all...I still love everyone so much,
even now...

Plus, Elaine did always say...
when the going gets tough,
we just gotta face things with a smile.
If you never let go of hope and
keep putting your best foot forward,
you’ll be blessed with an angel’s guidance.

That’s what must have
led me to all of you... Right?

I still believe...that I will meet
all of them again someday.
That the day will come when
we can laugh with each other again.
I just know it!

A healer’s job is to heal people’s wounds
and soothe their hearts.

When I was injured and crying
alone in the middle of the woods,
the one who saved me was a gentle healer.

The medicinal herbs she used burned
as they soaked into the wound...
But, she consoled me until
all of my tears had dried.

Even when she learned I was a witch,
her attitude toward me never changed.
She also taught me something very important.

“Anyone who gets injured feels pain,
be they witch or not.”

That became my life’s motto.

I want to help people in need...
just like what she did for me.

To be someone who wraps
all wounded hearts in love...
That is the kind of healer I aspire to be...

After being saved by that healer,
I became her apprentice and
learned healing techniques of all sorts.

As my master wasn’t a witch,
she couldn’t use magic.
But, when she saved my life,
her warm hands felt just like magic to me.

I believed this was where my power
as a witch could finally be of use.

Despite my optimism though,
there were times I felt using
my power was unfair.
I could perform even the most complex
healing techniques in an instant,
while everyone else had to
put in so much work...

But, my master told me this...
“With your magic,
even more people can be saved.
Treasure it dearly, Yuni.”

That’s when I realized...
The person with the most prejudice
against witches was none other than myself.

Witch or not, it makes no difference.
I’ll heal everyone with this power of mine.

Before I knew it, the time had come
for me to make it on my own.
The time for me to go out
on my healer’s journey.

But, all that stood in the back
of my mind was doubt.
I couldn’t even lift my head,
let alone set out on a journey.

Seeing me like that,
my master said in a kind,
yet stern voice...

“From this day forth, you will learn many things
in this vast world of ours and save countless lives.
So lift your head up at once, Yuni the healer.”

That’s right...
There are people in this world
waiting for my help.
I’d become a healer to
save those very people.

“...Right...! I’ll be going, then, Master!”

As those words left my lips,
I broke into a sprint without
turning back even once.

From this day forward,
meetings and endings will continue
with each new person I meet.
I’ll have to bear the pain of every goodbye.

I’m sure the only comfort I’ll find
is in my own memories.
That’s why...I won’t look back anymore.

From then on, I traveled from nation to nation.
If I came across someone sick or injured,
I would soothe their pain with magic.

There were those who feared me
because of my magic,
but once I had healed them,
they all thanked me...
That alone was rewarding enough.

I showed them that magic wasn’t
something just to harm—
like medicinal herbs,
it could be used as a poison or a salve.

By using my power as a witch for good,
perhaps someday, even the Witch Hunt
may come to an end...
Then, the hearts of both
people afraid of witches,
and witches afraid of the Church,
can be healed.

That was what I believed back then.

I thought that...
as long as I wished to heal the injured,
things would turn out alright.

But, the world wasn’t so simple.

“Don’t get any closer, you filthy witch!”

...How many times does that make, I wonder?

As the fervor of the Witch Hunt grew,
so too did everyone’s caution towards witches.
More and more patients interrupted,
or simply refused my healing.

I had prepared myself for such prejudice, but...

...No, I can’t let it get to me!

If a healer gives up, no one can be healed.
I need to stay strong...!

I know!
As long as I hide the fact that I’m a witch...
there’s still a way I can heal people.

That idea was what led me to start
healing people without the help of magic.

...I only use my magic for good,
so why should I have to hide it?

Thoughts like those crossed my mind
more times than I could count,
but I desperately tried to drown them out
by focusing solely on my healing.

There were many people who would’ve
healed faster with my magic,
but there was no other way.
After all, witches are...

One day, there was a big landslide
in a village I happened upon.
More than half of the victims
were heavily wounded,
including the Knights who
had come to rescue them...

I can’t heal this many people at once...!
The victims are already at death’s door...
But if I use magic, I can still save them...!

“With your magic,
even more people can be saved.”

As if scolding me for hesitating,
the words of my master floated
to the back of my mind.

I am a healer.
I came here to relieve
the pain of the people.
That’s why...!

I used my magic, all with the intention
of saving those who were suffering.

Thank goodness...
I saved them before it was too late.
But...

Everyone was staring at me
with fear in their eyes...
Ahh, just like how I knew they would.

But, it doesn’t matter.
Doing nothing at all
would’ve felt much worse.

So, it’s alright...

Steeling myself, I held out my hands
to a knight lying in the rubble.
But, he simply clasped them
as though to console me,
and said, “Thank you...”

When I raised my head,
I saw everyone was looking at me
with warmth in their eyes...
No one seemed afraid.

Wh...Why...?
I’m...a witch...

“There is no evil witch bringing
harm to the people here—
only a benevolent saint
blessing us with a miracle.”

...Ahh, I really do have a lot to learn...

Deep down I knew...that not everyone
could possibly see me as a monster...
But, because I’m a witch...I just gave up...

If I give up, though...
I can’t save the ones who need me most.

I need to be strong enough
to face whatever may come.
I won’t waver any longer...
both as a witch...and as a healer.

I’ll be alright.
After all, the world is filled with
so much warm, gentle light...

A peaceful life.
Those words described me
and my big sis perfectly.

She and I lived alone together
deep in the mountains,
far away from the nearest human settlement.
We didn’t want to live rustic—
it was our only choice.
Witches weren’t allowed
to live in the settlement, after all.

Whenever we’d go down to
the settlement to sell the
animals we’d trapped,
I remember everybody
there’d often glare at us.
But, even if they point at us
or call us every name in the book,
it’s all just water off a duck’s back to me.

I have my big sis with me, after all.
She does yell at me sometimes,
but she’s still my kind,
beautiful sister who’s
just like a mother to me.

Big Sis is my only family.
As long as I have her,
I don’t need anythin’ else.
She was all I needed,
and yet...

Across the snowy mountain,
a single gunshot rings out.
Seein’ all the birds fly
into the air and flee at once,
a sense of dread wells up inside me.

“No, it can’t be!”
Saying that to myself,
I sprint to the place my sister
and I were supposed to meet.

My big sis was there,
her abdomen stained with blood.
Standing opposite was a woman
with eyes colder than ice,
holding a hunting rifle—

My head went blank.
Even so, I still desperately
push my body to move,
standing in front of my sister to guard her.

But, with calm eyes and a cracking voice,
my big sis began pleading with her adversary
to at least spare my life!
Stop, don’t say such things!
If you’re gonna die,
then I will too!!

“——”

In place of the final words
my sister wished to impart,
only the bang of a gunshot
resounds in my ears.

I’ll kill you.
As the one who murdered my sister,
I’ll do whatever it takes to kill you...!

From that day forward,
I got rid of everything
unnecessary for my revenge.

Tree roots, insects, rotten meat.
I put anything into my mouth.
It helped save money for my travels,
and I had no need to enjoy my food, anyway.
While I did need sleep,
I had no need for pleasant dreams.
Comfort wouldn’t be of any use to me now.

One day, with the senses
I’d sharpened from depriving myself...
I overheard a rumor about a duke
who dispelled Curses and saved witches.
It came to me right away.
Since that woman hunts witches,
it only makes sense she’d go
where witches gather!

Hehe, haha... Ahaha...
AHAHAHAHAHA!
Ahhh, I haven’t laughed like this in ages!
Just you wait, Big Sis.
I’ll definitely avenge you.

The atmosphere of the Duchy of Fran
resembles the cabin I’d lived in with my big sis.
It makes me want to break down into tears.
But, it’s too soon for that yet.
I’ll save those tears for after
my vengeance is wrought.

Haah... Now’s the time for concentration.
I need to focus everything on killing
that hunter who’s finally shown herself!

Ahaha! I can’t believe my intuition was right!
She actually came here!!
Now, I can finally avenge my sister!!

I’d planned to kill her in one blow.
That is, until I saw those eyes of hers.

“I accept everything.”
That was what her eyes said.
It was as though she wanted to die.
I can’t allow that...!
She deserves to feel much
more pain than that...!

There’s no way in hell
I could give her the very thing she’s beggin’ for!
I can’t let her die...
Not with the same eyes as my sister...!

While fighting against a cursed creature,
I got distracted by the sight of her
and suffered a deep wound.
She rushes to apply pressure
to the wound as I bleed out.
I can’t believe I’m gettin’ saved
by the very person I’m tryin’ to kill...

Glaring up at her,
I realized that her eyes
were different than before.
As though resisting fate itself,
her eyes shine like she isn’t ready to die yet...

Ahh, now’s my chance.
My chance...to kill her...
...Huh? How strange.
I can’t muster any strength in my body,
and my head feels all fuzzy.

Must be ’cause I lost so much blood...
If Big Sis saw me now,
I’m sure she’d be mad...
I have to kill her...
before her eyes change...

She...keeps saying something
over and over again...
I feel like...I’ve heard
those words somewhere before...
But where...?

“I’m so glad you’re alive.”
Those were the words that spilled from her lips
as I regained consciousness.

Her eyes are accepting of death,
her voice gentle.
Those words as the trigger,
I’m brought back to the moment
of my sister’s murder.
For the first time,
I could hear my sister’s words
over the sound of that gunshot.

Ahh, I remember now.
What my big sis said to me was...!

Why am I only remembering now?!
Why is she of all people
reminding me of my sister?!
“You’re an unfeeling murderer, aren’t you?!
If you aren’t gonna play the part,
what reason do I have to despise you?!”

As I yelled this,
she even lowered her eyes in remorse...
How stupid...
What am I supposed to do...?
How am I supposed to
avenge you now, Big Sis...?

Hearing her story,
I came to understand the factors
that led to her decision.
But, that still doesn’t pardon her
from the sin of murdering my sister.
If she was capable of making
the choice to spare me, then surely...

If she’d just been rotten down to her core,
I wouldn’t have had to suffer this much.
But, my resolve won’t change.
I will kill her.
Just, not now.

Once she finds something irreplaceable to her,
and all her days feel precious because of it...
Then I will kill her.
Until that time comes,
I’ll make sure she doesn’t die.
But, now is still too soon to
seek my vengeance.

So, until then... “Live.”
That is the revenge
my sister and I will give you.
A curse so gentle,
it brings one to tears...

To protect a master
under the cloak of darkness.
Such a role was given to a clan of shadows.

I was a shadow.
Even more, a shadow to one of
the Shogun’s children—the Princess.

Apparently, her life had been threatened
well before she was born,
and all of her siblings assassinated.
The Princess was the sole survivor.

It’s no exaggeration to say that
we shadows were born
to keep the Princess alive.

We were once wanderers,
but taken in and given a home
by the shogunate.
To repay this great debt,
we will indeed die
if it means protecting them!

Such a duty was everything
to my clan of shadows...

“Thou art too carefree in my presence,
lowly shadow. ’Tis disrespectful.”

Those were the Princess’s first words to me.
My situation might be more difficult
than I’d anticipated...

B-But, I’m the shadow to the Princess!
It’ll take more than that to crush my spirit!

Indeed, there were some who called
the Princess’s orders selfish...
but I sensed something different.

After all, the Princess is always...

One day, assassins snuck inside the castle.
Naturally, I disposed of them,
but I was left severely wounded.
Nnnrgh, how pathetic of me...

But, the Princess suddenly
came rushing over to me.

“Art thou hurt, Asahi?!”

W-Wait...did she just say...my name...?

It’s only natural for those
like me to be nameless.
Simply referring to us as “shadows”
is more than enough.

That’s why, I’m sure I misheard her...

“If thou art to be my shadow,
live and be useful to me.
Such is what it means to protect.
Understand, Asahi?”

In that moment, I felt I’d taken my first
proper look at the Princess’s face.

Her stern gaze was shaking with
loneliness and unease...

It revealed the Princess’s true colors.
And, a heart that no one had
ever dared peer into...

...I mustn’t let her be alone.

“Yes. I shall live and be useful to you.
As your shadow.”

I heard the Princess was also raised
without being called by name.
Doing so was seen as utterly insolent,
and even her own relatives would not be forgiven.

“Asahi, I shall grant thee special permission
to call me by my name.”

The Princess then offered her hand to me...
but I’m a shadow.
Someone like me will never be forgiven.

“I must refuse, my princess.
...For I am but a shadow.”

The Princess smiled hearing those words,
hints of sadness written on her face.
All that she said was, “Yes...that thou art,”
before leaving my sight.

Several days later.
I was in a fight with yet another assassin,
till the moment our weapons
cut into each other.

...To think that this assassin coated
their blade...with poison...

...There’s no chance of me
surviving this attack...

...But, I have no regrets.
I was able to protect the Princess, after all...

...My princess...
I’m glad to have served as your shadow...

...Farewell...my princess...

...Huh, I’m alive...? How...?
That poison should’ve been fatal...

When I awoke, I saw a mysterious fog
and people in deep slumber.
There was also a man with a staff.

Apparently, he’s some kind of “savior”
from a distant world,
traversing different worlds to dispel Curses.

And, he was the one who saved me.
If he hadn’t found my body
lying on the ground, I would’ve...

He says this fog is the work of a witch
whose heart fell into the clutches of a demon,
and saving that witch’s heart is the key
to dispelling the Curse...

But, something dawned on me.
The moment I touched the fog,
I heard something.

“...I long to see thee again, Asahi.”

That was the Princess’s voice.
Thus, I must go to her.

Such is my duty as her shadow!

I accompanied the man with the staff,
and we headed towards the Stargazing Tower.

With each step inside, I felt us
drawing closer to the Princess’s heart.
This thick, enshrouding fog was surely
the very manifestation of her anxieties.

The Princess had always feigned composure,
all while being afraid someone might die.
Many saw that as strength, and none had ever
tried looking behind her facade.

I’m just as guilty.
I never noticed how you truly felt...

But...it’s clear to me now...
The meaning behind your words that day.

We finally arrived at the top of the tower.
There she was, as if reigning supreme
over all that lay beneath her feet.

On that day, I could only see you as a princess,
declining to step out of the shadows
and walk by your side...

But...by your side was
where I truly wanted to be.

“My princess—no... Lady Kaguya!!”

“...Asa...hi...?”

The Princess slowly opens her eyes.
Then, reaches her hand out to me
as if pleading for help.

“I’m sorry. On that day, I ran away
without noticing how you truly felt...but...”

“I shall live by your side simply as Asahi!
So, please come back to me...LADY KAGUYA!”

I saw the hand I was unable to touch that day,
and grasped it with all my might.

“...At last... Thou hast called me by name.”

The fog that was concealing her heart
began to fade, the darkness melted away
by golden hues of light.

But, the moment we felt a sense of relief,
Lady Kaguya brushed my hand away.

“As the one who willed
mine own country’s destruction,
I can no longer call myself a princess...
However...”

Lady Kaguya once again
offered her hand to me, and spoke.

“As of now, I am but Kaguya.
If thou hast no qualms...
wilt thou live at my side...Asahi?”

The shadow in me whispered,
“That would be insolent of you, lowly shadow.”
...But, I pushed that shadow away, and smiled.

“Yes. From now, till forever.
I shall dedicate my life to you...Lady Kaguya.”

“Serruriaaa, save meee~!!”
The bright, cheerful voice booming across
the lab didn’t sound at all like the cry
of someone in dire need of assistance.
But, just in case, I still whirled around
to check for myself.

“What is it now, Meria?”
“Ahhhh, these marshmallowy cheeks
of yours send me straight
to the pearly gates of heaven~!
I can just feel
my world-weary soul takin’ flight~!”

She rubbed her cheek against mine
while professing some nonsense beyond my,
or any rational human being’s, comprehension.
I stood aghast at her
illogical-as-ever exclamations.
But, knowing that despite her baffling behavior,
she was still the greatest intellect this country
had ever known left an even worse taste
in my mouth.

“So, what do you want?
You’re interrupting my research.”
“I see you’re bein’ extra icy today~
Well, y’see, I just made this new discovery—”

From there, she prattled off about
what she’d found, but her explanation
was almost too difficult even for me to follow...
This girl is a genius in the
truest sense of the word.
Unlike me, who’s just a complete failure...

Everything started when I was
placed in charge of a certain experiment
at the Academy.

The Academy was expecting big things.
It was the one thing
I couldn’t afford to mess up.
But, my new medicine
made to accelerate plant growth
did the exact opposite—
it killed all the plants in the school.
I desperately clung to the teacher
as they tried to leave.

“Please, just give me one more chance!
I’ll get it right this time for sure!
I promise!”

In place of a response,
all I received in answer was the cold,
booming slam of a closing door.
Their decision was clear.
My dismissal from the Academy
was all but confirmed.
Seeing me collapsed on the ground,
tears pouring from my eyes, a lone girl
reached out her hand to me.
Lifting my head, I saw her break into
a gentle smile.

“Say, tell me.
How do you feel right now?”

Huh...?
Who the hell does this girl
think she is...?

“Y’see, my whole life, I’ve just
always been too smart to fail!
So, how does it feel
to fail at somethin’?”
“Sure... Let me just kill you first!”

Tackling the girl to the ground
and climbing on top of her,
I taught her exactly how it felt
with my fists.

“Obviously...it hurts...like hell!
I put in all that time and effort...
only to mess up...and lose everything...!!”

Before I knew it, my clenched fists
had lost their strength,
tears raining down in their place.

“This...is the only place I have...
If the Academy throws me out...
I’ll have nowhere left to...!”

As I lost the ability to move,
the girl wrapped me in a warm embrace.

“It’ll be alright.
You have an infinite future ahead of you.
Just keep messin’ up and startin’ over
as many times as it takes.
One little failure isn’t the end of the world.”
“...!”

It’s okay to fail.
That was the first time I’d ever been told
such a thing, so I found myself
lifting my head without thinking.
When I did, the girl let out an amused laugh.

“If you’re up for it, let’s be friends.”

The fact that I’d felt saved for a moment
by her sudden words would be
the end of my luck, as the girl offering
her friendship was none other than Meria.

After the two of us waited out our
temporary suspension from the Academy,
I began assisting Meria with her research.

Long ago, Derulla had once been
on the verge of ruin.
The cause remains a mystery to this day,
and was the subject of Meria’s research
at the Academy.
Proposing new theories, modifying
lab equipment only to tear it apart
right after, raising plants together...
It hurts to admit, but the days I spent
with Meria weren’t just hectic,
they were fun.

Our research even includes
classified government intel,
but that doesn’t seem to bother Meria,
seeing as how she just leaves
confidential documents out on her desk
in broad daylight.
Just as my eyes happened to glance
across the contents of said documents,
I found myself suddenly doing a double-take.

Demon seed...transplantation...?
The test subject is...Meria?!

That very moment, I heard an explosion
coming from the Academy’s prohibited
research facility, as an ominous-looking
plant began to break forth from the building.

“Meria...!”
A giant bud began to surge
from the research facility,
spreading its viny tendrils
across the campus.

This level of rapid growth can’t be possible
with just the plant’s power alone.
Don’t tell me that what once brought
this country to the verge of ruin was...!
If that’s the case, then the only ones
who can put a stop to this are the ones
who researched its origins—Meria and I.

I slowly relaxed my clenched fists.
If Meria is inside of that bud, then...
there’s only one way to save her.

Meria had that plant put inside her
of her own volition.
I don’t know why she did such a thing...

But, I won’t let you go and die on me...
without so much as considering
how I feel...!

“Meria... Our research is behind again
because of you.”

I call out to the tightly knit petals of the bud,
believing Meria to be inside.

“As punishment, I’ll have you sort
100,000 pollen spores out by hand,
so you better get ready!”

In response, I felt like I heard
Meria’s voice saying,
“That’d be a real pain...”
If she’s still conscious in there, then...
I glance down at what’s
in my hand once more.
I have no proof that this will work.
But—

“Meria, you were the one who told me
it’s okay to fail, so take this...!”

I threw the vial clenched in my fist
as hard as I could—the vial of my failed
experimental medicine that had killed
every plant in the school...

Bathed in my medicine,
the foreboding bud’s petals unfurled,
a frail frame falling from
its once twisted maw.
Frantically reaching out my arms to catch her,
the fallen girl weakly smiled up at me.

“At least make it...10,000...”

“That won’t do.
If you miss even one spore,
I’ll have you start from scratch...
Over and over again.
As long as it takes!”

“As long as it takes, huh...?”

Why did you do such a stupid thing?
I wanted to lecture her on a million things,
but something else left my lips.

“Welcome back...Meria.”

Nestled in my arms,
Meria grinned back at me.

“Awww, look who’s got a cute side
underneath all that ice! Hehehe~”

Why do I like someone like this...?
I shouldn’t have saved her after all...

The place I lived was a largely
barren region where it was
especially difficult to grow anything.
Food was rationed.
There were days when the food we received
was less, but everyone was optimistic.

Peace had been restored to Emeria at last,
so no one would have to suffer anymore.
Everyone was full of hope, believing that
from now on, we would all help one another.
But, as the rations we received slowly grew
smaller and smaller, the atmosphere of
the village began to change...

The air turned tense,
like a loose string on a guitar
being slowly pulled tighter.
Wanting to lighten the mood,
I often sang together with
the other kids in the village.

I knew it wouldn’t change
the underlying cause of our suffering.
But, I couldn’t just watch and do nothing...

One night, the village chief
made an unbelievable declaration.
“As our fields were burned to ash by demons,
we no longer have enough food for everyone.
That’s why...”
The village chief’s words
fell into a barely audible mumble.

I caught on as soon as I saw
his darkened expression.
That he meant to lower
the number of mouths to feed.
In the tense air, the adults slowly turned
their gazes towards the old and sick...

“You said we would all help one another!
Things are finally peaceful, so why...?!
...Then, I’ll go out and gather food myself!
If I can’t find any, you can just banish me!”

Everyone tried to calm
my stubborn outburst.
But, since they’d all used
the last of their energy that morning,
they soon just let me go.

I have to hurry and find food
for all of us somehow...!

A few days had passed since I’d left the village.
But, I’d only managed to gather
enough food for two people.
This’ll barely make a dent...!
I have to get more...
But, how...?

Maybe because I haven’t eaten in two days,
I can barely think...and I’m so hungry...!

“If you’re that hungry,
why not just eat what you’ve found?”

Nrgh, no!
This is for everyone...!

“You’ll be the one banished
if you go back like this, y’know.
Should you really be worrying
about others right now?”

As though someone were
whispering in my ear,
bad thoughts floated into
my head one after another.
My stomach let out a loud grumble.
Its constant rumbling gnawed away
at both my reason and soul.

I was suddenly overcome with the fear
that I would become someone else, so...
I began to hum a tune.
It was the song I’d often sung
together with the other kids in the village.

There should still be
vegetation left in Emeria’s East.
I’m sure of it.
Since getting there and back’ll
take several days, I’ll have to
leave everyone waiting a bit longer...
But, it’s better than not bringing
anything to them at all!

Clinging to that sliver of hope,
I wandered through eastern towns
and Armed Force bases.
After searching far and wide...
I was able to head back to the village
in a carriage full of food!

Everyone was shocked at my return,
but were over the moon to see me!
We had a grand feast that day,
just like it was a festival!
At everyone’s request,
I even played a song on my guitar.
The villagers all cheered along
to my performance!

In the midst of the festivities,
I didn’t even notice the sad,
downcast faces among the crowd...

My second journey to
the east was a success.
I’ll have great news
for everyone when I get back!
The Armed Forces said they’d
take in the people of our village
in one of their bases in the east!

Supplying food for a village of our size
wouldn’t be a problem, so as long as
we’re okay with it, they’ll let us stay there!
It’ll be sad to leave our home, but now
there’ll be no need to consider things like
lowering the number of mouths to feed!

But, when I entered the village,
it was eerily silent.
Like everyone had disappeared...
Timidly knocking on the village chief’s door,
the chief’s grandchild appeared from inside.

Thank goodness...!
But, my relief was short-lived.
The grim foreboding I’d felt quickly transferred
to the letter the child handed to me.

The village chief’s letter was
full of repentance and regret.

“Milla, I’m sorry.
Before you returned,
I had colluded with a few others
in exiling a number of villagers.
After that, we were overtaken by greed,
believing that the more people we eliminated,
the more we would be able to eat.”

“We spent our days culling
one person at a time,
before quickly deliberating
who to get rid of next.
But, when we saw you singing with your face
so gaunt, we suddenly felt deeply ashamed.
It was clear you had not succumbed
to the same desires we had all fallen prey to.
We would likely only have continued
to elect others to sacrifice.”

“Humans who become
like demons have no right to live.
That’s why, for all those
involved in the culling, I...
The future of this village
is in the hands of those who remain.
Please, make this a world where
no one needs to be sacrificed...”

The rest of the letter was illegible...
So, I couldn’t read any more...

If I’d only come back sooner,
I could’ve saved the chief and the others.
If I was just...a little faster...!
As I was overcome with regret
from my own powerlessness,
the remaining villagers gently comforted me.

“They may be gone, but the fact
that we’re still alive is all thanks to you, Milla.”
“The food you brought back that day
was so warm and tasty,
it brought me back to my senses.”

I began to tear up at their words.
Bringing the bowl of soup I’d been
gently handed to my lips, I slowly took a sip.
“...! It’s delicious...!”
As tears flowed down my cheeks,
I felt myself break into a smile.

Even though peace has returned
to the world, tragedy still remains.
But, there are things that can
pull us out from the darkness.
That’s what I want to give people.
Warm, delicious meals that soothe
one’s body and heart!

I know the difference it makes is small.
But, when our bodies and hearts become full,
the peaceful world we wished for
will finally begin.
That’s why it’s my goal.
So, I’ll work hard for the day I can
finally welcome a warm world
full of satisfied bellies and hearts—!

Allow me to tell you the legend
of the infamous mononoke!

In the days when humans
still feared the gods,
’twas said a heinous mononoke
caused great commotion
among the people.

A very wise mononoke she was, indeed.
And above that, brave and unbeatable!
Truly the mightiest!

Those who heard the rumors of
the mononoke came to vanquish her
nearly every day, but they were all
sent back home utterly defeated!

Yes, that mononoke...
was none other than me—
Tama the Glorious!

Heh-heh!
There was not a soul who could stop me.
The world existed for my sake!

Indeed, even the mightiest
have the mightiest of worries.

Back then, while some sought
to exterminate me as a mononoke,
others worshipped me, saying,
“Dear guardian spirit...”
’Twas troubling how attitudes
were completely different
person to person.

Well, ’twas the same for me.
I cannot tell one human from another.

But, I was the mightiest...the wisest.
And all who opposed me...defeated!

From then on, I was in top form.
Every human who dared
come to vanquish me
were sent back home utterly defeated.
Unbeaten, I was!

But, negligence is always
the greatest of enemies...
I never expected what happened next.

One day, a horde of humans
came to vanquish me.

Naturally, I delivered
my punishment unto them all.
But at that moment,
a strange melody reached my ears.

’Twas quite a pleasant melody,
and my heart felt as if
’twas being purified...
Oh, how I wished to listen to it more...
until suddenly, I was engulfed
in a blinding light!

“Be still, and reflect on all thou hast done!”

That voice was the last sound I heard
before finding myself sealed away
inside a magic crystal...

I was the mightiest...but now...shamed!

’Tis unknown to me how many years
have passed since then,
but I was suddenly set free.

By the hands a human
who wields a mysterious staff,
claiming to have come from another world.

To think this was the one who freed me.
I expected this human to be extraordinary
but all he prattles on about
is carefree nonsense...
saving the world and what not.

Hmph, feigning the virtuous hero, I see...
Scoundrels like this are the most malicious.

A greedy human, this one.
’Tis certain he aims to attain
the power of Tama the Glorious,
but I shall not let that be.

That mysterious staff
grants power to witches.
Oh, how much more powerful I could be
if I could have it all to myself.

But, it appears that this human
is the only one able to use that staff.

I suppose I will just have to
take advantage of this situation.
Heeeh-heh-heh~♪

Humans are selfish creatures.
In one whimsical moment,
they worship me as a god, and the next,
they attempt to exterminate me
as a mononoke.

This human is no different.
That was what I had thought...
but he seems to be slightly different
from the ones I know.

He is...simply far too weak!
Not even a match for the horn
of a tiny rhinoceros beetle!

Despite that, he always
sticks his nose into trouble,
helping anyone in need...
Hmph! Damn wolf in sheep’s clothing.

But, everyone he helps
have naught but smiles.
Even those who are angry or sad...
they all smile when he does
as if being drawn in by his charm...
Good grief, every last one of them
is being tricked.

...Well, I will not be tricked.
Just you wait, human.
I shall tear away your sheep’s clothing,
and unveil your true,
filthy nature for all to see!

Now that my mind is set...
’tis time to prepare at once~!

All who feign the virtuous hero
are powerless before my traps.
Just like that corrupt monk from ages ago,
everyone reveals their true nature in disgrace.

To start things off,
I tied his hair with a ribbon as he slept.
Behold! This is the hidden power
of the infamous mononoke!

Now, become the laughingstock of humans,
and unleash all the anger you like...
Wait, not even a flinch?!
Fine, so be it. On to the next prank!

Heh-heh! As expected, even that human
was startled by the trap this morning.

I made him burst in laughter
as he was consulting with his citizens.
The sight of him laughing his head off
upon seeing my face...
Heh-heh! ’Twas utterly disgraceful.

Oh, here he is, appearing before me.

“Heh-heh! So you have come
seeking payback, but that will not happen.
Tama the Glorious shall deliver punishm...
Hm? Today’s prank caught you
a little off guard, you say?”

Not only are my traps ineffective,
he is actually enjoying them...
And, even I started having fun
somewhere along the way...

Hah... No wonder he could break my seal.
He is proving to be quite the formidable foe.

I remained by that human’s side
to expose his true nature.
But, it seems I no longer need to do that...
Now then, what am I to do next?

He does not become angry
when I play pranks on him,
and he even gives me food.
Also, whenever he smiles at me,
for some reason,
I feel warmth inside my heart...

...!
I have no reasons to leave his side.
Rather, I only have reasons why I cannot.

Well, if that is the case,
I guess it does not trouble me.
I do not really have any goals,
so I might as well stay by his side
and bask in this warmth a little longer...

I am the infamous mononoke
and mightiest guardian spirit.
The world exists for my sake.

Naturally, the place at your side
belongs to me too, Master,
as I have decided so.
I shall yield it to no one!

Heh-heh! You had best do
as much as possible
to ensure that I am not bored, Master.

Well, it does not seem
to be a concern for now...
Why, you ask?

’Tis because, despite how I appear,
my devotion is unmatched. Heh-heh...!

Witches have nowhere to live.

I was born into a family of knights,
and have undergone the most rigorous
of training since I was a child.

But in the midst of my training,
I awakened to my power as a witch,
and was driven out of my home.

If there’s no place in this world for me...
I might as well...

As that thought ran through my mind,
she appeared before me.

“...I need your power.”

She smiled at me with eyes full of love,
as if shielding me from gazes of disdain.

It was this moment that I made my decision.
I will live as her—as Lady Elfriede’s knight.

Soon after Lady Elfriede took me in,
I became one of the Guardian Knights.
They were the regiment of knights
directly under her, the next Pope.

But, was it truly acceptable for me,
a witch, to be at her side?
If that were to cause her any trouble, I...

One day, as those worries plagued my mind,
Lady Elfriede took me outside,
leading me to the city square.

There were so many people there.
Some were dressed in tattered clothes...
but there wasn’t a face without a smile.

“I wish to protect all you see here.
But, I cannot do it alone.
So I ask, with me as inexperienced as I am...
will you lend me your help
as one of my knights?”

Is she trying to raise
my spirits, of all things...?
Ahh, I see.
I was never a witch in her eyes—
I was always me.

The same went for the others
in the Knights of Longinus.
Rather than speak ill of me for being a witch,
they accepted me as one of their own.

From that day on,
I never belittled myself ever again.

Since her ascension as the Pope,
Lady Elfriede had been terribly busy,
and the opportunities for us to meet
became few and far between.

She always shoulders everything alone...
That really worries me.
And apparently, she didn’t seem to be
in good health when she summoned
Illya to see her the other day.

And, there are times when
she speaks to herself...

Come to think of it,
I haven’t seen either Illya
nor Miss Loki as of late.
I wonder if something happened.

Then one day, Lady Elfriede
assembled the Knights of Longinus,
and made a startling declaration.

“Begin the Witch Hunt.”

Did I just hear the words “Witch Hunt...?”
From the one who treasured
and loved life so much...?

“Lady Elfriede...”

As my trembling voice called out to her,
an inhuman smile spread across her face.

“Perfect. You’ll be the one
to take command of the Witch Hunt.”

...Huh?
What did she just say...?

“You seem like you’d have
the loveliest of screams.
Use those hands and see to it that there’s not
a single drop of filthy witch blood left
in this world.”

“You’ll be the witch who
massacres all witches.
Isn’t that the greatest pleasure of all?!”

Is this the Lady Elfriede I know?
She seems like a completely different person...

“Then, when you’re the last one left,
I will watch as you die.”

After whispering those words into my ear,
she left my sight,
her laughter echoing with scorn.

I was utterly helpless...
unable to chase after her
or object against her order...

After all, if she were to abandon me, I...

Her Holiness wasn’t the only one who changed.

One after another,
my fellow knights became more distant...
and some of them changed
in the same way Her Holiness did.

Just what in the world is happening?
This isn’t like Her Holiness at all...

Wait, what am I thinking?!
There’s no one more righteous
than Her Holiness!
How can I call myself a knight
if I don’t have faith in her?!

From then, I obeyed what
Her Holiness ordered me to do.
All the while knowing that
all those girls were innocent...

What I would give...
for someone to hunt me down too...

I grappled with that thought,
but was powerless to do anything.
I spent day after day executing her orders,
until suddenly, she disappeared.

Even with Her Holiness nowhere to be found,
there was no clamor among the people.

The Church... The Knights of Longinus...
Everyone just continued carrying out
the orders given to them.
It was as if they were puppets...
No, I was no different.

Even now, I’m still executing the order
Her Holiness gave me that day.
The order to carry out the Witch Hunt.

Her Holiness’s orders are absolute,
and the idea of her being wrong is absurd.
That’s what I had always thought...

Deep inside though,
I began to second guess
how “absolute” her orders were.

It was my first time feeling this way.

But...if my doubts ring true...
what should I do?

When the one I serve
commits a transgression,
as a knight, I...

I don’t even need to give it any thought.
My mind has long been made up.

Since then, I heard many rumors
about Her Holiness’s infamy.
Those who had adored her began to leave,
and some were even executed
as a warning to others.

I’m sure there’ll come a day
when you face punishment.
A day when all your suppressed hatred erupts,
and someone comes trying to strike you down.

If that’s what’s bound to happen,
I’ll share the burden of your sins with you.

If I hadn’t met you, Your Holiness,
I would’ve died in the middle of nowhere.
That’s why, ever since that day,
my life has belonged to you.

My loyalty to you is unwavering.

Even if the entire world
were to condemn you as evil,
I alone will continue serving you
as your knight.

Even if this is the wrong path,
if you choose to go down it,
I’ll go with you until we both
fall into the abyss...!

Even if my mind has been corrupted,
this is my code of chivalry!

With doubts still lingering in my heart,
I raised the Church’s blood-stained flag!

“To all who dare oppose Her Holiness,
what awaits you...is death!”

A little before Cerberus and I became witches,
back when our mother was still kind to us...

Whenever we’d help her,
she’d give us candy as a reward.

The sweetness
tasted just like happiness...
So to us, candy was proof
that something good happened.

That’s why every year for Cerberus’s birthday,
I’d give her handmade candy as a present.

After our family abandoned us
and we started living
on that mountain, though...
I couldn’t give her candy anymore...

But, this year will be different!

To make up for all the times
I couldn’t give her any candy,
I’ll give her the tastiest one ever!

Now, it’s time to roll up my sleeves
and get to cooking...!

Strawberry, apple, cream...
I’ve made candies of all kinds of flavors...
but it still feels like something’s missing...

Hmm... Since it’s such a special occasion,
I want to give her something
even better this year...
Like, a candy as pretty as a gemstone,
and just as magical...

Magical...?
That’s it...!

After cleaning up the kitchen,
I headed for the library.

She should be here again today...
I knew it! She is!

Before my eyes was Miss Merlyn,
surrounded by stacks of thick books.
But, she looked as if
she were puzzling over something...

I wonder if she’s learning some new magic...
What should I do...?
If I call out to her now, she might get mad...

Uuu, but...
I have to be brave...!

“U-Um, Miss Merlyn...!
I-I have a favor to ask...!”

I’m glad I was able to borrow
a book on magic from Miss Merlyn...!
She even gave me all the ingredients I’ll need...

Now, let’s see...
So, all I have to do
is melt down these ingredients,
and put some magic in
as a finishing touch, huh?

If I do that,
my witch power can make a candy
that keeps sparkling forever...!

I can make a candy
as pretty as a gemstone...
A sparkling candy
that’ll make Cerberus happy...!

Alright! Now, then...
Let’s try again,
from a fresh batch of candy syrup...!

“Big Sis!”

Ah...! Is that Cerberus...?

Skipping her way into the kitchen,
Cerberus peered down at my handiwork.

“Is that what I think it is...?!”

“I’m making candy.”

“I knew it, I knew it!
Big Sis remembered after all!”

“Of course!
I’m going to give you a special candy this year,
so make sure you look forward to it, okay?”

“Hehe, yaaaay~!♪
I’m so happy I can finally have
Big Sis’s candy again!
Oh, I know, I know!
Let me help, too!”

“Huh? You want to help make them, Cerberus?”

Cerberus...wants to make
her own birthday present...?

“Yeah! I wanna make them with you!
Can I, can I?!”

“Hehe, of course you can!
Let’s make them together, then.
But, fire is dangerous,
so don’t touch it, alright?”

“Don’t worry! I won’t!”

I started making the candy
together with Cerberus.
Though, since making the candy syrup
was dangerous, I took over stirring the pot.

While the sugar cooked,
we could hear the sizzling crack
of its sweetness melting down.
And as it turned into syrup,
we could even hear tiny bubbles popping...
Alright, I bet it’s almost ready!

“All we need to do now
is add some of our witch power,
and it’ll be done!”

“Huh? Witch...power?”

“Yeah! Let’s do it together, Cerberus,
on the count of...”

When I turned around,
Cerberus was wringing her hands together,
a terrified expression on her face.

That’s right...
She thought she’d killed me with her power...
But, that wasn’t her fault.
It was because I...!

“It’s alright, Cerberus.”

I grabbed hold of
the trembling Cerberus’s hands.
Things have changed since then.
I’ve even gotten stronger, too...!

I won’t let you cry anymore.
I want you to always have that bright,
innocent smile on your face.
That’s why...!

Just then, a small light began to glow
from our clasped hands.
Is this...a new witch power...?

Thanks to the feelings in my heart,
I gained a new power...
No, it wasn’t just me.
Cerberus did, too...!

Oh yeah...
This was written in Miss Merlyn’s book—
“When you take the hand
of someone important to you,
your hearts will sing as one,
and cast an ever brighter light.”

Our two lights blended into a beautiful glow,
binding our two hands together.
Right now, I’m sure we can...!

“Big Sis, what’s this...?”

“It’s our light.
Mine and yours, Cerberus...!”

I then squeezed her hands tightly.

“Cerberus, I won’t let go
of your hands no matter what.
So, it’s going to be okay.
You just need a dash of courage!”

A witch’s power comes from her caring heart.
The power born from your heart, Cerberus,
is the kindest magic in the whole wide world...!

“Yeah... If you’re here, Big Sis, I’ll be okay...!”

As we held each other,
we both raised one hand
towards the bubbling pot.

Our blended light poured into the pot,
illuminating everything around us
in a bright glow.

Hesitantly opening our eyes,
we saw that the syrup in the pot
had begun to sparkle, just like a gemstone.

“Big Sis, is it...?”

“Yeah, we did it!
Our two lights came together to make it—
our candy!”

It’s so pretty...
And it drips just like honey,
as if we melted an aurora from the sky...
Ah, oh no!
I have to hurry and cool it down...!

I then scooped up all of the sparkling syrup
and poured it out on a tray.

“All we have to do now is let it cool,
and it’ll be done.
Oh, right...
I should clean up the kitchen while we wait.
You can take a break, Cerberus...”

“I’ll help, too!”

Cerberus squeezed my hand tightly.

“Cooking, cleaning...
everything’s better when we do it together,
Big Sis!”

“Yeah, you’re right!
Let’s clean up together!
Now then, first off...”

To you, my dear lord.
How have you been?
hope all is well with
Nadia, Sasha, and Chilki.

As your secretary,
I sincerely apologize for
not being able to be by
your side at the moment.
You must be fraught with worry
by my sudden disappearance,
but I assure you that I am safe,
so please put your mind at ease.

Currently, I am under the care
of the Duke of Fran.
Fran. It must be your first time
hearing of a country by such a name.
But that is only to be expected, I suppose.

For I am not in the Gilsanian Empire,
or even on the continent of Centrea...

I am in another world.

Another world. It must seem like
a place so far away from ours.
Farther even than the stars in the sky.

I thought so too at first.
But, something happened
that changed my perception.

Fran is known as the country of flowers.
Just as its reputation suggests,
it is home to a wide variety of them.
I even came across one identical to
the lilacs you were growing in your garden.
It was blooming all over this land.

Their light purple bells blowing in the wind
gave off a gentle, sweet scent.
It reminded me so much of home.
I felt as though I was back
at your mansion, my lord...
For a brief moment, my heart felt so full.

And while I have no proof,
I strangely began to think...

That I will be able to return
to our world someday...
back to your side, my lord.

There are other similarities
I’ve noticed between this world and ours.

“Giant monsters wreak
calamity across the land.
Those who cross their paths
can only wish they are in a dream.”

“They are disasters wrought by
the heavens and given shape.
The people call them Mystical Beasts.”

Mystical Beasts—the name of
the creatures feared back in our world.
Just like how Mystical Beasts
were feared in our world,
witches are feared in this one.

Hearing the word “witch” probably
brings to mind our Nadia,
who can use a variety of magic.

However, since this world does not
have magic like the one found in ours,
witches are seen as abominations.

The girls in this world
are no different from us.
They just so happen to have
slightly extraordinary powers.

But the existence of those powers
has led to the girls being blamed for
causing the calamity called “Curses”...
leading them to be persecuted.

The witches who were saved by
the Duke of Fran also live in his mansion.

There is Illya, a girl as bright as the sun,
who treats everyone with kindness.
Then there is Iris, the caring attendant
to the Duke, who is just as strict
with others as she is with herself.

Rosalie, who is known
as the Great Sorceress,
may look young, but has lived
for hundreds of years.
Natasha tends to keep to herself,
but she loves flowers more than anyone.

By simply hearing about
everyone’s personalities,
it is difficult to see them
as terrifying creatures, is it not?

Girls called the Witches of Qlipha are
sent out of control by some outside force,
spreading their Curses against their own will.

Seeing a witch in that state
gave me a sense of déjà vu.
I wonder if you would feel
the same way too, my lord.

Someone is making
the witches go out of control.
Does it not remind you of Noah
and the Mystical Beasts in our world?

Someone making the witches
go out of control...
Noah and the Mystical Beasts...

Nations here falling to ruins from the Curses...
Our homeland being burned by
the Dragon of Revelation, Apocalypse...

The Duke of Fran and the witches...
You, my lord, who journeyed from
our land around the continent of Centrea...

This world feels almost like
a mirror image of our own.

Perhaps because of that,
I feel that I simply cannot turn
a blind eye to what is happening here.
That may even be the reason
I ended up in this world in the first place.

No... Perhaps there is no
rhyme or reason to me being here at all.
Whether it was meant to be or not,
I want to be of use to everyone in this world.

I’ve been thinking of
your kindness, my lord.
If you could see what
was happening in this world,
I have no doubt you would
jump to their aid.

As your secretary, I cannot possibly
turn my back on them either.
Doing so would be the same as losing
the right to call myself your secretary.

For the sake of repaying all those who
have taken me under their wing here...
For the sake of bringing this world
even a little closer to a brighter future...

And more than anything,
for the sake of continuing
as your prided secretary...
I want to do everything
I can for this world.

The power of being believed in
by one’s comrades...
That was what we needed to win
the final battle at Mana Chaos.

This world parallels our own,
so I am positive that same
warm power exists here too.

Since I have seen the power
of the faith placed in you, my lord,
I want to let the same trust
take root among everyone here.
I want it to blossom in their hearts,
just like how those beautiful lilacs
were able to grow in both worlds.

Until the day comes when the two of us
can talk in your mansion’s garden once more,
I ask you to please wait just a little longer.

I may be in a different world...
and unable to stand by your side right now,
but I shall make it back no matter what.

For no matter where I may be...
I am forever your secretary, my lord.

To me, my mother was my role model.

Whenever something bad happened,
everyone in our village always
came to her for help.
Because they knew that
no matter what the problem was,
she’d always find a way to fix it.

Knowing how much her people
depended on her,
my mother made sure
that no one was left unheard.
All the hard work she always did for everyone
naturally made her the talk of the village.

Ever since I was young,
my grandmother would always say,
“Learn from your mother, Matilda.”
Learn from the great Queen,
loved and trusted by all—

Isabella Penthesilea.

Clever, nice, and extremely beautiful.
That’s the kind of person
I was proud to call my mother.

She embodied perfection—so much so
that I’ve never once seen her act weak.
I don’t even think I can imagine it.
Even my two sisters, who were
much older than me, agreed.

Everyday, I’d look at my busy mother
and ask her, “Are you okay?”
But, she’d always smile and say,
“I’m alright.
Your mother’s the Queen, after all.
If it’s for our village—for our family—
there’s nothing I cannot do.
Thank you for worrying about me, Matilda.”

After saying that, she softly pat my head.
I still remember that moment
like it was yesterday.
My mother’s hand... Her voice...
They all felt so much warmer than usual...

When I was eight, a disease came
and assaulted our village.

“Dendrification”—a disease unheard of
by all that turns the body into a tree.

Once symptoms appear, the time it takes
to completely turn varies
from person to person.
For some, it may take months for
even an arm to turn, while others...
are a part of the forest in a matter of days.

My mother and my symptoms were mild.
But, my grandmother...and my sisters...
Their feet took root in the ground...
and have since lost the ability
to move from that spot.

In an attempt to save everyone,
my mother searched high and low
for a way to cure the disease.
But, no matter how hard she searched,
she never found a cure.

I can say this now, but it’s
no surprise she couldn’t find one.
After all...

Dendrification...is not a disease.

Dendrification is a curse...
brought about by a goddess—
a witch—who’s gone insane.

The first one to propose that idea
was my grandmother.
Within the forest we call
our home lives a goddess...
and she is the reason our forest
is so abundant with life.

In the past, many people from our village
were able to see the goddess,
but they slowly lost that ability
through the generations.
Now, only the Penthesileas,
who carry royal blood,
are able to see her.

If that were true, then the only ones
now who could find the goddess and
bring her back to her senses
were my mother or me.
Without hesitating,
my mother stepped forward, saying,
“I will carry out my duty as Queen.”

Upon hearing those words,
everyone’s faces softened with relief.
Everyone except me...and my grandmother,
who had the ability to see into the future...

On the day she was to leave the village,
my mother gave me a collar.

“If anything happens to me,
take care of everyone, okay?”

The collar was a precious heirloom
passed down from queen to queen
through the generations.
Receiving this from my mother meant
that rather than one of my sisters,
who were paralyzed from the curse...
I had been selected to succeed the throne.

“You are a loving girl who
always looks out for others.
That’s why I know you’ll
make a wonderful queen.
But, that does not mean you have to
do everything by yourself, Matilda.
You are still young.”

“Depend on those around you—
your two sisters, your grandmother,
your personal guard Hilda...
They all would gladly lend you their help.
Goodbye, Matilda. I love you.”

With those words, my mother left the village.
Her destination—the goddess’s temple.

My mother was found a few days later...
completely turned into a tree.
She stood on the summit of
the mountain that overlooked our village,
beautiful flowers blossoming
from her branches...

Smiles immediately vanished
from everyone’s faces,
and the village lost the life it once had.
Seeing this, I knew I just couldn’t
let things go on as they were.

Now’s not the time to be moping around...
These tears won’t get me anywhere...
I’m Queen now... With Mother gone,
I need to protect our village...our family...!

My mind was swimming with worry,
and I was so scared,
my legs wouldn’t stop shaking.
But even so, I still managed to raise my voice.

“I am Matilda! Matilda Penthesilea!
Queen Isabella’s rightful successor!
Now that my mother’s soul has
returned to Heaven’s Ocean,
I will inherit her dying wish,
and I will break the witch’s curse!”

That...was my resolve as Queen.

Not a single person believed
I’d accomplish anything.
All they wanted from me was
to leave my sisters to die,
and to banish my grandmother
from the forest.

My personal guard, Hilda,
didn’t believe in me either.
All she ever did was worry about me.

But even so, I refused to give up.
I couldn’t give up.
My mother, the person I had always admired,
entrusted her dying wish to me.

I pushed through the fear and anxiety,
and searched desperately for someone
who could lend me their strength...

Half a year passed.
I received help from a human who
had fallen down from Heaven’s Ocean.
Thanks to the strange power they possessed,
we defeated the witch.

The curse of dendrification was broken.
Those who had been affected by the curse,
like me with my feet,
didn’t turn back to normal...
But at the very least, we don’t need to
live in fear of the curse anymore.

It may take a while,
but I’m sure that with time,
people will be able to smile
and live in peace once more.
The days that my mother fought
so hard to protect will surely return.

That’s why...
please watch over us, dear mother.
Your village... Your dear family...
all have bright futures ahead of them.

The teachers called it,
“The Philosopher’s Stone.”

What appeared at a glance to be nothing
but an ordinary seed,
was actually an unknown organism
bearing no resemblance to
any previously discovered lifeform.
It was said to hold all
the knowledge of this world
in its shell casing, just like a god.

For the sake of reading its “memories,”
the seed was implanted in me
from the moment of my birth.
I was created solely to become
the seed’s incubator.
But, exactly because I grew alongside it,
I know its true nature.
This is a demon’s seed.
If we carelessly allow it to keep growing,
one day, it’ll...

Well, whenever that happens,
I’ll be dead as a doornail,
so it’s got nothin’ to do with me.

I’ve been gifted since the day I was born,
but I’m not actually a genius or anything.
It’s just the influence of the seed.
In exchange, my life expectancy is cut short.
But, the entire point of my existence
has always just been
to read the memories in the seed,
even if that ends my life.

So, till the day I finally croak,
my life is all about killin’ time.
Before that, so long as
I’m still alive and kickin’,
who cares what I do?
That’s how it felt, anyway.
My enhanced intellect meant
I’d already mastered most things,
and the teachers made sure I had
everything I could ever dream of.
There was no reason for me to feel at all
dissatisfied with my life.

But, y’know,
it just felt like somethin’ was missin’.
I didn’t want for anythin’,
but there was nothin’ fun in my life either...
That’s why at first,
I didn’t have the slightest interest
in that experiment goin’ on...

The experiment was a failure,
leaving a lone student on her knees in tears.
The sight stole my breath away.
I mean, I just didn’t get
her feelings in the slightest.
Living without a purpose like I have,
I’ve never seriously cried or rejoiced
over anything before.

Just how frustrated would you have to be
to sob in a pile on the floor like that?
Just how fun would that feel...?
So, when I asked the girl in question
exactly that, she laid on quite the bruisin’...
But, thanks to that,
it was like my eyes’d finally opened.

A life without failure
is just a life without challengin’ yourself.
Maybe if I started
takin’ somethin’ seriously now,
things’d get a little more fun...

Hehe... Aw man... I always thought
I’d be fine just dyin’ whenever.
Wanting to live now is like some sick joke...

I was going to remove
the seed from inside me.
That’s what I’d decided, but as its roots
were already embedded inside me,
removal was already impossible.
But, its very impossibility
is what makes it worth the risk!

The teachers were sure
to oppose me if they knew,
so I pretended I was gonna conduct
an experiment to read the seed’s memories.
Even cuttin’ into my sleep
left me with barely any time,
so I was forced to cut corners.
Makin’ concessions on
my potential survival felt
so frustratingly at odds with the whole point,
it gave me a strange thrill.

Finally, it was the day of the experiment.
At the teacher’s,
“I assume you’re fully ready for this?”
I couldn’t answer.
After all, if I failed, I’d die.
I’d be dead, just like that.
I knew that from the start,
but only then did my legs begin to shake.

Ahh... So dying was...
always supposed to feel this scary, huh...?

“Serruriaaa, save meee~!!”

Throwing my arms around her in the lab,
I felt myself calm down a little.
Serruria’s my serious-to-a-fault,
hardworking, favorite underclassman.
She flashes me a look of disgust,
but I know she doesn’t really hate me.
Seeing her like that only cheers me up more,
and I squeeze her even harder.

When I think of this possibly
being our last day together,
it makes me so sad that...
I only want to remove the seed even more!
I’d crafted new theories,
implemented the tiniest of improvements
to my equipment, and left my documents
in plain sight all for this.
But, despite my efforts,
I still have no proof that any of this will work.

I’m sure of one thing, though.
If this works, I’ll be the happiest
I’ve ever been in my whole life!
That’s why...I no longer felt
any fear holding me back.

“Begin the experiment right away!”

Upon seeing my return, the teacher smiled
before activating the machine attached to me.
After that, I felt something inside me burst.

My head hurts so much it feels like it’ll split.
It’s like all the knowledge held in the seed
is spreading out before me like an infinite sea.
If all that information
pours into a small human mind...

Well, of course it’d break you...
I really did try my best...
But, I guess it is impossible after all...
This may be how it ends,
but at least I got to have
a bit of fun before I go.
I don’t regret a thing...

Of course...that’s not true...
I hate this... I don’t want to die...
Please, save me...Serruria...!

“Meria!!”

...! Serruria...
You really came to save me...?

“As punishment, I’ll have you sort
100,000 pollen spores out by hand,
so you better get ready!”

Whaaat...? That’d be a real pain...
Shocked back to my senses,
my consciousness lifts,
floating above the sea of flowing knowledge.
Serruria never ceases to impress me...
I can’t waste the chance she’s given me!

The foundation of the world.
Angels and demons.
The blueprint for
a new “tree” made of 22 branches...
With this knowledge at your fingertips,
you could even become a god...
But, I’ll destroy every last trace of it.

Like water spiraling down a drain,
the truths of this world began to disappear.
When I finally opened my eyes,
I did my best to put on my biggest smile
for the girl crouching before me,
who looked to be on the verge of tears.

“At least make it...10,000...”

100,000’s way too much...

The seed’s still inside me,
but it’s only an empty husk now.
Thanks to that,
I was chased out of the Academy.

But, not long after that,
a guy with a staff approached us.
Apparently when I unleashed
the powers of the seed,
the world outside got kinda crazy,
so he came to help us out.

Still, inside the girl that’s with him,
there’s almost an exact replica of...
Huh? What’s wrong, Serruria?
You’re worried about me
so you wanna come too?

Awww, Serruria, you really are adorable
when you can’t be honest!
You don’t need to worry.
I’ll always stay by your side.
’Cause...I can only get serious
when it comes to you, Serruria.

This rotten world
is finally being purged...!
Ahh...!
I’ve never seen a more beautiful sight...!

At times,
I can hear screams of terror
ring through the air...

But, karma does tend to hurt.
This is punishment, after all.

“Can you see it, Lucille...?
This ugly world
and all its filthy sinners
are melting to nothing in my bubbles...!”

Make sure and watch closely, Lucille...

As I destroy this world all for you...!
Hehehe... Ahahahaha...!

I wonder when it was
that Lucille and I first met...
We’ve been inseparable for so long,
I can’t even remember.

In a slum where abandoned witches gathered,
Lucille looked after all of us orphans
as our leader.

But, the other orphans
all died from starvation or illness...
Only the two of us were left...
Until today, it seems...

“Lucille...
Stay with me...until the end...”

As my consciousness began to slip away,
I stretched my hand towards Lucille.

“I’m right here...
I’ll live and die...by your side...”

Lucille grasped my outstretched hand.
In that moment, I thought...
as long as Lucille was beside me,
even death itself no longer seemed scary...

Just before my consciousness faded,
I felt as though I heard a voice
calling out to us in the distance...

Several years have passed,
but the two of us are still here...
Thanks to the nun
who took us into her church back then.

The church was full of young children,
and as we looked after them,
they began to call us both “Leader”...
Lucille made sense,
but why me, too...?

“Nebra, I guess the two of us
are everyone’s leaders now, huh?
And this proves it.”

Lucille snapped her necklace in two,
and handed me a half.
We then pushed our halves together,
forming a whole.

“The two of us are one.”

This necklace is like a symbol
of our vow to each other...
I couldn’t be happier...
I’m sure the two of us
will be together like this forever...
Or, so I thought...

“Let’s save witches
from the clutches of humans.”

One day, Lucille tried to leave the church,
with only witches in tow.

“Lucille, wait...!
Humans aren’t our enemies.
All of us can live as one...!”

But, the hand I extended towards her
was only smacked away,
before she left the church for good.

“Don’t follow me.”

Those were her only parting words...

Lucille didn’t look back even once...
I...must mean nothing to her anymore...

I wonder if she even forgot everything about...
our vow to each other that day...

The sands of the hourglass
had long since shifted,
but time has only frozen still in my heart...

“She was only ever meant
to be yours, wasn’t she?”

Just then, I felt as though I heard
someone whisper in my ear.
Was that a priest’s voice...?
Or...the voice of my own heart...?

That’s right...
Lucille used to belong only to me...
But then, they...

I must get her back...
My Lucille...

If I become the humans’ emissary,
I can have a chance to see Lucille,
who became the witches’ leader, again...

I had my reservations, but to my surprise,
the humans welcomed me with open arms...

They were acting a little strange...
But, that doesn’t matter.
Because now...
I’ll finally be able
to stand beside Lucille once more...!

At the time, I didn’t suspect a thing.
Not about the humans
letting me be their emissary,
nor that they told me to only invite Lucille
to our peace talk.
Why did I think I could trust them...?

“Get your filthy hands off of Nebra!!”

What do I do...?
This is all my fault...!
As Lucille said those words,
she threw down her blade...

“Now, this world will also rot
at the hands of the Curse...”

With those words,
the humans shoved the two of us
down into the lake below.

I can’t...breathe...!
Lucille...!
Why is this happening...
right as I finally get you back...?!

Suddenly, two ice-cold hands
pulled my face close...
and something brushed against my lips.

Lucille...?

“Nebra...
You must...live...!”

Through the bubble of air
Lucille breathed into me,
I felt like I could hear her voice.

As I swallowed it, Lucille looked relieved,
and slowly closed her eyes...

Lucille...!!

I frantically squeezed her hand.
But, it only remained limp in my grasp...

Before I knew it,
I found myself up on the surface of the lake,
holding the now cold body
of Lucille in my arms.

Lucille...you’re leaving me behind again...
No, that’s not true...
Because this time, I’m the one who...!

Just then, a bubble floating beside me popped,
and I heard a voice ring out.
The voice of my own heart,
now screaming with hate.
