“Yes... If only I’d recognized the truth sooner...
You were right all along, Lucille...
Humans will never accept witches.
The rift between us is far too deep
to ever understand one another.”

In that case...!

“I’ll become what you all want...
What you all loathe...
A full-blooded witch,
out to destroy this world!”

Then, I became The Witch of Malefic Bubbles.
To destroy this world, all for Lucille.

“Look, Lucille...
Just a little more,
and the whole world will be...!”

Just then,
a beam of light made all of my bubbles
vanish in an instant.
What could have possibly—

“Nebra!”

This voice... Lucille...?!
No way... At the lake, you were...

“I heard your voice in those bubbles, Nebra.
Everything is clear to me now.
I’m sorry...
Back then, I never knew
how much I hurt you...
when I left you behind.”

Lucille took my hand.
She’s...alive...
Is this...a dream...?

No...this is real.
I know it is,
because I could never
forget this warmth...!
The warmth...of my Lucille...!

“Let’s go home.
To where everyone’s waiting.”

Everyone...?
So, in the end, to you I’m just...
No, no...I can’t think like this...!
I can’t let you find out how I really feel...!

“Nebra...
I want to know every part of you.
So tell me right here, right now—
the true feelings
you’ve been hiding all this time.”

The last thing I want to do
is tell you the truth...
But, when you look at me like that,
I can’t hold the words back anymore...!

“...I want you...to look only at me...!
You’re everything to me, Lucille...
My heart belongs to you alone,
yet you only have eyes for everyone else...!”

“This is the real me...!
I’ve always been carrying this...
this ugliness inside of me...
That sweet girl you fell for...doesn’t exist...!”

In that moment,
Lucille pulled me into a tight embrace...
as though she were accepting all of me...

“Thank you for telling me
how you really feel...
But, I could never hate you
for something like that.
Both the darkness hidden in your heart,
and the kindness you show to others
make you who you are, Nebra.”

“Besides, the two of us are one, remember?
Not feeling whole without the other
is only natural.”

“Yes...! I love all of you too, Lucille...!”

My clouded bubbles popped,
and rays of light shine down around us.
Light shining within the darkness,
and shadows lurking amongst the light...
That is my heart.

It doesn’t matter
if every part of me is pure or not.
There’s no need to live in fear
of my own darkness.
Because...I have someone who loves
the darkest parts of me at my side...!

Blown by the wind,
a small scattering of petals
rises into the air all at once.
A cheer of joy rings out
as the storm of petals covers
the sky in its fluttering dance.

It appears the season of spring
is upon us once more.
Master. Your beloved flowers are
blooming yet again this year.

Even this flower festival,
once only the custom of this tiny village,
now brings in people from all over
to partake in the festivities.
Just as you wished,
this festival is bringing smiles
to the faces of people from
all around the world.

If you could see the scene before me,
I’m certain you would be
beside yourself with joy.
Or, perhaps you are already watching
from somewhere far above.

Master. Even now,
I’m keeping my promise to you.
I’m still here, keeping the dream
you spoke of all those years ago alive...

That day was shortly after
my master and I had first met.
We had passed a small village
decorated with colorful flowers of all sorts,
and stopped to see what was happening there.

Flowers truly are strange things.
Just the sight of them brings
smiles to people’s faces.
The village was full of
their lovely floral scents.
Thanks to that, that day felt like
the very image of spring itself.

Master may have been the Duke,
but he was having as much fun there
as though he were just another
member of the village.
I only learned that this was called
a “flower festival” after
the festivities had ended.

On our way home, my master told me...

“This village is nice, isn’t it?
Here they grow flowers instead of crops.
They say it’s to bring smiles to people’s faces.
Someday, I want to make the entire Duchy
just like this village.”

“I cannot fight like all of you.
But, I can at least grow flowers.
If I cover this Duchy with flowers,
I’m sure I can bring smiles
to everyone’s faces.”

“If I filled the entire world with flowers,
I’m positive everyone in
the whole world would smile.
Just as other nations
raise crops or make weapons,
I want to build a nation that grows flowers.”

“But, I can just hear everyone now, saying,
‘How do you expect us to eat off of flowers?!’”

“Hehe! That sounds like
a very nice dream, indeed.”

The flowers before my eyes
were incredibly beautiful.
Looking at them,
I felt convinced that flowers
really could save the world.

“Please, allow me to help you
make that dream come true.”

He gave a look of surprise at my response,
but then broke into a smile.
From that day forth,
my master’s dream became my own.

200 years have passed since then.
The life my master gave me has
kept my body from aging a day.
The dead cannot come back to life.
Resenting such a fact after
all this time is pointless.

So, instead, I journeyed across the world.
I attained vast knowledge,
all to bring my master’s dream to fruition.
Now, the flowers he adored so much
are admired by people all over the world.

If you asked me if I feel grief
at his absence, I do.
But, I am not lonely.
When the flowers bloom in spring,
I can still feel traces of Master.
Whenever I close my eyes,
I can see that gentle smile of his
as clearly as ever.

Even if he is no longer by my side,
I can still keep a piece of him with me.
That...is all I need...

Then, one day, something changed.
How long it had lain there
or from where it had come I knew not,
but a single key sat perched in my bedroom.

The moment I touched it,
the knowledge of its origins
flowed into my mind.
This is a “Key of Contract.”

In this world,
there are beings called “Apostles.”
Ｗitches who have made contracts
with angels—servants to
the servants of God.
Those who gain particularly strong power
are called “The Apostles of Sephirah,”
and are said to be granted the ability to
enact a single miracle of their choosing.

The power of angels is the power of God.
Thus, God’s law that the dead
cannot come back to life must
still be impossible to overturn.
But, what if...?
This may be just another
trap laid by a demon,
or the scheme of an angel.

But, the wish I should have
given up on long ago...
blossomed in my heart once more.

An angel’s miracle can grant any wish.
But, in exchange, one must give up
the very thing they treasure most.
For me, what I hold most dear is obvious.
I dare not even think of losing
my memories of my master.
It would be a fate worse than death.

Using the powers of an angel, a servant of God,
to defy the very laws of life ordained
by their master is preposterous.
There’s no way it could be possible.
Even if I enact a miracle,
my wish cannot possibly be granted
just by losing my memories of my master...
It simply won’t work.

I know that. I know, but...

Even still...for 200 years...
I haven’t forgotten a single day
we spent together...
I’ve always, always kept
my master in my heart...

How could I ever possibly give up on him...?

The flower festival continues on into the night.
The bonfire lit in a prayer for happiness
crackles into countless flowers of fire,
each lighting up the night sky
before rising to the heavens...

At the dreamlike sight,
I recalled the events of the previous day.
Contracting with the angel was
surprisingly simple.
The angels must be desperate now that
the demons have begun to move.

Flowers may wither,
but in the coming year,
they will bloom anew.
Even if this festival comes to an end,
it shall be held again next spring.

Nothing lasts forever.
That is why we pass things on
to the next generation,
so they can repeat the cycle.
That is the circle of life...
A fate I, too, shall one day have to meet.

A loud cheer suddenly
breaks out amongst the crowd.
It seems the festival has come to a close.

...I won’t wish for my miracle just yet.
There is still something I must do.
But, once everything is over...
After that, I can finally...

Even if I do forget everything between us,
if I can hear how the gentle dream of
that person continues, then...

The place Nebra and I first met was a slum
where abandoned witches gathered.

Everyone was overwrought with despair,
except for her.
She smiled so happily,
just having her by my side
felt like a salve to my wounded heart...

Many of the orphans relied on
that saintly girl’s smile,
but I was the one they called, “Leader.”
I couldn’t afford to show
any hint of vulnerability or weakness.

When those thoughts pushed me
to keep my distance from Nebra,
she told me this...

“You don’t have to do
everything on your own.
I’m here, too.”

Back then,
I ran away out of embarrassment...
But, despite my shyness,
she’d always chase me down
to smile at my side.
Before I knew it,
having her there felt so natural,
that one day, I began to think...

I have to protect this smiling girl.
That is my true calling.

I’ll live and die by your side, Nebra...

Eventually, Nebra and I were taken in
by the nun of a church,
and lived as a family
with the other orphans there.
The nun was a warmhearted, kind person,
just like Nebra...

But, this world
takes the kindest of us first...
The nun was murdered...
by the hands of humans
who despised witches.

I knew witches and humans
should never have tried to coexist...
At this rate, someday, even Nebra will...
I’ll change the world
before that can happen.
I’ll make a world
where she never has to cry...
a land only for witches.

“We’ll make the place we belong
by our own hands.
Those who agree, come with me.”

Afterwards, I left the church
with my comrades,
even smacking Nebra’s hand away
as she tried to stop me...
I never wanted her to leave my side,
but I couldn’t risk putting her in danger.
So...

“Don’t...follow me...”

This is the last time
I’ll ever make her cry...
I’ll come back for you one day, Nebra.
I swear it.
So until then, wait for me...!

I marched forward,
desperately resisting the urge to turn back.

Several years passed,
and we were now called
the Witch Liberation Army...
It was then that Nebra,
who should’ve still been at the church,
suddenly appeared before us...
as the humans’ emissary...

She spouted nonsense about
making peace talks to finally end
the conflict between us...
There’s no way that would work!
Humans will never listen to witches.
That’s why we took up arms
in the first place...!

Yeah...
It could never be that simple.
Because, if it were,
then what have we been fighting for
all this time...?

“Witches and humans can
understand one another.
After all, that nun loved us witches too,
didn’t she?”

This time, as she said those words,
I couldn’t push her hand away.
The determination burning in her eyes
wouldn’t allow it.

But, to us witches,
this is our last stronghold.
We can’t possibly surrender now...!

I’m everyone’s leader...after all...

As everyone’s leader, I can’t fold here.
But...is using force really the only way...?

It was as though Nebra
could see right through me,
straight to the doubts in my heart.

“You don’t have to do
everything on your own.
I’m here, too, remember?”

Suddenly, I felt as if
I was looking at the Nebra I knew
when we were younger.
That’s right...
Nebra has always been beside me.
That’s why I was able to make it this far...

I can’t shine a light through
the darkness of this world by myself.
But, with the two of us standing as one...!

I accepted Nebra’s proposal.
To negotiate as soon as possible,
I left the stronghold in my comrades’ care.
I then headed for
the humans’ meeting place...
But, something’s strange...

This place was built by a lake,
so it’s eerily quiet...
Not only that,
but Nebra should’ve been here by now.
Where could she...?

“Lucille, run!!”

Nebra?!

Nebra stood captured before me,
a group of priests
holding knives up to her neck.

“Get your filthy hands off of Nebra!”

“So you’re Lucille, are you?
If you wish to spare her life,
throw down your blade!”

You rotten...!
I knew humans couldn’t be trusted...!

“...You better keep your word...”

As I followed their orders
and threw down my blade,
the priest holding Nebra released her.
I rushed to catch her,
and saw something glint from behind me...

“Look out!”

Frantically lunging to pull Nebra
out of harm’s way,
I felt something hot sear into my back.

“Lucille...?”

“I’m fine... Don’t worry...”

Hiding my wound from her view,
I grasped Nebra’s hand and ran.

Guh...! This is...nothing...!
I can...still move...!
I need to at least make sure...
Nebra escapes...!

...! Up ahead is the lake...!
At this rate, we’ll...!

“Now, this world will also rot
at the hands of the Curse...”

The priest let out a demonic laugh,
before shoving us both down
into the lake below.

My body began sinking
to the bottom of the lake.

In this world,
the kindest people
are the first to be sacrificed.
That’s why I wanted to make a world
where that kind girl
would never have to cry...

But, despite my best intentions,
I only ever left her in tears...

Through my fading vision, I spotted Nebra.

I couldn’t even lift a finger,
but as soon as Nebra’s pained expression
entered my sight,
my body mysteriously regained its strength.

Pulling her to me,
I breathed all
of my remaining oxygen into her...
as though giving her my life itself...

Nebra...
You must...live...

“It’s just like you said, Lucille...
Humans can’t be trusted...!”

Ne...bra...?

Nrgh... Where...?
How did I end up on the shore...?
I should’ve sunk to the bottom of the lake...

As I surveyed my surroundings,
I saw dark, murky bubbles
descending on the world.
Whatever the bubbles touched
began to melt...
It was like the end of the world...

Just then, a bubble nearby popped,
and a voice rang through my head.

“Don’t leave me...!
Stay with me...forever...!”

Is this...Nebra’s voice...?

I...left Nebra?
Why would she...?

Suddenly, the sight of Nebra’s
saddened expression
floated into my mind.

That’s right...
I never told her how I truly felt.
I simply assumed she would understand,
even if I didn’t say it out loud...
I just...abandoned her...!

I should have told her everything
that was running through my mind...!
...No... It’s not too late...!

I began walking towards the place
where the bubbles were gathering...
to stand by that girl’s side once more.
And tell her—

“Nebra...
My feelings haven’t changed.
The two of us are one.”

“I’ll live and die...by your side...”

Demons are trying
to destroy the world.
So, under the orders of
our angel lord, Samyaza,
we set out on a journey
to stop them.

We were given the noble
mission of saving the world.
Failure was not an option.
And yet...Morgana and Elaine
were acting like
they were on vacation,
with the usually serious
Myrlennia and Guinevere
also in high spirits.
Even the two Heroes
said they’d rather us
have fun than
tense up and make mistakes.

Bonds are the only power
that can stand up
to the demons.
That’s why we were
all raised together,
just like a family.
Because of that, though,
we may have gotten
a bit too close...

Honestly, these people...
Looks like it’s up to me
to get things done
around here!

Before setting out, I conquered
Lord Samyaza’s seven trials,
and was chosen to wield
the shining holy sword, Caladbolg.
I was the protector who’d
cut down evil with swift justice.
And yet, Caladbolg never once
shone as it should...

Bonds are the source of strength.
I’ve always been told
I was too serious about rules, though,
and never got along with others.

But, rules exist to be followed.
I know I’m not in the wrong!

...Maybe that’s why
Caladbolg didn’t accept me.
For an outsider like me, bonds are...

“You’re always there for us
when we need you, Artoria.”

That’s what the Hero of the Staff
told me as those worries were
running through my mind.

“It’s because of how reliable you are,
that we can relax and have fun.”

...Wait, having fun is the last thing
I want you all to do...

But, you’ve actually
been watching me, Great Hero...
Even if Caladbolg doesn’t accept me,
if I can do anything for you, I...

The next day,
a beautiful light started
shining from the holy sword.

Our journey to crush the demons and save
the world was going according to plan.
I mean, with the powerful bonds
that tied us together,
of course it was.

But, we also encountered worlds
that were beyond saving.
Demons were making
witches succumb to madness,
unleashing Curses that were
tearing these worlds apart.
And, in many worlds
lurked another enemy.
Witches corrupted with
demonic power—acolytes.

Not every acolyte was an enemy...
But, the mission given to us
by Lord Samyaza eventually
turned into a journey to eliminate
both the demons and their acolytes.

One world was overrun with demonic plants—
the most dangerous world
we’ve encountered so far.

We fought with everything we had,
but Solomon—the acolyte
of the most ancient demon—
reawakened an even more powerful Curse.
Elaine chased after Solomon,
but he got away...
In the end, we had no choice
but to seal the Curse away inside seeds.

We knew the seals
would eventually be broken,
but there was nothing else we could do.
That was because...
something strange was happening
to the Hero of the Staff...

Back in our training days,
when I caught Elaine lazing about,
she said to me...

“Humans have no real purpose in life.
That’s why Lord Samyaza is giving us one—
the beautiful purpose of saving the world.
But really, we don’t need anything like that.
We should just live for
whatever we find to be beautiful.”

“That’s a nice excuse
for skipping out on training,
you rule-breaking nun,” I thought.
But...part of me understood
where she was coming from.

Now, I’m fighting to save the world
with the holy sword
Lord Samyaza bestowed upon me.
But...the one I truly want to protect is...

Ever since we sealed that Curse away,
the Hero of the Staff’s health had worsened.
Caladbolg’s scabbard has the power to heal.
If I can use it to help him, even just a little,
that’s what I want to do...!

“Great Hero, are you alright?
If there’s anything I can do to help...
Oh, you’re here too, Elaine.
Hmph, some nun you are,
sneaking ahead to tend to the Hero first...”

“Elaine...what did you just do...?
Why did you stab him...in the heart...?
Just what the hell are you doing?!”

Elaine turned towards me,
the look on her face
sending chills down my spine.
She just killed the Hero of the Staff—
the one she loved—with her own hands.
And yet...how?
How could she have that gentle smile
spread across her face...?

Then Elaine vanished without a trace,
taking the Hero’s body with her.
I wanted to chase after her,
but the others said
the mission had to take priority.
“Our journey to vanquish
the demons and save the world
is far from over,” they explained.

“But...I can’t let Elaine
go unpunished... I won’t!
How can I even think about doing that
when she killed the Hero in cold blood?!
And yet, you say we still
have to save the world,
even if it means letting
that murderer get away?!”

We then opened a new “door.”
But, with our hearts divided,
it crumbled to pieces,
and we were flung into an endless void.

Beyond the “door”
was an abyss sprawling below.
Falling in means there’s no coming back!
I have to hurry past the door and...!

I can’t feel Lord Samyaza’s power...
Why...? Could it be...?
Has our world been destroyed too...?
No, impossible...
I mean, Lord Samyaza is there!
It can’t be destroyed,
even by the likes of the demons!!
Unless...it was by some...god of destruction...

I was reeling from disbelief,
when someone shoved me from behind...
As I fell off the “path,” down into the abyss,
I saw a thin arm reaching out into the void.

I woke up to find myself
in the ruins of some unfamiliar world.
It seemed like a miracle that I survived,
but I was all alone...
and Caladbolg had lost all its light...

...This is all my fault...
I lost sight of the mission, and everyone...
...I have to push forward.
Crying won’t bring anyone back.
If this is all my fault,
then I have to be
the one who makes it right.

After all, the holy sword Caladbolg exists
to protect everyone...!

We all came to play at the lake today.

Me and Cerberus played underwater tag,
a bunch of us played shark attack
with Moddey and chased her around...

Then after that,
a little bit of trouble happened...
Still, I had so much fun!

But, as we were coming back from the lake...
there was even bigger trouble.

It happened right when
everyone was changing clothes.
I was done, but everyone looked like
they needed more time...

Hmmm?
Who’s there?

Huh? Master?
Why are you waving me
to come over there?

H-Hey, wait up, Master!

Just where did you run off to, Master?

...Huh? Where am I?
Why am I in the woods...?
And what’s with the big white fluff here?
I can’t see anything in front of me.

Nnnrrrgh...

...? Master!
I knew that was you!
I’m so happy I didn’t get lost!

Listen, listen!
When I ran after you,
I ended up in this strange place...!

But, I’m okay ’cause Master’s here!
Hehehe. You had to come find me again, huh.

What are you doing here, Master?
Huh? You’re gonna play with me?
Yaaay~! What should we play?

Just you wait, Master!
I’m coming after you~!
...Gotcha!

Hehehe,
I’m the tag champion!

Nnnrrrgh...
Why are you rubbing
your cheeks against mine?
Aren’t you being clingier
than usual today, Master?

No, I’m okay with that.
I love it when Master
gives me hugs too, after all.

Alright, this time...
I’m also gonna squeeeeeze
my cheeks against yours.
When our cheeks touch each other,
they say hello~♪

Hehehe, this is sooo much fun~
...? Who’s that poking me from behind...?
Huh, Master?!
But, aren’t you also in front of me...?

Huh? Wh-What?!
Master...why’s there so many of you?!

Gotcha, tiny Master~!
And you, sad Master—
I’m gonna give you a biiig hug, okay?

Hey, smiley Master and shiny Master!
Hold hands with me,
and let’s play swingy-swing~

With so many Masters,
we can play a lot and have tons of fun!
But, how did you make more
of yourself, Master?

’Cause you’re a grown-up?
Oh, that’s why!
Grown-ups are so amazing, huh!

Alright, all together now...
Nina’s Special...High Fiiive!

Oh, I can’t reach you, giant Master.
Hey, upside-down Master,
can you carry me...?
Yesss, this’ll do it...

Okay!
Nina’s Special...
High Fiiive~♪

We already played Master swingy-swing,
hide-and-seek...and also...

Hmmm...
Is there anything else we can play?
Hey, let’s get Cerberus, and...
Oh, yeah.
Cerberus and the others aren’t here.

Well, I’m hungry now,
so I guess it’s time for me to go back.

Huh?
If I stay here,
we can keep playing?

That’s true...
I had lots of fun playing with all of you...

But yeah,
I wanna be with everyone.
If we all play together,
it’ll be much more fun.

And besides,
I gotta head back soon...
“Real Master” is gonna get
worried, after all.

Real Master is my home.
Playing with you fluffy white
Masters is fun and all...
but I gotta go back to my home.

So, thank you sooo much
for playing with me,
fluffy white Masters!

Huh?
You all wanna play some more?

C’mooon...
That’s a big no-no!

After you leave home,
say, “I’m heading out,”
and play a lot with your friends,
you’re supposed to come back home
and say, “I’m back.”

So, bye-bye!
Let’s play again one day!

...!

Uh-oh...
Did all the Masters just disappear,
along with the big white fluff?

...Looks like it’s time
for everyone to go home, huh.

I guess I’ll go back too.

~~~~♪

“Nina!”

Oh, it’s Miss Amleth!

“So, it is thanks to you, Nina,
that the illusions were dispelled.”

Illu...sions?

“Wait...
More importantly, are you hurt?
Did anything frightening happen to you...?”

Well actually, I had loads of fun!
There were so many fluffy white Masters
who came out to play with me...

“H-His Grace?
There were many of him...
that were fluffy white?”

But y’know,
I really wanted to play with everyone,
so I came back.
After all, my home is...

Huh?
Ah! It’s Master!
Not a fluffy white Master...
And everyone else is here too!

I’m baaack!
I found my way back home
like a good kid!

But, I’m kinda pooped.
Master...gimme a piggyback ride~

Hehehe♪
I knew it.
Real Master is warmer and...haaah...
I’m getting kinda sleepy...

Master, wake me up
when we get back, ’kay?
Also...hehe...
You’re the one I love the most
in the whole wide world, Master.

It appears that Ophelia is late...
From atop this hill,
I have a clear view of the children
playing in the lake.
It might be best if I wait here.

Ophelia is my dearest friend since childhood,
the knight I can trust my life with...
And, the one who I caused the most pain.

Executioner and Oathkeeper.
The sword that vanquishes tyrants,
and the sword that embodies
a knight’s loyalty.

On the day we exchanged our swords
to end each other’s lives...
our fates changed forever.

The one who forced that choice
upon Ophelia was none other than me.

And yet, she has always been there for me.
I wonder...am I doing everything I can
to live up to her trust?

Being surrounded by nature,
in all its stillness and beauty,
casts my mind back to Vyde in its former glory.
With my kingdom fallen to its cursed fate,
as the Queen, my duty is to restore it.

However, at times I become filled with anxiety.

After all, the world is a stage.
We are all helpless players,
merely performing a script called “Fate.”
There is nothing we humans can do...

...This is not what I should be doing.
I came here to relax,
yet here I am weighing myself down
with such thoughts.

Indeed.
We went to great lengths
to visit this wonderful lake, after all.
Once Ophelia joins me,
we will go for a swim.

“Master!
Wait for me~!”

Is that...Nina?
There should be a cliff
in the direction she is heading...

No chances must be taken.
I shall pursue her at once.

The fog here has grown thicker.
It is not uncommon for fog
to appear at a lakeside,
but on a day like this, at such an hour...

...Wait...
I feel a magical force mingled with this fog.

If I remember correctly,
Sabrina said she was assailed by illusions.
If this were the same magical force...

Ophelia is likely to berate me again
for plunging into danger alone,
but now is not the time to be hesitating.
I must hurry and find Nina.

...!
The fog is suddenly lifting...

“I was waiting for you,
Queen Amleth.”

Ophelia?
Why are you here...?

Suddenly, I was in the royal capital,
with no hint of its destruction in sight.
Many a citizen were traversing
across a busy street.
And among them, the brethren
who I had slain with my own hands...

This must be a dream.
Even though I know it is one,
I just cannot...

As I stood there motionless,
Ophelia presented Executioner to me.

“I return this sword to you, Queen Amleth.
We have no more need of it.
Our day of freedom has come,
and the sword is no longer
the master of our fate.”

I expected to struggle
with the sheer weight of the sword,
only to find it strangely light.

“Queen Amleth.
Let go of your royal duties...
Instead, take me into your arms...
then allow me to feel
the whisper of your breath,
and the warmth of your body.”

“You see, Queen Amleth...I love you.”

Ophelia’s hand invites me to take it, and I...
I am the only one who cannot refuse.
For I must forfeit even my own life
if she wishes me to do so. However...

I softly pushed Executioner
back towards Ophelia,
and her face began to twist in sorrow.

“Why...?
Is this not what you desire,
Queen Amleth...?”

It was.
I wanted to protect my loved ones
without spilling one drop of blood...
That was my wish—
a future that my own weakness
prevented me from choosing.

But...I have no regrets.

The world is a stage.
We are all jesters merely performing
a script called “Fate”...
Still, should we fear decisions
and choose to do nothing,
we will truly become slaves to fate.

Without performers,
the stage’s curtain will not be raised.
Should a cruel fate end as a tragedy,
or change into a comedy?
That is nothing for any god to decide.

It is for us humans to decide.

Thank you for the beautiful dream.
It allowed me to remember.
Our two swords,
interchained with one oath.
There is nothing more we need.

Yes. This is a dream.
A phantom of the night.
A cheap play full of nonsense,
wafting in the heat of midsummer.
And with that,
a clichéd line would serve well
to draw the curtain on this stage.

Ophelia.
Although I say these words
to your imposter, the feelings
I put into them bear no lies.

I love you too...Ophelia.

“Queen Amleth,
why are your arms thrown
around that tree?”
“...!! N-No.
There is nothing to worry about.
Nothing at all...”

What I said was only necessary
to close the curtains on the stage—
not my true feelings in any way...

Before I knew it, the fog had vanished.
The real Ophelia, who had finally joined me,
was looking at me with
a curious look on her face.
It appears that Nina was also
safe and sound.

Indeed, that fog must show
illusions that reflect one’s own desires.
That is why I found myself telling Ophelia...

“...There are more mysterious things
in heaven and earth than
you can ever imagine.”
“...What is the matter, Queen Amleth?”
“Nothing.
More importantly,
since we do not have
many a chance like this,
shall we go for a swim?”

Humans are frail.
We shape fantastical nightmares
in a future of airy nothing.
But with you here with me,
I will not lose my way.
Thus, please be by my side
forevermore, Ophelia.

Witches are the chosen ones,
meant to rule over all foolish humans
and control the world.

In this town,
that’s what every witch believes.

That’s why my mother,
who was born a witch,
is revered by the whole town.
My three elder sisters
are also idolized for being
the daughters of such a special witch.
It goes without saying that one day,
I’ll follow in my mother and sisters’
footsteps, and—

“If you use your power from a young age,
you’ll rely on it too much.
I’ll train you on how to use it
when you’re older.”

Oh, come on...
Mother, you worry too much...!

“Say, Mother...
Do you think I can become
as great a witch as you one day?”
But, instead of answering,
Mother only flashed me a smile.
A soft, but sad smile...

Through the window,
I gazed out at the sky,
which looked as if it would
pour down rain at any moment.

“Do you wish to go outside?”

That’s what my eldest sister asked me,
her parasol in hand.
She looked sad as she said it,
just like Mother did...

“No. I promised Mother to stay indoors
since my health is poor, remember?”

My third eldest sister
then softly squeezed my hand,
and said...

“Today, I’ll tie your hair
with your favorite red ribbon, Lillicotte...”

After that, my second eldest sister
closed her pocket watch,
and poured tea into each of our cups.

“The first time you leave this house,
we’ll all go together.
We promise.”

Then, my sisters all hugged me.
Their embrace felt so warm,
it almost tickled.
Even if I can’t leave the house yet,
I can handle it.
I have my mother and my sisters
here with me, after all.

“That girl is already ten years old,
yet she still hasn’t awakened as a witch.
At this rate...”

One stormy night,
I overheard my mother say those words,
and felt my mind go blank.

“‘Still’...? But...
I’m already a witch, aren’t I...?”

At my whisper,
my mother and sisters
looked at me in shock.
Then, in pain...

Oh, I get it...
They all had those sad looks
because of how guilty they felt
about me, huh...?

I’m not a witch, so I have no power...
That’s why I couldn’t be given
any training...
The reason I was never allowed
to leave this house...
was all so they could hide their shame
over me not being a witch...!

I was the only one born different...
I was the only one confined here...
And I was the only one they never...!

“...! You’re all liars...!!”
I then ran back to my room
and locked the door.

My head’s spinning so much...
I don’t know what
to believe anymore...!

As drops of rain pelted the window,
my eldest sister spoke softly
through the locked door.

“It was all to protect you.
In this town,
girls who haven’t awakened as witches
by their eighth birthday are, by law,
to be exiled.”

“If the townspeople found out about you,
they would surely come to take you away...
For a young girl like you to survive alone
in the world outside is...”

“...No... Your discovery could lead
to much worse than that...
That’s why, we...!”

My sister’s voice began to tremble...
As though she had been truly
overtaken with fear...

I’ve never heard her sound
so rattled before...
But, just as I was hesitantly
about to twist the door handle...

“So... There’s a human here, is there?”

Besides my family’s,
that was the first witch’s voice
I had ever heard...

“Why do you keep up the Witch Hunt
against children who fail
to become witches?!”

Breaking through the tension,
Mother’s voice rang out.

“What defines a human or witch
is all but trivial.
Look inside each of us—
surely we’re all the same.
That’s why this child and I can coexist...
No... We will...!”

“...Ahh... I...finally said it...”

Mother...

“She may not be a witch,
but that girl is still
our adorable little sister...!”

Sisters... I feel the same...
I want to stay here with all of you too...!

“Is that so...?
...What a shame.”

After that, a thunderous explosion rang out,
and the house became filled
with a cacophony of noise.

Before I knew it,
the house fell silent once more.
I quietly called out to my mother and sisters.

“Lillicotte...? Good...
It seems...casting that protective charm
on the door...worked...”

I could see Mother’s brooch
through the keyhole.
But, when I tried to call her name,
my lips wouldn’t move...

I heard a drip fall,
then saw a pool of something
slowly seep in from under the door...

“I can still remember
the day you were born...so clearly...
Wondering just what kind of witch...
you would one day become...”

Mother, open the door...!
Your wounds need tending, quickly...!!

“But, such thoughts...
weren’t what truly mattered...
I’m so sorry, Lillicotte...”

Enough of that, just hurry and—!!

“Please, never forget...
Just how much...we all...”

...I won’t...!
Even if I can’t remember your voice...
I’ll always remember
what you truly felt...!

I leaned against the door
to be closer to her...
before feeling my own consciousness fade...

Nrgh... Mm...it’s so bright...
Is that you, Mother...?
When my puffy eyes finally focused,
I saw a group of unfamiliar witches
standing before me.

“It seems that this little witch survived.”

“Little witch”...?
Following their eyes,
I suddenly saw several objects
floating in the air beside me.
They were...

A brooch. A parasol.
A pocket watch. A ribbon.
Each object, having lost its master,
seemed to be calling out to me...

We wanted to protect you.
We wanted to be with you longer.
These...were my mother and sisters’...!

“There’s no need to shed any tears
for traitors who defend humans.
If you have any pride as a witch,
lift your head.
Us witches are the chosen ones, after all.”

The chosen ones...?
...Don’t make me laugh.

A black, hot something...
began to bubble up within me...

...Ah, yes...
This must be what they call, “hatred”...
I want to destroy them...
Each and every one
of these witches before me...!

Suddenly, my sister’s parasol
popped open without a sound.
The white lace obstructed my view,
its handle facing towards me.

As though it were
shielding my eyes from evil,
and prompting me
to walk the path that was right...

“My dear sister, I do apologize.
That was far too hasty
for a lady, wasn’t it?

At this rate, just like before,
the two o’ them’ll be...!
...I know that, but my legs won’t move...!

This is just the same as last time...
All I ever did...
was shut down an’ run away...!

I always heard the rollin’ thunder
on that mountain in Lupus—
the very cries o’ Cerberus...
Yet, I’m still too scared to move...!

“Of course I feel scared.
But, I still fight because
I just can’t turn my back
on those in need.”

Oh yeah...! That’s what the Duke said...
Just by wantin’ to save people,
he can always jump straight into danger...!

I want to be like that, too...!
Because... Because...!

“I’m sick o’ only ever runnin’,
an’ losin’ the friends I love most...!”

“Haah, haah...! I-I somehow...
managed to fight off those Inquisitors...!”

“Is everyone alright...?!
...Fenrir, Cerberus...?
So yuh two are both safe an’ sound, too...!”

“Uuu... Thank goodness...
Thank goodness...!
I’m sorry... I’m really sorry...!
I wanted to apologize...this whole time...!”

“Even though I could always hear
the rollin’ thunder
on that mountain in Lupus—
the very cries o’ Cerberus, I...!”

“I hated myself
for only ever shakin’ in fear...!
That’s why...
I just couldn’t stand
to run away anymore...!”

“I’m sorry...! So sorry...
I-I couldn’t do anythin’ to help
the two o’ yuh back then...!”

“Finally bein’ able to protect the two o’ yuh,
my best friends...makes me so happy...!”

Since all three of us
started bawlin’ in each other’s arms,
our faces got all wet...
But, all our tears felt warm, too...

Thank yuh for everything,
Great Dragon God!
Since I didn’t have the courage
to help back then,
yuh gave me one more chance, huh...?

Thanks to yuh...
I feel like I can finally
start to like myself a little more...!

“Oh no. Another one withered away.”

Flowers are delicate,
so they have to be treated with lots of care.
That’s what Mom and Dad taught me,
but I still have so much more to learn...

“I’m sorry, little flower.
I’m sure if Mom and Dad were here...”

The moment they came to mind,
I saw flashes of them
lying on the icy, cold floor...

“No...!!”

...It happened again.
Lately, I’ve been seeing flashes of that day.
The day when the Witch Hunt
took away my parents, all because of me...
...Time to call it a day.
I’ll tend to the flowers again tomorrow...

Huh? Flowers that were full of cheer
just a moment ago, are now wilting...

“No... It can’t be...”

As my trembling hands touched the flowers,
they turned black and withered away
before my very eyes...

“A-Aaah... Did I really become...
a wicked witch...?”

“Oh no... Oh no... What should I do...?”

I was hiding in my room,
when something strange caught my eye.
The part of the wooden floor
I was touching was black...
in the shape of my hand...

“No... NOOO!!”

“Natasha!”

My lord rushed over and hugged me tight.

“N-No! If you touch me, my lord,
even you will...!”

But, he didn’t let me go.

“It’s okay,” he said.
“There’s nothing to worry about.”

Hearing his gentle words slowly calmed down
the scary power in my heart.

“That should help you keep yourself together
for the moment,” assured Granny Rosalie.
“However, this is bound to happen again.
A witch’s power comes from the heart.
I understand this may be painful for you,
but you must face what lies in your heart.”

“My...heart...?”

Granny Rosalie told me,
“In wishing to forget
the pain from your past,
you locked it away inside your heart.
And now, that pain is beginning to overflow.”

My Curse covers the land in cursed flowers.
Flowers that look
just like the one Dad loved...
There are still seeds of that flower
left at my old house,
so I might learn something by going back.

But, just trying to remember Mom and Dad
floods my mind with the sight
of their still bodies,
and the smell of burning flames...

“You’ll be okay. Try and relax.”

My lord then grasped my trembling hands.

“I can tell by looking
at the flowers in the garden.
Painful memories aren’t all
that’s in your heart, Natasha,” he said.
“There’s definitely something else
precious in there.
Let’s find them together.”

The idea of going back to my old house
still scares me...
but Dad was once my lord’s gardener.
Dad might’ve left something behind
here at the mansion.
With that idea in mind,
I searched his old room, and found a notebook.

“Today, my lord spoke to me.”
“The snacks I had during break time
were so delicious.”
“The rain makes the flowers
look like they’re dancing.”

This is Dad’s handwriting...
There was even a drawing of dancing flowers.
Wait, was Dad good at sketching...?
As I continued reading,
missing Dad more and more,
I came across one particular sentence.

“Thanks to a certain flower,
I’ve become good friends
with the woman from the flower shop.”

This woman is...Mom? Yeah, I know it is.

Every entry afterwards
was all about that woman.

“She’s such a kind and wonderful person.”
“We’re going out on a date next week.”
“I’m going to propose to her tomorrow.”

It looks like they had
a truly wonderful wedding,
surrounded by countless blooms
of their favorite flower.

“From this day forth,
we’re going to grow our precious flower.”

With that entry, the diary came to an end.

So, Mom and Dad met here, at the mansion.
I wonder what kind of flower
brought them together.
Since they both loved it,
I’m sure it’s a wonderful flower.

I sure want to see it.
Maybe, if I search the garden,
I can find it there.

“Today, I replaced the soil in the garden,
and tried out some new fertilizer.
The seeds I planted last week
have started sprouting...”

I walk through the garden
while reading Dad’s diary,
as if I were retracing his footsteps.

And then... “Ah! I found it!”

There it was—a beautiful flower
blossoming quietly in a corner of the garden.

“This is the flower that Dad loved...”

Of course. It’s the flower
that brought him and Mom together,
so it’s only natural that it’s his favorite.
The Curse in my heart
looks just like the flower that Dad loved.
I was always scared of it, but...

“So, it’s thanks to you
that Mom and Dad met, and that I was born.”

I gently brush the special flower.
It didn’t wither
at the touch of my fingertips,
and only moved as if it were dancing happily.

A gentle breeze rustles my hair.
The scent of grass drifts in from far away.

Right now, my lord and I
are heading towards my old house.
Just getting close to it
brings back memories of that day.
Scary memories...but...
I hold Dad’s diary as tightly as I can,
and take one last step forward.

“It’s so...beautiful...!”

The place that was once my house
was now a vast field blanketed with flowers.
The seeds that were in the house
must have all blossomed together.
The seeds Mom and Dad left behind...

I make my way
through lots of the pretty flowers,
then crouch down in front of a tiny stone.

“Mom. Dad... I’m home.
I’m sorry it took so long
for me to come back.
I found your memories, you know.
They made me a bit jealous,
wishing I could love someone
like you guys did. Hehe.”

After that,
I spoke to them for just a little while.
I really wanted to talk more,
but if I stayed too long,
I’d end up causing trouble for my lord.

And besides,
I can come back anytime to see them.

“Goodbye, for now.”

The gentle breeze brushes my hair.
The special flowers
standing before Mom and Dad sway,
as if waving goodbye to me.

My dream is journeying to
the farthest corners of the world.

There’s no way our
current map of the world is finished.
I just know it...’cause the world
just can’t possibly be this small!

The map cuts off partway,
but the sea still goes and goes!
I’m sure there’s a world out there
on the other side of the sea
that just hasn’t been drawn on the map yet!

I wonder what shape it is~?
Just thinking about it gets me all fired up~♪

That’s why I decided to go out
and discover it for myself!
The cut-off part of the map...
the farthest corners of the world
that no one’s ever seen before!

Then, I’ll make it!
A map that shows the whole world—
a world map just for me, Eureka!

I decided to set off on a journey—
a harsh and grueling journey
to the farthest corners of the world.

But, everyone from my village
just laughed at me, saying,
“There’s no way lazy lil’ Eureka can do that!”
They even said, “I bet she’ll come back
as soon as she gets hungry”...

Uuu...
I am a tad bit lazy...
But, I’m also an adventurer!

I won’t go home
until my map is complete!

Besides, I have my own unique
Eureka pace of doing things!
As the wind blows, and my spirit flows,
it’s okay if my progress is slow!
I’ll just get tired if I try to
rush anyway, right~?

And so begins Eureka’s
big journey across the world~
Yaaaay~!

But...I’m a bit tired now...
So, I’ll start my journey with a break~

I love looking at maps~!
Just by looking at one,
a whole day will go by
before I even know it!

Everyone always asks me
what’s so fun about maps, but...
Mmmm...
I just wonder why nobody else
gets how great maps are!

Maps are the shape of the world!
You can learn how places
you’ve never been to before look,
and they’re so much fun~!

Oh, I know!
Since I’m traveling the whole world,
I should write a travel diary
while making my map, too~!

I’ll start right now by writing down
how these snacks the innkeeper
from yesterday gave me taste~♪

Om...!
Mmm, they’re so sweet~
But, they’re making me a little thirsty...
Time for tea~

My harsh journey to
the farthest corners of the world...
reached its final act all too soon...

An army of demons
suddenly appeared one day,
and made the whole world a mess...
In the middle of ravaged landscapes
were villages blanketed in flames...
All you could hear from some towns...
were horrified screams...

I was saved by some army members
and brought to an evacuation shelter,
so I was left unharmed...
But...I heard others...weren’t so lucky...

“The world’s days are numbered.”

Day in and day out,
I’d hear the same words
travel across the shelter.

Those words became a curse
sapping everyone’s hope and energy...
It was like everyone was just waiting to die...
The shelter’s door also remained tightly shut,
so none of us were sure
what was happening outside...

So this’s the end of the world...huh...

If the whole world gets destroyed,
what’s gonna happen to us...?

I spread out my map.
Maps are the shape of the world...!
If the world has a shape, it exists!
That’s why...!

This town is gone, so it gets an X.
And this village...and here, and there...!

There’s nothing...left...!
The map was covered in X’s,
to the point it was almost entirely
covered in black ink.
Is this...the shape of the world now...?
Then...that means this really is...!

...No! I can’t just sit around crying!
The world isn’t done for yet!
’Cause...I’m still here!
And everyone else in here is, too...!

I won’t give up...!
I’m an adventurer!
If an adventurer stops,
then their journey does, too!

Clutching the map in my hands,
I took a deep breath.

“This isn’t the end!!”

Everyone turned their heads in shock
at my sudden shout.
I don’t usually like to yell...
But, right now, I have to!

“The world is bigger than you think!
It goes way beyond
where the map cuts off!
So I just know there’s gotta be
a place out there somewhere with no X’s!”

I actually wasn’t too sure
if my words were true or not...
Those places could be
destroyed by demons
as we head for them,
or may not even exist anymore at all...

But, those things wouldn’t change
even if we stayed here.
So...!

“I’m gonna find a place with no X’s!
I’ll find a whole new frontier just for us...!”

Then, I stretched out my hand
to the closed door of the shelter...!

“Everyone~!
We’re gonna take a right next~!”

After that, all of us left the shelter behind.

“We’re sure to run out of food eventually.
So, while we can all still move,
we should go find a safer place to shelter!”
That’s what we all decided together.

My map had all the
different routes I’d found written on it.
If we keep going down these
while avoiding all the X’s
and find a safer route, then surely...!

There were people who said
they were scared to leave at first...
And well, it wasn’t like I could guarantee
we wouldn’t cross paths
with any demons along the way.

But, rather than
getting stuck in a place worrying,
it’s better to imagine something fun
just around the bend and keep going~

None of us can know
what might lie ahead, after all.
We can only find out
if we go there ourselves~

That’s why we’re all going to keep marching.
Marching across the land to find out
the shape of the world for ourselves,
so we can keep moving forward!

The adventurer Eureka’s journey
still has a long, long way to go~!

The Holy Night is when you create
fun memories with someone you love.
A special time that comes once a year.

Until now, I’ve been living in hiding
from the Church of Longinus,
so I’ve never been able to properly celebrate...

But, this year’s different.
Everyone lives happily here in Mister’s country,
whether they’re a witch or not,
so there’s no reason to hide anymore.

Mister and Big Sis are here,
and even Theodora.
This year will be our first Holy Night together.
I can hardly wait!

I’m gonna make up for all the times
I couldn’t give you anything,
and give you the best present ever, Big Sis.

Alright.
Now that my mind’s all set,
it’s time to hurry and do some shopping!

On the Holy Night, there’s something
that I just have to give Big Sis.
And that’s...a scarf.

When we still lived at our old house,
I was knitting together a scarf for her.
But, before I had the chance to finish it,
the two of us were...

Back then, I couldn’t give Big Sis that scarf.
But this time, I will finish knitting it.
Just like how she knitted this scarf for me
all those years ago.

No matter how freezing it got,
as long as I had her scarf
wrapped around me,
I never got cold.
It felt like her love was protecting me.

That’s why, this time,
I’m gonna be sure to make Big Sis
all nice and warm.

...Finding yarn that would make
the perfect scarf for Big Sis
is much harder than I thought.

Oh, wait!
In that gift basket, I see some yarn...
It’s pure white, like snow,
and its color’s so gentle.
It’s exactly like Big Sis...
Yup, that’s the one!

Alright, I’ll just hurry and...

“That gift basket’s the prize
for winning the contest.”

Out of the blue,
a lady standing nearby started talking to me.

“Fran holds a gift contest every year,
and the person who can make
the most heartwarming gift
will be rewarded with that gift basket.”

In other words,
I can get the yarn if I win the contest.
If that’s what it takes...!

Okay, we can either prepare a gift beforehand,
or make one on the spot.
They also provide
any tools and materials we need,
so I think I’ll make some bread.

But, it looks like most people
came with their gifts ready.
Each and every one
took a lot of time to make...
Nrgh... I can’t help but feel anxious.

Suddenly, the air filled with a roar of cheers.
Oh, everyone’s looking at
that lady from earlier...

“That’s last year’s winner!”
“I bet she’s gonna take home
the prize this year too!”

Huh...? Last year’s winner?!
I didn’t know that lady
was such an amazing person!

I peeked out onto the stage
and saw her unveiling a decorated cake.
It was so beautiful, I didn’t even realize
how much it had captivated me...

My plain, simple bread
was nothing compared to that...

That lady’s presentation was a huge hit.
Everyone was drawn into that cake...
I have no chance at winning now...

“Winning or losing is not what’s important.”

As I stood there feeling down,
someone quietly appeared beside me,
and started talking to me.

“There’s nothing more beautiful
than seeing someone doing their best
for the person most special to them. Look.”

In that moment,
as the lady stood on stage,
she muttered something to herself.

“I hope he can see this,
all the way from Heaven...”

...Aaah, I see.
She’s also doing this
for someone special to her...
That’s why everyone was so moved.
They all resonated with her feelings.

That’s right.
The stuffed bear Big Sis gave me
might be slightly misshapen.
But to me, it’s my most prized possession.

“I feel a lot more confident now.
Thank you!”

“Good luck.
I look forward to hearing about
the feelings you want to share♪”

Alright...I got this!

Feelings cannot be seen.
That’s why we all give presents.
Each one filled to the brim with our feelings.

Giving a present
and sharing your feelings
are one in the same.
That’s why...

I stood on stage, holding a large, round,
black bread high above my head.
A hard, nearly tasteless,
plain, and simple bread.

“This was the first bread I ever baked.
I burned it back then,
but my big sis told me that
she could taste the kindness I put into it.”

“Even though I’ve improved a lot since then,
and can bake even fancier bread now,
my big sis says
she still loves this bread the most.
Because it’s the first one I ever baked.”

“Whenever I see that smile on her face,
her kindness makes my heart so full...”

“This bread is hard,
and doesn’t really taste like anything.
But, for my sister and me,
it’s something that fills us with more warmth
than any fancy gift ever could.
It’s a bread full of memories.”

In that moment,
I heard a faint sound of clapping from behind.
As I turned around,
there was that lady,
clapping with a big smile on her face.
Then, others started following her lead...

Hehe...!
It looks like my feelings
resonated with everyone too.

“Hehe. I never thought I’d actually win.”

To be precise, though,
that lady and I both won the contest.

But, everyone was so excited,
saying that having two winners
made this year full of happiness.

Even the lady told me,
“Your story really warmed up my heart.
Thank you.”
...Hehehe♪

I have Big Sis to thank for everything.
I mean, the very thought of her
fills my heart with so much warmth.
I want her to be happy.
I want her to keep smiling.
And... Hehe!
I’ll tell her the rest in person.

In any case,
this yarn really is just like Big Sis.
With its gentle, soothing color.

She always protects me with her kindness,
and this time, I’ll...

I’ll weave every “Thank you” and “I love you”
into this scarf...and use it
to wrap you up in one biiig hug, Big Sis!

The Holy Night is when you give a present
filled with all your gratitude
to someone you cherish.
A special time that comes once a year.

Tonight at the mansion,
everyone’s planning to hold a party
to celebrate the Holy Night,
so there wasn’t a single person
who didn’t look occupied.
Even Sol’s been out helping
with preparations since this morning...

I do nothing but cause trouble for her,
and she always has to take care of me.
So, I want to express my gratitude
by giving her a present.

After Sol left, I took out the present
I had been hiding from her.
There’s only a few hours
left until the party starts...

“T-Today...I will finish making it!”

I always fail,
and can never get anything right
no matter what I do.
Sol’s so kind,
and still cherishes that birthday present
I gave her all those years ago...

But this year, I want to give her
a proper present.
Not something that’s misshapen,
but something really pretty.
A present that’ll make Sol so happy,
she’ll proudly show it off to everyone.
The party’s tonight,
and I still haven’t finished making it...

B-But, it’ll be okay. I still have time.
Okay, um...
I’ll start by putting this part here, and...
Huh? Wait... What?!

Nrgh, I’m following the instructions properly,
so why isn’t anything going
the way it should be...?
I want to make bear earmuffs,
but they keep coming out
looking like brown snowmen...

But, I really want to give Sol
a proper present this year...
Maybe I should keep trying
just a little bit more...
In that moment,
I heard Mimi and Sophia
talking outside my room.

“Miss Sophia, why don’t you make
a paw-made gift like everyone else?”
“I’m all thumbs,
so I’m sure no one would be pleased
to receive a poorly-made gift by me.
Something nice from a shop
would make them much happier.”

Even after their voices
faded into the distance,
Sophia’s words lingered inside my head.

...No one would be pleased
to receive a poorly-made gift.

No one...would be pleased...

...I guess that’s true.
Sol’s so nice,
so she’d probably be happy...
even if she received a gift
as misshapen as this...
Maybe it’d be better if I leave now
to go buy something from a shop...

“There’s nothing wrong with failing.”

Suddenly, standing in my room,
was a girl with a big smile across her face.
Huh, the door’s closed,
so how did she get in...?
The window’s open, I guess,
but this is the second floor...

“What matters most is the heart.
It’s truly beautiful
seeing someone put in so much effort
for someone else, after all.”

B-But...I’ve been working so hard
to make this present,
but it never turns out well... So...
I stood there,
my eyes staring at the floor,
when she tightly grasped my hands,
trying to fill me with courage.

“Remember why
you’re working so hard for Sol.”

I’m working so hard...
because Sol always
does everything she can for me,
even though I do nothing but fail...
That’s why I want to tell her,
“Thank you for everything.”
And, “I love you.”

Yes... I’ve always made excuses to run away...
But now, at least for Sol, I want to do my best.

I don’t want to give up on Sol’s present...!

“It’s... It’s done...!”

My desire to show my gratitude to Sol
kept my hands moving, and somehow,
I finished making the present.

Thank goodness... I made it just in time...
It’s a little misshapen...but it’s fine.
With me as I am now,
this is the best job I can do.
Feelings cannot be seen,
which is why we express them
by giving them shape.
Like, a present filled to the brim
with our feelings.

By the way, that girl from earlier...
Was she one of Sol’s friends?
I’ll have to thank her
the next time I see her.
Now then...
Huh, it’s already this late?!
Oh no! I need to hurry and get ready!

As I hurried into the grand hall,
the party had already started.
Sol should be here too, but...

I looked around,
and saw how beautiful
the gifts everyone was exchanging were.
Compared to all those gifts, mine’s just...
Nrgh, I can’t stop myself from worrying.
Will Sol even like my gift...?

Suddenly, someone hugged me from behind.

“You look absolutely gorgeous, Big Sis!”
“S-Sol... Don’t surprise me like that...”
“Hehehe. Well, look at you, Big Sis.
You really are gorgeous!”

Sol’s smile melted away
some of the gloominess I was feeling inside.

“Sol, here’s...a present from me.
I hope you’ll accept it.
I mean, it’s totally fine
if you don’t want it though...”
“Whoa! Bear earmuffs! They’re sooo cute!!”

With the brightest smile on her face,
Sol hugged the present as tightly as she could.

“They’re so warm...
It feels like I’m wrapped up
in your love and kindness...
Thank you so much, Big Sis.
I’m so happy!”

Th-Thank goodness. Sol looks so happy...

“Alright, this one’s from me—a scarf!
I made this just for you, Big Sis.”

As soon as she said that,
Sol wrapped me up in a scarf
as white as snow.

“Thank you, Sol.
It’s so warm, like I’m wrapped up
in your love and kindness... Huh?”

I just said the exact same thing as Sol...
Hehe. I guess we are sisters, after all.
As we found ourselves gazing at each other,
Sol smiled as brightly as the sun.

“I love you, Big Sis!
Always have, and always will!
Forever and ever!”
“Yes... I love you too, Sol.
Always have, and always will.
Forever and ever.”

“Thank you for everything, Ma’am.”

Today, another one of my pupils
is graduating from my instruction.
“I want the strength
to protect those I love.”
Those were the words
she imparted to me,
so I taught her every
combat technique I know.
In turn, she overcame
every grueling trial I threw at her.

Seeing just how capable she had become,
I couldn’t hold back the barrage of tears
threatening to spill out.

“You’ve really, truly worked hard.
The power you’ve gained is just proof
of your unfaltering efforts all this time.
Now, go!
No matter what anyone may say,
you’ll always be my prided pupil!”

Some time later,
I heard that my pupil’s army
emerged victorious in battle.
But, only her beloved blade
made it home from the battlefield.

I have the ability to see
the power hidden in others.
Someone said it was the power
to see others’ souls...
But, I don’t know much about it myself.
All that matters is that the heavens
bestowed me with this sacred acuity,
which allows me to aid those
who are trying their hardest in life.

Someone trying their hardest
is the most beautiful sight in the world.
That’s because, a person’s purpose in life
isn’t a destination to arrive to,
it’s defined by the path they walk.
So, over the years,
I’ve used this power of mine
to send off countless pupils.

But, one day,
in the midst of my teachings,
a family of nobles from the region
asked if I would take a look
at their daughter for them.
Requests like that
were made to me surprisingly often.
Witches were feared and persecuted,
but if they could learn
how to control their power,
they could also learn how to hide
their true identity, after all.

But, when that girl stood before me,
the power hidden within her
moved me to tears...

This girl is “the child of miracles.”
It’s rare, but I have
come across those who hold either
the power of an angel,
or that of a demon.
But, this is the first time I’ve ever laid eyes
on a girl who possesses the power of both.

Not only does she wield a soul
strong enough to withstand
two completely opposing powers,
those powers dwell in harmony within her.
This girl doesn’t even realize
how much of a miracle she truly is.

...No...
This can’t possibly all be a coincidence.

She is a miracle that shouldn’t exist.
Someone made her this way.
To be able to save the world,
or destroy it...

What lies in store for this girl
is a destiny full of struggle.
It’s a fate no ordinary girl could bear.
But, if she can face her destiny
without giving up,
and continue to push forward...
she’ll likely be more beautiful,
and shine brighter, than anyone.

I want to see her reach that destiny...!
And, I have the ability to give that girl...
to give Illya, that power...!

After that, a year passed,
and I had nothing left to teach Illya.
The power hidden within her
has also remained stable.
Right now, she’s the perfect image
of a “child of God.”

The number of ways people react
to such great power are as limited
as the flip of a coin.
The fact that her parents didn’t forget
their love for their daughter
is yet another miracle.

“From here,
you’ll have to go forward alone.
Do your best out there!
I’ll be cheering you on
from the bottom of my heart,
hoping your journey turns out
as wonderfully as your very soul!”

Almost 10 years have passed
since I began watching over Illya
from the shadows.
The idea of offering her my guidance
never once crossed my mind.
But, the situation has changed
now that there are those
trying to control that girl’s will...

It goes without saying
that whatever Illya chooses
will greatly alter the fate of the world.
But, even so...
No, perhaps I should say
because of that...
The choice should be hers to make.

Precisely because people
decide their own fate, their lives shine,
and their journey becomes
an object of beauty.
If anyone dares
to interfere with that journey,
I won’t let them,
even if they’re God Himself.

As that is what I believe to be...
my...true calling...

“Thank you for everything, Ma’am.”

“Do you really have to go...?”
At my question, the girl stopped,
turning back to flash me a soft smile.

She’s a kind and caring girl
with a brilliant smile.
A girl like that
is heading for the battlefield,
blade in hand.
Only for her beloved blade alone
to return...

Why does it always turn out like this...?
All I want...
is for everyone to come back alive...!

I don’t have the ability
to see the power others hold.
Even if I teach them
how to survive in combat,
only a few ever make it back...
That may very well be the path
my pupils have chosen,
but I can’t stand to watch
their fates play out!
I want to save them,
even if it means interfering
with the destiny they’ve decided
to march towards.

If I could have the power to do that,
I would make any sacrifice...
So, I beg you...
Please...give me the power
to change everyone’s fates...!

I...feel as though
I just woke up from a dream...
What was it...?
I can’t remember a thing...
It felt so important,
but when I try
to reach out my hand for it,
it collapses like a castle of sand...
As though it never existed
in the first place...

I have the ability to see
the power hidden in others.
I don’t remember
when I first gained this power.
Though, it feels like it was
a long time ago now...

That reminds me...
Since when was I able
to send off my pupils
with a smile like this?
I used to only ever wish
for them to be safe,
and come back alive...

...Wait, what was I thinking about again?
Hmm... Well, since it slipped my mind,
I guess it wasn’t important!
Anyway, I wonder what kind of girl
Illya has grown up to be!
I can’t wait to see her again
and find out!

“Stop that crying at once!”

Unable to stop crying
after the death of my parents
in the conflict between
witches and humans,
Gran snapped those words at me.
“Gran, do you not want to see
Mom and Dad again...?
I feel so sad just remembering
the two of them...!”

“Your tears won’t
bring back the dead.
A whole lot of good
that blubbering will do...”

When I looked up at Gran’s face,
she seemed like she was
about to cry herself...
If I keep crying all the time like this,
it’ll only make Gran cry, too.
So...I promised myself
that I’d never cry again.

After living deep in the forest
for many years,
Gran suddenly became sick.
No medicine seemed to work,
and we grew more scared by the day.
What saved us were two traveling witches.

A witch with long, flowing blonde hair—
Miss Aura—handed me a ring
inset with a blue gemstone.

“Tell me. What is it that you wish for?”

Coaxed by her gentle voice,
I told her my wish.
“Please, save my grandmother...!”

As the words left my lips,
the blue ring began to glow bright gold.
It then became a ball of light
covering Gran.
When the light faded,
Gran’s pained breaths began to ease...

“...It worked...!
Gran, everything will be all right now!
We can still be together
for a long time...yet...”
Suddenly, I lost all of my strength,
and felt on the verge of fainting.
My consciousness faded
as soon as the other witch with Aura
caught my fall.

When I came to,
the witches had long gone...
Mmm... I...missed my chance
to thank them...

After the two witches left,
Gran and I spent many peaceful days
with one another.
I grew taller,
and Gran grew more wrinkles,
as we both aged side by side...

One night,
Gran handed something to me.
In the palm of her hand was a brooch
with an emblem of a bluebird on it.

“I couldn’t face my own grief,
and forced even you
to endure your pain for my sake.
I failed to teach
the baby bird in my care to fly,
chaining you forever to the nest.
Be free now, my little bird.”

The next morning,
Gran had passed away.
My tears won’t come out...
But, when my parents died,
I could never stop crying...
Like the lid of a jam jar
crusted tightly shut,
something inside me is stuck.
But, I don’t know what
that something is...

Am I...not sad...?
Have I been resenting Gran
this whole time...?
How can I be this heartless...?!

What should a free bird do...?
I can’t think of anything...
Anything at all...
After all, I have nothing left...
Ah... I never got to thank
Miss Aura or her friend...
Yeah... I should go thank them.
I can tell them how peaceful
the last years of Gran’s life were, too...

But, as soon as I left the forest behind,
I heard a rumor—
“The blonde witch is dead.”

With heavy steps,
I headed for where she was said
to have been laid to rest—
“The City of Graves.”
In the seemingly endless cemetery,
standing beside Miss Aura’s casket
was the witch
that had once traveled with her,
rapier in hand.
Just as I approached to greet her,
she pointed the tip of her blade
at my neck.

“Have you come here
to disturb the dead as well?”

Her cold tone sent a chill up my spine,
so I quickly shouted—

“I-I came to leave
some flowers for her!”

The witch’s breath caught,
and she lowered her sword,
which had begun to tremble slightly.
When I peered up at her face,
she was crying.

This person...can feel sad...
The guilt I felt seeing her tears
made my chest sting.
As if confessing a deep sin,
I blurted out
my overflowing feelings of remorse.

“My grandmother died,
but I haven’t been able to cry at all...
I’m a horrible grandchild, aren’t I...”
“But, you look like you’re
on the verge of tears as we speak.”
“I...do...?”

With those words as the trigger,
I was suddenly hit
by a flood of memories.
Our life together in the forest.
Her deeply wrinkled, but warm hands.
Her face that had once looked
so close to tears...

As I remembered all of this,
I felt something hot
rush to the corners of my eyes.
Are these...tears...?
Yeah...! I really do love Gran...!

I...don’t want to believe she’s gone...!
I want more time with her...!
I hate the thought
of never seeing her again...!
Of course...it makes me sad...!

I laid my flowers atop Miss Aura’s casket.
Through the glass case,
I could see her lying on her side.
Years had passed since her death,
but it didn’t look that way at all.
It was as though she were merely asleep.
Even her once flowing locks
were now cropped short...

“You’re the first to ever come here
offering flowers.”

The sword-bearing witch,
Miss Rustica, grew silent
after spilling those words.
I was sure that if I asked
what she meant,
it would only make her sad again.

That very instant,
a group of men suddenly appeared,
one holding a knife up to my neck.
“Hand over that witch
with the golden hair,
or this girl dies!” they said.

I don’t know their motive,
but if we do what they say,
Miss Rustica will be even more sad...!
“I won’t let you take her!”
I bit the man’s arm
with all of my might.
My body was freed—

But, a sharp pain
ran through my back,
and my chest became red...
Miss Rustica...
Don’t...look at me like that...

Something...feels warm...
Hands emitting golden light
were pressing against
the wound on my chest.
The hands belonged to Miss Aura.
As our eyes met, she gave a small smile...

“I’ve always wanted
to give you my thanks...!
Thank you, Miss Aura...!”
At those words, Miss Aura’s smile
seemed to grow a bit sad,
and she hugged me tightly to her...

When I came to,
I was in Miss Rustica’s arms.
The group of men had all vanished.
Miss Aura was also nowhere to be seen.
“Is Miss Aura gone...
because she healed me...?”

“No. You set her free.
And...me as well...”

I can’t let Miss Rustica be all alone...!
I quickly reached out my hand to her.

“Would you like to travel
the world with me?”

Miss Rustica’s eyes widened.
But, she then smiled softly,
and took my outstretched hand.
Gran... I...won’t stuff down
my grief any longer.
I’ll remember you and my parents,
cry every last tear,
and then move forward again.

That way, I’m sure I’ll be able
to fly freely once more...!

The garden is blanketed in snow.
Before my eyes,
straw posts stand silently side by side.
Crisp is the morning air—perfect for training.
It clears the mind, sharpening one’s senses.

After drawing in the freezing air,
I swing my great katana.

Upon hearing the straw posts
fall to the ground,
a slow breath escapes my lips.
I sheathed my blade and
examined the straw posts...
As I feared, every cut was far from clean.

’Twas clear that my strikes
were losing their edge,
yet the cause eluded me.
With uncertainty clouding my mind,
I entered battle, yet failed to fell the enemy...
exposing the Duke to mortal danger.

Though the Duke told me I needn’t fret,
’tis unacceptable for me to go on like this.
The blade is my only saving grace.
Beyond it, I have nothing.

If I am unable to wield this katana,
then what purpose do I even serve...?

To be born into a family of samurai means
that mastery of the blade is inevitable.
Even for me,
’twas natural to choose this path,
yet I was met with
my father and brothers’ frigid gazes.

All I wanted was to be praised,
to be acknowledged.
That made me
pour myself into my training,
yet it gained me nothing.
When fate’s tides
swept everything away from me,
all that remained was
an emptiness too vast to fill.

At the end of my travels,
only one person took me in—the Duke.
To repay his kindness in full,
I must protect him at all costs.

But, with my blade having lost
so much of its edge, I cannot.
Nor can I lay claim to stand by his side.
“One’s worth lies in
the strength of their blade.”
...My father’s words haunt me still.
Yes. That’s why I must grow stronger.
Ever stronger...!

“Eight hundred ninety-seven...
Eight hundred ninety-eight...
Eight hundred nine...ty-nine... Nrgh...!”

Partway through training,
the pain forced me to stop
and sheathe my blade.
As I removed the bloodstained
bandages from my hands,
I wasn’t surprised to see
my old blisters once again torn open.
The healer will surely chastise me once more.
But, if I cannot carry on with my training...

“One’s worth lies in
the strength of their blade.”

Suddenly, my father’s words
resurface in my mind.
They repeat relentlessly,
like an echo rolling
over the mountaintops.
Am I truly void of any right
to wield this blade...?

An artisan’s chisel
carves out magnificence.
A woodcutter’s axe
fells even the tallest of trees.
But for me...what purpose
does my blade serve...?

“Shizu.”
Upon hearing my name,
I raised my head,
and before me, he stood...
“My...lord...”

The Duke finished applying
medicine unto my hands,
before wrapping them in fresh bandages.
For a samurai to burden the hands
of the one they serve...
’Tis a shame beyond words.

“Shizu. I know how hard
you’ve been training lately,
but I just can’t turn a blind eye
to this kind of recklessness.”

The Duke’s kindness knows no bounds.
But as I am now, I have no right to accept it.

“If I’m without my blade,
I’m without any reason to be here.”

The Duke’s hands stilled for a brief moment,
then resumed wrapping the bandages.
For a while onwards,
a heavy silence hung in the air.
After he finished treating my hands,
the Duke spoke.

“Can you see that tiny flower over there?”

I followed his gaze,
and my eyes came upon a white flower,
faintly peeking out from the snow.

That plant always bears flowers in the winter.
Since the flowers bloom
quietly amidst the snow,
it seldom catches the eyes of passersby.

“If a flower’s worth lies in
people’s admiration of it,
then does it mean that white flower
is without any worth...?”

“‘Worth’ is merely a label—
an afterthought that people give out
only to suit themselves,” he explained.

“A flower blooms whether it’s admired or not.
It chooses where to take root
and when to bloom.
Those choices make the flower.
That’s why it’s okay
for you to do the same, Shizu.
No matter which choices you make,
you will always be you.”

He told me that I needn’t seek from others
a reason nor right to exist...
Such a thought had never once
crossed my mind before...

I needn’t a reason nor right to be here?
Truly...?

“One’s worth lies in
the strength of their blade.”
...Those words linger in my mind.
I desperately steadied my trembling hands.
Though I was terrified to voice my worries,
I couldn’t help but ask the Duke...

“If a flower chooses its place and season,
yet fails to bloom beautifully...
wouldn’t it only be cast away?
Is a flower...worthy of existing,
simply by being...?”

What followed was a silence
more terrifying than any frigid gaze
cast by my father or brothers.
My body froze, stiff as stone.
Even my breath was bated
as I waited for his answer.

“If that is what the flower desires,”
spoke the Duke.
...Ahh, yes. That’s right.
That choice is not for others to make—
’tis for the flower.

“...Yes. The flower shall bloom
amidst the snow as much as it pleases...
For that is what it desires.”

Sunlight then breaks through the clouds.
Winter’s end draws near.
And before I knew it,
the relentless echoes of my father’s words
had fallen completely silent.

As the snow melts,
the warmth of spring
softly tinges the morning air.
I don my new garments, tie back my hair,
and make my way to the garden.
Before my eyes, straw posts
stand side by side.
I close my eyes, calm my breath,
and swing my katana.

As I slowly sheathe my blade,
the straw posts fall in silence.
Every cut, flawless.

The Duke’s words echo in my mind—
“What matters most is
what you desire to do.”
For all the guidance you’ve given me,
what I desire is to protect you,
my lord, and all who you call friend.
Thus, I shall ensure that my blade
never again loses its edge.

The lesson you imparted
will always remain with me.
Never again shall I dwell on the past.
With this new attire,
I vow to serve you with unwavering loyalty.

I, Shizu, shall bloom proudly
at your side for all eternity.
Like that white flower,
blooming quietly amidst the snow...

I can hear angered shouts in the distance...
Ah... More looting, I bet...

For this country,
ravaged by the on-going conflict
between witches and humans,
stealing to survive
is just a matter of course.
That’s why an orphan like me,
dying on the side of the road,
is simply ignored.
What a good-for-nothing world this is...

If I could be reborn,
I’d want to be a bird...
That way, I could fly
somewhere far away from here...

...? Why...does my face feel wet...?
When I opened my eyes,
I was surrounded by
a halo of golden light,
and a girl with blue eyes
was crying over me.
Was what I felt just now her tears...?

“I won’t let you die...!”

The words the girl spilled
along with her tears
somehow brought me
to tears as well...
Maybe this world
isn’t so bad after all...
That was the first time in my life
I had ever thought as much.

The blue-eyed girl, Aura,
was not only a witch,
but an orphan of war just like me.
Until now, she had been helping people
she came across in her travels.
When I asked how
she was helping them,
Aura handed me a bracelet
inset with a red gemstone.

“Rustica, what is it that you wish for?”

“I want...a sword...”
As the words left my lips,
the bracelet emitted
the same golden light as before,
transforming into a rapier.

By sacrificing a piece of jewelry
worn on her body for
an extended period of time,
she could grant any wish.
That was Aura’s power.
It was also why Aura
was covered head to toe
in jangling jewelry of all sorts.
I called her a bagworm,
only to get a right hook to the face
in response.

“My power alone isn’t enough
to save everyone.
But, that doesn’t mean
I shouldn’t still try my best
to help people, at least.
If the ones I help
reach out their hands
to others too some day...”

Does this self-sacrificing softie
not have a hint of skepticism
in that brain of hers?
Despite her good intentions,
all she truly seemed to attract
were jewel-hungry thieves.
Good grief...
She’s so naïve, there’s no way
I can leave her alone...

Those who learn of Aura’s power
all get overtaken with greed
sooner or later.
That’s what I’d decided...

We found ourselves in a village
ravaged by a deadly disease,
its villagers too poor to buy
the medicine or rations to fight it.
“Aura, you’ve already used up
all your jewelry, so there’s
nothing else we can... Aura...?”

“If I stretch the definition
of what counts for my power...!”

As she muttered this,
she slid a knife across her palm.
With no time to stop her,
a wealth of golden light
shot forth from her hand,
enveloping the entire village in its glow.

When the light faded,
the ailing villagers began to rise
from their sickbeds one after another.
Don’t tell me...she healed everyone...?!

Her face white as a sheet,
Aura turned to face me
and flashed a smile.
Good grief...
As the drained Aura was offered
a chance to stay until she recovered
by the villagers, I felt myself
break into a smile.

Your dream just got a little closer
to becoming reality, Aura.

Kuh...! We’re finally out of that village...!
I need to hurry and get Aura
far away from here...!
Those scum...!
Feeding me lies that it was just
taking her longer to recover...!

With no jewelry left,
they used her power by force...!
Aura was drained thin,
covered in wounds
across her entire body.
Even her hair has been cut this short...
And, her eyes...!

“Rustica... Is that you...?”

“Yeah, it’s me...
I’m sorry I didn’t make it sooner.”

“Yes, that’s definitely
Rustica’s voice...! Hehe...
Maybe...because I’m so relieved,
I feel a bit...sleepy...”

“No, Aura!
You can’t sleep right now...!”

“Thank you...
for staying with me this whole time...
Please...”

“I’m the one
who should be thanking you...!
You were the only one
who ever reached out to me...!
I’ve only made it this long
because of you...!”

“So, please...!
