the epitome of innocence.

“My name is Ayse...!
Thank you for saving me...!”

That was my first encounter
with my secret friend—Liberia.

Liberia and I were different
in every respect you could think of.
Our understanding of the world,
our values—everything.

Because of that, we clashed often at first.
But before long,
Liberia tried to bridge the gap between us.

“I...want to know Ayse.
I want to know, because...
I do not know Ayse yet...!”

Ah... This girl has the power
to accept those who are different from her.
Unlike me, who rejects them,
believing we won’t
understand each other anyway...

As a researcher,
I may possess more knowledge than her,
but she has a greater understanding
of what’s truly important.
If I could become more like her...
then we could be...

“I...want to know you, too...
Because...I want to be your friend, Liberia.”

“My...friend...?
Me...and Ayse...?!”

“Yes, your friend.
Y-You don’t want to?”

“No...! Ayse, my friend...
I am happy...!”

If we both try to bridge the gap between us,
we can understand one another.
At the time, that’s what I believed, but...

It turns out...
we should never have met after all...

Several years passed since then,
with Liberia and I becoming dear friends.
One day, I was on my way
to meet with Liberia like always, until...

“Intruder!”

Suddenly, I became surrounded
by armed men from the People of the Sand.

I-It’ll be alright...!
If I just tell them why I’m here,
like I did with Liberia...!

But, just as I was about to explain myself
to the spear-wielding men...

“We will kill you, as our law wills!”

The men raised their spears in unison.

Eek...!
But, just as I squeezed
my eyes shut in fear...

“Do not kill her!”

Liberia leapt before me
in a guarding stance.
Liberia...you came...!

“She is an outsider.
We must kill her, as the law wills!”

“N...No...! Ayse...is my friend...!”

As the trembling Liberia gripped her dagger,
the men glared at her with eyes turned cold.
Eyes filled with scorn towards a traitor.

At this rate, Liberia will also be...!
What can I do...?!

Watching the trembling Liberia
attempt to guard me,
I suddenly had an idea.

If it’s to save just one of us,
there is a way.
I simply have to betray her.

Liberia and I have gotten close...
But, our friendship really was
doomed from the start.
Reaching an understanding
with the People of the Sand is just...

So, this is just how it has to be, right?

“Hmph! What a waste...!
And just when I had you
good and fooled, too.”

As I coldly said that,
Liberia looked back at me
with a shocked expression on her face.
Yes...that’ll do just fine.

“Ayse...? Fooled...?
What...is ‘fooled’...?
You said...we are friends—”

“You really are
as dense as a rock, aren’t you?
Did you really think the likes of you
could ever become friends
with someone like me?”

“I only pretended to be your friend
so I could find the location of the oasis.
Otherwise, who would ever
befriend a stupid girl like you?”

Liberia’s hand began to shake

The People of the Sand

“Liberia...!!”

As I lunged to grab Liberia,

Then...

“Guh...!”

I grabbed hold of Liberia’s hand...

Me, the one who betrayed you...

As I crumpled forward,

“Ay...se...?”

After all,

So, it’s alright...

“I’m...sorry...Liberia...”

A world buried beneath a storm of sand.

Among the raging tempest winds,

We shouldn’t have met, huh...?

I never thought about how your people felt...

The two of us meeting wasn’t a mistake.
What heals the scars on our hearts,

If you’re in pain right now,

You changed me,

so that’s something only I can do.
Right...Liberia...?

The Holy Night provides a chance

I want to show Mister Apprentice

“Master Merlyn!”

Suddenly, a girl draped in a black cloak

“The Shining Star of Holy Darkness,

There’s a legend—making a wish

“We should look into that mystery!”

But, a miracle that grants wishes

Gifting magic sounds perfect

“Sure, let’s go look together.”

To begin our investigation
of the Holy Night’s miracle,
Stella and I visited a shop

“Whoa, this is so cool!
I knew I could count on you

Stella was completely enamored
by the countless number

Hehe, it’s nice to see her so excited.
In the meantime,
I should get started on my research.

Oh...! Apparently, the Holy Night
was originally celebrated

And over time, the holiday evolved
into one to express gratitude
to those you cherish.
But, there’s nothing
written here about miracles...

“A long-lost secret art...
Powerful magic from
the ancient legends of yore,
harnessed to summon miracles from God...

Stella seemed even more excited
that there wasn’t much
written down, though...

Watching her relish in the task
of uncovering a mystery reminds me
of when I first started studying magic.
I wonder if my eyes
sparkled like hers back then.

Wait a minute!
My master was
pretty knowledgeable
about old legends and the like.
I might be able to find more leads
in her library back home.
And it has been a while,
so maybe I should go visit...

After temporarily parting ways with Stella,
I headed deep into the forest of Brook.

I used to live here with my master.
It’s been a while since
I’ve come back to visit, but...wow.
Even the library’s
completely covered in dust.

Alright, cleaning everything all at once
will be a breeze with some wind magic!
...Oh no, my hat...!
...Uuu. Okay, no shortcuts.
I’ll clean everything
one by one with a duster...

Oh, now this one takes me back—
Master’s pumpkin pie recipe!
I believe we made one together one day.
I kept messing up,
and she couldn’t stop laughing... Hehe!

My master isn’t here in our world anymore,
but I can see her again
like this in my memories...
Let’s see what’s on the next page...
Huh?

“To my dear Merlyn.
So, you’re finally old enough
to need this, huh?”

This is Master’s handwriting...
Did she know I’d find this eventually?

...Hm? Th-This is...!

I returned to the mansion
to tell Stella what I’d found out, but...

“On the Holy Night,
confess your love under the large tree
in the town square.

That seemed to be the true nature
of the Holy Night’s miracle.
My master even wrote,
“Feel free to use this as a reference

Confessing to Mister Apprentice...

N-No, that’s not what I was planning to do!
Besides, Mister Apprentice and I
are master and apprentice,
so it’s much too soon
for that kind of thing—
or rather, it’s not like that at all!
A-Anyway, I’m just glad
I got to the bottom of this
Holy Night’s miracle mystery! Yeah!

Um...so, where did Stella run off to?
I heard she was
talking to Gil’uial earlier, but...

...Ahh! Why in the world
is snow falling on me indoors?!

I’m inside the mansion,
but snow is falling from the ceiling...
It’s even starting to pile up in the hallways...

“Wh-Whoa! Ngh... Owww...”

I slipped and fell on the frozen floor...
Uuu... If the hallways are all frozen over...
could this be Lunalynn’s work again?
But, this seems different from usual...

At any rate, there’s still a bit of time
before the Holy Night,
so I should turn everything
back to normal before someone gets hurt.

...Phew, I think I’ve cleared most of it.
Huh? I can hear
the faint ringing of bells from town.
Is it evening already...?!
But the clock here on the wall says...
Wait, the hands are frozen and stopped?!
There’s only a little time left
before nightfall...!

I-I-I have to act fast and find Stella...!

“The power of the miracle
becomes stronger when it snows...”

Ah, there she is!
Heeey! Stella, over here!

“So, it seems that what they call
the Holy Night’s miracle
is a legend that says,
‘Confess your love under the large tree
in the town square.
Then, the love you seek will be yours.’
That’s why... Hm? Stella, are you okay?”

“I-I’m gonna have to...
c-confessh...to B-B-Bossh?!”

Her face was as bright as a tomato,
and she froze in place...
Oh, she’s slowly wobbling away...

Um... When you’re not feeling well,
be sure to stay warm
and sleep early, okay...!
It didn’t seem like she was sick, though...

Hah... Well, putting that aside,
what am I going to do about
Mister Apprentice’s present...?

Soon after, the town lit up,
and the Holy Night began.

In the end, I couldn’t find
the perfect gift to show my gratitude...
But, I still can’t wait to see
Mister Apprentice tonight.
Because...there’s so much
I want to tell him about.

Like, investigating the mystery
of the Holy Night’s miracle with Stella,
how dusty the library was
when I went back home,
or how sweeping all those spellbooks
was such a daunting task...

And not to mention all the snow
inside the mansion—
I’m sure that’ll surprise him.
Or maybe it’ll just make him laugh.

Just thinking about
how I should tell these stories,
along with imagining what kind of faces
you’ll make in response... Hehe!

I may not have prepared a special gift,
but I have a feeling
it’ll be a wonderful Holy Night.
I’m sure of it.

Heh-heh-heh,
so the time has finally come...!
The time for me to attain the Holy Miracle
with these two hands...!

It all started a few minutes prior,
or more accurately, just now.

I heard tell of a certain rumor...
A rumor about the Holy Miracle!

A celebration that comes
but once a year—the Holy Night.
On that special night,
it’s said that if you make a wish
under a large tree,
the Holy Overlord shall descend,
and make your wish come true...!

Well, in other words,
as long as you make a wish
under a large tree,
it’s guaranteed to come true...!

And, the noble recipient
of the miracle’s blessing is but one soul—
the Holy Overlord’s chosen one!

Heh-heh...!
I’ll get my hands on that miracle no matter—
No, scratch that...
I, the Shining Star of Holy Darkness,
will be chosen!

HAH-HAHA! HAH-HAHAHA!

I will uncover the truth
of the Holy Miracle...
The reason for my investigation
was simple...

It happened moments after

Out of nowhere,
Boss appeared before me.
As though I was being guided by fate!

I’ll bet Boss knows something about it.
Alright...I’ll try asking him!

“Um... I-I heard a rumor
about the Holy Miracle...
D-Do you happen
to know anything about it, B-Boss...?”

Boss doesn’t know anything either, huh...
So, there are things
even Boss doesn’t know...
In that case...!

“I...I’ll show you
the Holy Miracle myself, then...!”

Boss smiled at me gently and said,
“I can’t wait,”
before patting me on the head...
Uuu... He’s treating me like a kid again...

But, a promise is a promise!

“Then, on the Holy Night,
meet me under the large tree
in the town square, okay?!”

After that, to help me uncover
the truth of the Holy Miracle,
I headed out to meet
the perfect witch for the job.

A large tree on the Holy Night...
When it comes to trees,
only one person comes to mind—
the Witch of the Deep Forest,
Master Merlyn!

Oh! There’s Master Merlyn
strolling down the hall right now!
Luck truly is on my side!

“The Shining Star of Holy Darkness,
Stella, has arrived!
Come, let us uncover
the ancient covenant
hidden in the shadows of night!”

“Sure, let’s go look together.”

With Master Merlyn now in tow,
we headed for the next trial

the Archive of the Ancients.

But, none of the texts

So, to increase our odds of success,
Master Merlyn and I
temporarily parted ways.
Now, next is, mm... Whoa, wait...!

It’s the Immortal Witch, Master Rosalie!
And, with her—
the Witch of Prophetic Wisdom, Miss Loki!

Luck—nay—the very world itself,
truly is on my side!

Without further ado,
I shall ask those two for some clues!

I tried asking the two of them...

“I see...

“When you invite someone out,

set the mood.

the two of them taught me

Um, like...“do this when it’s snowing,”

I guess they mean that I should
make it snow at night...?

Snow, huh...?
Then, my next stop is...!

“Master Gil’uial,
I need your guidance and wisdom~!”

To get even more wisdom this time,
I came to Master Gil’uial to learn magic
that would help me make it snow.
But, Master Gil’uial was smirking at me, too...
I wonder why...?

Heh-heh!
I’ve already gained this much power...!
To learn such ancient arts so easily,
I tremble before my own talent...!
Though, this is naught but the fate

“O incantation of the frigid wintry winds...!
Become an unbreakable wish

The room was suddenly enveloped

Heh...! I really am
the Holy Overlord’s chosen,
ah...ah-choo!

Ugh, it’s colder than I thought...
This oughta do it...
O frigid winds, begone...!
Or, not...?

Whoa, whoa, wawawa...!
At this rate, the whole mansion

Wait... It stopped...?

Th-That’s a relief...
But, this means I’m all set to go!
Tonight’s finally the Holy Night, too.
I’m sure I just lost control for a second

But, it’s no big deal!
It’ll all work out fine, I just know it!

Alright! It’s almost our meeting time,

“Heeey! Stella, over here!”

Oh, it’s Master Merlyn!

“Master~! I’ve learned the secret
of the Holy Miracle!
If it snows at night, the Holy Overlord will...

“‘Confess your love under the large tree
in the town square.

...So that’s the Holy Night’s miracle, eh?
Mmhm, mmhm, I see...
Confess, huh? Con...”

“CONFWESSH...?!”

I-I can’t believe the Holy Miracle

Why didn’t anyone tell me~...?!

I already told Boss

our promised meeting time...!
What do I do~?!

For now, I’ve at least made my way

Ah, wait...! Boss is there already...!

Everybody else here’s a couple...!
Boss, you idiot...!
If you do that,

“Oh, B-Boss...!

I-Isn’t this just like a d-d-d-d-d—!

Suddenly, Boss pointed up at the sky.

It’s so pretty...

Oh yeah...
Didn’t Miss Loki say something

Setting the mood, huh...

Surrounded by embracing couples

N-Now’s my chance...!

“B...Boss...!”

As snow continued to fall overhead,

It’s strange...
I can’t hear anything else around us.
All I can hear is the loud thumping
of my own heart...

Urgh... For some reason,
I can’t look Boss in the eye.
B-But, I’m gonna say it!
You can do this, Stella...!

“B-Boss, I...ah...ah...AH-CHOO!”

Uuu...! I-It’s way colder

When I started to shiver,

“B-But, if you give me this, you’ll...

Uuu, I know there’s

Since Boss is so nice, everyone...and...

“I...really do love...”

...Huh...? Wait...

“U-Uh... S-Snow!!

Jeez, he has no clue how I feel, does he?
But...

“It really is pretty, huh, Boss?”

The two of us gazed on

Right now, this is more than enough.
It’s the most effort I can muster
as I am now.

“Now then, without further ado,

“Now, I can die as a human.”

Wait. This wasn’t what I wished for.
I just wanted...more time...
to be with...!

“Hah... What a horrible dream.”

As I lay, sunken deep into my bed,

At some point in time,
doing this became a habit of mine.

Because, each time I touch the flower,
her selfish, yet gentle smile

I’ll live as a human,
and die as a human.
That’s what I’d decided to do, but...

...Hey, this flower
won’t ever go away, right?
Until the day I die,
it’ll always be by my...

Huh, what’s this?
One of the petals
have turned a little browner...

“...No way.”

The flower...is withering...

The day my village was attacked,
I ran away and abandoned my family,
wishing to only save myself.

It was that moment
when my power of immortality was born.
A cursed power that forces me
to live forever in pain.
And the only thing that can let me die is...
this flower.

I have no idea why it started withering.
I’d always assumed that,
since she gave her life

Maybe...the power she

If I use it before

But...I’ll live as a human,
and die as a human.
That’s what I promised you, after all.

I heard about a witch

She might be the one
who can restore the flower.

I wasted no time

“Hey, you okay?”

She didn’t respond to my voice,

It’s like her power’s gone out of control.
Haah...guess I’ve got no other choice.

“I can’t believe you saw me like that.

Now looking a little better
from when I found her,
the girl let out a weak smile
from atop the bed.

“Thank you for saving me.

I gave my arm a quick cut.

immediately close up,
her smile darkened.

“You...can’t die.”
“I am an immortal witch, after all.”
“...You know...
they say I’m going to die soon.”

Particles of light were still scattering
from her trembling fingertips.

her life essence was the very light
spilling out of her.

“What a pretty light.”
“...Huh?”
“A witch’s power comes from the heart.

from a heartfelt wish
that’s just as beautiful.”

Unlike mine.
I caught the girl gazing at me
with eyes full of wonder.
Before long, that darkened face of hers
was beaming with childlike happiness.

“You think so too, huh!”

That’s how I met the girl
who houses the essence of life

Yubera was always inside her house
painting pictures.

“This is a painting of my hometown.

Yubera set down her paintbrush,
and brought her fingers
towards the canvas.

“A witch’s power

Light scattered from Yubera’s fingertips,
and the dried paint started shining,
as if it had been brought to life.
Her life essence dwindles away
each time she does that,
yet she refuses to put
the paintbrush down.

I see.
Yubera’s just like the two of us.
Fallen into despair
over a power she never wanted,
and looking for a way to be forgiven.

Just like how she sacrificed
her life to leave me this flower,
Yubera is trying to whittle down
her life essence to make sure
this trace of her hometown remains.

I raise my hand
to touch the withering flower.
Yubera’s power gives light to paintings.
It’s not meant to give this flower life.

I’m sure I only have a little time left.
I wonder...
is there anything I can leave behind?

One day, just like any other day,
I was visiting Yubera’s house,
when I found her lying on the bed,
her face deathly pale.

“It looks like...this is it for me...”

The light that had been spilling out

from her entire body,
rapidly burning through
the little life essence she had left.

“I never got to finish my painting...”

I reached for my chest
and touched the flower.
She gave me this flower
so I can die.
If it can put a stop to my immortality,
then it should be able to do the same
to Yubera’s power.

so I’m sure using it now
would consume every ounce of its power...
to make it wither away completely...

“No... I’m not the kind of person

Yubera then weakly shut her eyes
in protest.
I don’t know anything about the despair

When someone closes off their heart,
no amount of kind words
will ever reach them.

of selfish kindness that can pry
that type of heart right open.

“If you’re gonna die anyway,
why not give your life over to me?”

Yubera slowly opens her eyes.

“If I’m giving it over to you, Fia... Sure.”

“I’m the worst kind
of human being out there.

but it had nothing to do with feeling scared,
or wanting to save everyone...

“So I figured,
if this power ended up killing me,

those words to me, Fia—
‘What a pretty light.’”

“I’d always regretted what I had done.

Once Yubera’s power
had finally calmed down,
she left for a faraway sanatorium

All that was left in her empty house

It was...a depiction of a city

A painting so beautiful, it was terrifying.

My hand found its way
to the shriveled black flower.

This isn’t the way you’d hoped
things’d turn out, huh.
But after abandoning my family,
I just knew I wouldn’t be able
to live with myself
if I did it again to a friend.

I wanna live just like you did.
I wanna take the kindness
you left me with,
and save others,
like you did for me.

To me, that’s what it means to
“live as a human.”

This flower was the one thing
she left me in her final moments.
The flower that would’ve let me die.

Now, no matter how gently I stroke it,

or gentle smile anymore.

But, that’s okay.
Because the essence of
your heart remains inside me.

Thank you.
And...goodbye.

I unsewed the black flower
from its place near my heart,

Then, the next day...
the once-withered flower

...Haah. There you go again,
completely ignoring how I feel...
Honestly, you really are
a selfish person.

I take the white flower into my hand,
holding it up like how I’ve always done.

The wind doesn’t blow,
yet it sways back and forth.
And for a moment,
I catch a faint, yet familiar scent.

“You useless, no-good waste of space!”

Ever since I was little,
getting yelled at by my parents

Anything I tried to do
would always end in failure,

“Damn it, damn it all!

or happily flutter around me.
That’s how I’d spend most of my days—
playing alone in the corner of my room.

“There you go again,
muttering to yourself like a creep!
All of our troubles
are ’cause of crap like that!
Do you get me,
you demon-possessed freak?!
I hope you do,

The fairies were my only friends,

It wasn’t long after

I was told I could start fresh,
build a new life here...

continue to play with my fairies...

“Hi there! And what are you up to?”

“Eep! I-I-I’m so sorry...!

so please...don’t hurt me...!”

“...No, no, it’s okay.

“...! You...can see the fairies too?”

“The most I can manage to do

She knelt down to look at me face-to-face,

“You’ve got quite the gift.”

The fairies were
my only light in the darkness...
and they’d heal each and every one
of my wounds...

When I showed my fairies
to that lady, Guinevere,

“You’re able to control them so easily...

“I-I’ve been playing with these fairies

so really, this is all I’ve got...

“I see... You’ve had such a gift all along,

“Huh...?”

“Myrlennia, you really
do have a gift.

or weird in the slightest.
With your gift, you can achieve anything
you put your mind to.
Your parents couldn’t see that,
but I’ll tell you
just how amazing you are!”

Saying that,
Guinevere pulled me into a warm hug...

“From here on out, we’re family. Okay?”

“...I-I’d always been told...
that I’m completely useless,
that I can’t do anything right...
I was only ever yelled at...
that I was better off dead...
over and over again...!”

“I know, let it out. You’re okay.
I won’t let anyone
scold you ever again.”

That day, I cried and cried
for what felt like forever,
all while gently nestled
in Guinevere’s arms.

Since then, I trained hard,
and eventually set out on a journey
to save the world
with Guinevere and her friends.

We were going to travel through “doors,”
and save different worlds
across a multitude of time periods.

I-I knew I wasn’t cut out
for such a noble mission,
but spending time with everyone
was so much fun.
I figured I could tag along,
even if it was just to carry their luggage...
Ehehe.

Day after day, we defeated demons
and saved worlds together.
Our journey was going smoothly so far.

Until one day,
the nun in our party, Elaine,
killed the Hero of the Staff...

And we all fell through a broken “door,”
into an endless abyss...

I-I knew I had to save everyone
who fell into the abyss...
but just the thought of
messing everything up again
made me freeze in fear...

After meeting the others,
every day I spent with them
was so much fun.
I even started to smile, just a little...
I thought that maybe, just maybe,
I was finally starting to be useful, but...

Why am I...so useless...?

At this rate, everyone’s going to die...
Then, I’d never be able
to see Guinevere again...!

No... No, no, no! I can’t let that happen!

For once...just this once,
I can’t run away...!
If I didn’t do something now,
this would be it for all of us!

I-I know I’m a worthless
good-for-nothing, but...
Guinevere told me, didn’t she—
that I had a gift!
That I could do anything
I put my mind to!

“That’s why...I can do this!!”

At that very moment,
something hot welled up
within my chest,
and all of the fairies
flew towards the others.
Then...

“I knew it.
I figured if anyone could do it,
it’d be you, Myrlennia.”

There she was behind me...
The one who betrayed us all...
Elaine...

“Elaine, you were
the one behind all this...?”

I-I was too scared to ask, but I had to...

“Just breaking apart our bonds
wouldn’t have been enough
to break the ‘door.’
Unless...someone
destroyed it themselves...”
“I did it all to save the Hero of the Staff.”

“I-I don’t really get what you’re saying,
but...if you go apologize to everyone now,
maybe... Eeep!”

E-Elaine’s fingers
delved deep into my chest...
as if trying to grab something...
inside me...!
Ah...!

“Who...no, what...
did you contract with, Elaine...?”

Elaine had chased
after Solomon by herself.
At that time, maybe she...?

“Heh. That fool has nothing
to do with anything.
I’ve always had this power.”

As she seized my soul,
her gentle whisper
sent shivers down my spine.

“I have a favor to ask of you.
Would you take me to ‘Paradise?’”

B-Before falling into the sprawling abyss,
I somehow managed to guide everyone
to different worlds.
But Elaine managed to escape
and head towards “Paradise”...

And now, I find myself
in a strange, unfamiliar world too...
Hehehe. I’ve got to find the others
as soon as I can...

...W-Wait a minute.
I don’t see a single fairy anywhere...
Why...?

...Hehe. Ehehe...
Having the fairies around to help
was all I had going for me,
and now that even they’re gone...
Ehe. Ehehe... I really do...
have no purpose now... Hgh!

What do I do now...?
Help me...
Guinevere, wherever you are,
please...help meee...!

“I wish I’d never been born.”
You can’t walk through the slums
without hearing those words.

I lost count of how many times
I thought that.
If the pain from this hunger
could all just go away...
maybe I should just...

That’s why,
when my little brother was born,
I felt no ounce of happiness.
I mean, how can I,
when living only brings suffering...

Then, when my father told me to go
and throw my little brother away,
I thought I had no other choice.

But, when I held him in my arms,
he looked up at me...and smiled.

The innocence of his smile
and his trusting eyes...
lit up the darkness clouding my heart.
Then...I felt the tears starting to pour out.

“I’m sorry...! It’s okay now.
Your big sister’s here!”

As I cradled my tiny brother in my arms,
I took one step forward, and kept going.

He’s sick and won’t survive on his own.
So, I’ll be the one to keep him safe.
Even if our time together will be short,
I’ll at least make sure
he’s the happiest kid
in the whole wide world.

Since that day,
my brother and I started
our new life together.
But, we lived among the poor.
And as of late,
we haven’t been able to afford
even a single piece of firewood.

That’s why I brought him
to one of the monasteries in town,
believing he’d have a chance
at a better life there. But...

“No! I wanna stay with you, Big Sis!”

As we stood in front of the monastery,
my brother tightly clutched at my clothes.

I wanna keep staying with him too,
but I had no way to make him happy...
So, I told him...

“They have blankets here
that’ll keep you warm and comfy,
and you won’t have to be alone ever again.”

I tried to gently pull away from my brother,
when he threw his arms around me.

“I don’t need anything like that, Big Sis!
Just hug me, and I’ll feel
warm and comfy enough...
You’re all I need—nothing else!”

I feel...the exact same way.
No matter how cold the nights get,
just curling with him
under a single blanket
was enough to warm my heart...
Ahh, how could I not see that?

We had more than enough.
Curling up alone under a blanket
might warm your body up,
but it’s not enough to warm your heart.
The only thing that can is...

“I’m so sorry.
You’re all I need, too.
Nothing else.”

I pulled my brother
tightly into my arms.

I will never let go of him again.
I’ll live on, keeping this
tiny bit of happiness safe...
My one and only...treasure.

Although we still lived among the poor,
we couldn’t have been any happier.
Until my brother fell ill, that is.

Any kind of medicine
would have eased his pain...
but I couldn’t afford anything like that...

If I had money, I could save him...
If only... If only I had money...!

“Oh God, I’ll give you anything—
no, everything I have.
Just please...save him!
Save my brother!”

“Very well. I shall help you.”

A voice suddenly
made its way inside my head.

“You shall have the power
to turn your memories into riches.
The more precious the memories you offer,
the greater the riches you will attain.”

Could it be?
Did God hear my prayer?
But, if I offer up my memories,
that means...

The day my little brother
spoke his first word...
The first time we cooked together...
I remember everything.
They’re all precious to me.
I don’t wanna lose any of them...!

“B-Big...Sis...”

My brother’s voice
was weak and faint.
His hands, cold as ice...

At this rate,
he won’t even
make it through the night...!
I’ll do it...!

The moment I made my choice,
God’s holy mark emerged
on my left hand.

“Now, call to your mind
a memory you wish to offer.”

As God’s voice guided me,
memories of my childhood
came into view.
Then, countless jewels
appeared in the palm of my hand...

Incredible...!
This is enough
to save my brother.
Thank you, God!

“Happy birthday, Big Sis!”

That was my brother,
now back on his feet,
wishing me a happy birthday.
With his face beaming with energy,
he seemed fully recovered.
This is all thanks to God...

I was worried after hearing
my memories would be
the price I’d have to pay.
But, it looks like not everything
was taken away from me.

Well, I guess my childhood memories
do feel a bit blurrier than before.
Still, those with my brother
remain safe and sound.

“Here are my presents to you, Big Sis.
A scarf and a stuffed doll!”

“Wow, you made all these by yourself?
It must’ve been hard to do.”

“They’re for you, Big Sis!
Doing something like this is super easy!”

Ahh, thank goodness.
He really has gotten better.

“Thank you. I’ll always cherish them.”

Our once dark days
are now bright with happiness.
I know we’ll only have more of them...
Bright days...that shine like treasures...

Ever since that day,
my little brother stayed healthy.
Our life had improved,
and I only have God to thank for that.

By simply wishing,
I could attain
as many jewels as I wanted...
Enough to afford
all the medicine and nutrition
we could ever want.

We could finally live in riches.
And so, day after day,
I used my power.

Until one day...
when my brother looked at me
with sadness in his eyes, and said...

“Why did you throw away
the scarf I made for you?”

He made a scarf...?
What’s he talking about?
I’d definitely cherish
something like that, and I...

...I can’t remember a thing about it.
Did using my power...
make me lose
such an important memory?

What should I do...?
If I keep this up,
even the memories
with my brother might one day...

“I’m sorry! I know I’ve changed,
but from now on, Big Sis is back!”

I held tightly onto my anxious brother.
I couldn’t lose him.
They can take these jewels,
these riches—just not him!

I’ll stop using my power.
We might go back to being poor,
but I’m sure things
will turn out for the better.

Because, as long as
I have my little brother,
I don’t need anything else.

Several days later,
my brother’s illness came back.

He seems in more pain than before...
He needs medicine.
Much stronger medicine...!
I can make that happen, can’t I...?

...N-No! I am not
using any more of that power.

“Worry not—
you can always
make new memories.”

As God spoke inside my head...
it almost sounded like
a demon whispering.

“If your brother dies,
so does your chance
to make new memories.
Do it now,
before it is too late...”

B-But I...

Suddenly, I felt
my brother’s hand grasp mine.

“See. Your brother is begging
for you to save him.”

...! You’re right—
I have to save my brother.
But, if it means forgetting about him...

I don’t wanna lose anything!
Not my brother, not my memories, but...
This is the only way to save him!

“Even if I forget everything...please...
don’t make me lose my brother...!”

A blinding light suddenly
envelops all I could see.
Then, something flashes in my mind—
someone’s silhouette, tinged in white.
Wait, is that...?

Little by little,
the silhouette is engulfed by the light,
vanishing into the blinding void...

“Don’t go...”

As my consciousness drifts away,
I can almost hear
someone calling out to me...
But, who...?

Ah~ I desperately wanted this hat,
yet I have already grown tired of it.

No matter—I can simply buy another one.

Whether it be dresses, banquets,
or even jewels in every shade and sparkle...
There is nothing
in this world I cannot have.

And yet, why do I feel this way?
There is something missing.
I have everything
I could ever wish for at my fingertips,
yet why am I left feeling...empty?

“...Oh?”

A stuffed doll slipped out of my purse.
It was filthy, and roughly patched together...
Where did this even come from...?

“This thing
is not to my liking at all.”

I raised my arm,
preparing to throw away the doll.

“Don’t go, Big Sis...”

“...! Why...?”

I found myself clutching
the doll close to my chest,
keeping it safe.

Whose voice was that just now...?
I have no idea. No idea at all, but...

The pain I feel in my chest
is almost...suffocating...! Why...?
There should be nothing
for me to be sad about, yet...
these tears do not stop pouring out...!

My gaze then met the doll’s.
Although its eyes were
coming apart at the seams,
I could not help but feel
they were trying to comfort “me”...

I held the doll tightly...
until all I could hear was the sound
of my own sobbing.

How’s it hanging, my Duke?
Need something from me?

You wanna hear about my past?
Oooh, what’s this?
Can I take that as you taking
more of an interest in lil’ old me?

Hehe. Well, I’m afraid
these lips are sealed!
Even for you, my Duke!
Us girls are made of sugar, spice,
and slices of vice, don’cha know?

“That’s not how the rhyme goes?”
Really? Hey, come on now!
Don’t sweat the small stuff!

Besides, secrets have value
because they’re secret.
If you spill everything,
it just ruins the fun!

Even so, you wanna know, huh?
You’re really something else, my Duke.
Just what am I gonna do about you?

...I guess I could
tell you one little fairy tale.
How’s that sound?
Okey-dokey!
One fairy tale, coming right up~

Here’s the story of a few animals
who tried to save the world...

Once upon a time,
there was a world teetering
on the brink of total destruction.

The animals who lived there
were full of distrust,
always bickering
over the smallest things.
Every day, they found all sorts of ways
to make a mountain out of a molehill!

In the middle of all that chaos,
a single tortoise spoke up.

“If everyone’s having a hard time,
I want to help them.”
That’s all it was—
just a pure, simple wish.

Maybe the heavens were moved
by that little display of courage,
’cause down came a staff,
entrusted to the tortoise.

“I’ll use this to help everyone,”
thought the tortoise.
And so, he set off on a journey,
staff in hand,
and his childhood friend,
the hare, in tow.

“I’m going to save the world.”
Upon hearing this, the hare worried
he might be biting off
more than he could chew.

He was the kind of guy
who never thought about
his own well-being,
who didn’t care if he got hurt.
That’s why...

“I’ve gotta protect him.”

Squeezing the tortoise’s hand in her own,
the hare made that solemn vow.

Together, the tortoise and the hare
traveled to many faraway lands.

In the land of the cat and mouse,
the pair was able to stop
their long-held feud
and help them reconcile.

In the forest where
the wolf and the bear clashed,
they brought in a tiger as a mediator
to fairly divide each animal’s territory.

They drove away the bat
who spread discord and,
with the help of a wise owl,
lit the way for all the animals
towards the path of truth.

But, the road to peace was never easy.

Whenever the hare
and her friends wanted to give up,
the tortoise’s bright smile urged them on.
“We can’t quit now.
Let’s see this through.”

“I’m supposed to be helping him out,
but he’s always the one supporting us...”
she thought.

So, the hare vowed to protect
the tortoise until the bitter end.

After countless trials and tribulations,
the pair finally defied
the world’s fated destruction.
And they lived happily ever after.

...Or so you’d think, right?
But come on,
there’s no such thing
as a happy ending.

The hare stood alone,
at the edge of their crumbling world.

The many conflicts across the lands
had supposedly been resolved.
But the seeds of mistrust
still lingered in the hearts of the animals.

Although they had supposedly reconciled,
the mouse lured the cat to a trap
disguised as a feast of gratitude,
ultimately costing the cat their life.

The wolf and the bear resented anyone
who dared stand above them,
so they ambushed and killed
their mediator, the tiger.

The nations that were once swayed
by the cunning bat betrayed the owl,
burying her along with her books.

And as for the tortoise...
his sturdy shell was shattered,
as he lay cold and lifeless.

All around him, the animals were fighting
over the very staff he used to help them.

“That dumb slowpoke
managed to save the world!”
“What’s stopping me
from doing the same?”
“I can do it too!”

They carelessly trampled
over the tortoise’s body,
as they fought to claim
the staff for themselves.

“Ah... Hah... AAAAAGH!!”

The hare’s mind went blank...
and before she knew it,
her white fur became
stained in deep black.

“I’m sorry...”

After laying the tortoise to rest,
the hare stood at the edge of the world...
and threw herself into the abyss.

When the hare came to,
she found herself washed up on a shore.

This wasn’t Heaven,
but rather, an unfamiliar land.
But the black hare,
who had traveled across the world
with the tortoise,
knew there shouldn’t be
any land she couldn’t recognize.

So, where exactly was she...?
After some thought, the hare realized.
She must have drifted into another world.

All she had wanted
was to follow after her friends.
So why? Why? Why...?!

“Why am I...the only one still here...?!”

Everyone and everything
she had cared about was gone,
leaving only the heavy weight of guilt
she felt for surviving.

Raindrops began to fall, one by one,
and distant thunder rumbled in the sky.
As if drawn by the sound,
the hare screamed,
her voice nearly tearing
her throat apart.

And to her luck, her cries were
drowned out by the storm,
reaching not a single soul.

“Nothing matters anymore...”

The hare set off on an aimless journey,
looking for a place to lay down and die.

While wandering,
she eventually happened
upon a land of flowers.
Suddenly, the hare felt
a familiar presence
and bounded towards it.

There, she found an animal
holding a staff that looked
just like the one the tortoise had.

And the animal was also surrounded
by companions left and right.

They laughed together,
helping others with all their might.
It was the spitting image
of the friends the hare
had once traveled with.

A wave of nostalgia washed over her...
along with the bitter, painful memories
of betrayal and loss.

If only I’d stopped him
from leaving for that journey back then.
Maybe things wouldn’t have
turned out the way they did...

“This time, I have to
put a stop to everything.
I can’t let anyone else
go through that hell again.”

With that declaration in her heart,
the hare called out to
the animal holding the staff.
And they lived happily ever after.

Well, thank you very much
for your time and attention!
My acting chops aren’t too shabby, huh?

“What happened to the hare?”
Heck if I know.

But whaddya think?
Do you get why I’m always telling you
to just throw in the towel now?
You do, but that
won’t stop you from trying?
And you want me to stay
and watch how everything plays out?!

What am I supposed to say to that?
Man, if that hare were here,
she’d definitely be over it.
You’re just such a
stubborn little Duke, aren’t you?

...But, you know what?
Out of respect for that stubbornness,
I think I’ll stick around in the hare’s place.
To watch over this world’s fate
’til the very end.

Oh, but don’t get it twisted!
I’m not gonna stop telling you to give up.
...Alright then. Looks like
we’re still in this together, my Duke.

Aw, man.
Those piercing eyes,
full of determination...
They look just like his.
Who knows, you just might
be able to save the world.

When peace finally comes to this world,
I wonder if I’ll even be
genuinely happy.

Or maybe I’ll just end up
being full of hate and envy.
Even I don’t know.

But if the day ever comes
when you lose hope
and feel like giving up...
...I’ll be there to tell you it’s okay.

I’ll tell you—you did your best.

With each stroke of Fia’s fingers
against my petals,
my consciousness would begin to stir.
Then, one day,
I realized that my consciousness
was now inside of a flower.
The reason for that lay with me.

I was the one who once turned
an entire city to dust—
the “Witch of Murder.”
Unable to bear the weight
of the sin I had wrought,
I rid myself of all guilt.
A trace of it must have
remained in this flower,
making me into what I am now.

In other words,
what I am now is
the part of my heart I’d abandoned
screaming out—
the forgotten fragment of my own soul.

Fia’s hand suddenly
stopped brushing against the flower.
Her trembling fingers halted
on a lone petal, now withered brown.

“...No way.”

Her shaking voice made my chest ache.

Fia may come across as cold,
but in truth, she’s just hard to read,
and an ordinary girl at heart.

But, there was nothing I could do.
Ever since the day
I turned my hometown to dust,
I’ve been unable to do anything
but stand by and watch...

Well, this is quite the surprise!
To think there would be
someone out there able to see me...

Actually, I think I’ve heard of this before.
Of a staff descended from Heaven
that can change bonds into power...
So, you must be able to see me
because you have that staff!

The current me is nothing but
a vestige of my old self’s emotions
left in this flower.
Little remains of my power
as the “Witch of Murder” either, so...
I’m like a ghost of sorts.

I’m also sure all the guilt weighing on me
is what’s making the flower wither, too.
That’s why, I’d like to ask you...

Would you do me a favor and kill me?

The Duke with the staff
asked me to watch over Fia...
saying that if I did,
my wish would be granted too.

It’s not like I’d be able to do anything
if something happened to her...
But, since he asked,
I guess it’s my ghostly duty to oblige.

In order to return the flower
back to normal,
Fia went to a witch
who was said to be able
to breathe life into anything.

The witch she visited, Yubera,
only had a few days left at most...
as her power was out of control,
slowly destroying her body.

Despite that, the girl kept using her power,
whittling away what remained of her life.
Turning her life essence into light,
all to keep painting a city long destroyed.

Even if her actions
made no sense to anyone else,
we understood...
Her behavior was far from irrational.
If she couldn’t finish that painting,
she wouldn’t be able to live with herself.

Just like the two of us, that girl...
was suffocating under her own guilt...

Me, Yubera, Fia...
All of us bore the same pain.

Unable to forgive ourselves,
sacrificing our own lives
is the only way we can seek to atone
for what we’ve done...

That must be why
we feel so drawn to one another.

Fia went to visit Yubera
almost every day,
gazing on at the girl
as she continued to paint.

I had no idea how
heartwrenching a past
lay depicted in that painting.
But the landscape she painted,
imbued with her very own life essence,
was hauntingly beautiful.

The crumbling city
looks like something out of a dream,
but also seems familiar somehow...
Even that collapsing house looks just like—
Wait...

I’ve...I’ve seen this place before...
It’s the exact landscape I’ve witnessed
countless times in my dreams...

This...is my hometown...
Yubera is a survivor...
of the very city I destroyed...

Stop, I beg you, please...!
The city continues to crumble.
One by one, my family, my friends...
Everyone turns to dust...

No... Stop...! Wait...!
Everyone, everyone is...!
Ah... Ahh... Aaaaaaaah—!

Haah... So, even ghosts
can have dreams, huh...?

That was the day I became
the “Witch of Murder.”
I saw everyone before me turn to dust.
And all I could do
was stand by and watch...

I’ve never been able
to shake away that guilt.
It never goes away,
no matter what I do...
And now, once again...

Yubera had collapsed.
The girl’s life was about to end,
with her painting left unfinished,
and the sin I caused her to commit
still haunting her...

And yet, right now,
I can’t do anything to stop it.

It’s happening again...
Even now, all I can do is watch...!
Yet another girl whose life I destroyed
is about to die before my eyes...!
Why...?!

Please, someone, help...!
That girl...and me...!
I beg you...!

Just then...
Fia approached the collapsed Yubera...
while holding my flower in her hand...

Fia’s emotions flowed into the flower,
and then into me.
Her wish for us to save Yubera together
was painfully clear.

...Yes, that’s right...
Even if I can’t save her by myself,
the two of us together can surely—

This flower was originally meant
to suppress Fia’s power.
But, if we wish it to,
the flower should be able to suppress
Yubera’s power, too.

In exchange, I’ll disappear.
But, that’s fine.
That’s how it should be...

This time, I’m no longer stuck
just watching—
I have the power to save someone.
As the “Witch of Murder,”
it’s an end far happier
than I deserve.

Our power then poured into Yubera,
as if our very lives were overflowing
from the flower.
Its petals lost all color,
and my consciousness began to fade.

Ahh... With this,
I can finally lay everything to rest...
Thank you, Fia.
I wish that you may also be blessed
with a happy death—

Countless specks of light filled my vision,
my consciousness melting
to become one with them.
My guilt and regret began to fade away.
I was in bliss,
ascending to Heaven, when...

I suddenly heard a voice ring out...

“If you’re gonna die anyway,
why not give your life over to me?”

Heh... Good grief...
Nothing ever goes
the way I want, huh...?
But, that’s alright.
Dying for your sake...
doesn’t sound so bad, either—

And juuust when I thought
I’d had such a beautiful death...

My consciousness,
which should have
vanished into the ether,
was still here.
In fact, it was even clearer than ever.

Before, the core of my consciousness
was my lingering guilt that had been left
in this flower, right...?
Then, my new core must be...

I see...
“A witch’s power comes from the heart”
certainly does sum it up,
doesn’t it?

I guess the Duke
asked me to watch over Fia
knowing this would happen, huh?
He may not look very reliable,
but I should’ve expected as much
from the Successor of the Staff
that makes bonds into power.

Well, since I’m still here,
I guess I’ll try living
just a biiit longer.

I don’t know how long
I’ll be able to remain here in this form...
But, this is the life
that girl gave me, after all.

This time,
I won’t just stand by and watch—

The Duchy of Fran—the peaceful country surrounded by flowers and windmills.

Located on the southernmost point of the continent, it is also known as a poor, remote nation. Its poverty is owed to its lack of industries, but the dukes throughout history have prioritized the happiness of the citizens over national growth. This has made the poorest country in the land into what many say is the happiest.

However, it could do nothing to stop the Witch Hunt. People’s fears created ensuing violence, which turned a normal, innocent girl into “The Witch of Mourning Flowers.”

The Principality of Brook—the country famous for its vast, beautiful forest, and the ancient castle dwelling within.

Since antiquity, it has been seen as the most suitable place for witches to live because of the rich magic power flourishing throughout the land. In recent times, witches who have escaped the Witch Hunt have come to live here in hiding, with some of them said to have lived for hundreds of years.

This country was once said to have the most beautiful greenery on the continent. But now, it is shut away from the world by the “Curse of Ice.” Freezing the land are the hopeless tears of “The Witch of Snowy Illusions,” whose powers were unleashed after being tortured by the Inquisition.

The Republic of Nedel—the country of water transportation, surrounded by canals big and small.

It is a country that developed through trade, having connections to western nations beyond the sea. Instead of a monarchy, this country is governed by a parliament of merchants. The upper elite swims in luxury, with their conspicuous buildings exuding extravagance.

However, the gap between the rich and poor is severe. The weak are tyrannized by the merchants, and their greed gave rise to “The Witch of Conflagration.” Her “Curse of Flames” burns with rage, reducing the merchants’ dazzling kingdom to ashes.

The Kingdom of Byrune—the scientific nation built within a deep forest.

It is a country researching ways to accelerate the growth of vegetation and improve crops.
However, this is all a facade. Unbeknownst to the world, they have been conducting forbidden research on life, leading to the creation of many synthesized creatures and artificial lifeforms.

Then, they reach a milestone when a man-made witch is finally born. She was created as the ultimate weapon that can destroy an entire nation by herself, but loses control and succumbs to madness. “The Witch of Rust” unleashed her “Curse of Rust,” causing this country to fall into ruin.

The Holy See of Hainz—the country ruled by the Pope of the Church of Longinus.

Long lines of pilgrims fill the roads leading to the sacred capital city—the center of the Pope’s power—where the blue banners of the Church are hung as far as the eye can see. It is not only believers who visit, but also droves of tourists who wish to see the Church’s beautiful architecture. However, very few know what lies beyond the capital.

When a single nun was taken into a conversion facility meant for the “reeducation” of heretics, “The Witch of Sacred Swords” unleashed her “Curse of Swords,” condemning this country to its doom.

The Kingdom of Vyde—the country confined in snow for more than half a year.

Since ancient times, the royal family has been at war with pirates from the open seas, fighting without any end in sight.

One young queen unifies the country, briefly bringing about peace before countless hordes of cursed creatures overrun the kingdom. Immediately afterwards, massive objects rained unceasingly down from the sky, causing the snowy land to vanish along with the creatures.

All that remains in this scarred land is endless snow, and “The Witch of Fallen Crystals” who awaits the queen’s return.

The Lupus Confederacy—the country where half of the land is covered in mountains, with beautiful plateaus stretching out beneath them.

The people of Lupus love nature in all its majesty, with many tribes living in harmony with it near the mountaintops. Because the people regard their great mountains as sacred, Lupus is the only country with little to no influence from the Church of Longinus.

This country and all its abundant nature have been consumed by the “Curse of Lightning” brought forth by “The Witch of Wailing Lightning.” Some fear it to be the wrath of the mountain god, while others weep as if it were the saddening cries of a young child.

The Kingdom of Chekkos—that was what this academic and artistic country was once called.

100 years ago, heavy rain began to fall without end, gradually submerging the country underwater. Many cities vanished, becoming one with the ocean floor. Then, at the very moment the Curses appeared throughout the world, the rain became more turbulent, creating violent floods that engulfed every city that remained.

Rusalka—“The Witch of Torrential Sorrow”—sleeps inside a temple at the bottom of the waves, where even her name has been forgotten with time. Her 100 years of despair have drowned this country in endless sadness.

The Kingdom of Galia—the country of military might and railroads.

Possessing the most magic crystal ore in the content, railroads were developed to transport them. This accordingly led to the development of their military technology. Civil wars for control over the country lasted for many years, but Galia was finally unified after its last war came to an end.

However, in the shadows of this country’s glorious history, there were soldiers who were buried in darkness. To rescue their souls, “The Witch of Lost Souls” raises her flag in rebellion. Her “Curse of Specters” has made apparitions appear throughout the country, and they all bear striking resemblances to soldiers who have perished in this land’s wars.

The Adrian Empire—the country located on the northernmost point of the continent.

Its 2000 years of culture remain pristine, leaving behind beautiful temples that people now call home.

This country, which once bustled with many tourists, pilgrims, and historical researchers, was purified by a beautiful tree of light brought forth by Elfriede—“The Witch of Longinus.” The light cleanses every kind of impurity, and not even humans can survive once bathed in it.

On the northern part of the continent lies a massive crater—a remnant of the time when the world was on the verge of destruction. What lies beyond this crater that pierces into the very depths of the world? There is not a soul who knows...

Emeria—the world that once prospered because of its freedom and economy.
However, its countries were constantly at war in their attempts to monopolize the world’s wealth, eventually causing the devastated land to summon an army of demons.

In the blink of an eye, 10 countries were reduced to merely two, leaving less than 10% of humanity alive. It was at this point that the surviving humans finally united together to form the “Armed Forces of Humanity.” As they fight against the demons, the Armed Forces score victory after victory, steadily taking back the land they had lost. However, black flames appeared without warning, consuming all in their path—be it human or demon—thus bringing about the end of the world.

At the heart of the flames was the supreme commander of the Armed Forces of Humanity. She was the one who destroyed the world more righteously than anyone ever could—“The Witch of Justice.”

Zivard—the world that is rich with more supernatural
energy than anywhere else.
In this world, everyone can wield power, spirits roam
freely in the darkness,
and even the powers of gods are within one’s reach.
Thus, the ones who rule
the land are treated
no differently than gods.

Zivard is home to a princess. Endowed with beauty and grace, her people revere her as the moon itself, which light is without equal.
Then came the moment
when a demon’s whispers fell on her ears.
The princess turns on the ones who loved and worshipped her, unleashing a “Curse of Fog”
that plunges the world into endless night.

“I long to see thee,
one more time.”
With one heartfelt wish,
“The Witch of Dreams” destroyed the world more gently than anyone ever could.

Derulla—the world that
flourished with flowers.
These flowers enriched people’s hearts and made their art blossom. There was not a soul that did not enjoy themselves during the prime of this developed civilization.

Thus, the people had forgotten.
That this world was once on
the verge of being destroyed.
That two heroes sealed its impending doom away, narrowly escaping the world’s collapse.

From the depths of the earth, humanity discovers “seeds,” and the immense “power” sealed within them.
When humans, in all their arrogance, reach their hands for this forbidden power,
“The Witch of Budding Doom” reemerges, covering the world with flowers that never bloom.

Lubeurg—the world where hatred overflows between
those who are witches and those who are not.
The long-oppressed witches led a rebellion that divided the world into two—one reigned by witches, and one by their former oppressors.

However, a saint who believes that witches and their once oppressors can coexist in harmony fights back against the divided world. Her words create a bridge between the two opposing factions, and the world enters an era of peace. But, when hatred fails to disappear from every heart, the saint loses the person most precious to her, plunging her soul into darkness.

To fill the void left by losing the one she loves, “The Witch of Malefic Bubbles” engulfs the world in her bubbles of despair. Resounding from each rupturing bubble are the cries of the saint’s long-suppressed hatred for the world, which she had kept locked away deep in her heart all these years...

Tottoh—the world where people live in harmony with nature.

The arid grasslands of Tottoh are home to tribes who worship animals as highly as their ancestors. The most ancient of these tribes guards a mythic oasis hidden deep in the desert, rumored to be nothing more than a mirage. The tribes have always lived in peaceful coexistence with nature, their respect for all life compelling them to survive without ever changing their customs and traditions.

But, the tribes’ way of life slowly begins to fall apart at the hands of those desiring to use the land to fuel their own prosperity. They seek to destroy nature to create a better life for their descendants, while the tribes continue to honor their ancestors’ teachings, protecting the natural world around them. The two groups seem destined to remain forever at odds, until a chance encounter between two souls twists the fates of everyone who calls the land their home.

As if the world itself decried their bond, when her precious friend learns the secret guarded by her tribe, “The Witch of Storming Sands” is forced to follow her ancestors’ most sacred law. When she buries the friend she holds most dear, the witch’s heart grows as dry and barren as the arid desert, her howls of despair burying the world under a tempest of raging sand.

Harbes—the world where
“The Witch of Miracles” Theresa ruled.
What the young queen cast upon the land was none other than the power to grant any wish—the Curse of Miracles.

Under the power of her radiant Curse, any wish the people’s hearts desired was granted, with not a soul needing more.
The land was the world’s glimpse of utopia. The people called it “Paradise”—the place closest to what God Himself would wish for.
With every wish fulfilled, and all imaginable suffering brought to an end, the overwhelming beauty and peace slowly began to gnaw away at the people’s sense of purpose.
Thus, the witch’s wish for peace was plunging her world into ruin more beautifully than any other.

Until the day “The Witch of Miracles” died.

Each radiant miracle suddenly became shrouded in a corrupting haze, with the late witch’s body nowhere to be found.
Then, at the center of the unleashed horde of roaming wraiths, “The Witch of Lamented Spirits” appears, continuing to make a wish no Curse, nor even God Himself, could ever grant...

■Increased Stat​
This buff increases a specified stat.​
The pre-increased/decreased stat is referenced
to calculate the amount the buff increases it by.

■Increased Damage Dealing​
This buff increases the damage a character deals when they attack.​

■Decreased Damage Taken​
This buff decreases the damage a character takes when they are attacked.​

■Increased Incoming Healing Potency
This buff increases the amount of HP restored to a character
when they take an HP-restoring effect.
This affects skills that restore HP, Regeneration, and HP Drain.

■Invulnerable​
This buff nullifies damage a character takes.​

■Multi-Barrier​
This buff provides a multi-layered barrier.
When a character takes damage,​
1 barrier layer is depleted to nullify that damage.​
If Multi-Barrier is overlapped with Invulnerable,
the barrier layer will not be depleted.​
If Multi-Barrier is overlapped with Shield,
Multi-Barrier will be used first.
If multiple kinds of Multi-Barrier are overlapping with each other,
they will be used based on the following order of priority.

Multi-Barriers with fewer effect turns left
▼
Multi-Barriers with larger amounts of damage
required for activation
▼
Multi-Barriers with fewer layers left

Skills that reference damage nullifed by Multi-Barrier,
such as those that say "deals a direct attack to the target
equal to 10% of the damage nullified by [Multi-Barrier]
for all enemies this turn" in their descriptions,
will be calculated after all increases/decreases
to DMG Dealt and DMG Taken, all damage cuts,
and all nullified damage.
Shield, surviving with 1 HP, and Immortality
are calculated after Multi-Barrier calculations,
and are thus not included in calculations for nullified damage.

■Shield​
This buff provides a shield that nullifies a designated amount of damage.​
When a character takes damage that exceeds the amount that can be nullified,​
the shield will be depleted, and the remaining damage will be dealt
to the character's HP.​
If Shield is overlapped with Invulnerable, Shield will not be depleted.​
If Shield is overlapped with Multi-Barrier, Multi-Barrier will be used first.​

■Force Field
This buff reduces a designated amount of damage
from attacks, Resonance, Devotion, and counterattack damage.
Damage from Poison and other debuffs that deal continuous damage
cannot be reduced.
The effects of Increased/Decreased Damage Taken
and Increased/Decreased Damage Dealing
are calculated before damage is reduced via Force Field.
The effects of Shield, Resonance, and Devotion are calculated
after damage is reduced via Force Field.​
When the effect of multiple Force Fields activates,
or when the effects of Force Field
and cutting activate at the same time,
the only effect that will be applied will be the one that results
in the least amount of damage
being ultimately dealt to the character.

■Debuff Immunity​
This buff prevents debuffs from being inflicted on a character.​
This does not nullify any debuffs a character is already afflicted with.​

■Unhindered​
This buff prevents action hindering debuffs from being inflicted on a character.​
There are 4 action hindering debuffs—Fainted, Sleep, Confusion, and Silence.​
This does not nullify any action hindering debuffs a character
is already afflicted with.​

■Silence Immunity​
This buff prevents Silence from being inflicted on a character.​
This does not nullify any Silence debuffs
a character is already afflicted with.​

■Taunt​
This buff guarantees a character is the target of enemy attacks and skills
dealt to 1 or more random targets.​
This does not make that character the target if the enemy attack or skill
is not dealt to random targets.​

■Stealth​
This buff prevents a character from being a target
of enemy attacks and skills dealt to 1 target.​
However, that character can be the target of attacks and skills
that are dealt to the target directly in front of the attacker.​
If all allies who are alive are enhanced with either Stealth or Invisibility,
the effect of Stealth will be nullified.

■Invisibility​
This buff prevents a character from being a target of attacks and skills
of enemies and allies.​
If all allies who are alive are enhanced with Invisibility,
the effect of Invisibility will be nullified.

■Counter-Fainted
This buff gives a character a chance to inflict Fainted
on their attacker when attacked.

■Regeneration​
This buff restores a specified amount of HP to a character each turn​
at the start of that character's action phase.

■Immortality​
This buff guarantees a character survives with 1 HP remaining​
if they take damage that would reduce their HP to 0.​
This includes damage taken from attacks, Resonance, and Devotion.
This also includes damage from Poison and other debuffs
that deal continuous damage, as well as counterattack damage.

■Counter Shift​
When attacked by an enemy, this buff allows a character to deal​
a designated amount of counterattack damage
to a specific enemy instead of dealing a regular counterattack.​
The amount of damage is not affected by the Counter stat
(even if [Increased Counter] or
[Decreased Counter] are applied to it).
Additionally, the amount of damage taken by a character
has no effect on this buff's counterattack damage.
Counter Shift is guaranteed to hit, but is not factored in
when counting the number of attacks that are dealt to an enemy.
Counter Shift does not activate when a character
takes damage from Poison
and other debuffs that deal continuous damage,
Resonance, Devotion, or Passive Skills.
Counter Shift activates only when an attack hits.
It does not activate when an attack is evaded.

■Devotion
This buff allows an enhanced target to substitutively take
a designated amount of damage
from the damage an attack would deal to another ally.
If the amount of damage taken by an ally exceeds their remaining HP,​
the amount of damage exceeding that ally's remaining HP will also be included​
in the damage dealt to the enhanced target.
If damage would be taken via Devotion and Resonance at the same time,
the damage will be totaled together and count as 1 instance of taking damage.

■Buff Cover
When 1 of the enhanced target's buffs
would be dispelled or stolen by an enemy's skill,​
this buff will be dispelled or stolen with the highest priority out of all buffs
the target is enhanced with.​
If the target is enhanced with multiple Buff Covers,
1 will be dispelled or stolen at random.​
For skills that lower a buff's turn count or stack count,​
Buff Cover will not be prioritized for dispelling.

■Character-Specific Buffs
These are buffs granted by the skills of specific characters.
The effects of the buffs vary depending on the character-specific buff.

■Decreased Stat​
This debuff decreases a specified stat.​
The pre-increased/decreased stat is referenced
to calculate the amount the debuff decreases it by.​

■Enfeeble
This debuff decreases a character's ATK.
Unlike normal Decreased Stat debuffs,
the amount a target's stat is decreased by via Enfeeble
is calculated based on their in-battle stat.

■Decreased Damage Dealing​
This debuff decreases the damage a character deals when they attack.​

■Increased Damage Taken​
This debuff increases the damage a character takes when they are attacked.​

■Decreased Incoming Healing Potency​
This buff decreases the amount of HP restored to a character​
when they take an HP-restoring effect.​
This affects skills that restore HP, Regeneration, and HP Drain.​

■Delay
This debuff stalls the decrease of a character's​
Active Skills' skill cooldown time​
at the end of each turn's action phase,​
effectively delaying the next time that character's Active Skills activate.​
The final amount that a skill cooldown time decreases by​
will never be less than 0.​
If Delay is overlapped with Hasten,
the final amount​ that the skill cooldown time decreases by will be decided
by how much​ the effects of Delay offset the effects of Hasten.

■Action Hindering Debuffs
The debuffs that fall under this category are
Silence, Fanted, Sleep, and Confusion.

・Silence
This debuff makes a character unable to activate Active Skills.
The afflicted character can only deal basic attacks.

・Fainted
This debuff makes a character unable to deal basic attacks
or activate Active Skills, ending that character's action phase.

・Sleep
This debuff makes a character unable to deal basic attacks
or activate Active Skills, ending that character's action phase.
This is dispelled after the specified number of turns,
or by other specific conditions.

・Confusion
This debuff makes a character select either allies other than themselves
or enemies at random as attack targets.
Even skills that specify its targets to be the enemy with the highest ATK, etc.,
will be dealt to enemies or allies at random.
Skills that make allies targets, as well as skills that affect allies and enemies
at the same time, are not affected by Confusion.
When characters are afflicted with Confusion,
they will not be affected by Taunt or Stealth.

■Debuffs that Deal Continuous Damage
The debuffs that fall under this category are Poison, Burn, Bleed, and Erosion.

・Poison
Each turn, at the start of the action phase,
this debuff makes the afflicted character take continuous damage
based on a percentage of their current HP.
The damage will not exceed the afflicted character's ATK stat value.

・Burn
Each turn, at the start of the action phase,
this debuff makes the afflicted character take continuous damage
based on a percentage of their current HP.
The damage will not exceed the afflicted character's ATK stat value.

・Bleed
Each turn, at the start of the action phase,
this debuff makes the afflicted character take continuous damage
based on a percentage of the inflictor's ATK.

・Erosion
Each turn, at the start of the action phase,
this debuff makes the afflicted character take continuous damage
based on a percentage of the total damage dealt by the skill
that inflicted Erosion.
The total damage dealt will be calculated based on its value
before it is reduced by cutting, Multi-Barrier, and Shield.

■Aggravation
This debuff increases the continuous damage a character takes.
If the continuous damage from Poison/Burn is increased via Aggravation,
that continuous damage will not exceed the ATK stat value
of the character who is afflicted with Poison/Burn.

■Blight​
This debuff prevents a character from having their HP restored.​
This affects skills that restore HP, Regeneration, and HP Drain.​

■Buff Immunity​
This debuff prevents buffs from being granted to a character.​
This does not nullify any buffs a character is already enhanced with.​
While a character is afflicted with Buff Immunity,
if a buff updates the value of a stat, etc.,​
when specific conditions are met, those increases will not be applied.​
Buff Immunity does not affect buffs that cannot be dispelled.​

■Bind​
This debuff makes a character unable to evade enemy attacks.​

■Resonance​
This debuff is inflicted on two characters,​​
and when one afflicted target takes damage from an attack,​
a designated amount of that damage is dealt to the other afflicted target.​
If the amount of damage taken by one target exceeds their remaining HP,​
the amount of damage exceeding that target's remaining HP will also be​
included in the damage dealt to the other afflicted target.
​If damage would be taken via Devotion and Resonance at the same time,
the damage will be totaled together and count as 1 instance of taking damage.

■Character-Specific Debuffs
These are buffs afflicted by the skills of specific characters.
The effects of the debuffs vary depending on the character-specific debuff.

■Hasten​
This buff speeds up the decrease of a character's​
Active Skills' skill cooldown time​
at the end of each turn's action phase,​
effectively hastening the next time that character's Active Skills activate.​
If Hasten is overlapped with Delay,
the final amount that the skill cooldown time decreases by will be decided
by how much​ the effects of Delay offset the effects of Hasten.

■Right of Covenant​
Buying the Right of Covenant will unlock a variety of benefits during the subscription term.​
These benefits will be valid on every World used by the same account.​
Purchasing the Right of Covenant will neither provide VIP EXP,
nor complete in-game charge-related events, so please be careful.​

■Subscription Period​
The Right of Covenant comes in 2 types—[1 Week] and [1 Month].​
They last for 7 and 30 days respectively, including the day of purchase.
You cannot buy both at the same time.

The date will change every day at 4:00 (Server Time).​
When there are less than 24 hours left on your subscription term,
the Right of Covenant will be automatically bought and extended for the same period.​

For only the first purchase, benefits will be unlocked free of charge for 3 days in either period.​
If you decide to end the Right of Covenant after the free period,​
you must cancel at least 24 hours before the free period expires.​

Even after canceling, you can still receive the Right of Covenant's benefits​
until your subscription period expires.​

■How to Cancel​
The Right of Covenant can be canceled from the subscription menu on your store's account settings.​
Uninstalling the app does not automatically cancel your subscription.​

■Android​
Open [Google Play], tap your account icon,​
then tap [Payments & subscriptions] before tapping [Subscriptions].​
Tap [MementoMori], then on the [Manage Subscription] screen, tap [Cancel subscription].​

■iOS​
Open [App Store], tap your account icon, then tap [Subscriptions].​
Tap [MementoMori], then tap [Cancel Subscription].​

*If the information above does not display because of your OS version, ​
please inquire with your platform's store.​

・Your Right of Covenant subscription will be tied to the Platform Account you used upon purchase.​
・Only one MementoMori Account can buy the Right of Covenant with the same Platform Account.​
・If you wish to change the Platform Account tied to your Right of Covenant subscription,​
please cancel your current plan before purchasing a new Right of Covenant subscription with
the new Platform Account you wish to tie your subscription to.
・The subscription will not be canceled automatically.
*Platforms include the App Store, Google Play, Steam, and more.
*Even in the event that you wish to change the Platform Account tied to your
Right of Covenant subscription to a different Account on the same Platform,
​you need to cancel your current plan and repurchase your subscription from
​the other Platform Account.​
・Usage fees will be billed towards your Platform Account.​
・If you have any questions related to fees or the numbers of days of use,
please inquire with your respective platform.​
・Even if you have purchased the Right of Covenant on multiple Platform Accounts using the same​
MementoMori account,​ we do not allow cancellations or refunds for duplicate purchases.​
・Additionally, we do not allow cancellations, refunds, or extensions of the subscription period​
unless it is stipulated by the law.​
