■Grand Battle
Grand Battles are special Guild Battles in which 48 guilds chosen from multiple Worlds wage war.

During 1 season, the 48 chosen guilds will be allocated to different maps.
In each map, 4 of the 48 guilds will fight for control over bases.

■Commencement Periods/Seasons
1 season takes place from Tuesday~Sunday.

Ranking Calculation: Tuesday 4:00 (Server Time)
Opponent Matching Finalized: Tuesday 7:30 (Server Time)

Strategy Phase: 7:45~20:30 (Server Time)

War Phase: 20:45~21:30 (Server Time)

For any Worlds where Grand Battles will be commenced,

the status of the map, base ownership, etc., were before the hiatus started.

Guild members who either join or temporarily leave a guild mid-season cannot participate.

Memo: アナウンス機能の存在を記載
Text:
■Chat​
You can chat with other players here.​​
Players can communicate by sending messages and stickers to each other.​​
*If we confirm that your speech or conduct is in violation of the Terms of Service Agreement,​​
we may take measures to limit or suspend the Chat feature on your account.​​
​
■Group​
This tab is for chatting with all players from Worlds​
in your Grand Battle or Legend League group at once.​
*After a certain amount of time has passed since the creation of a World,​
the Group tab will be unlocked.​
​
■Grand Battle​
This tab is for chatting with all players in your Grand Battle Block at once.​
*If your guild is participating in the Grand Battle,​
the Grand Battle tab will be unlocked
from Tuesday to the following Monday during the Grand Battle commencement period.
​
■World​​
This tab is for chatting with all players in your World at once.​​
​
■Guild​​
​This tab is for chatting with all the members of your guild at once.​​
You can use the reaction, announcement, and poll features here.​

■Private​​
This tab is for chatting one-on-one with other players, like friends.​​
​
■Start a Conversation​​
To access this screen, tap the "Select from List" button in the Private tab.​​
From here, you can select another player to chat one-on-one with.​​
The players you can select are sorted into 3 tabs—Friends, Guild, and World.​​
In this screen's Guild tab, your guild members will be displayed.​
However, if you are unaffiliated with a guild, this tab will not be displayed.​​
In this screen's World tab, only players who have logged in and sent a message​​
in the main World chat tab will be displayed.

■Sticker Shop​
The Sticker Shop is a shop that is displayed within your Sticker List.​​
You can use Diamonds to buy previously released Stickers that you do not yet own.​​
Stickers will be added to the Shop after a certain amount of time​​
has passed since their initial release.​​
If you already own all available Stickers,​​
the Sticker Shop will not be displayed to you.

​■Chat Settings​
Here, you can change the font size, backgrounds, and text bubbles
used in Chats to suit your preferences.

In the "Text Bubble" tab, you can use Diamonds to buy​
previously released Text Bubbles that you do not yet own.​
Text Bubbles will be added after a certain amount of time​
has passed since their initial release.

■Inviting a Friend
When you invite a friend, you and your friend can both obtain rewards.​
The duration and contents of the Invite a Friend Campaign may be
changed without prior notice.

■The One Being Invited
After receiving an Invite Code from a friend,
enter it on the Enter Invite Code screen to obtain rewards.
Only players who are within their first 10 days after starting the game can enter an Invite Code.
If the campaign has started within 10 days after a player has started the game,
that player will have a duration of 10 days from the start of the campaign to enter a code.
The button to enter an Invite Code will not appear for players
who do not meet the requirements.
You are limited to entering only 1 Invite Code.

■The One Inviting
During the campaign, 1 Invite Code will be generated for you.
When a friend you shared your code with enters that code in-game, you will obtain rewards.
The more friends you invite, the more rewards you will obtain.
*The amount of rewards you can obtain from inviting friends is limited,​
and you will not be able to obtain any more rewards after inviting 20 friends.

■Invite Code
You cannot use the Invite Code of someone who is from a different server than you.
*You can check your server on the bottom-left of the title screen.
As long as you are on the same server as someone,
you can use the Invite Code of someone who is on a different World than you.
You cannot use your own Invite Code to invite yourself.
You cannot use Invite Codes that were generated during past Invite a Friend Campaigns.

■DMG Dealt​
This displays the total amount of damage each character dealt in battle.​
Only damage dealt by attacks is totaled.​
Damage dealt by other means, such as Counter, Poison and other debuffs​
that deal continuous damage, and Resonance, are not totaled.​
Any amounts of damage dealt that exceed each target's remaining HP
are also included in the totalization.
The amounts displayed reflect the damage dealt before the following​
damage reductions are factored in:​
Cut, Shield, Multi-Barrier, Invulnerable, and Immortality.​

■HP Restored​
This displays the total amount of HP each character has restored
to themselves and their allies in battle.
The amounts displayed also reflect the HP restored by
reviving characters and HP Drain.

■DMG Taken​
This displays the total amount of damage each character took in battle.​
Damage taken from attacks, Counter, Poison and other debuffs that deal continuous damage,​
and Resonance are all totaled.​
Any amounts of damage taken that exceed each character's remaining HP
are not included in the totalization.
The amounts displayed reflect the damage taken after the following​
damage reductions are factored in:​
Cut, Shield, Multi-Barrier, Invulnerable, and Immortality.​

Memo: パネルミッションヘルプ

Text:
■Panel Missions
Here, you can unlock a total of 9 squares on a 3×3 panel.
Unlocking all the squares will allow you to complete 1 special illustration.
Each square is assigned a different number, and a square can be unlocked
by clearing a mission that allows you to obtain a Memory Shard with the matching number.

When you complete unlocking all squares in either a horizontal or vertical line in the panel,
you can obtain rewards from a special chest according to the line you completed.

When you unlock all 9 squares, you can obtain an event panel
as a reward for completing the illustration.
If there is another panel available, you will be able to challenge its Panel Missions next.

You will also be able to view all the event panels you have obtained
at any time from the Panel Index.

To unlock the Panel Missions, you must first reach Day 7 of the Start Dash Missions.
Additionally, if you are not able to reach Day 7 of the Start Dash Missions,
the Panel Missions will be unlocked at a designated date.​

If you unlock the Panel Missions right before the end of their duration,
you can continue participating in the Panel Missions for a certain period of time
regardless of the duration coming to an end.

Please note that Panel Missions will become unavailable when their duration has ended.
At that point, if you have any rewards left unclaimed, you will no longer be able to claim them.

Memo: 音楽プレイヤーヘルプ

Text:
■Music Player
With the Music Player, you can listen to the music featured in the game.

The Music Player supports background playback on your device.
As long as the game is running, you can listen to music even when using another app.

If you are using an iOS or Android device,
the music will play via your device's music player.
Music being played will not affected by the game's volume settings,
and will instead be based on your device's volume settings.
Depending on your device's volume settings, music may suddenly start playing.
Please check your device's volume settings before using the Music Player.

Leaving the Music Player screen will stop the music you are listening to.

*Music may need to be downloaded to be played.
*Some music is not available due to copyright restrictions.

■Unlocking Music
By using Music Tickets, you can unlock music for the Music Player.
Music Tickets can be obtained when you newly obtain a character
who was not previously in your roster, or from the Shop.

■Playlists
Playlists can be created by selecting the music you like out of the ones you have unlocked.

■Shuffle
Shuffle can be enabled by tapping the Shuffle button.
This will allow the music on your current playlist to be played in a random order.

■Repeat
Repeat can be enabled by tapping the Repeat button.
You can select between "Repeat 1" or "Repeat All."

"Repeat 1" will repeatedly play the piece of music you are currently listening to.
"Repeat All" will repeatedly play the playlist you are currently listening to.

■Deletion of Downloaded Data
You can free up space on your device by deleting the music data you have downloaded.
Deleted music can be downloaded again at any time.​

Memo: ギルドツリーHelp見出し

Text:
■Guild Tree
In the Guild Tree, you can cooperate with other guild members
to challenge enemies on each of the Guild Tree's Floors.
When your guild fulfills the conditions to clear a Floor, the next Floor will be unlocked.
You can challenge the Guild Tree up to 3 times in 1 day,
and your challenge attempts will reset every day at 4:00 (Server Time).

After joining a guild, you cannot challenge the Guild Tree until 4:00 the next day (Server Time).
However, if you join a guild on the same day it was formed,
you can challenge the Guild Tree immediately after joining.
In this situation, the number of challenge attempts you had left
before joining the guild will be carried over.
Additionally, the number of challenge attempts per day for a single guild
is limited to 50 members' worth of challenge attempts,
and any number of challenges exceeding this limit cannot be made.

■The Conditions to Clear Each Floor
Each Floor has a gauge with the words "★s Needed to Clear,"
and by maxing that gauge out, your guild can advance to the next Floor.
The gauge can be filled by winning battles in the Guild Tree and obtaining ★s.
The higher difficulty setting you select, the more ★s you will be able to obtain.
All guild members share the same gauge, so when any amount of it is filled,
that amount will be applied to every member's progress.
If you challenge the Guild Tree and obtain ★s that exceed the gauge's required number,
the excess ★s will be discarded.

■Challenge Difficulty
On every Floor, each guild member can select the difficulty for their own challenge attempts.
The higher the difficulty, the more ★s you can obtain to fill the gauge.
As your guild climbs to higher Floors, higher difficulty settings will become selectable.

・Floors 1~9: 1~5★s
・Floors 10~29: 1~7★s
・Floors 30 and higher: 1~10★s

■Bloom Seeds
Bloom Seeds are obtained when winning battles on each Floor.
There are 3 kinds of Bloom Seeds, and they correspond to the 3 character Types.
・Warrior, Sniper, and Sorcerer
The more characters of the same Type you have in your party,
the more Bloom Seeds of that Type you can obtain when winning a battle.
By going to the "Uprade Bloom Bonus" screen,
you can use the Bloom Seeds that you have collected to raise the stats of each Type.
A Bloom Seed can only be used during the Guild Tree event it was obtained in,
and cannot be used in any later Guild Tree events.
Leaving or being dismissed from a guild will reset the number of Bloom Seeds you have to 0.

■Combo
A combo will start when a guild member wins a battle in the Guild Tree,
and the combo count will grow by 1 for each time any guild member wins a battle.
As the combo grows, the number of Bloom Seeds guild members can obtain
will be boosted based on the current combo.
Even if a guild member loses a battle, the combo will not be broken.

Each combo has a duration, and when a duration reaches 0,
that combo ends, resetting the combo count to 0.
When a guild member wins a battle, the duration of the combo they start will be 10 minutes,
and the duration will be extended by 10 minutes for each time any guild member wins a battle.
A duration can be extended to up to 8 hours, and cannot be extended any further than that.
Your guild's combo will reset every day at 4:00 (Server Time).

■Decreased Stats
A character's stats, such as ATK and HP, will be decreased
based on the number of times that character has won battles.
These decreased stats are only applied to Guild Tree battles,
and are considered part of a character's pre-increased/decreased stats.
The decreased stats are not applied to any other content.
All decreased stats will reset every day at 4:00 (Server Time).

■Floor Rewards
These are rewards obtained based on the Floors that your guild has cleared,
and every guild member can claim them.
If you join a guild after the Guild Tree event has ended, you cannot claim these rewards.

■Missions
These are specific missions that, when cleared, allow you to claim rewards.
If you join a guild after the Guild Tree event has ended, you cannot claim these rewards.

■Rankings
By checking the Guild Rankings, you can see the rankings of Guilds in your World
based on the last Floor they have cleared.
If there are multiple guilds that have the same last cleared Floor,
their rankings will be decided by the timing they cleared that Floor,
with the earlier guilds ranking higher.

By checking the Member Rankings, you can see the rankings of your guild members,
sorted into two different categories.
・★Contribution: Rankings based on the number of ★s each guild member obtained
during the current Guild Tree event.
・Bloom Contribution: Rankings based on the number of Bloom Seeds
used by each guild member towards the growth of each Type and Lv.

*All ★s a guild member obtained based on the difficulty of battles challenged will be totaled,
even if they have obtained ★s that exceeded the number required to clear a gauge.

Memo: ギルドツリータイプ強化Help見出し

Text:
■Bloom Bonus
By visiting the "Upgrade Bloom Bonus" screen,
you can raise the Lv of each character Type's Bloom Bonus.
The Lv of a character Type's Bloom Bonus can be upgraded when all guild members
jointly use a set number of Bloom Seeds.
Since all guild members can jointly use Bloom Seeds for upgrading, when any amount is used,
that amount will be applied to every member's progress.

When raising the Lv of a Type's Bloom Bonus, all characters of the same Type
will be granted bonuses to their stats, such as increased HP, ATK, etc.
These bonuses are only applied to Guild Tree battles,
and are considered part of a character's pre-increased/decreased stats.
The stat bonuses are not applied to any other content.

Memo: ギルドツリー使用キャラ登録Help見出し

Text:
■Character Registration
In the Guild Tree, you participate in battles using characters who you have registered.
You can register only 1 copy of each character.
Registration can be done 1 time per day, and is reset every day at 4:00 (Server Time).
Characters who have been registered, but were removed from your roster
due to awakening, releasing, etc., will become unusable.

■Changing Registered Characters and Gear
If you want to change your registered characters, the gear they have equipped, etc.,
after registration has been completed,
you can use the "Reregister" feature to make any desired changes as many times as you like
until you win your first Guild Tree battle for the day.
If you have already won your first Guild Tree battle for the day,
you will have to wait until the next day's registration to make your desired changes.

■Locking of Equipped Gear
The moment registration is completed, the state of your characters' gear will be locked.
After registration, any gear upgrades or changes of equipped gear
will not be applied to the Guild Tree battles for the day unless you perform a reregistration.
*Only the state of equipped gear will be locked, not your characters' Lvs, etc.,
and those current states will be applied to Guild Tree battles for the day.

■What Will Be Locked?
The following aspects of a character's gear will be locked.
・The gear that character has equipped
・The gear's Lv
・The gear's rarity
・The gear's Upgrade Lv
・The gear's Dark Lv
・The gear's Holy Lv
・The gear's Bonus Effects
・The runes that are mounted on the gear

■Use Previous Winning State
By selecting this option, you can challenge the Guild Tree
using your characters in the state they were in during the last time you won a battle.
Every character will have the state of gear from your last victory preserved.
This feature will be selectable starting from the 2nd day you participate in the Guild Tree.

■Guild Missions
These are special missions that only members of a guild can challenge.
There are two types of rewards that can be obtained from Guild Missions.
・Rewards from missions that each guild member can challenge indivudually,
Clearing these missions will also give guild members Guild Contribution Medals.
・Rewards from chests that are unlocked each time the guild collectively obtains
certain amounts of Guild Contribution Medals.
The number of chests a guild can unlock will increase depending on their Guild Lv.
Guild Missions reset every Monday at 4:00 (Server Time).

If you join a new guild after leaving or being dismissed from your previous one,
the previous guild will retain all Guild Contribution Medals you had obtained,
with none carrying over to your new guild.
Your status regarding Guild Missions that you have cleared,
as well as your status regarding chests that you have obtained rewards from, will carry over.
You will be able to obtain any unclaimed rewards in your new guild.
*Those unclaimed rewards cannot be obtained
if your new guild has not unlocked the corresponding chests.

■Limited-Time Login Bonus
On the limited-time login bonus screen,
there is a specified number of login days displayed at the bottom of the screen.
While the limited-time login bonus is available,
you will be able to obtain rewards for each day you log in.
After you log in for the specified number of login days mentioned above,​
you will be able to obtain a special reward.
The rewards you can obtain may change depending on your progress in the game.​

Example: Log in 14 days and get 1000 Diamonds.
In the example above, when you log in on the 14th day,
you will be able to obtain 1000 Diamonds.

If you log in for the first time right before the end of the limited-time login bonus's duration,
you can continue obtaining rewards for a certain period of time
regardless of the duration coming to an end.

■ゴールド交換
Text:
■Alchemy Workshop
The Alchemy Workshop is unlocked after clearing Main Quest 27-4.
This feature allows you to alchemize specific items into Gold (xx hrs).
After alchemizing is completed, any amount of Gold (xx hrs) obtained
that exceeds the limit of what your Item Box can hold will be sent to your Presents Box.

The items you can alchemize into Gold (xx hrs) are as follows:
・Chest of Chance
・EXP Orb (xx hrs)
・Kindling Orb (xx hrs)
・Growth Set (xx hrs)
*EXP Orbs or Kindling Orbs obtained after using any of the items above cannot be alchemized.

■Weekly Topics​
Weekly Topics will be unlocked after clearing Main Quest 4-20,​
and after 12 days have passed since starting the game.
In the Weekly Topics, you can check various statistics recorded​
from the previous week within your World.​

■Character Growth by Soul​
For this topic, the top character for each Soul grown by the players in your World​
will be posted in order of highest BP.​
1 character for each Soul will be chosen and posted based on who has the highest BP​
at the time that processing has ended every Monday at 4:00 (Server Time).​
Each chosen character's BP and gear information, as calculated at the time​
that processing has ended every Monday at 4:00 (Server Time), will be displayed here.​

■Battle League and Legend League​
In this topic, the statistical information for the "Consecutive Wins," "Character Usage Rates,"​
and "Must-See Battles" for the Battle League and Legend League will be posted each week.​
This topic will use information collected from​
the previous Monday at 4:00~the current Monday at 3:59 (Server Time).​
Information posted for the Legend League can be checked after it is unlocked.​

■Main Quest​
Here, the statistical information for the number of "Players who Cleared a Chapter" and above,​
"Character Usage Rates," and "Must-See Battles" for the Main Quest will be posted each week.​
This topic will use information collected by Monday at 4:00 (Server Time).​

■Weekly Item Shop​
In the Weekly Item Shop, you can purchase a variety of items using Gold or Diamonds.
The items for sale will be randomly selected via lottery each week.​
All items will automatically change every Monday at 4:00 (Server Time).

■Popularity Poll​
The most popular characters in the game will be chosen​
based on the results of players' votes in the Popularity Poll.​
Players will also obtain rewards based on the number of votes they cast​
during the Popularity Poll.​

■Poll Candidates​
All characters released prior to 9/1/2024 will be possible candidates to vote for.
*Collab characters will not be included as candidates.​
Characters that have multiple forms, such as ones with different Souls,​
will appear as their initial form in the game,​
with all forms being regarded as the same character.​

■Poll Tickets​
For each Poll Ticket used, one vote will be cast for the specified character​
in either the Prelims or the Finals.​
Poll Tickets can be used in both the Prelims and the Finals.​
In addition, Poll Tickets can only be used during the Popularity Poll period they were obtained in.​
Poll Tickets can be obtained during the Popularity Poll Missions period from either​
Daily Mission chests or as rewards for clearing Popularity Poll Missions.​
Popularity Poll Missions will also be reset once during the Popularity Poll event period.​
After the missions are reset, players will be able to obtain rewards once again​
for clearing the same missions.​

・Popularity Poll Missions Period: {7:MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm}~{8:MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm} (Server Time)​
・Popularity Poll Missions Reset Time: {11:MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm} (Server Time)​

■Poll Schedule​
The Popularity Poll event is split into 3 stages:
the "Prep Period," the "Prelims," and the "Finals."​

■Prep Period​
During this period, players can check and decide on what characters to vote for.
Votes cannot be cast during this period.​

・Prep Period: {0:MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm}~{2:MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm} (Server Time)​

■Prelims​
Players can vote for all characters who are candidates during this stage.​
On the date of the Prelims Midway Report, the top 20 characters​
at the midway point will be announced.​
On the date of the Prelims Results Announcement, the top 25 characters​
of the Prelims will be announced.​

・Prelims Period: {2:MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm}~{3:MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm} (Server Time)​
・Prelims Midway Report: {9:MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm} (Server Time)​
・Prelim Results Announcement: {4:MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm} (Server Time)​

■Finals​
The top 16 characters from the Prelims will move on to the Finals,​
where they can be voted for once again.​
Each character's total obtained votes from the Prelims​
will be reset at the start of the Finals.​
On the date of the Finals Midway Report, the top 5 characters​
at the midway point will be announced.​
However, each character's ranking will be hidden in the announcement.​
On the date of the Finals Results Announcement, each character's final vote count​
will be announced in order of their final rank.​

・Finals Period: {4:MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm}~{5:MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm} (Server Time)​
・Finals Midway Report: {10:MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm} (Server Time)​
・Final Results: {6:MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm} (Server Time)​

■Each Stage's Rankings​
Rankings will be determined based on the number of votes that have been obtained​
at the time each stage's Counting Period begins.​
If there are any characters that have the same number of votes,​
their rankings will be decided by the timing they reached that number of votes,​
with the earlier characters ranking higher.​

■Poll Rewards​
Players can claim rewards based on the number of votes they cast.​

■Rewards for the Top 3 Characters​
The character who receives the honor of ranking 1st in the Finals​
is planned to appear as a new summer-ready character in Summer 2025.​
In addition, as a bonus, the characters who rank 1st through 3rd in the Finals​
during the same period will appear together in​
special illustrations and accompanying short stories.​
These are planned to be viewable in Panel Missions, etc.​

​■Popularity Poll​
The most popular characters in the game will be chosen​
based on the results of players' votes in the Popularity Poll.​
Players will also obtain rewards based on the number of votes they cast​
during the Popularity Poll.​

■Poll Candidates​
All characters released prior to 9/1/2025 will be possible candidates to vote for.​
Characters that have multiple forms, such as ones with different Souls,​
will appear as their initial form in the game,​
with all forms being regarded as the same character.​
Characters who won 1st place in previous Popularity Polls​
will be enshrined in the Hall of Fame, and will no longer be included as candidates.​
・Hall of Fame Characters: Cordie​
In addition, Cryptract and Mitrasphere collab characters (Liselotte/Matilda)​
will not be included as candidates.​

■Poll Tickets and Character Groups​
▼Group Poll Tickets​
All possible candidates will be divided into 1 of the following 5 Groups:​
・Azure Group​
・Crimson Group​
・Emerald Group​
・Amber Group​
・Radiance/Chaos Group​
For every 1 Group Poll Ticket, you can cast 1 vote​
for each of your chosen characters from the 5 Groups all at once, casting a total of 5 votes.​
To vote using a Group Poll Ticket, you must choose​
1 character to represent each of the 5 Groups.​

▼Poll Tickets​
For every 1 Poll Ticket, you can cast 1 vote for any candidate,​
regardless of their Group.​

Poll Tickets and Group Poll Tickets can be used in both the Prelims and the Finals.​
Both ticket types can only be used during the Popularity Poll period they were obtained in.​
Both ticket types can be obtained during the Popularity Poll Missions period​
from either Daily Mission chests or as rewards for clearing Popularity Poll Missions.​

■Popularity Poll Missions​
By clearing missions, you can obtain Poll Tickets and Group Poll Tickets.​
Popularity Poll Missions will also be reset once during the Popularity Poll event period.​
After the missions are reset, players will be able to obtain rewards once again​
for clearing the same missions.​

・Popularity Poll Missions Period: {7:MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm}~{8:MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm} (Server Time)​
・Popularity Poll Missions Reset Time: {11:MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm} (Server Time)

■Poll Schedule​
The Popularity Poll event is split into 3 stages:
the "Prep Period," the "Prelims," and the "Finals."​

■Prep Period​
During this period, players can check and decide on what characters to vote for.
Votes cannot be cast during this period.​

・Prep Period: {0:MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm}~{2:MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm} (Server Time)​

■Prelims​
Players can vote for all characters who are candidates during this stage.​
In the Prelims, each character will be divided into 1 of 5 Groups​
(Azure Group, Crimson Group, Emerald Group, Amber Group, Radiance/Chaos Group),​
and will be ranked against their fellow groupmates.

On the date of the Prelims Midway Report,​
the top 5 characters with the highest total obtained votes in each Group​
at the midway point will be announced.​
However, for the Prelims Midway Report,​
each character's ranking will be hidden in the announcement.​
On the date of the Prelims Results Announcement,​
the top 8 characters with the highest total obtained votes in each Group of the Prelims​
will be announced.​

・Prelims Period: {2:MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm}~{3:MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm} (Server Time)​
・Prelims Midway Report: {9:MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm} (Server Time)​
・Prelim Results Announcement: {4:MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm} (Server Time)​

■Finals​
The top 5 characters with the highest total obtained votes in each Group from the Prelims (25 total)​
will move on to the Finals, where they can be voted for once again.​
In the Finals, instead of being ranked against their fellow groupmates,​
each character will be ranked against all other finalists.​​
In addition, each character's total obtained votes from the Prelims​
will be reset at the start of the Finals.​
On the date of the Finals Midway Report, the top 5 characters​
at the midway point will be announced.​
However, each character's ranking will be hidden in the announcement.​
On the date of the Finals Results Announcement, each character's final vote count​
will be announced in order of their final rank.​

・Finals Period: {4:MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm}~{5:MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm} (Server Time)​
・Finals Midway Report: {10:MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm} (Server Time)​
・Final Results: {6:MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm} (Server Time)​

■Each Stage's Rankings​
Rankings will be determined based on the number of votes that have been obtained​
at the time each stage's Counting Period begins.​
If there are any characters that have the same number of votes,​
their rankings will be decided by the timing they reached that number of votes,​
with the earlier characters ranking higher.​

■Poll Rewards​
Players can claim rewards based on the number of votes they cast.​

■Rewards for the Top 3 Characters​
The character who receives the honor of ranking 1st in the Finals​
is planned to appear as a new character in Summer 2026.​
In addition, as a bonus, the characters who rank 1st through 3rd in the Finals​
during the same period will be made into Stickers,​
which will be sent to all players, and can be used in Chats.

■Serial Codes
Serial codes are special codes you can enter to claim different items.
After entering the code successfully, the items will be sent to your in-game Presents Box.
*Items expire in 14 days.
Once a serial code has been used, it cannot be taken back.
Before using a serial code, please check your Player ID and entry information
to make sure they are correct.
If you send incorrect serial codes multiple times within a short period,
you will need to wait a while before sending again, so please be careful.

■Serial Code Usage Requirements
Depending on the serial code, the usage requirements and expiration dates may be different.

・Public Serial Codes
These serial codes are released by an official MementoMori account (social media, etc.),
and can only be used 1 time per World.
You can claim the items from the same code in multiple Worlds you have play data in.

・Private Serial Codes
These serial codes are included with purchases of products,
and can only be used 1 time per account.
Even if you have play data in multiple Worlds,
you can only claim the items from the code once, so please be careful.

■How to Contact Us
If you have any questions about entering serial codes,
please contact us using the method below.

1. Open the Home screen.
2. Tap the Menu icon located on the upper-right corner.
3. Tap "Support."
4. Tap "Contact Us."
5. Scroll down, then tap the "Contact" button.
6. Scroll down, then tap the "Question" button.

​■Premier Gifts​ (Bulk Buy)
With Bulk Buy, by adding products such as Daily Packs or Diamond Packs to your cart,​
you can purchase multiple products at one time.​
*Any products featured under the "Recommended" tab,​
as well as Ultra Sale Packs, cannot be bought in bulk.​
*Bulk Buy is a feature exclusive to Premier Gifts in the BOI Version of the game.​

■Other Warnings​
Only adding products to your cart will not complete your purchase.​
After selecting products and adding them to your cart,​
please use the procedure below to complete your purchase.​

【How to Complete Your Purchase】​
Tap the "Bulk Buy" button in the bottom-right corner of the Premier Gifts screen.​
On the Payment Confirmation screen, tap the "Buy" button.​

The purchase of products added to your cart​
will only be completed by following the procedure above.​
In the event that you purchase a single product from the "Recommended" tab​
while other products are in your cart,​
those other products will not be automatically purchased,​
so please be careful.​

Products left in your cart upon exiting the app will also not be automatically purchased,​
and will instead be removed from your cart.

■Spellbook Sweep
Spellbook Sweep is a puzzle mini-game where you search for hidden objects​
by clearing tiles on each Floor of the library​
to find the 1 Key Tile and 1 Door Tile hidden among 35 tiles.​
Once you find both the Key and Door Tiles,​
you can obtain Floor Rewards and advance to the next Floor.

■Bonus Floors
Bonus Floors appear after every 5 Floors.
On Bonus Floors, you can set the Bonus Floor Rewards to the rewards of your choice,
allowing you to obtain greater rewards than on Normal Floors.
The rewards you can select will correspond to your progress in the Main Quest.
For details on the available rewards, please check the Floor Information
in the top-right corner of the event page.

■Cleaning Items
Each tile can be cleared by using Cleaning Items.
The number of tiles that can be cleared at once varies depending on the type of Cleaning Item used.
During the event period, Cleaning Items can be obtained from Daily Mission Chests,
Helper Dispatch, Spellbook Sweep Missions, Floor Rewards, and more.
Cleaning Items can only be used for the iteration
of the Spellbook Sweep event in which they were obtained.
After the event ends, any unused Cleaning Items will
be automatically converted into Arbored Bookmarks.

■Arbored Bookmarks
Arbored Bookmarks can be obtained by clearing Normal Tiles on each Floor.
They can be used to purchase various items in the Limited-Time Event Shop.
Arbored Bookmarks can only be used in the Event Shop
during the event period in which they were obtained.

■Helper Dispatch​
In Helper Dispatch, you can dispatch characters on Dispatch Quests,​
and obtain Cleaning Items once the quest completion time has passed.​
You cannot dispatch the same character multiple times on different Dispatch Quests.​
Dispatch Quests refresh every day at 4:00 (Server Time).​
Any Dispatch Quests not dispatched to by the refresh time will be discarded,​
with new Dispatch Quests matching​
the number of dispatch slots you have available being added.​

■Adding Dispatch Slots​
By obtaining certain characters or purchasing certain packs,​
you can increase the number of dispatch slots you have to a maximum of 3 slots.​
The dispatch slots you add will only be usable during​
the same Helper Dispatch period in which you obtained them,​
and will expire once the event has ended.​

■Cleared Rewards Grades​
The higher the rarity of the character you dispatch,​
the more stars will appear on Dispatch Quests, and the more Cleaning Items you can obtain​
after dispatching has been completed.​
Each Dispatch Quest has a Rewards Grade,​
and rewards for higher grades cannot be obtained.​

■Helper Lv​
The grade of Dispatch Quests that appear and the number of dispatch slots you have​
will increase based on your Helper Lv.​
You will level up every day at 4:00 (Server Time)​
if the number of dispatches needed has been reached.​

■Held Item Limit​
The limit for some held items will be unlocked upon clearing Main Quest 27-4.​
The limits of the following held items will be unlocked:​

・Gold (xx hrs): 9999​
・EXP Orb (xx hrs): 1999​
・Kindling Orb (xx hrs): 1999​
・Growth Set (xx hrs): 1999​

If an item is obtained and having it in your Item Box causes it to exceed its held item limit,​
that item will be sent to your Presents Box instead.

Memo: 図鑑ヘルプ新規作成
図鑑ヘルプ新規作成
Text:
■Character Index​
Here, you can view information about characters in the game.

■Gear Index​
Here, you can view information about different gear in the game.​

■Country Index​
Here, you can view information about the countries you have visited in the Main Quest.​

■Panel Index​
Here, you can view panel illustrations you have obtained in events or by other means.​
Previously unobtained panel illustrations for an event can be unlocked using Panel Tickets or Diamonds
after a certain period has passed following that event’s conclusion.

■Dance of the Dolls​
Dance of the Dolls will be unlocked upon clearing Main Quest 6-14.​
In the Dance of the Dolls, you can challenge battles while using​
characters other players have raised as Support Characters.​
Stages 1 and 2 will be unlocked during the first half of the event period,​
with Stages 3 and 4 unlocking during the latter half.​

■Support Characters​
When challenging each stage, you can add up to 1 character​
set as a Support Character by another player in the same World to your party.​
The Support Character's Lv and gear at the time they were set​
as a Support Character will be applied to them.​
The Support Character's Rank Bonuses and/or Arcana effects​
will reflect those unlocked or set by the player​
using the character as a Support Character.​

・Max Lv for Support Characters​
Support Characters have a Max Lv,​
which is based on the Max Lv decided by the number of days​
that have passed since the World being played on was created,​
and the Max Lv of the Level Link for the player​
using the character as a Support Character.​
If the Support Character's Lv is higher than both​
the Support Character Max Lv and the player's Level Link Max Lv,​
then the Support Character's Max Lv will lower to either​
the Support Character Max Lv or the Level Link Max Lv,​
based on whichever of the two is higher.​
If the character's Lv lowers,​
the gear Lv of the Support Character's equipped pieces of gear​
and their typing that corresponds to said gear Lv,​
as well as any gear set names, may change, so please be careful.​

■Support Points and Support Rewards​
If the Support Characters you set support another player,​
you will obtain Support Points.​
You will obtain different amounts of points depending on the following.​
・For Friends or Guild Members: 3 Points​
・For Other Players: 1 Point​
After obtaining a certain amount of Support Points,​
you can obtain Support Rewards.​

■Raid Bosses​
Raid Bosses will appear on Stages 2 and 4.​
There is no limit to the number of times you can challenge a Raid Boss.​
Witch’s Gift buffs will not be applied in battles against Raid Bosses.​

・Damage Rewards​
When the Max DMG Dealt to a Raid Boss has been refreshed,
​the Damage Rewards will also be refreshed, and you can obtain them again.​
Your progress for obtaining Damage Rewards will be reset​
every day at 4:00 (Server Time).

・The Period Damage Rewards can be Obtained​
You can obtain the Damage Rewards for each Stage​
for 7 days from the date you first challenged them.​
However, if the event has ended, all access to that Stage's challenges​
and that Stage's rewards will be lost,​
with the rewards no longer being obtainable.​

・Restricted Missions​
If you deal a certain amount of damage to a Raid Boss​
while meeting certain party conditions,​
you can obtain rewards.​

■Rankings​
These are rankings for the Max DMG Dealt to each Raid Boss.​
There are 2 types of rankings: World Rankings and Server Rankings.​

・World Rankings​
World Rankings are calculated based on your current World.​
You can obtain rewards based on your rank at the time the event ends.​
The higher you rank, the more rewards you can obtain.​

・Server Rankings​
These rankings include all Worlds within the same Server.​
However, Worlds that have not been open​
for a certain period by the time the event begins​
will not be included in the ranking calculations.​
Worlds not included in the ranking calculations​
will not be displayed in the Server Rankings.​
In addition, there are no rewards obtainable from Server Rankings.​

・Party Types​
In World Rankings and Server Rankings, there are 2 categories:​
"Restricted Parties" and "Unrestricted Parties."​
"Restricted Parties" are parties that meet certain restrictions,​
with rankings calculated based on the previously reached Max DMG Dealt by that party.​
"Unrestricted Parties" have no set restrictions,​
with rankings calculated based on the previously reached Max DMG Dealt by that party.​

​■Weapon Sync​
Weapon Sync will be unlocked upon both reaching a Party Lv of 360,​
and after obtaining 2 or more types of unique weapons at a rarity of UR or higher.​
By setting unique weapons to the Weapon Sync, their Gear Lv can be raised​
without the need to enhance them.​
Only unique weapons at Lv 300 or higher can be set to weapon sync slots.​

■Base Slots​
Unique weapons set to base slots will serve as the base Gear Lv​
for the unique weapon set to the corresponding sync slot.​
Unique weapons set to base slots cannot be dismantled.​
If you wish to dismantle the unique weapon set to a base slot,​
you will need to remove it from that base slot first.​

■Sync Slots​
Unique weapons set to sync slots will have their Gear Lv raised​
to match the lowest Gear Lv of the unique weapons set to the corresponding base slots.​
Unique weapons set to sync slots cannot be dismantled or enhanced.​
If you wish to dismantle or enhance the unique weapon set to a sync slot,​
you will need to remove it from that sync slot first.​

After a unique weapon has been set to a sync slot, that sync slot will enter a 24-hour cooldown.​
Until the cooldown ends, the unique weapon set to that sync slot cannot be changed.​
By ending the cooldown early, you can change the unique weapon set to that sync slot.​

Additional sync slots can be unlocked​
by clearing Weapon Sync Missions and obtaining Sync Hammers.​

■Upgrade Material Return​
If the Upgrade Lv of the unique weapon set to a sync slot exceeds its Gear Lv​
after it is removed from that sync slot,​
or after the unique weapon set to a corresponding base slot has been changed,​
that unique weapon's Upgrade Lv will become the same as its Gear Lv,​
and the items used to upgrade it will be returned as upgrade materials.

■Custom Music Settings​
Custom Music Settings will be unlocked upon clearing Main Quest 9-24.​
Using Custom Music Settings, you can change the in-game background music,​
with the exception of select screens, to any song of your choice.

Only songs that you have already unlocked in the Music Player​
will be displayed in your Custom Music Settings.​

Your Custom Music Settings will be applied when you close the window​
while a song is playing on the Custom Music Settings screen.

■Playable Songs​
Only songs that you have already unlocked in the Music Player​
can be used in your Custom Music Settings.​

*Music may need to be downloaded to be played.​
*Some music is not available due to copyright restrictions.​

■Repeat​ing Songs
You can select between "Repeat 1" or "Repeat All"​
in your Custom Music Settings.​
Selecting "Repeat All" in the Music tab​
will repeatedly play your downloaded songs.

■How to Stop​
You can disable your Custom Music Settings​
by tapping the Stop button on the Home screen,​
or by stopping the song in Custom Music Settings and closing the window.​

Text:
The Cave of Space-Time has 3 Levels, and beating each Level’s boss will let you go to the next Level.
Your progress will reset every 48 hours, and the map will be changed.​
All damage will carry over from battle to battle, so healing frequently is crucial.​

In the Cave of Space-Time, you select adjoining encounters to traverse the map.​
Different events will trigger based on the type of encounters you select.​

In the Cave of Space-Time, winning battles will grant you blessings.
There are a variety of blessings that can give you the edge in battles inside the Cave.​
Prepare for all the strong enemies by collecting as many blessings as you can.​

You can get rewards, like Space-Time Coins, by winning battles and clearing Levels.​
Trade these coins for valuable items and SR character shards at the Shop.

The Tower of Infinity rewards you with gear and items useful for growing stronger.​
Beating the boss on each Floor will unlock the next Floor.

You can form a guild with other players.
Joining a guild lets you unite with guild members​
and take on guild-only challenges, like Guild Battles.

Dispatch characters with Souls and rarities set by each quest and get rewards.​
There are 3 types of quests—Normal, Team, and Guerilla.​
Guerilla quests are special, limited-time only quests.
Compared to other quests, Guerilla quests give more lavish rewards.​

Clearing a certain number of quests will raise your Fountain Rank,​
making it easier for even rarer quests to appear. ​

The Temple of Illusions lets you unite with other players and challenge bosses.
You can challenge the Temple up to 6 times in 1 day. The rewards you can obtain will depend
on the bosses you challenge. Additionally, you will earn boosted rewards by challenging
the Temple between 12:30~13:30 and 19:30~20:30 (Server Time).

Characters set in slots will become the same Lv as a base character.
Your 5 highest Lv characters will be automatically chosen as base characters,​
and the slotted characters will adopt the lowest Lv among the base characters.​

Battle other players’ parties and aim for the highest ranks.​
You can get daily rewards, like Diamonds, based on your rank,​
and rewards will increase as you rank higher.
Challenges are free for up to 5 times in 1 day.​

Here, the top Battle League players from each World compete in ranked battles.
Seasons are Tuesday~Sunday, and you can get lavish Daily Rewards and Season Rewards based on your rank.

Smelting unneeded gear gives you a chance to create high rarity gear.​
If no gear is created, the smelted gear will be converted to Fragments.​
Fragments can be traded for dark gear, holy gear, and more at the Shop.​
If S-rarity gear is smelted, dark gear can be created.​

Consume upgrade materials to upgrade gear.​
Gear can be upgraded to the same value as its Gear Lv.​

Constructing slots and mounting runes on gear will raise the targeted stats.​
The type of gear determines the type of rune that can be mounted.​
・Offensive-type runes for weapons, accessories, and hands.​
・Defensive-type runes for head, body, and feet.​

You can upgrade a rune’s Rune Lv by synthesizing it with another rune of​
the same type and Lv. A rune can be upgraded to the max Rune Lv of 15.​

A character’s rarity can be raised by using characters with the same Soul.
Raising rarity will increase the character’s stats and Max Lv.
Any materials that made the used characters grow stronger will be returned.

In Guild Battles, you fight over bases on the map against rival guilds.​
During Strategy Phase, you decide the bases to siege during War Phase.​
Guilds in the previous day’s top 16 of the Guild Stock Ranking can join the battle.​

​During Strategy Phase (7:45~20:30), you can declare attacks
on red-colored bases adjacent to ones your guild controls.
This determines the bases you will siege during War Phase.

You can defend any base your guild has captured.
These bases are marked in green on the map.
Deploy characters to prevent the enemy from taking control of your bases.

During War Phase (20:45~21:30), you can siege bases you declared attacks on.
Deploy characters into wars for dominance over the enemy’s bases.

If a base is captured, defenders have 15 minutes to counter.
When countering, defenders and attackers will switch roles and battle.
The base can be taken back after completely defeating the enemy.​

In Guild Battles, you can earn more rewards the more bases you capture.​
Larger bases will yield more rewards, and you can earn the most rewards​
from “Brussell”—the base located at the center of the map.​

Grand Battles are special Guild Battles in which guilds chosen based on BP come​
from other Worlds to take part in. Battles are held from Tuesday~Sunday,
and guilds are arranged into groups of 4. The points earned from keeping control​
over territory will determine each guild’s rank within their group.​

In Guild Raids, the total damage dealt to the boss determines the amount of rewards​ you can get.
There is a set number of times you can challenge the boss in one day.

On top of personal rewards, you can get guild rewards based on the total damage​
dealt by all guild members. The total damage will be reset every day.​

The Lv of all characters in the Level Link will become the same as the Party Lv.
From this point on, raising the Party Lv will also raise all characters’ Lv.​
The max Party Lv will increase based on the number of LR characters in your roster.​
Having multiples of the same LR character will not affect that amount the Max Party Lv increases.​

By clearing Main Quest 8-14, after clearing Level 2,
you will be able to choose to challenge Level 3 on Hard Mode.​
The enemies in Hard Mode are powerful, but yield more rewards.

The Towers of Azure, Crimson, Emerald, and Amber can be challenged depending on​
the day of the week. Characters can only enter if they have the Soul that matches​
the name of the tower.​

Acquiring specific groups of characters will unlock arcana.
Each arcana will boost a different set of stats and strengthen those characters.
Additionally, as the rarities of the characters in the arcana group get higher,
the arcana’s Lv will increase, and new effects will be unlocked.

Any characters set as favorites will appear on the Home Screen.​
Even characters obtained just once can be set as favorites at any time you like.​

By using dark gear, holy gear, and other specialty items,
you can upgrade your gear’s​ Dark Lv and Holy Lv.​
If you use holy and dark gear for upgrading, you can synthesize augmented gear with​
both holy and dark effects. Effects are determined by the body part the piece of gear is for.

By using items to reforge gear, its bonus effects will change at random.​
The bonus effects’ total points will not change—only the balance distribution will.​
Distributing points to the unique type stat of the character equipping the gear​
will also raise that character’s ATK.

If you defeat all enemy defense parties at a base, you can capture it.
When War Phase ends, rewards will be determined
by the number and types of bases captured.

Guild Battles consist of Strategy Phase (7:45~20:30) and War Phase (20:45~21:30).​
During Strategy Phase, you can declare attacks on enemy bases.
In War Phase, you will siege those bases and aim to capture them.

While the event is underway, some of the Cave’s encounters will change into event encounters.
By beating them, you will obtain special event items that can be exchanged at the Shop
for amazing items and characters. If you reattempt an event encounter,
enemies with reduced HP will have 30% of their max HP restored.

While the event is underway, all quests will change into event quests.
By beating them, you will obtain special event items that can be exchanged at the Shop
for amazing items and characters. Also, you can earn boosted rewards
by challenging the Temple from 12:30~13:30 & 19:30~20:30 (Server Time).

Tapping the “Lock” button will lock the state of gear being used by characters in certain content.
Only one copy of the same character (the one with the higher BP) can have their gear locked.
After a character's gear has been locked, it can be unlocked or updated at any time.

While the event is underway, a limited raid boss will appear.
By challenging them, you will obtain special event items that can be exchanged at the Shop
for amazing rewards. Additionally, you can obtain World Rewards
according to the total amount of damage dealt by all users in your World.

Clearing a mission will allow you to unlock its corresponding panel square.
When you complete unlocking all squares in a horizontal or vertical line,
you can obtain rewards from that line’s corresponding chest.
Unlocking every square will allow you to obtain a limited event panel.

Memo: ギルドツリーチュートリアルテキスト①
Text:
In the Guild Tree, you can cooperate with guild members and challenge bosses on each Floor.
The more participants there are, the more advantageously your guild can progress up the Floors.
Once your allies have gathered, team up and obtain even more rewards.

Memo: ギルドツリーチュートリアルテキスト②
Text:
By maxing out the gauge on each Floor, your guild can advance to the next Floor.
This gauge will fill up based on the difficulty of Guild Tree battles won by each guild member.

Memo: ギルドツリーチュートリアルテキスト③
Text:
Use Bloom Seeds to raise the Lv of each character Type’s Bloom Bonus.
By raising the Bloom Bonus’s Lv, characters of the corresponding Type will be granted stat bonuses.
This will give you the advantage when challenging Guild Tree battles.

Memo: ギルドツリーチュートリアルテキスト④
Text:
Winning a Guild Tree battle will start a combo.
While the combo’s duration is active, the combo will grow whenever a guild member wins a battle.
As the combo grows, the number of Bloom Seeds obtained will be boosted based on the current combo.

Memo: ギルドツリーチュートリアルテキスト⑤
Text:
The number of Bloom Seeds you obtain from battles will change based on the character Types in your party.
By setting more characters of the same Type in your party, you can obtain more of that Type’s Bloom Seeds.

In the Popularity Poll, you can use Poll Tickets during the Popularity Poll period to vote for characters.
You can obtain Poll Tickets from Daily Mission treasures chests or Popularity Poll Mission rewards.
You can also obtain Poll Rewards based on the number of votes you cast.

By using Auto-Mount, you can easily switch the runes mounted to all of your gear.
You can even create custom sets of rune combinations for each character.
*Up to 50 custom sets total can be saved (up to 9 for each character).

With Awaken Unlock, you can increase a character's Max Awakening and raise their rarity even higher!
This feature can only be used on certain characters with an initial rarity of R.​
Awaken Unlock can be used on only 1 character per month.

In Friend Battles, you can form a party and battle against your friends.
Use Friend Battles to try out new battle strategies,
or see just how strong you are!

Use a number of items equal to what it takes to perform 20 reforges,
and reforge a piece of gear 20 times at once!
By selecting 1 reforge result containing your desired Bonus Effect stat values,
you can aim for your ideal Bonus Effect to be applied to your gear with greater efficiency!

Clear tiles on each Floor to find the 1 Key Tile and 1 Door Tile hidden among 35 total tiles.
Once you find the Key Tile and Door Tile,
you can obtain rewards and advance to the next Floor.

Arbored Bookmarks can be obtained by clearing Normal Tiles on each Floor.
They can be used to purchase various items in the Limited-Time Event Shop.

At times, you may obtain stronger Cleaning Items as Floor Rewards.
Using these items will allow you to clear multiple tiles at once.
Be sure to take full advantage of them!

With Weapon Sync, you can set a variety of unique weapons to base slots and sync slots.
For each sync slot, you must set unique weapons to all corresponding base slots.
Unique weapons set to sync slots will sync their Lv to the lowest Lv unique weapon set to
its corresponding base slots. Only unique weapons of Lv 300 or higher can be set.

You can obtain the item needed to unlock sync slots by clearing Weapon Sync Missions.
Missions will be cleared based on the number of unique weapons at UR or higher that you have.
So, the more unique weapons you have, the more sync slots you can unlock!

With Reset Enhanced Gear, you can get back materials from unique weapons that do not need
to be upgraded beyond Lv 300, such as unique weapons at Lv 310 or higher set to sync slots.
Materials will be returned as Magic Crystals, so you can use them as materials for other gear you have.
The Reset Enhanced Gear feature has a limit of 1 use per month.

Dance of the Dolls consists of 4 Stages.
By clearing battles in each Stage, you can proceed to the next one.
You can obtain more rewards based on how much damage you deal to the Raid Bosses in Stages 2 and 4.
Raid Bosses can also be challenged as many times as you like while the event is underway!

In the Dance of the Dolls, you can form a party using 1 Support Character set by another player.
You can set up to 2 Support Characters from the “Support Settings” screen.

In the Popularity Poll, you can use Poll Tickets or Group Poll Tickets to vote for characters.
During the Popularity Poll Mission period, you can obtain Poll Tickets and Group Poll Tickets
from Daily Mission chests or Popularity Poll Mission rewards.
You can also obtain Poll Rewards based on the number of votes you cast.

Voting for characters can be done using either Poll Tickets or Group Poll Tickets.
For every 1 Poll Ticket used, you can cast 1 vote for a character of your choosing.
You can vote using Group Poll Tickets after choosing 1 character to represent each of the 5 Soul Groups.
For every 1 Group Poll Ticket, you can cast 1 vote for each Group’s chosen characters all at once.

The cursed land is turning back to normal!
So this is the power of the Staff’s Successor—
your power...

You probably still don’t believe a word I’m saying,
but you have the power to save this cursed world.

...?! It can’t be... The Church of Longinus’s
“Witch Hunt” has made its way here?!

I’ll take down all the enemies who attack us.
So, in the meantime, please take care of the battle preparations!

The Church’s knights are no pushovers.
Make sure you’re properly prepared.

Monica’s a handmaiden who’s a bit timid,
but you can rely on her to heal your party.

I may still just be an inexperienced apprentice,
but I will do my best to live up to your expectations!

You heard it from Iris.
We will protect you no matter what comes our way.

Iris is not only your attendant,
but also your personal guard.
If you add her to your party, she’ll overpower
the enemy with her incredible strength.

Leave everything to me.
I shall protect you, even if it costs me my life.

It’s just as Rosalie says.
If we calm down and prepare ourselves,
we’ll come out victorious.

Rosalie said she’s just a small, weak maiden,
but she’s actually an amazing witch who many call
the Great Sorceress.

We somehow managed to win,
but the enemies have gotten stronger.
Still, we can’t afford to stop now...

We needn’t hurry. Haste makes waste.
You’ve become used to wielding the power of the Staff,
so now you should be able to help us level up.

As you envision the one you wish to level up,
reach out and touch them.

Amazing—I feel power surging from deep inside my body!
So this is your power.
As it so happens, we’ve also gotten ahold of some new gear, so let’s hurry and equip them.

Perfect!
The enemies are bound to get
stronger from this point on.
But with your power,
no one will stand a chance against us!

The town’s been ravaged by the Curse,
but it’ll really return to normal...?!
Amazing!​

Well, well... It seems you not only have the power to
dispel the Curse, but also the power
to rebuild an area affected by it.
Now, touch the town with your hand.

Next, envision how the town would look
once you’ve restored it.

To think you’ve already mastered the Staff’s
power this much...
It’s certainly no coincidence that this era
would see someone of your talent emerge.

Up ahead may be another town that
you can heal with your power.
When the time comes,
please do everything you can to help.

For no matter how much pain they may be in,
just having a place to go home to
is enough for people to persevere...

Now you can use your power to see into
everyone’s memories.

Because of “The Witch Hunt,”
every witch in the world has been persecuted.
Even girls burdened with the sufferings they’ve
experienced in the past...

As kind as you are,
you’ll probably want to avert your eyes.
I can’t force you to look at them, either...

But, I want you to get to know these girls
as much as possible.

No matter how much pain they are in,
just having someone at their side should be enough
for them to overcome it.

Alright, let’s push on ahead.
It’s only a little further until we reach the Witch of Qlipha.

Shall we get going?
The next country is “The Woodland Nation—
the Principality of Brook.”
It’s a nation afflicted by a Curse that shrouds the land in ice, hindering anyone who dares enter.

Looks like you’ve unlocked the ability to invoke.
The battles from this point on will get even tougher.
But with your power, we’re bound to find new allies
who’ll help us.
Let’s go and give it a try.

I see you’ve found a new ally to join us.
Now, let’s return to the estate for a moment.

Looks like there are some mission rewards
you can collect.
Let’s check them out.

Wow—you’ve already achieved so much.
I knew you had it in you!
Go ahead and collect them all.

Here’s the next mission.
Let’s head out and clear it.

Huh...? Your staff is glowing...
I wonder what’s making it do that. Let’s go and find out.

Wha—?! Where are we?!
We’re somewhere different all of a sudden...!

Wait—could this be the “World of Trials?”
The illusionary realm said to guide
the ones chosen by the Staff...?!
I can’t believe it really exists...

Anyway, let’s press forward.
I think something might just be waiting for us there...

I thought this was just a big cave at first,
but it feels like the inside of a tree...

The space inside here is warping,
so it’s a dangerous place that takes on
a different form every time we enter...

But, if this really is the “World of Trials,”
then there should be something here that can help us.
Let’s proceed with caution.

Something’s happened in the World of Trials.
I feel a massive amount of power...

This is one tall tower.
I wonder how high up it goes.

But, each floor in this tower contains a large room...
This entire place feels familiar to me...
Maybe this world...is what our world will look like...

Let’s go.
If we make our way to the top,
we might be able to find something.

Looks like you can now join a guild.
Our enemies will keep getting stronger from this point on.
So, let’s join forces with as many allies as we can!

Something’s happened in the World of Trials.
I feel a strange power...

Check out this fountain... The water’s surface is
showing us someplace different.
From the looks of it,
we can travel to other worlds from here.

But, this fountain is another place
created by the “World of Trials,” right?

Who knows what kinds of trails are waiting
on the other side...
But, if we let fear stop us, we never will.
Let’s go and take the plunge.
Select a world to start an expedition.

I guess each world has different conditions set that
determine the rarity or Soul of the characters
who can enter.
Go and select who you want to send on this expedition.
When you’re ready, let’s head out.

Looks like everyone made it back safely.
What a relief...
Alright, let’s check out the rewards we’ve collected!

Something’s happened in the World of Trials.
I can sense hundreds—no, thousands of people...

In ancient times,
whenever warriors crossed swords,
their battles were seen as an offering to God.

Over the years, people stopped believing in God,
and their devotional traditions faded away with time.
But, it seems like the people of this world are still here.

Maybe God’s still seeking it out—
the radiance of life that overflows from souls laid bare.

Let’s set up a defense party that can fight for us,
even when we’re not around.

Something’s happened in the World of Trials.
I sense something, but what...?

I heard the people of this temple
worshipped the Tree of Life.

It gave birth to life, souls, the land—everything.
The Tree itself is the creator of the world.
That’s what the people of this temple believe.

Apparently, we can earn more rewards at specific times—
when the Tree’s power is at its peak.
But, the inside is protected by powerful guardians.
It’s dangerous to go alone,
so let’s all work together and take this challenge on.
Looks like your staff has obtained a new power.
Now, you can access Level Link!

Using your power to bond people together,
your allies can now share their power with each other.

Rather than hear me explain it,
it’ll be much quicker if we just test it out.
This should make the power of your allies
grow by leaps and bounds!

Something’s happened in the World of Trials.
I feel the strongest of powers coming together...

This is the renowned Legend League...
It’s the arena of the gods,
where only those who have ascended to the tops of
their worlds are allowed to enter.

If what the stories say are true,
then only one of the many assembled here
will earn the right to call themself the Disciple of God...

We won’t know if that’s true unless we see it with our own eyes.
If we can enter, by all means, let’s do it!
Looks like any unneeded gear can be smelted from here.

If you decide to smelt, you’ll obtain Fragments.
You can exchange Fragments for new gear at the Shop.

The variety of gear will be updated every day,
so you should probably check in frequently.

Looks like you can upgrade your gear from here.
Let’s give it a try!

Looks like you have some runes that
you can mount onto your gear.
Let’s try and put them on.

Runes are crystalized masses of magic power,
and they strengthen different abilities
depending on their source of power.

To mount a rune, you need to
construct a slot onto your gear.
Can you select where you want to construct?

Now, let’s take the rune you chose and mount it.
After constructing a slot, you’re free to mount or
remove any rune from it as you please.

Looks like you can awaken characters here.
If you raise our rarities, we’ll get even stronger.
Go and select the character you want to awaken.

Awakening needs the power of allies.
Next, select characters who meet the requirements.

Now we can awaken this character.
Let’s try it out!

This is a place where rampant, negative emotions gather.
Souls who have lost their way join together,
taking the form of a witch who has
lost control of her powers.

The more you attack, the more souls you can free.
Even one person can make a difference,
so please lend some help.

It’s overflowing with incredible amounts of energy here.
Looks like it’s a special place where we can obtain power from the Tree of Life.

But, it appears that other guilds are also making
their way here.

Only the most superior of guilds can come,
hence why everyone looks so strong,
but that doesn’t mean we’ve been outmatched.
It’s time to show just how strong we really are!

Let’s launch attacks on bases and capture them.
We can earn rewards based on how many we’ve captured.

Bases are comprised of churches, castles, and temples.
We’ll get the best rewards from the temple at the center of the map.
Guess this is the temple we need to set our sights on.
Go ahead and tap Base to see more information about it.

What amazing energy...
This place is overflowing with the power of life—
the likes of which I’ve never seen...

Looks like this is a special place that bridges
different worlds together.
There’s a massive amount of energy here,
which means a lot of powerful people are on their way.

But, we have nothing to worry about.
We’ve come this far by uniting our powers as one.
It’s time to show everyone just how strong we are!

Looks like you can augment gear from here.
You can take holy and dark powers
and bestow them onto your gear.
Go and select the materials required for augmenting.

The materials you can use are gear that have
holy or dark effects, and Dark Perfume.

This will raise the gear’s Dark Lv.
A piece of gear’s holy and dark effects depend on
the body part it’s for, so try augmenting other gear, too.

Looks like you can reforge gear here.
Let’s give it a try!

Reforging can rebalance a piece of gear’s stats.
Let’s test it out.

Now each stat’s numerical value has changed.
Let’s try reforging again and again so
a character’s unique type stat gets even stronger.

Thank you. Because of you,
we somehow managed to save the world...

But, there’s still someone left who seeks to destroy
the world—the demon lord.

Right now, he’s sealed away inside me.
When he eventually makes his return,
the end of the world will be on my hands...
To prevent that from happening, I have to forge ahead...deep into the underworld, to the demons’ throne.
What awaits us from here is a road to Hell, created by the remnants of a world destroyed by the demons.

Our journey still has a long way to go.
But, it would mean so much if you help me
see this through until the very end.

Now, let’s get going...
This time...we will save the world.

The final Curse is lifting...
You’ve done excellent work in saving this continent.

From here, we’ll be heading to a place full of magic
that’s different to that born from the Tree of Life.
The presence of demons is much higher,
so we’ll likely encounter even stronger foes.

There are worlds ruined by the spread of demonic flowers,
and even ones torn asunder by rebellions led by witches...

As we advance, the perils befalling
the continents we enter shall differ.
Amongst them, there are likely even worlds
that contradict everything we think we know.
But, we may just meet some new comrades along the way.

You seem nervous, but there is no need to fear.
I, the Great Sorceress Rosalie, shall be with you every step.
All will be well as long as you keep lending us your strength.

Now, let us go forth. To the world fallen into ruin
by demons’ flowers, Derulla.
Looks like you’ve unlocked a useful new feature for augmenting gear.

Now, you can automatically select
all of the materials you need to reach
the Holy Lv or Dark Lv you wish to augment to.
Let’s first try setting a Dark Lv!

By tapping the Select button,
the materials you need to reach that Dark Lv
will be automatically selected for you.

Seems like you can set the Holy Lv or Dark Lv you want
from here. Let’s try setting the Dark Lv
once we’ve gathered more materials!

The last Curse is lifting!
You’ve done it again, Master!

A world where witches and humans hate each other...
It was almost as if those cursed bubbles
were filled with sadness...

It was a world full of tragedy.
But, because you believed
witches and humans could live as one,
you were able to save it, Master.

You’ve also brought us deeper towards the underworld,
closer to where the demon lord is said to be sealed.

But, now that we’re so close,
I can sense even more terrifying power than ever
emanating from the Curses ahead...

Like a world buried under a storm of arid sand,
or a world plunged into ruin
more beautifully than any other...

But...there’s no need to fear.
As long as you’re leading us, Master,
we can overcome any obstacle!

We’ve already made it this far, after all!
So, I have no doubt everything will end up alright.

Plus... A-As weak as I may be,
I’ll still be at your side, doing everything I can to help!

Now, let’s keep marching on.
As what lies waiting for us is the world
buried and taken away by the sands...Tottoh.

We were so close.
Just a little more and we could’ve won!

Even when you’re not here,
we never stop fighting to save the world.
You can see every detail about our battles from here.

Here’s the loot from our battles.
Tap the rewards and see what kinds of items
we’ve obtained.

As we save more people, and our population grows,
so will our rewards.
If we push forward, we’ll also see more rewards from enemies. So, let’s keep going.
Let’s use these rewards and level up immediately!
Looks like you’ve amassed some more rewards!
Let’s level everyone up right away!

We lost...but that’s okay.
If we just upgrade our gear, we can get even stronger!

Look inside your Item Box for runes, Master!
If you mount them onto our gear, I think we can get stronger!

The enemy is quite strong... Oh, that reminds me. Do you know about augmenting?
It can set free the power hidden away inside gear. You should try it out for yourself.

Ugh... My deepest apologies, my lord... It looks like we are in need of retraining.
Let’s awaken some characters and raise their rarities.

Is the gear reforged and ready to go, Master?
Let’s take good care of everyone’s gear so we can win the next battle!
