Memo: 周年パネルミッション
周年パネルミッション

Text: A Sea of Smiles and Cheers

“I’ll take my wishes...and feelings...and pour them into this blade!”

Illya’s sword emits a light
at the sound of her voice.
Although that light was still but a tiny glow, seeing it made Illya quickly lift her head towards me.

“Your Holiness... I did it!”
“Indeed. Please do not ever forget this sensation. A witch’s power comes from the heart. Picturing your power in your mind is very important.”
“Of course!”

Illya answered me with a smile on her face, then once again readied her sword.

At this moment,
her light is but small.
But before long, it shall grow into a great, shining radiance that will save the world.

Deep inside Illya sleeps a power that can perform miracles.
It is a mystery that even I do not know the true nature of.
A power so absurdly massive and beautiful, it makes one doubt even the slightest possibility that a human body could ever wield it...

I believe it to be fate that allowed us to meet.
Thus, I must lead her down
the correct path.

“Come now, Illya. Try doing it one more time while that sensation is still fresh
in your mind.”
“Yes, Your Holiness!”

After all, there are two sacred treasures that were sent down from Heaven...
And, I finally found the person who I could entrust one of
them to.

“As I thought, the one who would put a stop to me was you, Illya...”

This child had grown since we last met. Now, she holds me
in her arms, smiling ever so gently.

“I’m Your Holiness’s greatest disciple, after all.”

Inside a large crater lies the altar of sealing.
Here, in the place where everything began and ended, the two of us have reunited.
But, in the way I least desired.

“Why did you save me...? I am no longer worthy of protecting the world... I would rather you put an end to me...”
“From this moment on, the world will need Your Holiness more than ever. So, please...save this world as you’ve done before.”

Are you saying that I am to continue committing even more sins...?

“Your sins won’t go away, but you can atone for them. That’s what you taught me, Your Holiness.”
“...Indeed, I did.”
“And besides...”

Illya’s hand then grasped mine, smiling with a tearful look in her eyes.

“I am Your Holiness’s greatest disciple, after all.”

Upon hearing those words, there was nothing else I could do except take her by the hand.

I destroyed the world using the Curses, and was saved from them...only to be afflicted with yet another curse.
A gentle curse called “Atonement.”

The wounds inflicted
on my back hurt.
All I had to do
was transport a bag—
a job that should’ve been easy.
Until I was surrounded
by 10 armed men, that is.

Somehow, I managed to fight
my way through them,
and deliver the bag
to its destination.
The recipient saw me covered
in wounds, but he didn’t even
utter a single “thank you.”
Instead, he berated me for not
making the delivery on time,
and used that as an excuse
to pocket half the reward.
I kept my mouth shut and
accepted the remaining half.


There’s a witch in the
backstreets who can take on
any job out there.
That rumor’s been floating
around since God knows when.
Although I owe it to that rumor
for having more jobs come
my way, it’s been nothing but
dangerous and dirty work.
Even the rewards I earn for
risking my life are just enough
to buy a few pieces of bread.
Still, I’m probably
one of the lucky ones.
After all, there’s always
someone out there starving
to death in the backstreets.
Today’s no exception.


On my way home, I caught the
eyes of a scrawny black cat.
Its golden glare floated
in the dark, fixated on the
bread I held in my arms.

“...Sorry, but I’m not giving you
any of this bread. These aren’t
just for me, you know.
If you insist on getting some,
I’m going to have to kill you.”

After we locked eyes
for a while, the black cat
jumped off into the darkness.
Down there, two scrawny
kittens were sleeping, only to
start crying once they noticed
their parent had come back.
Even though the kittens were
right in front of me, their cries
were so faint that even I had
trouble hearing them.

The black cat began
apologetically licking
its kittens’ faces.
Before long, I stopped hearing
their cries.

“...So, you were fighting
for your family too, huh.”

I can’t afford to feel sympathy.
There are friends who are
waiting for me to come home.
Without this bread, the ones
who’ll starve to death tomorrow
might be us.

“This is all I can give you.
It’s my portion.”

With the bread in my arms
one portion lighter,
my feet make their way
through the backstreets.
Far behind me, I hear the cries
of two happy kittens.

A home with a roof.
Meals served hot and fresh.
Friends I could cherish.
Everything I could’ve
ever wished for was here
in this world.
Things I should’ve gotten,
if I’d only walked towards
the “right” future...

I’ve already lost everything...
so what’s the point
in me knowing about
all of this now...?

“Well then, you should join us.
Be our friend.”

The “me” of this world speaks,
her hand reaching out to me.

“If you stay with the Duke,
you should be able to find
a new reason to live.
Just like I did.”
“...That’s so damn easy for you
to say, isn’t it.”

I brush her outstretched hand
away from me.

“You must’ve had one hell
of a happy life, huh!
Being protected by your
ever-so-gentle Duke and all...
You’ve never even had
a single taste of mud or blood,
so don’t even pretend
like you know me!”
“You’re right. I know nothing.
But, had you used your power
as a witch, you could’ve lived
in any way you so pleased.
And yet, in the end, you didn’t
end up like that man
we once called our father.
No matter the path we walk,
we’ll always be us.”
“......”
“If there’s a reason why you
came to this world, it’s that the
Duke and I are here. I have no
doubt that you’ll be able find
something precious to you,
just like I did when
he saved me.”

With her face looking more
serious than before,
she extends her hand to me
once again.

...She’s right, I guess.
I can tell right away just by the
look on her face when she
talks about this “Duke” of hers.
She’s telling me the truth.
Thinking of how weak I look
right now doesn’t sit well
with me though...

I think I get it now.
This is a miracle performed by
some god on a whim.
I’m sure the time I can
have here is limited.
Which means...

“Fine. I’ll believe everything
you’ve just said.”

Keeping my new wish hidden
deep inside my heart, I grab
hold of her outstretched hand.

“But, you and I are one in the
same, right? Then, I’m sure
I’ll end up liking the
same things you do.
When that time comes...
I’ll be taking the Duke
for myself, okay?”
“...WHAT?!”

After all, I’m sure that’s
the reason why I came
to this world.

In a room tucked away within the Duke of Fran’s mansion, Lise lifted her head as a gentle breeze brushed past her cheek.
The light of the sun filters in, along with the sound of leaves and flowers swaying
in the wind.
The chill air of the room gradually grew warm
from the sunlight.
Guided by the light coming in from the window, Lise turns
her gaze to the world outside.

Illya and Iris stood
absorbed in conversation.
Rosalie was instructing Soltina and a group of girls on how to properly wield their powers.
Natasha and Monica were planting a variety of flowers and herbs in the garden flowerbeds.
The girls gathered in the sunlit garden were enjoying peaceful moments together.
This was exactly what
one would call
a pleasant afternoon.
As Lise gazed out at the garden, a tiny bird landed on the windowsill.

“Why, hello there.”

The bird had been under Lise’s care until only a few days prior.
She had wanted to return it to its nest, but the bird was so weak, it needed to be nursed back to health first.
Her plan was to search for its nest before the young bird could learn to fly, but that hope of hers was dashed when the bird suddenly took flight
one day.
Rather than disappearing, though, the small bird often returned to Lise’s side to show its face just like this.
Upon crumbling a handful of bread and sprinkling it on the sill, the bird drew closer.
Seeing its energetic pecking at the crumbs, Lise let out a small sigh of relief.

However, regret still lingered in the secretary’s heart at being unable to reunite the bird
with its mother.
In the wild, the chances of a baby bird reuniting with its mother were slim.
It was very likely that the young bird would never meet its mother again.
Such things as birds leaving the nest or children separating from their parents were rules of the animal kingdom—
an inevitable, unavoidable
law of nature.
Even though she understood that in her mind, Lise couldn’t push down the burgeoning remorse in her heart.
She felt a chill run through
her at the thought.
It threatened to consume her, but—
In that moment, there was a flapping of wings announcing the arrival of a different bird
on the windowsill.
This bird was much larger,
and upon approaching the smaller bird, began to preen its tiny wings.
The action was just as though this new bird was its...

“Ah...”

Like a flower blossoming after a snowfall to mark the beginning of spring, Lise’s expression softened into a gentle smile.
That bird may very well be nothing but a new friend the baby bird had made,
not its mother.
But in that moment, the preening bird appeared the spitting image of a parent caring for its child.
Even if it were only a coincidence, or her own convenient interpretation,
Lise felt her heart grow warm.

“Yes. Surely, even I
will one day...”

Before the feeling could fade, she resolved to write a letter.
Even if it could not yet be sent, the day would surely come when the faithful secretary could hand it over herself.
Lise faced her desk and straightened her shoulders before reaching for her quill.
She already knew the words she would pen.

“To you, my dear lord...”

“Amazing... This is sooo amazing!”

Matilda and Illya arrive at a pasture outside the capital
of the Duchy of Fran.
The young queen’s eyes sparkle with glee as she gazes upon the vast green landscape unfolding before her.

“Do you like it here?”
“Oh, I sure do! Thank you so much for taking me here, Illya!”
“You’re very welcome,”
says Illya, stretching in delight as the pleasant breeze blows through her hair.
“There’s not a cloud in the sky. It’s the perfect day for a picnic, wouldn’t you say? I can’t wait to have the tea Lise made for us~!”
“Hey Illya. Is it okay if I go enjoy the greenery for a bit?!”
“That’s fine with me, but don’t go anywhere too far away.”
“You got it!!”

The moment Matilda answers, she takes off running towards the meadow. Her red cape flutters behind her as she sprints, cutting right through the wind.

“I’ll race you to that tree, Upa! The first one to touch it wins!”
“Upa! Upa-paaa!”
“Hold on, Matilda. If you go down the hill running that fast, you might get—”
“AAAAAH!!”
“—hurt...”

Illya’s warning proves to
be in vain, as Matilda’s wild, hysterical scream echoes throughout the pasture.

“Oooow...!”
“Hah... That’s what happens when you get a little too
carried away...!”

Illya comes rushing over to Matilda, offering a hand
to help her up.
However, Matilda makes no effort to take it.

“What’s wrong?
Are you in any pain?”

As Matilda lies flat on the ground, she shakes her head
in reply.

“Whenever I’d fall down like that, my personal guard Hilda was always the first one to come over, asking, ‘Are you okay, Princess?’ But now, falling down won’t bring Hilda to me, no matter how long I wait...”
“Matilda...”
“I’ve been so lonely
thinking about that...”
“Even now?”
“Yeah, but just a little.
...You did came over to help me after all, Illya.”

Matilda raises her head,
then takes hold of Illya’s outstretched hand. Making sure not to let go of Matilda’s little hand, Illya firmly grips it,
gently helping the girl back to her feet.

“I just can’t keep whining and think only about myself though. There’s also Hilda. With her as overprotective as she is, I’m sure she’s worried sick about where I’ve gone off to... And besides, I’m the Queen of Jobari after all. I need to set an example for my people.”
“Then for now, I—we will keep helping you get back on your feet. Until you finally go back to your world, you can always count on us.”
“...Yeah! Thank you, Illya!”

Carried by the breeze, a floral
scent wafts into the room.
Ahh, so this season is upon us
once more, is it...?

Just once every year, the entire
Duchy becomes filled with the
fragrant scent of flowers.
That time is the season of
the flower festival.

From outside the window,
I could see Natasha and
Freesia walking alongside
one another.
Both look ecstatic as they
hold their favorite flowers
in their hands.

In the courtyard,
Monica idly strolls along,
flowerpots filled with
flowers just about to
bloom straddled between
both of her tiny arms.
Chiffon trails closely behind,
following after Monica like
a faithful puppy being led
by its master.

This is the flower festival
my master founded here
long, long ago.
It was only a small local affair
at first, but has since spread
across the Duchy, now being
celebrated all across the land.

Master, the dream you spoke of
so long ago, is now right here
before my eyes...

The nation was awash with the
vibrant colors of flowers and
the smiling faces of the people.
It was a pleasing sight to
behold indeed.
However, it still lacked
one color in particular.

Good grief.
I suppose this is my cue...

“I thought you might be here.”

Just as I’d expected, when
I entered the Duke’s room,
he was sitting before
a towering stack of ancient
magic tomes, a haggard
expression deeply
chiseled into his features.
He’d most likely been
researching “doors” into
other worlds.

“I understand time is of
the essence. However...
This flower festival is
a tradition my master
began long ago.
Being his successor as the
Duke of Fran, can’t you spare
a moment to join in and
liven up the festivities?
This is also part of your
duties as Duke, you know.”

If I didn’t go out of my way to
lecture him like this, I’m sure
he would just stay cooped up
in his room the entire time.
Jeez, it wouldn’t hurt him to
rely on the people around him
a little more.
If he only asked,
everyone would gladly jump
at the chance to assist him.
But I’m already well aware
it simply isn’t in him to do
such a thing.

Holding everything in by
yourself, only to give everything
you have to help others...
You truly do resemble him far
too much for your own good...

“The festival can’t start
without its own Duke of Fran.
Come now,
everyone is waiting.”

Grabbing hold of his
wavering hand, I pull him
out of his room.
As I opened the door,
a shower of flower petals
rained down through the air
as though in celebration.
Just as our eyes were
mesmerized by the sight...

“Oh, my lord...”
“Master!”
“My lord!”
“It’s Master, it is!”

As soon as we exited
the Duke’s mansion,
Natasha and the others
circled around him.

“My lord, please look.
Freesia made a bouquet
out of the flowers I raised...
It turned out so lovely.”
“Hehe, it only turned out
so well because of how
wonderfully you grew
them, Natasha.
My lord, there are many
more flowers blooming
farther in. Why don’t you
come see them with us?”

Smiles truly do blossom on
the faces of those around you.
Just like they did for him...

In that moment,
as everyone pulled the Duke
further into the courtyard,
he turned back towards me.

“Come with us, Rosalie.”

It felt like that was what
his kind gaze towards me
was saying.

Give me a break.
Even that part of you
is exactly the same.

“Miss Rosalie...?”
“Don’t rush me so much,
Monica. My word, can’t you all
be a little more respectful
of your elders?”

Smiles bloom as flowers
blossom—that is the heart
of the flower festival.
At the center of the
festivities stands the one
who makes everyone smile,
the Duke of Fran.

“Your flowers have grown
beautifully again this year,
Master.”

Even now, when I look
at flowers, I remember him.
As gentle as a flower,
he bathed me in light
as warm as the sun’s.
The flowers remind me of him,
the one whose light
has long since faded.

After noon, the number of
visitors to the flower festival
steadily grew.
The once tiny festival that
my master had begun was
now a nationwide celebration
bringing in people from
all over the world.
My master’s dream of making
people across the world smile
had come true, exactly as
he had wished.

Making your dream come true
was my dream, and now,
many people have taken over
your dream for me.
As long as this Duchy exists,
smiles will continue to blossom
on people’s faces forevermore.
Even long after
I’m no longer here...

In exchange for
what I hold most dear,
I can enact a miracle
and grant a single wish
of my choosing.
That was the power
bestowed upon me after
becoming an apostle.

I want to see
my master once more.
There is nothing
more precious to me
than that wish.

If it will allow me to see you
once more...and if I can get to
hear how that gentle dream of
yours continues...I will sacrifice
whatever I must.
Even if it means losing
everything besides
my heart’s greatest desire.
This Duchy no longer
needs me, after all.

“Granny Rosalie,
we’re in trouble!”

“...Soltina?
What’s gotten your feathers
in such a twist, hm?”

“When we tried to get
the flowers to bloom for
the festival using magic,
they all suddenly withered up!”
“I-I-I’m sorry... It’s my fault
the temperature dropped...”

“That’s because flowers
are delicate, girls.
Even the smallest change
can lead them to fully bloom
or wilt completely.”

“Ugh... What should we do,
Granny...?”
“U-Um... If you’re going to yell
at someone, let it be me...!”

“There’s no need to get
all worked up.
Just who do you take me for?
Making my master’s beloved
flowers bloom is nothing.
But since you’ve handed me
the opportunity, why don’t
you call all the others over
as well?
Today is our one
flower festival of the year.
I’ll show you all the true power
of the Great Sorceress,
posthaste.”

Master...
The day we can be reunited
seems like it will have to wait
just a little while longer.
It appears there are still
those here who need me...

“Ready~!”

After me and Cerberus shouted that word together, we hid in some bushes beside the lake.

“Listen up, Nina.
Until Sabrina passes us by,
we gotta stay quiet. We gotta!”
“Okay!”

Suddenly, we heard the sound of footsteps getting closer.
It’s Miss Sabrina!
But, her footsteps passed
right behind us...

“Now then, it looks like
the first order of business
is securing you...Moddey.”
“Nooo~! How didya know
I was here?”
“You hid your head, but your
tail was out in the open.
It was sticking out from
behind that tree.”
“Ugggh!”

Right after that, the two of them went off somewhere else.

“Thank goodness, Nina~!
We didn’t get caught.”
“Yup! Everything worked out perfectly, huh, Cerberus!”

Suddenly, something jumped out of the lake.

SPLASH!

“Whoa!”
“Nnnrrrgh...”

Water hit us right on our faces.

“Huh? Was that a fish?”

When we looked into the water, we saw lots of fish!

“There’s so many of ’em,
aren’t there, Nina?”
“Yup. This has gotta be
the fishes’ home, huh?”

There were even fish inside
the underwater plants.
They looked a bit like
me and Cerberus playing
hide-and-seek.

“The fish here kinda look like
you and me, Nina.
And the one nearby watching
over them’s Big Sis.”
“This teeny-weeny fish here is Monica, and the one swimming with her is Miss Iris.
Then there’s...”
“That hungry muncher, right? It’s Illya for sure. And that small fish is chasing after others, so that’s gotta be...”
“Chiffon!”

When me and Cerberus spoke at the same time, our voices surprised another fish, and our faces got splashed on again.

“Hehehe~!
You’re in for it now~!”
“Let’s show these troublemakers who’s boss, Cerberus!”

The two of us then jumped
into the water to try
and catch some fish.

“Take this, Cerberus!”
“You can’t beat me, Nina~!”

After we forgot about the fish, and started having fun playing water war with each other,
Miss Sabrina and Moddey
came over to us. But...

Hm? Why does Miss Sabrina have that weird smile
on her face?

Then, Moddey spoke to us with an irritated look in her eyes.

“Hey! Weren’t we supposed to be playing hide-and-seek?”
“Ah...”

As I hold onto my hat to prevent it from being blown away,
I surrender myself to the refreshing breeze.

“Ah, such a pleasant wind.”
“Nothing pleases me more
than to see you reinvigorated, Queen Amleth.”
“You always act too seriously, Ophelia. You should also relax from time to time.”
“Well, I am your royal guard, after all. The sword
at your command.”

Upon hearing Ophelia’s response, filled with the same seriousness that has gone unchanged since childhood,
I could not help
but let out a smile.
Besides, although everything turned out fine in the end,
I was just assailed by illusions.
As such, perhaps it is understandable for Ophelia
to be more on her guard
than usual.
Since this is a rare vacation
we are having,
I do feel a hint of loneliness
lingering inside, though...

Nevertheless, this is a place of peace and beauty.
The scenery is not all
that I am talking about.

From up here, I have
a clear view of the children
as they play.
Watching them play hide-and-seek, splash around in the water, and innocently
run about warms my heart.
This is what a country
should look like.
A country should be teeming with children who will shape the future, growing up to be strong and healthy.
That is precisely
the country I must restore.

I am making progress
with the restoration of Vyde,
but how much more time
will it take to bring back
the kind of sight
I see before me now?

“There is no need to hurry, Queen Amleth.
With you leading the way,
I have no doubt that
success is inevitable.”
“...You are right, Ophelia.”

Patience is the key.
For even on slopes where
those stumble that run fast,
the wise and slow shall be
without incident.

“Ophelia.”

I am truly grateful
to experience this
beautiful sight with you.
What we see is indeed the future we must strive for.

“I have something important
to tell you. Would you listen
to what I have to say?”

Memo: 周年パネルミッション
Text:
“Mom! Dad!
Look, I made a flower crown!”
“Wow, that’s amazing!
You’re so talented, Natasha!”
“Thank you, Dad. Hehehe...”
“You really do love flowers,
don’t you, Natasha.”
“Yup! The flowers Dad grew
are so pretty.
That’s why I love them!”
“Hahaha! Hearing that
from you makes me happy.”
“I’ll give the flower crown
to you, Dad.
When I grow up,
I’m gonna be your bride!”
“Oh my, so you’re going to
leave your poor mom here
without a flower crown?”
“Huh?! Um... Nrgh... Okay then,
I’ll be your bride too, Mom!”
“You can only be the bride of
one person, though, Natasha.”
“Whaaat?!
So, I can’t be with Mom...?
Uuuuu, I don’t like that.
I wanna be with both of you
forever...”
“There, there,
don’t cry Natasha.
Hehe, you’ve always been
our little crier, haven’t you?”
“B-But...”
“I’m sorry
for teasing you, Natasha.
Don’t you worry—
we’ll always be together.”
“...Really?”
“Of course.
Mom loves you so much,
after all.”
“Dad loves you too, Natasha.”
“I love you guys too!
I’m gonna go make
one more flower crown, okay?”
“The pie’s almost ready,
so make sure you come back
before it gets too late.”
“Yay! I love your pies, Mom!
I’ll be back soon!”

“...Natasha sure has grown up
to be such a sweet,
innocent girl,
hasn’t she, Dear?”
“I think she takes after you,
Darling.”
“What are you talking about?
I’m sure you’re the one
she takes after.”
“Hehe. Then, I’m sure
she takes after the both of us.”
“I wonder what kind
of young lady
she’ll grow up to be.”
“We’ll find out soon enough,
Darling. Children grow up
so fast, you know.”
“Just thinking about that
makes me sad...”
“That’s why we should take
the precious time we have now
to love her as much as we can.”
“...You’re right, Dear.
It’s our job as parents
to wish our child happiness...
That’s why...”
“Oh my, why are you crying
all of a sudden?”
“Just imagining the day
she gets married...
All the happiness and sadness
just make the tears come out...
GAAAH! Please, Natasha!
Never stop saying
that you love Dad!!”
“Hehehe.Looks like Natasha
really does take after you,
Darling.”

Memo: 周年パネルミッション
Text:
Dear Mom and Dad,

Stretching over that hill
is the field of flowers
you guys left behind.
We used to have lots
of picnics there, didn’t we?

Mom, you always baked
pies for us.
They were so delicious,
so I never stopped
looking forward to having them.

I remember wanting to be
just like you,
copying everything you did,
and even baking so many pies.
I failed a lot, though,
and you guys laughed at me.
But now, I’ve gotten
pretty good at baking pies.
Just the other day,
my lord even complimented me
on how delicious they were.

I still can’t bake pies
as deliciously as
you can, Mom...
But, I want you to try tasting
one of my pies again,
so I’ll bring one
the next time I visit.


Dad, you always smiled
at Mom and me
while we baked.
You’d just stay there
watching us without even
lifting a finger,
so Mom often got mad,
telling you to help out
once in a while...

You taught me so much about
the kind of flower
blossoming on this hill, Dad.
Like, what its name is,
and even how to grow it.
That same flower was the one
I found blossoming in the
mansion’s garden, wasn’t it?
Speaking of the garden,
I can now help with tending
the flowers there,
and it’s all thanks to
everything you taught me.
I’ve even made
some friends there, too,
and I owe it all to you.


Every day I spent with you guys
was so much fun.
Even now, I still get anxious
and cry easily.
Till this day, each time
I remember your smiling faces,
I can’t ever stop myself
from crying.
But, with all the
lovely memories you left me,
I can bake delicious pies,
and grow lots of pretty flowers.

I’m still a bit lonely
not being able to
see you guys...
But, my heart’s already full
from all the gifts
that you’ve given me.
That’s why, I’m okay now.

Mom. Dad.
Thank you for all the memories.

Thank you...for loving me.

Love,
Natasha

“Long, long before
you were born, Illya,
witches weren’t known
as witches—
they were called,
‘Messengers of God’.”
“Why?”
“That’s because
a witch’s power
was thought to be
a gift from God.
Though, the truth is,
everyone is born with power
inside them.
The only real difference
is how much of that power
a person can draw out—”
“But, Miss Eirene,
everybody says witches
are bad.”
“They do, don’t they.
At some point,
everyone just started
viewing witches that way.”

The passage of time
changes everything.
There may very well
come an age when
these witches will be revered
by the people once more.
Or, perhaps this girl
will build such an age herself—
this “child of God,”
born with the kind of power
only God Himself
could have planted there.

“Do I have
witch powers too, Miss Eirene?”
“Of course you do.
Power lies in the soul.
Your soul is where you can
draw your power from.”
“What’s a ‘soul’?”
“A soul is a warm light
that shines inside you.”

Upon telling her this,
Illya looked down at her heart,
tilting her head in confusion.

I guess the concept
is still a bit beyond your grasp.
But, someday,
you’ll be forced to confront
the destiny that very light
brings forth.
Standing before
a light too strong
for one human alone to bear,
you may become paralyzed
with fear,
and wish to run to the safety
of the dark.

There’s no shame in running.
If that’s the choice
you decide to make,
I’ll support you
just the same.

But, if I can,
I want to see your shine.
More beautiful than
the cascading light of angels,
and deeper than the darkness
cast by demons—
I want to see
the shine of your human soul.

That’s just how great
the power lying within you
is, Illya.

“Your lesson is hard today,
Miss Eirene...”
“Hehe, I’m sorry.
It’s about time
we took a break, isn’t it?”

It’s beyond my ability
to grant you that light.
All I can teach you
is how to find it
within yourself.

But, if you do find it,
I’m sure your resolve
will become stronger
than anyone else’s...

Young Master,
despite how nice you look,
you sure don’t hesitate
to get down to business, huh?

Dispelling all the
world’s Curses,
saving the girls called
the Witches of Qlipha,
liberating every country
you travel to...
Not only that—
you’ve even started
opening “doors”
to new worlds so you can
climb down the
Tree of Life’s roots.
Beyond those roots
lies the world of demons.
To go that far is...

Hm? What’s with that
look on your face?
You’re just a bit taken aback

who’d lost sight

But, that impression
began to change
the longer we talked.

She appeared cold
at first glance,
but was really
just a normal girl
beneath the surface.
I learned that
the closer you get to her,
the more she mouths off.
And that she’s
unexpectedly defenseless
against people who
keep pushing their way
into her bubble...

Each time we talked,
I saw more of the girl
she was before
she became
an immortal witch.
I’m sure Fia
only ever found
those conversations
to be a bother,
and probably doesn’t even
remember them anymore.
I didn’t dislike
those moments
between us, though.

But now,
I can no longer
be seen by her,
or even touch her.
I can never talk
to her again.
But, that’s alright.
Because I—

Drip.

A drop of rain
falls from a leaf above,
and slips right through me.
It wets Fia’s cheek,
making her look up
at the sky—
up at me.

“Hey...you aren’t up there,
are you...?”

The heart
I shouldn’t have
began to race.
Don’t tell me...
she can really...

Just one word
would be enough.
I want that curt,
but warm,
voice to call my name.
Just that alone
would make me—

“Fia, I—!”

She then
turned around once more
and stared out blankly
at the still falling rain,
as though nothing
had happened...

Of course she did...
My voice
can’t reach her.
I don’t deserve it to...

“...You should hurry up
and forget about
someone like me.
That’s what’s best
for you, Fia...”

Those words
hung in the air,
unable to reach her,
as I continued to
wait out the rain
by her side...

・This Invocation’s content may be changed without prior notice.
・Pull rates vary depending on the character.
・Each displayed pull rate is rounded to the 4th decimal place, so the combined value may not equal 100%.
・There will be a lottery based on the pull rates of each consecutive pull, so it is not guaranteed that a character with a 2% pull rate will appear 1 time out of 50 pulls.

・You can use Diamonds or Tickets of Guidance to Invoke.
・Characters and items will appear.
・Only the character you set will be the character who appears.
・If the set character does not appear after 56 consecutive pulls, the pull rate of each pull from the 57th pull onward will rise until the character appears, with the 70th pull’s pull rate being 100%.
・Your pull count for the guaranteed appearance is currently【{0}/70】.
・If the set character is changed, the pull count for the guaranteed appearance will not reset, but will carry over within each Soul group. Additionally, even if the duration of the set character has expired, the pull count will carry over to the next Invocation of The Stars’ Guidance.
・There are 2 Soul groups: [Azure, Crimson, Emerald, Amber] and [Radiance, Chaos].
・You can obtain 1 Chest of Chance as a bonus reward with each pull.
*The bonus reward will be sent directly to your Item Box.
*If your Item Box is full, the bonus reward will be sent to your Presents Box.
